entry.summary: Presents LPM 1.0, a Large Performance Model for video-based character performance including speaking, listening, reacting, and emoting in full-duplex audio-visual conversation, addressing the expressiveness/speed/stability trilemma.

entry.title: Lighting-grounded Video Generation with Renderer-based Agent Reasoning

author.name: Ziqi Cai, Taoyu Yang, Zheng Chang, Si Li, Han Jiang, Shuchen Weng, Boxin Shi

entry.summary: Presents LiVER, a diffusion-based framework for scene-controllable video generation that conditions on explicit 3D properties (layout, lighting, camera) using renderer-based agent reasoning and a new large-scale annotated dataset.

entry.title: Uni-ViGU: Towards Unified Video Generation and Understanding via A Diffusion-Based Video Generator

author.name: Luozheng Qin, Jia Gong, Qian Qiao, Tianjiao Li, Li Xu, Haoyu Pan, Chao Qu, Zhiyu Tan, Hao Li

entry.summary: Proposes Uni-ViGU, a unified framework for video generation and understanding that extends a video generator (rather than an MLLM) as the foundation, using unified flow matching for video and text.

entry.title: MedVR: Annotation-Free Medical Visual Reasoning via Agentic Reinforcement Learning

author.name: Zheng Jiang, Heng Guo, Chengyu Fang, Changchen Xiao, Xinyang Hu, Lifeng Sun, Minfeng Xu

entry.summary: Introduces MedVR, an RL framework for annotation-free visual reasoning in medical VLMs, using entropy-guided visual regrounding and consensus-based credit assignment to reduce visual hallucination without requiring manual annotations.

entry.title: Lost in the Hype: Revealing and Dissecting the Performance Degradation of Medical Multimodal Large Language Models in Image Classification

author.name: Xun Zhu, Fanbin Mo, Xi Chen, Kaili Zheng, Shaoshuai Yang, Yiming Shi, Jian Gao, Miao Li, Ji Wu

entry.summary: Reveals that medical MLLMs consistently underperform traditional deep learning models on image classification despite massive pretraining advantages, systematically analyzing 14 open-source medical MLLMs to identify where degradation originates.

entry.title: Novel View Synthesis as Video Completion

author.name: Qi Wu, Khiem Vuong, Minsik Jeon, Srinivasa Narasimhan, Deva Ramanan

entry.summary: Formulates sparse novel view synthesis as a video completion task, leveraging the implicit multi-view knowledge in video diffusion models. Key insight: video models contain multi-view knowledge and should be order-invariant for sparse inputs.

entry.title: Visually-grounded Humanoid Agents

author.name: Hang Ye, Xiaoxuan Ma, Fan Lu, Wayne Wu, Kwan-Yee Lin, Yizhou Wang

entry.summary: Introduces Visually-grounded Humanoid Agents, a two-layer world-agent paradigm where digital humans perceive, reason, and behave using only visual observations in novel 3D environments, enabling scalable population of virtual worlds.

entry.title: Act Wisely: Cultivating Meta-Cognitive Tool Use in Agentic Multimodal Models

author.name: Shilin Yan, Jintao Tong, Hongwei Xue, Xiaojun Tang, Yangyang Wang, Kunyu Shi, Guannan Zhang, Ruixuan Li, Yixiong Zou

entry.summary: Proposes a meta-cognitive approach for agentic multimodal models that teaches them when to use external tools vs. internal knowledge, using decoupled reward optimization to avoid blind tool invocation.

entry.title: The Weaponization of Computer Vision: Tracing Military-Surveillance Ties through Conference Sponsorship

author.name: Noa Garcia, Amelia Katirai

entry.summary: Studies the weaponization of computer vision by analyzing military-surveillance company sponsorship at major CV conferences, revealing systematic ties between the field and military/surveillance applications.

entry.title: SIM1: Physics-Aligned Simulator as Zero-Shot Data Scaler in Deformable Worlds

author.name: Yunsong Zhou, Hangxu Liu, Xuekun Jiang, Xing Shen, Yuanzhen Zhou, Hui Wang, Baole Fang, Yang Tian, Mulin Yu, Qiaojun Yu, Li Ma, Hengjie Li, Hanqing Wang, Jia Zeng, Jiangmiao Pang

entry.summary: Introduces SIM1, a physics-aligned simulation engine for deformable object manipulation that grounds simulation in real-world physics, enabling zero-shot sim-to-real transfer for cloth manipulation.

entry.title: Selective Neuron Amplification for Training-Free Task Enhancement

author.name: Ryyan Akhtar

entry.summary: Explores Selective Neuron Amplification (SNA), a training-free method that increases task-relevant neuron influence at inference time without parameter changes. Finds it helps mainly when the model is uncertain, suggesting some failures are due to weak activation rather than missing capability.

entry.title: SAT: Balancing Reasoning Accuracy and Efficiency with Stepwise Adaptive Thinking

author.name: Weiyang Huang, Xuefeng Bai, Kehai Chen, Xinyang Chen, Yibin Chen, Weili Guan, Min Zhang

entry.summary: Introduces SAT (Stepwise Adaptive Thinking), framing LLM reasoning as a finite-state machine with thinking modes (Slow/Normal/Fast/Skip). Uses a lightweight process reward model for step-level difficulty-aware pruning of reasoning chains.

entry.title: LINE: LLM-based Iterative Neuron Explanations for Vision Models

author.name: Vladimir Zaigrajew, Micha{\l} Piechota, Gaspar Sekula, Przemys{\l}aw Biecek

entry.summary: Introduces LINE, a training-free iterative approach for open-vocabulary neuron labeling in vision models, using an LLM and text-to-image generator in a closed-loop to discover concepts encoded by individual neurons.

entry.title: LAMP: Lift Image-Editing as General 3D Priors for Open-world Manipulation

author.name: Jingjing Wang, Zhengdong Hong, Chong Bao, Yuke Zhu, Junhan Sun, Guofeng Zhang

entry.summary: Proposes LAMP, which lifts 2D image-editing priors into 3D for open-world robotic manipulation, using image editing models to provide fine-grained spatial reasoning that LLMs/VLMs lack.

entry.title: Weakly Supervised Distillation of Hallucination Signals into Transformer Representations

author.name: Shoaib Sadiq Salehmohamed, Jinal Prashant Thakkar, Hansika Aredla, Shaik Mohammed Omar, Shalmali Ayachit

entry.summary: Proposes a weak supervision framework to distill hallucination detection signals into a model's internal representations, combining substring matching, embedding similarity, and LLM-as-judge labels. Trains probes on transformer activations to detect hallucinations without external verification at inference time.

entry.title: Benchmarking LLM Tool-Use in the Wild

author.name: Peijie Yu, Wei Liu, Yifan Yang, Jinjian Li, Zelong Zhang, Xiao Feng, Feng Zhang

entry.summary: Introduces WildToolBench, a benchmark for LLM tool-use grounded in real user interactions, capturing compositional tasks, implicit intent, and instruction transitions that existing benchmarks overlook.

entry.title: The End of the Foundation Model Era: Open-Weight Models, Sovereign AI, and Inference as Infrastructure

author.name: Jared James Grogan

entry.summary: Argues the foundation model era (2020-2025) is ending, with open-weight models reaching frontier performance, inference costs approaching zero, and the industry restructuring across economic, technical, geopolitical, and institutional axes.

entry.title: SALLIE: Safeguarding Against Latent Language & Image Exploits

author.name: Guy Azov, Ofer Rivlin, Guy Shtar

entry.summary: Introduces SALLIE, a lightweight runtime detection framework for defending against both textual and visual jailbreaks/prompt injections, using mechanistic interpretability to detect attacks without degrading model performance.

entry.title: DosimeTron: Automating Personalized Monte Carlo Radiation Dosimetry in PET/CT with Agentic AI

author.name: Eleftherios Tzanis, Michail E. Klontzas, Antonios Tzortzakakis

entry.summary: Presents DosimeTron, an agentic AI system using GPT-5.2 for automated patient-specific Monte Carlo radiation dosimetry in PET/CT. Uses 23 tools across four MCP servers for end-to-end automation.

entry.title: In-Context Learning in Speech Language Models: Analyzing the Role of Acoustic Features, Linguistic Structure, and Induction Heads

author.name: Charlotte Pouw, Hosein Mohebbi, Afra Alishahi, Willem Zuidema

entry.summary: Investigates how linguistic and acoustic features affect in-context learning in Speech Language Models, finding that speaking rate strongly affects ICL performance while pitch range and intensity have little impact.

entry.title: Beyond Functional Correctness: Design Issues in AI IDE-Generated Large-Scale Projects

author.name: Syed Mohammad Kashif, Ruiyin Li, Peng Liang, Amjed Tahir, Qiong Feng, Zengyang Li, Mojtaba Shahin

entry.summary: Studies design quality of large-scale projects generated by Cursor AI IDE, proposing a Feature-Driven Human-In-The-Loop framework. Evaluates design issues in AI-generated codebases.

entry.title: Inference-Time Code Selection via Symbolic Equivalence Partitioning

author.name: David Cho, Yifan Wang, Fanping Sui, Ananth Grama

entry.summary: Proposes Symbolic Equivalence Partitioning for inference-time code selection, using symbolic execution to group candidate programs by semantic behavior and selecting from the dominant partition. Improves over best-of-N baselines at N=10.

entry.title: Evaluating LLM-Based 0-to-1 Software Generation in End-to-End CLI Tool Scenarios

author.name: Ruida Hu, Xinchen Wang, Chao Peng, Cuiyun Gao, David Lo

entry.summary: Introduces CLI-Tool-Bench, a benchmark for evaluating LLMs' ability to generate complete CLI tools from scratch (0-to-1 generation), using black-box differential testing rather than unit tests. Addresses gaps in evaluating full repository generation.

entry.title: Do We Need Distinct Representations for Every Speech Token? Unveiling and Exploiting Redundancy in Large Speech Language Models

author.name: Bajian Xiang, Tingwei Guo, Xuan Chen, Yang Han

entry.summary: Reveals structured redundancy in Large Speech Language Models: shallow layers encode essential acoustics while deep layers are extremely redundant. Proposes Affinity Pooling, a training-free token merging mechanism that achieves significant compression.

entry.title: FP4 Explore, BF16 Train: Diffusion Reinforcement Learning via Efficient Rollout Scaling

author.name: Yitong Li, Junsong Chen, Shuchen Xue, Pengcuo Zeren, Siyuan Fu, Dinghao Yang, Yangyang Tang, Junjie Bai, Ping Luo, Song Han, Enze Xie

entry.summary: Proposes Sol-RL for integrating FP4 quantization into diffusion RL rollouts, enabling efficient scaling of reinforcement learning-based alignment for large text-to-image diffusion models like FLUX.1-12B.

entry.title: Stochastic Gradient Descent in the Saddle-to-Saddle Regime of Deep Linear Networks

author.name: Guillaume Corlouer, Avi Semler, Alexander Strang, Alexander Gietelink Oldenziel

entry.summary: Analyzes SGD dynamics in deep linear networks during the saddle-to-saddle regime, modeling training as stochastic Langevin dynamics with anisotropic noise. Derives exact decomposition showing maximal diffusion along a mode precedes the corresponding gradient descent escape, providing theoretical understanding of how SGD noise interacts with saddle points.

entry.title: When Does Context Help? A Systematic Study of Target-Conditional Molecular Property Prediction

author.name: Bryan Cheng, Jasper Zhang

entry.summary: First systematic study of when target context helps molecular property prediction, evaluating across 10 protein families, 4 fusion architectures, and varying data regimes. Key finding: FiLM-based fusion architecture dominates, outperforming concatenation by 24.2pp, and context enables otherwise impossible predictions in data-scarce settings.

entry.title: Bi-level Heterogeneous Learning for Time Series Foundation Models: A Federated Learning Approach

author.name: Shengchao Chen, Guodong Long, Dikai Liu, Jing Jiang

entry.summary: Proposes federated learning approach for training time series foundation models that handles bi-level heterogeneity (inter-domain and intra-domain). Uses domain-invariant distillation to reduce cross-domain interference while preserving shared temporal knowledge.

entry.title: MENO: MeanFlow-Enhanced Neural Operators for Dynamical Systems

author.name: Tianyue Yang, Xiao Xue

entry.summary: Introduces MENO, combining MeanFlow with neural operators to recover high-frequency details lost by Fourier-based neural operators. Achieves accurate multi-scale prediction of dynamical systems with one-step inference, avoiding the overhead of diffusion-based enhancement.

entry.title: Epistemic Robust Offline Reinforcement Learning

author.name: Abhilash Reddy Chenreddy, Erick Delage

entry.summary: Proposes an epistemic-robust offline RL framework that replaces discrete Q-value ensembles with compact uncertainty sets, addressing limitations of ensemble-based methods that require large ensembles and conflate epistemic with aleatoric uncertainty.

entry.title: Telescope: Learnable Hyperbolic Foveation for Ultra-Long-Range Object Detection

author.name: Parker Ewen, Dmitriy Rivkin, Mario Bijelic, Felix Heide

entry.summary: Introduces Telescope, a two-stage detection model for ultra-long range (500m+) autonomous driving, using learnable hyperbolic foveation to handle objects occupying only a few pixels. Addresses highway driving safety requirements for heavy trucks.

entry.title: FedDetox: Robust Federated SLM Alignment via On-Device Data Sanitization

author.name: Shunan Zhu, Jiawei Chen, Yonghao Yu, Hideya Ochiai

entry.summary: FedDetox addresses unintended data poisoning in federated learning for small language models by using knowledge distillation from safety-aligned teacher models to create lightweight safety classifiers for on-device data sanitization.

entry.title: SepSeq: A Training-Free Framework for Long Numerical Sequence Processing in LLMs

author.name: Jie Sun, Yu Liu, Lu Han, Qiwen Deng, Xiang Shu, Yang Xiao, Xingyu Lu, Jun Zhou, Pengfei Liu, Lintao Ma, Jiancan Wu, Xiang Wang

entry.summary: SepSeq is a training-free framework that inserts separator tokens into long numerical sequences to mitigate attention dispersion in LLMs, demonstrating that separators act as attention sinks that recalibrate focus on local segments.

entry.title: Beyond Social Pressure: Benchmarking Epistemic Attack in Large Language Models

author.name: Steven Au, Sujit Noronha

entry.summary: PPT-Bench benchmarks epistemic attack on LLMs—where prompts challenge knowledge legitimacy, values, or identity rather than simply opposing answers—organized around a Philosophical Pressure Taxonomy with four attack types at three intensity levels.

entry.title: MemReader: From Passive to Active Extraction for Long-Term Agent Memory

author.name: Jingyi Kang, Chunyu Li, Ding Chen, Bo Tang, Feiyu Xiong, Zhiyu Li

entry.summary: MemReader introduces active long-term memory extraction for agent systems: MemReader-0.6B for passive extraction and MemReader-4B optimized with GRPO for active writing decisions, addressing memory pollution and low-value writes.

entry.title: Kathleen: Oscillator-Based Byte-Level Text Classification Without Tokenization or Attention

author.name: George Fountzoulas

entry.summary: Kathleen is a 733K-parameter text classifier operating on raw UTF-8 bytes using oscillator-based frequency-domain processing with no tokenizer or attention mechanism, introducing RecurrentOscillatorBanks and FFT-Rotate encoding.

entry.title: SeLaR: Selective Latent Reasoning in Large Language Models

author.name: Renyu Fu, Guibo Luo

entry.summary: Proposes SeLaR (Selective Latent Reasoning), a training-free method that selectively applies latent reasoning only at uncertain steps, using entropy-triggered transitions and a temperature-scaled mixture mechanism. Addresses soft embedding collapse in latent reasoning approaches.

entry.title: SubSearch: Intermediate Rewards for Unsupervised Guided Reasoning in Complex Retrieval

author.name: Roxana Petcu, Evangelos Kanoulas, Maarten de Rijke

entry.summary: Introduces SubSearch, a framework using intermediate reward signals instead of outcome-only supervision to guide multi-step reasoning in complex retrieval tasks. Differs from process reward modeling by not requiring annotated trajectories.

entry.title: ConsistRM: Improving Generative Reward Models via Consistency-Aware Self-Training

author.name: Yu Liang, Liangxin Liu, Longzheng Wang, Yan Wang, Yueyang Zhang, Long Xia, Zhiyuan Sun, Daiting Shi

entry.summary: Proposes ConsistRM, a self-training framework for generative reward models that eliminates need for human annotations by using temporal consistency-aware pseudo-labels. Addresses instability and reward hacking in GRM self-training.

entry.title: ACIArena: Toward Unified Evaluation for Agent Cascading Injection

author.name: Hengyu An, Minxi Li, Jinghuai Zhang, Naen Xu, Chunyi Zhou, Changjiang Li, Xiaogang Xu, Tianyu Du, Shouling Ji

entry.summary: Introduces ACIArena, a framework for evaluating robustness of multi-agent systems against Agent Cascading Injection attacks. Covers multiple attack surfaces and objectives with systematic evaluation suites.

entry.title: Alloc-MoE: Budget-Aware Expert Activation Allocation for Efficient Mixture-of-Experts Inference

author.name: Baihui Liu, Kaiyuan Tian, Wei Wang, Zhaoning Zhang, Linbo Qiao, Dongsheng Li

entry.summary: Introduces Alloc-MoE, which optimizes expert activation budget allocation at both layer and token levels for efficient MoE inference. Treats activation budget as a constraint and minimizes performance degradation under it.

entry.title: PIArena: A Platform for Prompt Injection Evaluation

author.name: Runpeng Geng, Chenlong Yin, Yanting Wang, Ying Chen, Jinyuan Jia

entry.summary: Introduces PIArena, a unified platform for prompt injection evaluation that enables systematic comparison of attacks and defenses across tasks and benchmarks. Addresses fragmentation in prompt injection research.

entry.title: Personalizing Text-to-Image Generation to Individual Taste

author.name: Anne-Sofie Maerten, Juliane Verwiebe, Shyamgopal Karthik, Ameya Prabhu, Johan Wagemans, Matthias Bethge

entry.summary: Introduces PAMELA, a dataset of 70K ratings across 5K AI-generated images rated by 15 users each, plus a personalized reward model for text-to-image generation. Addresses the gap between average-appeal optimization and individual aesthetic preferences.

entry.title: Beyond Surface Artifacts: Capturing Shared Latent Forgery Knowledge Across Modalities

author.name: Jingtong Dou, Chuancheng Shi, Jian Wang, Fei Shen, Zhiyong Wang, Tat-Seng Chua

entry.summary: Proposes a modality-agnostic forgery detection framework that shifts from feature fusion to modality generalization, aiming to detect deepfakes across unseen modalities by capturing shared latent forgery knowledge.

entry.title: ReconPhys: Reconstruct Appearance and Physical Attributes from Single Video

author.name: Boyuan Wang, Xiaofeng Wang, Yongkang Li, Zheng Zhu, Yifan Chang, Angen Ye, Guosheng Zhao, Chaojun Ni, Guan Huang, Yijie Ren, Yueqi Duan, Xingang Wang

entry.summary: Proposes ReconPhys, the first feedforward framework for jointly learning physical attribute estimation and 3D Gaussian Splatting reconstruction from single monocular video, using self-supervised training without ground-truth physics labels.

entry.title: Mitigating Entangled Steering in Large Vision-Language Models for Hallucination Reduction

author.name: Yuanhong Zhang, Zhaoyang Wang, Xin Zhang, Weizhan Zhang, Joey Tianyi Zhou

entry.summary: Proposes MESA, a plug-and-play framework that mitigates hallucinations in large VLMs through controlled latent intervention, addressing the problem of entangled steering signals that disrupt generation behavior.

entry.title: Guiding a Diffusion Model by Swapping Its Tokens

author.name: Weijia Zhang, Yuehao Liu, Shanyan Guan, Wu Ran, Yanhao Ge, Wei Li, Chao Ma

entry.summary: Proposes token-swap guidance for diffusion models that enables CFG-like quality improvement for both conditional and unconditional generation by swapping semantically dissimilar token latents.

entry.title: AdaSpark: Adaptive Sparsity for Efficient Long-Video Understanding

author.name: Handong Li, Zikang Liu, Longteng Guo, Tongtian Yue, Yepeng Tang, Xinxin Zhu, Chuanyang Zheng, Ziming Wang, Zhibin Wang, Jun Song, Cheng Yu, Bo Zheng, Jing Liu

entry.summary: Proposes AdaSpark for efficient long-video understanding in Video-LLMs with adaptive cube-selective attention and adaptive token-selective FFN that dynamically adjust sparsity based on content.

entry.title: On the Global Photometric Alignment for Low-Level Vision

author.name: Mingjia Li, Tianle Du, Hainuo Wang, Qiming Hu, Xiaojie Guo

entry.summary: Identifies and theoretically analyzes a photometric inconsistency problem in supervised low-level vision training data, proving that photometric and structural loss components are orthogonal under least-squares decomposition, and proposes a global photometric alignment solution.

entry.title: Orion-Lite: Distilling LLM Reasoning into Efficient Vision-Only Driving Models

author.name: Jing Gu, Niccol\`o Cavagnero, Gijs Dubbelman

entry.summary: Introduces Orion-Lite, which distills LLM reasoning from large VLA models into compact vision-only driving models for efficient deployment, evaluated in closed-loop rather than just open-loop settings.

entry.title: Phantasia: Context-Adaptive Backdoors in Vision Language Models

author.name: Nam Duong Tran, Phi Le Nguyen

entry.summary: Demonstrates that existing VLM backdoor attacks are less stealthy than previously thought, and proposes Phantasia, a context-adaptive backdoor attack that generates dynamic, context-dependent poisoned responses.

entry.title: Phantom: Physics-Infused Video Generation via Joint Modeling of Visual and Latent Physical Dynamics

author.name: Ying Shen, Jerry Xiong, Tianjiao Yu, Ismini Lourentzou

entry.summary: Introduces Phantom, a physics-infused video generation model that jointly models visual dynamics and latent physical properties, aiming to produce physically plausible videos rather than just visually realistic ones.

entry.title: Scal3R: Scalable Test-Time Training for Large-Scale 3D Reconstruction

author.name: Tao Xie, Peishan Yang, Yudong Jin, Yingfeng Cai, Wei Yin, Weiqiang Ren, Qian Zhang, Wei Hua, Sida Peng, Xiaoyang Guo, Xiaowei Zhou

entry.summary: Proposes Scal3R for large-scale 3D reconstruction from long videos using a neural global context representation that compresses and retains long-range scene information, enabling test-time self-improvement.

entry.title: Fail2Drive: Benchmarking Closed-Loop Driving Generalization

author.name: Simon Gerstenecker, Andreas Geiger, Katrin Renz

entry.summary: Introduces Fail2Drive, the first paired-route benchmark for closed-loop autonomous driving generalization in CARLA, with 200 routes and 17 shift types, isolating memorization from generalization.

entry.title: How Much LLM Does a Self-Revising Agent Actually Need?

author.name: Sungwoo Jung, Seonil Son

entry.summary: Studies how much of a self-revising agent's competence comes from the LLM versus explicit structure around it, using a declared reflective runtime protocol evaluated on noisy Collaborative Battleship with progressively simpler LLMs.

entry.title: MAT-Cell: A Multi-Agent Tree-Structured Reasoning Framework for Batch-Level Single-Cell Annotation

author.name: Yehui Yang, Zelin Zang, Changxi Chi, Jingbo Zhou, Xienan Zheng, Yuzhe Jia, Chang Yu, Jinlin Wu, Fuji Yang, Jiebo Luo, Zhen Lei, Stan Z. Li

entry.summary: Proposes MAT-Cell, a neuro-symbolic multi-agent reasoning framework for single-cell annotation that reframes classification as constructive proof generation. Uses adaptive RAG and dialectic verification with rebuttal agents.

entry.title: AgentOpt v0.1 Technical Report: Client-Side Optimization for LLM-Based Agent

author.name: Wenyue Hua, Sripad Karne, Qian Xie, Armaan Agrawal, Nikos Pagonas, Kostis Kaffes, Tianyi Peng

entry.summary: Introduces AgentOpt, a client-side optimization framework for LLM-based agents that addresses how developers should allocate resources (model choice, tools, API budget) across pipeline stages subject to quality, cost, and latency constraints.

entry.title: Scientific Knowledge-driven Decoding Constraints Improving the Reliability of LLMs

author.name: Maotian Ma, Zheni Zeng, Zhenghao Liu, Yukun Yan

entry.summary: Proposes SciDC, a method that converts scientific knowledge into multi-layered standardized rules to constrain LLM generation, using strong LLMs to automatically create decoding constraints that reduce hallucination.

entry.title: A Parameter-Efficient Transfer Learning Approach through Multitask Prompt Distillation and Decomposition for Clinical NLP

author.name: Cheng Peng, Mengxian Lyu, Ziyi Chen, Yonghui Wu

entry.summary: Presents a multitask prompt distillation framework for clinical NLP that learns a shared metaprompt from 21 clinical source tasks and adapts to unseen targets with <0.05% trainable parameters across three backbone models.

entry.title: WRAP++: Web discoveRy Amplified Pretraining

author.name: Jiang Zhou, Yunhao Wang, Xing Wu, Tinghao Yu, Feng Zhang

entry.summary: Proposes WRAP++, which improves LLM pretraining by discovering cross-document relationships from web hyperlinks and synthesizing joint QA over document pairs, moving beyond single-document rephrasing.

entry.title: MoRight: Motion Control Done Right

author.name: Shaowei Liu, Xuanchi Ren, Tianchang Shen, Huan Ling, Saurabh Gupta, Shenlong Wang, Sanja Fidler, Jun Gao

entry.summary: Introduces MoRight, a framework for motion-controlled video generation that disentangles camera and object motion and models motion causality, enabling user-specified actions to trigger physically plausible scene dynamics.

entry.title: FlowAdam: Implicit Regularization via Geometry-Aware Soft Momentum Injection

author.name: Devender Singh, Tarun Sheel

entry.summary: Introduces FlowAdam, a hybrid optimizer that augments Adam with ODE-based gradient-flow integration when landscape difficulty is detected. Uses 'Soft Momentum Injection' to blend ODE velocity with Adam's momentum, addressing Adam's limitation with dense parameter couplings.

entry.title: GraphWalker: Graph-Guided In-Context Learning for Clinical Reasoning on Electronic Health Records

author.name: Yue Fang, Weibin Liao, Yuxin Guo, Jiaran Gao, Hongxin Ding, Jinyang Zhang, Xinke Jiang, Zhibang Yang, Junfeng Zhao, Yasha Wang, Liantao Ma

entry.summary: Proposes GraphWalker for clinical reasoning on EHRs, using graph-guided in-context learning to select demonstrations for LLMs. Addresses perspective limitation, cohort awareness, and information aggregation challenges in ICL-based EHR reasoning.

entry.title: Bi-Lipschitz Autoencoder With Injectivity Guarantee

author.name: Qipeng Zhan, Zhuoping Zhou, Zexuan Wang, Qi Long, Li Shen

entry.summary: Proposes Bi-Lipschitz Autoencoder (BLAE) that ensures encoder injectivity through bi-Lipschitz constraints, addressing a core bottleneck in regularized autoencoders. Formalizes 'admissible regularization' and provides sufficient conditions for robust dimensionality reduction.

entry.title: Predictive Representations for Skill Transfer in Reinforcement Learning

author.name: Ruben Vereecken, Luke Dickens, Alessandra Russo

entry.summary: Develops Outcome-Predictive State Representations (OPSRs) for transfer in RL, providing task-independent abstractions based on outcome predictions. Shows formally and empirically they enable optimal but limited transfer, then overcomes this with OPSR-based skills using options.

entry.title: How Does Machine Learning Manage Complexity?

author.name: Lance Fortnow

entry.summary: Provides a computational complexity perspective on machine learning, modeling it as producing P/poly-computable distributions with bounded entropy. Shows how focusing on computable distributions enables better complexity management, connecting ML to complexity theory.

entry.title: MedRoute: RL-Based Dynamic Specialist Routing in Multi-Agent Medical Diagnosis

author.name: Ashmal Vayani, Parth Parag Kulkarni, Joseph Fioresi, Song Wang, Mubarak Shah

entry.summary: Proposes MedRoute, an RL-based dynamic routing system for multi-agent medical diagnosis using Large Multimodal Models, where each agent acts as a specialist. Uses RL to dynamically select which specialists to consult rather than static routing.

entry.title: Towards Robust Content Watermarking Against Removal and Forgery Attacks

author.name: Yifan Zhu, Yihan Wang, Xiao-Shan Gao

entry.summary: ISTS introduces instance-specific watermarking with two-sided detection for text-to-image diffusion models, dynamically controlling injection time and patterns based on semantics to resist both removal and forgery attacks.

entry.title: Measurement of Generative AI Workload Power Profiles for Whole-Facility Data Center Infrastructure Planning

author.name: Roberto Vercellino (National Laboratory of the Rockies), Jared Willard (National Laboratory of the Rockies), Gustavo Campos (National Laboratory of the Rockies), Weslley da Silva Pereira (National Laboratory of the Rockies), Olivia Hull (National Laboratory of the Rockies), Matthew Selensky (National Laboratory of the Rockies), Juliane Mueller (National Laboratory of the Rockies)

entry.summary: Presents high-resolution (0.1s) power consumption measurements of generative AI workloads on H100 GPUs across training, fine-tuning, and inference, linking workload profiles to whole-facility energy planning.

entry.title: Enabling Intrinsic Reasoning over Dense Geospatial Embeddings with DFR-Gemma

author.name: Xuechen Zhang, Aviv Slobodkin, Joydeep Paul, Mandar Sharma, Samet Oymak, Shravya Shetty, Gautam Prasad

entry.summary: DFR-Gemma enables LLMs to reason directly over dense geospatial embeddings from the Population Dynamics Foundation Model, bypassing lossy text conversion. Aligns continuous embeddings into Gemma's input space for efficient geospatial reasoning.

entry.title: Efficient and Effective Internal Memory Retrieval for LLM-Based Healthcare Prediction

author.name: Mingchen Li, Jiatan Huang, Zonghai Yao, Hong yu

entry.summary: K2K replaces external retrieval in healthcare LLMs with internal key-based knowledge access, encoding clinical information into model parameters for rapid retrieval without the latency of searching external knowledge bases.

entry.title: TEMPER: Testing Emotional Perturbation in Quantitative Reasoning

author.name: Atahan Dokme, Benjamin Reichman, Larry Heck

entry.summary: TEMPER tests whether emotional framing degrades LLM quantitative reasoning while preserving all numerical content. Finds 2-8% accuracy drops across 18 models from 1B to frontier scale, with consistent degradation patterns.

entry.title: GRASS: Gradient-based Adaptive Layer-wise Importance Sampling for Memory-efficient Large Language Model Fine-tuning

author.name: Kaiyuan Tian, Yu Tang, Gongqingjian Jiang, Baihui Liu, Yifu Gao, Xialin Su, Linbo Qiao, Dongsheng Li

entry.summary: GRASS proposes gradient-based adaptive layer-wise importance sampling for memory-efficient LLM fine-tuning, dynamically adjusting which layers to train based on task-specific and stage-dependent gradient information.

entry.title: TSUBASA: Improving Long-Horizon Personalization via Evolving Memory and Self-Learning with Context Distillation

author.name: Xinliang Frederick Zhang, Lu Wang

entry.summary: TSUBASA improves long-horizon personalization for LLMs via dynamic memory evolution for better memory writing and self-learning with context distillation for better memory reading.

entry.title: HyperMem: Hypergraph Memory for Long-Term Conversations

author.name: Juwei Yue, Chuanrui Hu, Jiawei Sheng, Zuyi Zhou, Wenyuan Zhang, Tingwen Liu, Li Guo, Yafeng Deng

entry.summary: Proposes HyperMem, a hypergraph-based hierarchical memory architecture for long-term conversational agents. Structures memory into topics, episodes, and facts connected via hyperedges to capture high-order associations beyond pairwise relations.

entry.title: Distributed Multi-Layer Editing for Rule-Level Knowledge in Large Language Models

author.name: Yating Wang, Wenting Zhao, Yaqi Zhao, Yongshun Gong, Yilong Yin, Haoliang Sun

entry.summary: Studies rule-level knowledge editing in LLMs, extending the RuleEdit benchmark to 200 rules. Reveals form-specific organization of rule knowledge across layers and proposes distributed multi-layer editing to maintain consistency across symbolic, natural language, and instance forms.

entry.title: Towards Real-world Human Behavior Simulation: Benchmarking Large Language Models on Long-horizon, Cross-scenario, Heterogeneous Behavior Traces

author.name: Jiawei Chen, Ruoxi Xu, Boxi Cao, Ruotong Pan, Yunfei Zhang, Yifei Hu, Yong Du, Tingting Gao, Yaojie Lu, Yingfei Sun, Xianpei Han, Le Sun, Xiangyu Wu, Hongyu Lin

entry.summary: Introduces OmniBehavior, a user simulation benchmark constructed from real-world data integrating long-horizon, cross-scenario, and heterogeneous behavioral patterns. Shows that isolated-scenario benchmarks suffer from tunnel vision while real decisions rely on cross-scenario causal chains.

entry.title: ORACLE-SWE: Quantifying the Contribution of Oracle Information Signals on SWE Agents

author.name: Kenan Li, Qirui Jin, Liao Zhu, Xiaosong Huang, Yijia Wu, Yikai Zhang, Xin Zhang, Zijian Jin, Yufan Huang, Elsie Nallipogu, Chaoyun Zhang, Yu Kang, Saravan Rajmohan, Qingwei Lin, Wenke Lee, Dongmei Zhang

entry.summary: Introduces Oracle-SWE, a method to isolate and quantify the contribution of individual oracle information signals (reproduction tests, edit locations, etc.) to SWE agent success. Provides upper-bound analysis of each signal's impact.

entry.title: Differentially Private Language Generation and Identification in the Limit

author.name: Anay Mehrotra, Grigoris Velegkas, Xifan Yu, Felix Zhou

entry.summary: Initiates study of differentially private language generation in the limit. Shows privacy comes at no qualitative cost for countable language collections but imposes quantitative costs, with impossibility results for uncountable collections.

entry.title: DailyArt: Discovering Articulation from Single Static Images via Latent Dynamics

author.name: Hang Zhang, Qijian Tian, Jingyu Gong, Daoguo Dong, Xuhong Wang, Yuan Xie, Xin Tan

entry.summary: Presents DailyArt, which infers articulated object kinematics from a single closed-state image by first synthesizing an opened state and then estimating joints from the pair, treating it as synthesis-mediated reasoning.

entry.title: Latent Anomaly Knowledge Excavation: Unveiling Sparse Sensitive Neurons in Vision-Language Models

author.name: Shaotian Li, Shangze Li, Chuancheng Shi, Wenhua Wu, Yanqiu Wu, Xiaohan Yu, Fei Shen, Tat-Seng Chua

entry.summary: Proposes LAKE, a training-free framework that identifies sparse anomaly-sensitive neurons in vision-language models for anomaly detection, challenging the assumption that VLMs need external adapters for AD.

entry.title: HAWK: Head Importance-Aware Visual Token Pruning in Multimodal Models

author.name: Qihui Zhu, Tao Zhang, Yuchen Wang, Zijian Wen, Mengjie Zhang, Shuangwu Chen, Xiaobin Tan, Jian Yang, Yang Liu, Zhenhua Dong, Xianzhi Yu, Yinfei Pan

entry.summary: Proposes HAWK, a visual token pruning method for multimodal LLMs that accounts for varying importance of attention heads, revealing that different heads capture distinct visual semantics.

entry.title: ImVideoEdit: Image-learning Video Editing via 2D Spatial Difference Attention Blocks

author.name: Jiayang Xu, Fan Zhuo, Majun Zhang, Changhao Pan, Zehan Wang, Siyu Chen, Xiaoda Yang, Tao Jin, Zhou Zhao

entry.summary: Proposes ImVideoEdit, a framework that learns video editing from image pairs by freezing 3D attention modules and using Predict-Update Spatial Difference Attention to decouple spatial from temporal editing.

entry.title: MotionScape: A Large-Scale Real-World Highly Dynamic UAV Video Dataset for World Models

author.name: Zile Guo, Zhan Chen, Enze Zhu, Kan Wei, Yongkang Zou, Xiaoxuan Liu, Lei Wang

entry.summary: Introduces MotionScape, a large-scale real-world UAV video dataset for world models, addressing distribution bias in existing datasets that mostly contain ground-constrained or smooth egocentric motion.

entry.title: SearchAD: Large-Scale Rare Image Retrieval Dataset for Autonomous Driving

author.name: Felix Embacher, Jonas Uhrig, Marius Cordts, Markus Enzweiler

entry.summary: Introduces SearchAD, a large-scale rare image retrieval dataset for autonomous driving with 423K frames and 513K bounding boxes across 90 rare categories, targeting the needle-in-a-haystack retrieval problem.

entry.title: $\oslash$ Source Models Leak What They Shouldn't $\nrightarrow$: Unlearning Zero-Shot Transfer in Domain Adaptation Through Adversarial Optimization

author.name: Arnav Devalapally, Poornima Jain, Kartik Srinivas, Vineeth N. Balasubramanian

entry.summary: Reveals that source-free domain adaptation methods leak sensitive source-domain information via zero-shot transfer to target domains, and proposes adversarial optimization-based machine unlearning to mitigate this privacy risk.

entry.title: PokeGym: A Visually-Driven Long-Horizon Benchmark for Vision-Language Models

author.name: Ruizhi Zhang, Ye Huang, Yuangang Pan, Chuanfu Shen, Zhilin Liu, Ting Xie, Wen Li, Lixin Duan

entry.summary: Introduces PokeGym, a visually-driven long-horizon benchmark for VLMs set in a complex 3D game environment (Pokemon Legends: Z-A), enforcing strict visual-only observation without state leakage.

entry.title: Self-Improving 4D Perception via Self-Distillation

author.name: Nan Huang, Pengcheng Yu, Weijia Zeng, James M. Rehg, Angjoo Kanazawa, Haiwen Feng, Qianqian Wang

entry.summary: Proposes SelfEvo, a self-improving framework for 4D perception that uses self-distillation with spatiotemporal context asymmetry to continually improve multi-view reconstruction models from unlabeled videos.

entry.title: ParseBench: A Document Parsing Benchmark for AI Agents

author.name: Boyang Zhang, Sebasti\'an G. Acosta, Preston Carlson, Sacha Bron, Pierre-Lo\"ic Doulcet, Simon Suo

entry.summary: Introduces ParseBench, a document parsing benchmark of ~2,000 human-verified enterprise pages evaluating semantic correctness for AI agent consumption across tables, charts, formatting, and visual grounding.

entry.title: Kuramoto Oscillatory Phase Encoding: Neuro-inspired Synchronization for Improved Learning Efficiency

author.name: Mingqing Xiao, Yansen Wang, Dongqi Han, Caihua Shan, Dongsheng Li

entry.summary: Introduces Kuramoto oscillatory Phase Encoding (KoPE) for Vision Transformers, adding neuro-inspired synchronization dynamics as phase states to improve training, parameter, and data efficiency.

entry.title: Bias Redistribution in Visual Machine Unlearning: Does Forgetting One Group Harm Another?

author.name: Yunusa Haruna, Adamu Lawan, Ibrahim Haruna Abdulhamid, Hamza Mohammed Dauda, Jiaquan Zhang, Chaoning Zhang, Shamsuddeen Hassan Muhammad

entry.summary: Investigates bias redistribution in machine unlearning for CLIP models, finding that forgetting one demographic group can amplify bias toward correlated groups rather than neutralizing the concept.

entry.title: On Emotion-Sensitive Decision Making of Small Language Model Agents

author.name: Jiaju Lin, Xingjian Du, Qingyun Wu, Ellen Wenting Zou, Jindong Wang

entry.summary: Studies how emotions affect decision-making in small language models using activation steering for emotion induction, combined with game-theoretic evaluation across cooperative and competitive scenarios.

entry.title: Robustness Risk of Conversational Retrieval: Identifying and Mitigating Noise Sensitivity in Qwen3-Embedding Model

author.name: Weishu Chen, Zhouhui Hou, Mingjie Zhan, Zhicheng Zhao, Fei Su

entry.summary: Identifies a robustness vulnerability in Qwen3-embedding models where structured dialogue-style noise becomes disproportionately retrievable in conversational retrieval settings, invisible under standard clean-query benchmarks.

entry.title: Beyond Facts: Benchmarking Distributional Reading Comprehension in Large Language Models

author.name: Pei-Fu Guo, Ya-An Tsai, Chun-Chia Hsu, Kai-Xin Chen, Yun-Da Tsai, Kai-Wei Chang, Nanyun Peng, Mi-Yen Yeh, Shou-De Lin

entry.summary: Introduces Text2DistBench, a reading comprehension benchmark requiring LLMs to infer distributional knowledge (population-level trends, proportions) from collections of text rather than locating specific factual evidence.

entry.title: Distributional Open-Ended Evaluation of LLM Cultural Value Alignment Based on Value Codebook

author.name: Jaehyeok Lee, Xiaoyuan Yi, Jing Yao, Hyunjin Hwang, Roy Ka-Wei Lee, Xing Xie, JinYeong Bak

entry.summary: Introduces DOVE, a distributional evaluation framework comparing human-written and LLM-generated text distributions for cultural value alignment using a rate-distortion optimized value codebook.

entry.title: ToxReason: A Benchmark for Mechanistic Chemical Toxicity Reasoning via Adverse Outcome Pathway

author.name: Jueon Park, Wonjune Jang, Chanhwi Kim, Yein Park, Jaewoo Kang

entry.summary: Introduces ToxReason, a benchmark for evaluating mechanistic chemical toxicity reasoning in LLMs using Adverse Outcome Pathways (AOPs). Integrates experimental drug-target interaction evidence to assess whether toxicity predictions are grounded in valid biological mechanisms.

entry.title: Harnessing Hyperbolic Geometry for Harmful Prompt Detection and Sanitization

author.name: Igor Maljkovic, Maria Rosaria Briglia, Iacopo Masi, Antonio Emanuele Cin\`a, Fabio Roli

entry.summary: Proposes HyPE and HyPS, complementary systems using hyperbolic geometry for detecting and sanitizing harmful prompts in VLMs. Leverages structured geometry of hyperbolic space for lightweight anomaly detection.

entry.title: Say Something Else: Rethinking Contextual Privacy as Information Sufficiency

author.name: Yunze Xiao, Wenkai Li, Xiaoyuan Wu, Ningshan Ma, Yueqi Song, Weihao Xuan

entry.summary: Formalizes privacy-preserving LLM communication as an Information Sufficiency task, introduces 'free-text pseudonymization' as a new privacy strategy beyond suppression and generalization, with conversational evaluation.

entry.title: AI-Driven Research for Databases

author.name: Audrey Cheng, Harald Ng, Aaron Kabcenell, Peter Bailis, Matei Zaharia, Lin Ma, Xiao Shi, Ion Stoica

entry.summary: Proposes AI-Driven Research for Systems (ADRS) using LLMs to automate database performance optimization via automated code generation, focusing on building fast evaluation pipelines for candidate solutions.

entry.title: MedDialBench: Benchmarking LLM Diagnostic Robustness under Parametric Adversarial Patient Behaviors

author.name: Xiaotian Luo, Xun Jiang, Jiangcheng Wu

entry.summary: Introduces MedDialBench, a benchmark that systematically evaluates LLM diagnostic robustness against parametric adversarial patient behaviors across five dimensions with graded severity levels.

entry.title: Q-Zoom: Query-Aware Adaptive Perception for Efficient Multimodal Large Language Models

author.name: Yuheng Shi, Xiaohuan Pei, Linfeng Wen, Minjing Dong, Chang Xu

entry.summary: Proposes Q-Zoom, a query-aware adaptive high-resolution perception framework for multimodal LLMs that dynamically allocates computation based on query intent, using coarse-to-fine processing.

entry.title: Dynamic Context Evolution for Scalable Synthetic Data Generation

author.name: Ryan Lingo, Rajeev Chhajer

entry.summary: Introduces Dynamic Context Evolution (DCE) to address cross-batch mode collapse in synthetic data generation, using verbalized tail sampling, semantic memory, and feedback-guided evolution.

entry.title: $k$-server-bench: Automating Potential Discovery for the $k$-Server Conjecture

author.name: Kirill Brilliantov, Etienne Bamas, Emmanuel Abb\'e

entry.summary: Introduces k-server-bench, a code-based challenge for automated mathematical discovery based on the k-server conjecture, requiring discovery of potential functions satisfying systems of linear inequalities.

entry.title: Transformer See, Transformer Do: Copying as an Intermediate Step in Learning Analogical Reasoning

author.name: Philipp Hellwig, Willem Zuidema, Claire E. Stevenson, Martha Lewis

entry.summary: Trains transformers on letter-string analogical reasoning tasks using Meta-Learning for Compositionality, finding that including copying tasks in training data is critical for making analogies learnable. More heterogeneous training data improves generalization to new alphabets.

entry.title: Learning to Query History: Nonstationary Classification via Learned Retrieval

author.name: Jimmy Gammell, Bishal Thapaliya, Yoon Jung, Riyasat Ohib, Bilel Fehri, Deepayan Chakrabarti

entry.summary: Reframes nonstationary classification as time series prediction, conditioning classifiers on historical labeled examples. Introduces learned discrete retrieval mechanism for sampling relevant historical examples, trained end-to-end with score-based gradient estimation.

entry.title: SBBTS: A Unified Schr\"odinger-Bass Framework for Synthetic Financial Time Series

author.name: Alexandre Alouadi, Gr\'egoire Loeper, C\'elian Marsala, Othmane Mazhar, Huy\^en Pham

entry.summary: Introduces SBBTS, a framework extending Schrödinger-Bass bridges to multi-step synthetic financial time series generation. Jointly calibrates drift and volatility, unlike existing methods that handle them separately, with experiments on the Heston model.

entry.title: Tracking Adaptation Time: Metrics for Temporal Distribution Shift

author.name: Lorenzo Iovine, Giacomo Ziffer, Emanuele Della Valle

entry.summary: Proposes three complementary metrics for evaluating model behavior under temporal distribution shift, distinguishing between failure to adapt and inherently harder data. Shows existing metrics miss important adaptation patterns.

entry.title: Adaptive Prompt Structure Factorization: A Framework for Self-Discovering and Optimizing Compositional Prompt Programs

author.name: Haoyue Liu, Zhichao Wang, Yongxin Guo, Haoran Shou, Xiaoying Tang

entry.summary: aPSF proposes an API-only prompt optimization framework that uses an Architect model to discover task-specific prompt structures as semantic factors, then performs interventional single-factor updates for credit assignment and controllability.

entry.title: Controller Design for Structured State-space Models via Contraction Theory

author.name: Muhammad Zakwan, Vaibhav Gupta, Alireza Karimi, Efe C. Balta, Giancarlo Ferrari-Trecate

entry.summary: Provides the first controllability and observability analysis of Structured State-space Models (SSMs) and develops controller synthesis via contraction theory and LMIs, establishing a separation principle for SSM-based output feedback.

entry.title: Fast Spatial Memory with Elastic Test-Time Training

author.name: Ziqiao Ma, Xueyang Yu, Haoyu Zhen, Yuncong Yang, Joyce Chai, Chuang Gan

entry.summary: Proposes Elastic Test-Time Training that stabilizes fast-weight updates using Fisher-weighted elastic priors and exponential moving average anchors, improving long-context 3D reconstruction by balancing stability and plasticity.

entry.title: Contextual Earnings-22: A Speech Recognition Benchmark with Custom Vocabulary in the Wild

author.name: Berkin Durmus, Chen Cen, Eduardo Pacheco, Arda Okan, Atila Orhon

entry.summary: Contextual Earnings-22 introduces a benchmark with realistic custom vocabulary contexts for speech recognition, addressing the gap between academic benchmarks (general vocabulary) and production needs (rare, context-defined terms).

entry.title: An Empirical Analysis of Static Analysis Methods for Detection and Mitigation of Code Library Hallucinations

author.name: Clarissa Miranda-Pena, Andrew Reeson, C\'ecile Paris, Josiah Poon, Jonathan K. Kummerfeld

entry.summary: Analyzes the potential of static analysis tools for detecting LLM code library hallucinations, finding they catch 16-70% of errors and 14-85% of library hallucinations, with manual analysis identifying fundamental detection limits.

entry.title: Sensitivity-Positional Co-Localization in GQA Transformers

author.name: Manoj Chandrashekar Rao

entry.summary: Investigates co-localization of task-sensitive and positionally important layers in GQA transformers, discovering strong anti-localization: task-sensitive layers concentrate in early/middle layers while positional encoding adaptation is most effective in later layers.

entry.title: Data Selection for Multi-turn Dialogue Instruction Tuning

author.name: Bo Li, Shikun Zhang, Wei Ye

entry.summary: MDS proposes dialogue-level data selection for multi-turn instruction tuning, combining global coverage via bin-wise selection in query trajectory space with local structural evaluation of topic grounding and information progress.

entry.title: Self-Debias: Self-correcting for Debiasing Large Language Models

author.name: Xuan Feng, Shuai Zhao, Luwei Xiao, Tianlong Gu, Bo An

entry.summary: Introduces Self-Debias, a framework for debiasing LLMs that reformulates the problem as strategic resource redistribution of output probability mass from biased to unbiased reasoning paths. Addresses 'Bias Propagation' through Chain-of-Thought reasoning.

entry.title: ReflectRM: Boosting Generative Reward Models via Self-Reflection within a Unified Judgment Framework

author.name: Kai Qin, Liangxin Liu, Yu Liang, Longzheng Wang, Yan Wang, Yueyang Zhang, Long Xia, Zhiyuan Sun, Houde Liu, Daiting Shi

entry.summary: Proposes ReflectRM, a generative reward model that uses self-reflection to assess analytical quality and enhance preference modeling. Trained under unified framework for joint response preference and reflection quality modeling.

entry.title: Mitigating Distribution Sharpening in Math RLVR via Distribution-Aligned Hint Synthesis and Backward Hint Annealing

author.name: Pei-Xi Xie, Che-Yu Lin, Cheng-Lin Yang

entry.summary: Addresses distribution sharpening in math RLVR through Distribution-Aligned Hint Synthesis (DAHS) and Backward Hint Annealing (BHA). DAHS constructs hints conditioned on student-style responses while BHA gradually reduces hint exposure across difficulty levels.

entry.title: Are GUI Agents Focused Enough? Automated Distraction via Semantic-level UI Element Injection

author.name: Wenkui Yang, Chao Jin, Haisu Zhu, Weilin Luo, Derek Yuen, Kun Shao, Huaibo Huang, Junxian Duan, Jie Cao, Ran He

entry.summary: Proposes Semantic-level UI Element Injection, a red-teaming method for GUI agents that overlays harmless but distracting UI elements on screenshots. Uses Editor-Overlapper-Victim pipeline to misdirect visual grounding without requiring white-box access.

entry.title: TOOLCAD: Exploring Tool-Using Large Language Models in Text-to-CAD Generation with Reinforcement Learning

author.name: Yifei Gong, Xing Wu, Wenda Liu, Kang Tu

entry.summary: Proposes ToolCAD, an agentic CAD framework using LLMs as tool-using agents for text-to-CAD generation. Introduces an interactive modeling gym with hybrid feedback and end-to-end RL optimization.

entry.title: Verify Before You Commit: Towards Faithful Reasoning in LLM Agents via Self-Auditing

author.name: Wenhao Yuan, Chenchen Lin, Jian Chen, Jinfeng Xu, Xuehe Wang, Edith Cheuk Han Ngai

entry.summary: Proposes SAVeR (Self-Audited Verified Reasoning), enforcing verification over internal belief states in LLM agents before committing to actions. Addresses systematic behavioral drift from unsupported beliefs in long-horizon systems.

entry.title: Learning Who Disagrees: Demographic Importance Weighting for Modeling Annotator Distributions with DiADEM

author.name: Samay U. Shetty, Tharindu Cyril Weerasooriya, Deepak Pandita, Christopher M. Homan

entry.summary: Introduces DiADEM, a neural architecture that learns how much each demographic axis matters for predicting annotation disagreement. Shows that LLMs with chain-of-thought fail to recover disagreement structure while DiADEM captures it.

entry.title: Bootstrapping Sign Language Annotations with Sign Language Models

author.name: Colin Lea, Vasileios Baltatzis, Connor Gillis, Raja Kushalnagar, Lorna Quandt, Leah Findlater

entry.summary: Develops a pseudo-annotation pipeline for sign language videos that combines fingerspelling recognition, isolated sign recognition, and K-Shot LLM approaches to bootstrap annotations for large datasets like ASL STEM Wiki and FLEURS-ASL.

entry.title: GEAR: GEometry-motion Alternating Refinement for Articulated Object Modeling with Gaussian Splatting

author.name: Jialin Li, Bin Fu, Ruiping Wang, Xilin Chen

entry.summary: Proposes GEAR, an EM-style alternating optimization framework for articulated object reconstruction using Gaussian Splatting, treating part segmentation as latent variables and joint motion as explicit variables.

entry.title: AnomalyAgent: Agentic Industrial Anomaly Synthesis via Tool-Augmented Reinforcement Learning

author.name: Jiaming Su, Tengchao Yang, Ruikang Zhang, Zhengan Yan, Haoyu Sun, Linfeng Zhang

entry.summary: Proposes AnomalyAgent, an anomaly synthesis agent with self-reflection, knowledge retrieval, and iterative refinement capabilities using five specialized tools for generating realistic industrial anomaly samples.

entry.title: Generative 3D Gaussian Splatting for Arbitrary-ResolutionAtmospheric Downscaling and Forecasting

author.name: Tao Hana, Zhibin Wen, Zhenghao Chen, Fenghua Lin, Junyu Gao, Song Guo, Lei Bai

entry.summary: Proposes GSSA-ViT, applying 3D Gaussian splatting to atmospheric forecasting with a scale-aware vision transformer for arbitrary-resolution weather prediction and downscaling.

entry.title: DP-DeGauss: Dynamic Probabilistic Gaussian Decomposition for Egocentric 4D Scene Reconstruction

author.name: Tingxi Chen, Zhengxue Cheng, Houqiang Zhong, Su Wang, Rong Xie, Li Song

entry.summary: Proposes DP-DeGauss for egocentric 4D scene reconstruction using dynamic probabilistic Gaussian decomposition that routes Gaussians into specialized branches for background, hands, and objects.

entry.title: OmniJigsaw: Enhancing Omni-Modal Reasoning via Modality-Orchestrated Reordering

author.name: Yiduo Jia, Muzhi Zhu, Hao Zhong, Mingyu Liu, Yuling Xi, Hao Chen, Bin Qin, Yongjie Yang, Zhenbo Luo, Chunhua Shen

entry.summary: Proposes OmniJigsaw, a self-supervised RL framework for omni-modal models that uses temporal reordering of shuffled audio-visual clips to improve cross-modal reasoning with three distinct modality orchestration strategies.

entry.title: InstAP: Instance-Aware Vision-Language Pre-Train for Spatial-Temporal Understanding

author.name: Ashutosh Kumar, Rajat Saini, Jingjing Pan, Mustafa Erdogan, Mingfang Zhang, Betty Le Dem, Norimasa Kobori, Quan Kong

entry.summary: Introduces InstAP, an instance-aware vision-language pre-training framework with InstVL dataset (2M images, 50K videos) that jointly optimizes global and fine-grained instance-level contrastive alignment.

entry.title: SurfelSplat: Learning Efficient and Generalizable Gaussian Surfel Representations for Sparse-View Surface Reconstruction

author.name: Chensheng Dai, Shengjun Zhang, Min Chen, Yueqi Duan

entry.summary: Proposes SurfelSplat, a feed-forward framework for efficient Gaussian surfel-based 3D surface reconstruction from sparse views, addressing limitations of optimization-based approaches that require dense views.

entry.title: RewardFlow: Generate Images by Optimizing What You Reward

author.name: Onkar Susladkar, Dong-Hwan Jang, Tushar Prakash, Adheesh Juvekar, Vedant Shah, Ayush Barik, Nabeel Bashir, Muntasir Wahed, Ritish Shrirao, Ismini Lourentzou

entry.summary: Introduces RewardFlow, an inversion-free framework steering pretrained diffusion/flow-matching models at inference time through multi-reward Langevin dynamics, including a novel differentiable VQA-based reward.

entry.title: GaussiAnimate: Reconstruct and Rig Animatable Categories with Level of Dynamics

author.name: Jiaxin Wang, Dongxin Lyu, Zeyu Cai, Zhiyang Dou, Cheng Lin, Anpei Chen, Yuliang Xiu

entry.summary: Proposes GaussiAnimate with 'Skelebones', a scaffold-skin rigging system that combines free-form bones with mean curvature skeletons for category-agnostic animatable 3D reconstruction from video.

entry.title: Scaling-Aware Data Selection for End-to-End Autonomous Driving Systems

author.name: Tolga Dimlioglu, Nadine Chang, Maying Shen, Rafid Mahmood, Jose M. Alvarez

entry.summary: Proposes MOSAIC, a data selection framework for autonomous driving that fits neural scaling laws per data domain to optimize training set composition across multiple evaluation metrics.

entry.title: PyVRP$^+$: LLM-Driven Metacognitive Heuristic Evolution for Hybrid Genetic Search in Vehicle Routing Problems

author.name: Manuj Malik, Jianan Zhou, Shashank Reddy Chirra, Zhiguang Cao

entry.summary: Introduces Metacognitive Evolutionary Programming (MEP), using LLMs as strategic discovery agents for evolving vehicle routing heuristics, going beyond reactive code mutations to strategic reasoning.

entry.title: RemoteAgent: Bridging Vague Human Intents and Earth Observation with RL-based Agentic MLLMs

author.name: Liang Yao, Shengxiang Xu, Fan Liu, Chuanyi Zhang, Bishun Yao, Rui Min, Yongjun Li, Chaoqian Ouyang, Shimin Di, Min-Ling Zhang

entry.summary: Proposes RemoteAgent, an RL-based agentic MLLM framework for Earth Observation that bridges vague natural language queries with multi-granularity visual analysis tasks, from image interpretation to pixel-wise predictions.

entry.title: Stitch4D: Sparse Multi-Location 4D Urban Reconstruction via Spatio-Temporal Interpolation

author.name: Hina Kogure, Kei Katsumata, Taiki Miyanishi, Komei Sugiura

entry.summary: Proposes Stitch4D for 4D urban reconstruction from sparse multi-location cameras with little view overlap, synthesizing bridge views to densify spatial constraints.

entry.title: Inside-Out: Measuring Generalization in Vision Transformers Through Inner Workings

author.name: Yunxiang Peng, Mengmeng Ma, Ziyu Yao, Xi Peng

entry.summary: Proposes using internal representations of Vision Transformers (attention patterns, token dynamics) as label-free proxy metrics for predicting generalization under distribution shift.

entry.title: Plug-and-Play Logit Fusion for Heterogeneous Pathology Foundation Models

author.name: Gexin Huang, Anqi Li, Yusheng Tan, Beidi Zhao, Gang Wang, Gaozu Hua, Xiaoxiao Li

entry.summary: Proposes LogitProd, a lightweight fusion strategy for combining heterogeneous pathology foundation models by learning sample-adaptive weights over their logit outputs without retraining encoders.

entry.title: ProofSketcher: Hybrid LLM + Lightweight Proof Checker for Reliable Math/Logic Reasoning

author.name: Kranthi Kommuru, Kunal Khanvilkar, Gaurav Parekh

entry.summary: Proposes ProofSketcher, a hybrid system combining LLM-generated proof sketches with lightweight formal proof checking to catch logical errors in mathematical reasoning that are hard to detect from text alone.

entry.title: What's Missing in Screen-to-Action? Towards a UI-in-the-Loop Paradigm for Multimodal GUI Reasoning

author.name: Songze Li, Xiaoke Guo, Tianqi Liu, Biao Yi, Zhaoyan Gong, Zhiqiang Liu, Huajun Chen, Wen Zhang

entry.summary: Proposes UILoop, a GUI reasoning paradigm that treats the task as a cyclic Screen-UI elements-Action process, enabling MLLMs to explicitly learn localization, semantic functions, and usage of UI elements for more interpretable interaction.

entry.title: Depression Detection at the Point of Care: Automated Analysis of Linguistic Signals from Routine Primary Care Encounters

author.name: Feng Chen, Manas Bedmutha, Janice Sabin, Andrea Hartzler, Nadir Weibel, Trevor Cohen

entry.summary: Investigates automated depression detection from 1,108 recorded primary care encounters using multiple NLP approaches. Zero-shot GPT-OSS achieves strongest performance, outperforming supervised methods.

entry.title: Hallucination as output-boundary misclassification: a composite abstention architecture for language models

author.name: Angelina Hintsanen

entry.summary: Frames hallucination as output-boundary misclassification and proposes a composite abstention architecture combining instruction-based refusal with a structural gate using self-consistency, paraphrase stability, and citation coverage.

entry.title: Invisible Influences: Investigating Implicit Intersectional Biases through Persona Engineering in Large Language Models

author.name: Nandini Arimanda, Achyuth Mukund, Sakthi Balan Muthiah, Rajesh Sharma

entry.summary: Introduces BADx, a metric for measuring persona-induced bias amplification in LLMs, combining differential bias scores, persona sensitivity, and explainability components to capture dynamic intersectional biases.

entry.title: Probabilistic Language Tries: A Unified Framework for Compression, Decision Policies, and Execution Reuse

author.name: Gregory Magarshak

entry.summary: Introduces probabilistic language tries (PLTs), a unified representation making prefix structure explicit for any generative model, serving simultaneously as a compressor, policy representation, and memoization index.

entry.title: From Exposure to Internalization: Dual-Stream Calibration for In-context Clinical Reasoning

author.name: Chuang Zhao, Hongke Zhao, Xiaofang Zhou, Xiaomeng Li

entry.summary: Proposes Dual-Stream Calibration (DSC), a test-time training framework for clinical reasoning that achieves 'deep internalization' by synergistically aligning semantic and structural calibration streams during inference, going beyond superficial knowledge exposure.

entry.title: TalkLoRA: Communication-Aware Mixture of Low-Rank Adaptation for Large Language Models

author.name: Lin Mu, Haiyang Wang, Li Ni, Lei Sang, Zhize Wu, Peiquan Jin, Yiwen Zhang

entry.summary: Proposes TalkLoRA, a communication-aware MoE-LoRA framework that introduces inter-expert communication before routing via a lightweight Talking Module, addressing the independence assumption in existing MoE-LoRA methods.

entry.title: Attention Flows: Tracing LLM Conceptual Engagement via Story Summaries

author.name: Rebecca M. M. Hicke, Sil Hamilton, David Mimno, Ross Deans Kristensen-McLachlan

entry.summary: Analyzes LLM conceptual engagement with long-form texts by comparing human and LLM-authored novel summaries, aligning summary sentences to source chapters to measure attention patterns across 150 novels.

entry.title: When to Call an Apple Red: Humans Follow Introspective Rules, VLMs Don't

author.name: Jonathan Nemitz, Carsten Eickhoff, Junyi Jessy Li, Kyle Mahowald, Michal Golovanevsky, William Rudman

entry.summary: Introduces the Graded Color Attribution dataset to study when VLMs behave unexpectedly in color naming tasks, finding that humans follow consistent introspective rules for color thresholds while VLMs don't adhere to their stated rules.

entry.title: MedConclusion: A Benchmark for Biomedical Conclusion Generation from Structured Abstracts

author.name: Weiyue Li, Ruizhi Qian, Yi Li, Yongce Li, Yunfan Long, Jiahui Cai, Yan Luo, Mengyu Wang

entry.summary: Introduces MedConclusion, a large-scale benchmark of 5.7M PubMed structured abstracts for evaluating LLM biomedical conclusion generation, with journal-level metadata for subgroup analysis.

entry.title: Towards Privacy-Preserving Large Language Model: Text-free Inference Through Alignment and Adaptation

author.name: Jeongho Yoon, Chanhee Park, Yongchan Chun, Hyeonseok Moon, Heuiseok Lim

entry.summary: Introduces Privacy-Preserving Fine-Tuning (PPFT), a training pipeline that eliminates raw text transmission during LLM inference by training a compact encoder to produce embeddings that preserve task utility while removing sensitive content.

entry.title: The AI Skills Shift: Mapping Skill Obsolescence, Emergence, and Transition Pathways in the LLM Era

author.name: Rudra Jadhav, Janhavi Danve

entry.summary: Presents the Skill Automation Feasibility Index (SAFI), benchmarking four frontier LLMs across 263 text-based tasks spanning all 35 O*NET skills, cross-referencing with real-world AI adoption data to create an AI Impact Matrix.

entry.title: Designing Safe and Accountable GenAI as a Learning Companion with Women Banned from Formal Education

author.name: Hamayoon Behmanush, Freshta Akhtari, Ingmar Weber, Vikram Kamath Cannanure

entry.summary: Presents a participatory design study with 20 women in Afghanistan exploring how they envision GenAI for learning and employability under surveillance and educational restrictions.

entry.title: Android Coach: Improve Online Agentic Training Efficiency with Single State Multiple Actions

author.name: Guo Gan, Yuxuan Ding, Cong Chen, Yuwei Ren, Yin Huang, Hong Zhou

entry.summary: Proposes Android Coach, shifting online RL for Android agents from single-state-single-action to single-state-multiple-actions paradigm, improving sample efficiency by exploring multiple actions per costly emulator state.

entry.title: Evaluating In-Context Translation with Synchronous Context-Free Grammar Transduction

author.name: Jackson Petty, Jaulie Goe, Tal Linzen

entry.summary: Evaluates LLMs' ability to perform in-context translation using formal synchronous context-free grammars as a controlled analogue, isolating the skill of inferring grammar rules from in-context descriptions.

entry.title: RoSHI: A Versatile Robot-oriented Suit for Human Data In-the-Wild

author.name: Wenjing Margaret Mao, Jefferson Ng, Luyang Hu, Daniel Gehrig, Antonio Loquercio

entry.summary: Introduces RoSHI, a hybrid wearable fusing sparse IMUs with egocentric AR glasses to estimate full 3D pose and body shape for collecting robot learning data in the wild.

entry.title: The Rhetoric of Machine Learning

author.name: Robert C. Williamson

entry.summary: Examines machine learning through the lens of rhetoric, arguing it is inherently rhetorical rather than objective. Explores 'manipulation as a service' as a pervasive business model. A philosophical/critical perspective on ML technology.

entry.title: Weaves, Wires, and Morphisms: Formalizing and Implementing the Algebra of Deep Learning

author.name: Vincent Abbott, Gioele Zardini

entry.summary: Introduces a categorical framework for deep learning architectures using novel axis-stride and array-broadcasted categories, formalizing broadcasting and enabling precise mathematical expression and manipulation of architectures compositionally.

entry.title: The Unreasonable Effectiveness of Data for Recommender Systems

author.name: Youssef Abdou

entry.summary: Studies how recommendation system performance scales with training data size across 11 large datasets and 10 algorithms. Investigates whether and when additional data stops providing meaningful gains, finding data scaling continues to help even at 100M interactions.

entry.title: Anticipating tipping in spatiotemporal systems with machine learning

author.name: Smita Deb, Zheng-Meng Zhai, Mulugeta Haile, Ying-Cheng Lai

entry.summary: Applies machine learning (parameter-adaptable reservoir computing with NMF) to predict tipping points in spatiotemporal dynamical systems, extending previous work from low-dimensional SDEs to complex systems. Forecasts both occurrence and timing of critical transitions.

entry.title: The Theorems of Dr. David Blackwell and Their Contributions to Artificial Intelligence

author.name: Napoleon Paxton

entry.summary: A survey tracing the influence of David Blackwell's three major theorems (Rao-Blackwell, Approachability, Informativeness) on modern AI and ML, including MCMC, SLAM, generative models, and online learning. Provides historical context for foundational statistical theory in AI.

entry.title: Variational Feature Compression for Model-Specific Representations

author.name: Zinan Guo, Zihan Wang, Chuan Yan, Liuhuo Wan, Ethan Ma, Guangdong Bai

entry.summary: Proposes a feature extraction framework using variational latent bottlenecks to produce model-specific representations that suppress cross-model transfer while preserving accuracy for authorized classifiers. Addresses input repurposing concerns in cloud-based inference.

entry.title: CBM-Dual: A 65-nm Fully Connected Chaotic Boltzmann Machine Processor for Dual Function Simulated Annealing and Reservoir Computing

author.name: Kanta Yoshioka, Soshi Hirayae, Yuichiro Tanaka, Yuichi Katori, Takashi Morie, Hakaru Tamukoh

entry.summary: CBM-Dual is the first silicon-proven digital chaotic dynamics processor supporting both simulated annealing and reservoir computing, using a 1024-neuron chaotic Boltzmann machine fabricated in 65nm with 99% reduction in MAC operations.

entry.title: Amortized Filtering and Smoothing with Conditional Normalizing Flows

author.name: Tiangang Cui, Xiaodong Feng, Chenlong Pei, Xiaoliang Wan, Tao Zhou

entry.summary: AFSF proposes a unified amortized framework for Bayesian filtering and smoothing using conditional normalizing flows with a recurrent encoder for summary statistics, enabling efficient inference in high-dimensional nonlinear dynamical systems.

entry.title: Non-identifiability of Explanations from Model Behavior in Deep Networks of Image Authenticity Judgments

author.name: Icaro Re Depaolini, Uri Hasson

entry.summary: Tests whether deep networks predicting human image authenticity judgments produce consistent attribution explanations within and across architectures, finding that models achieving similar prediction accuracy can have divergent explanations.

entry.title: The Theory and Practice of Highly Scalable Gaussian Process Regression with Nearest Neighbours

author.name: Robert Allison, Tomasz Maciazek, Anthony Stephenson

entry.summary: Develops theoretical framework for Nearest Neighbour Gaussian Process regression, deriving almost sure pointwise limits for MSE, calibration, and log-predictive score under mild regularity assumptions.

entry.title: Lexical Tone is Hard to Quantize: Probing Discrete Speech Units in Mandarin and Yor\`ub\'a

author.name: Opeyemi Osakuade, Simon King

entry.summary: Demonstrates that discrete speech units from self-supervised models encode lexical tone poorly compared to segmental structure, with quantization being the primary bottleneck, shown across Mandarin and Yorùbá.

entry.title: Reasoning-Based Refinement of Unsupervised Text Clusters with LLMs

author.name: Tunazzina Islam

entry.summary: Proposes a reasoning-based framework using LLMs as semantic judges to refine unsupervised text clusters through coherence verification, redundancy adjudication, and label assignment, rather than as embedding generators.

entry.title: Tool Retrieval Bridge: Aligning Vague Instructions with Retriever Preferences via Bridge Model

author.name: Kunfeng Chen, Luyao Zhuang, Fei Liao, Juhua Liu, Jian Wang, Bo Du

entry.summary: Proposes a bridge model to align vague real-world user instructions with retriever preferences for tool retrieval, addressing the gap between academic benchmarks with detailed instructions and practical vague queries.

entry.title: Linear Representations of Hierarchical Concepts in Language Models

author.name: Masaki Sakata, Benjamin Heinzerling, Takumi Ito, Sho Yokoi, Kentaro Inui

entry.summary: Investigates how hierarchical relations are encoded in LM representations using linear transformations at different depths and domains, analyzing multi-token entities and cross-layer representations across domains.

entry.title: AfriVoices-KE: A Multilingual Speech Dataset for Kenyan Languages

author.name: Lilian Wanzare, Cynthia Amol, zekiel Maina, Nelson Odhiambo, Hope Kerubo, Leila Misula, Vivian Oloo, Rennish Mboya, Edwin Onkoba, Edward Ombui, Joseph Muguro, Ciira wa Maina, Andrew Kipkebut, Alfred Omondi Otom, Ian Ndung'u Kang'ethe, Angela Wambui Kanyi, Brian Gichana Omwenga

entry.summary: Presents AfriVoices-KE, a 3,000-hour multilingual speech dataset covering five Kenyan languages (Dholuo, Kikuyu, Kalenjin, Maasai, Somali) from 4,777 speakers. Includes both scripted and spontaneous speech across diverse demographics.

entry.title: SYN-DIGITS: A Synthetic Control Framework for Calibrated Digital Twin Simulation

author.name: Grace Jiarui Fan, Chengpiao Huang, Tianyi Peng, Kaizheng Wang, Yuhang Wu

entry.summary: Proposes SYN-DIGITS, a calibration framework for LLM-based persona simulation (digital twins) inspired by synthetic control methods from causal inference. Learns latent structure to align LLM predictions with human ground truth.

entry.title: Reasoning Graphs: Deterministic Agent Accuracy through Evidence-Centric Chain-of-Thought Feedback

author.name: Matthew Penaroza

entry.summary: Introduces reasoning graphs that persist an agent's per-evidence chain of thought as structured edges, enabling evidence-centric feedback for future queries. Unlike flat memory, enables traversal of prior evaluation edges for each evidence piece.

entry.title: Squeeze Evolve: Unified Multi-Model Orchestration for Verifier-Free Evolution

author.name: Monishwaran Maheswaran, Leon Lakhani, Zhongzhu Zhou, Shijia Yang, Junxiong Wang, Coleman Hooper, Yuezhou Hu, Rishabh Tiwari, Jue Wang, Harman Singh, Qingyang Wu, Yuqing Jian, Ce Zhang, Kurt Keutzer, Tri Dao, Xiaoxia Wu, Ben Athiwaratkun, James Zou, Chenfeng Xu

entry.summary: Introduces Squeeze Evolve, a multi-model orchestration framework for verifier-free evolutionary inference. Allocates stronger models to high-impact stages and cheaper models elsewhere, addressing both diversity collapse and cost efficiency.

entry.title: Rethinking Entropy Allocation in LLM-based ASR: Understanding the Dynamics between Speech Encoders and LLMs

author.name: Yuan Xie, Jiaqi Song, Guang Qiu, Xianliang Wang, Ming Lei, Jie Gao, Jie Wu

entry.summary: Revisits LLM-based ASR from an entropy allocation perspective, introducing metrics to characterize how training paradigms distribute entropy reduction between speech encoder and LLM. Proposes capability-boundary-aware multi-stage training.

entry.title: SOLAR: Communication-Efficient Model Adaptation via Subspace-Oriented Latent Adapter Reparametrization

author.name: Seyed Mahmoud Sajjadi Mohammadabadi, Xiaolong Ma, Lei Yang, Feng Yan, Junshan Zhang

entry.summary: Proposes SOLAR, a post-training compression framework for LoRA adapters that expresses each update as a linear combination of foundation model singular vectors with random perturbations. Reduces communication cost in federated/edge settings.

entry.title: SkillClaw: Let Skills Evolve Collectively with Agentic Evolver

author.name: Ziyu Ma, Shidong Yang, Yuxiang Ji, Xucong Wang, Yong Wang, Yiming Hu, Tongwen Huang, Xiangxiang Chu

entry.summary: Presents SkillClaw, a framework for collective skill evolution in multi-user LLM agent ecosystems. Converts cross-user interaction signals into reliable skill updates, enabling agents to improve with experience.

entry.title: KV Cache Offloading for Context-Intensive Tasks

author.name: Andrey Bocharnikov, Ivan Ermakov, Denis Kuznedelev, Vyacheslav Zhdanovskiy, Yegor Yershov

entry.summary: Studies KV cache offloading for context-intensive tasks (requiring extraction of large amounts of information from context). Creates Text2JSON benchmark and evaluates offloading approaches on tasks where prior evaluations showed insufficient coverage.

entry.title: Direct Segmentation without Logits Optimization for Training-Free Open-Vocabulary Semantic Segmentation

author.name: Jiahao Li, Yang Lu, Yachao Zhang, Fangyong Wang, Yuan Xie, Yanyun Qu

entry.summary: Proposes a training-free open-vocabulary semantic segmentation method that bypasses logits optimization by deriving an analytic solution directly for segmentation maps from vision-language features.

entry.title: WUTDet: A 100K-Scale Ship Detection Dataset and Benchmarks with Dense Small Objects

author.name: Junxiong Liang, Mengwei Bao, Tianxiang Wang, Xinggang Wang, An-An Liu, Ryan Wen Liu

entry.summary: Introduces WUTDet, a large-scale ship detection dataset with 100K images and 381K annotations across diverse maritime scenarios and challenging conditions like fog, rain, and low light.

entry.title: DSCA: Dynamic Subspace Concept Alignment for Lifelong VLM Editing

author.name: Gyanendra Das, Sai Satyam Jena

entry.summary: Proposes DSCA for lifelong VLM editing using dynamic subspace concept alignment, hypothesizing that editing instability comes from entangled concept representations in shared space.

entry.title: ABMAMBA: Multimodal Large Language Model with Aligned Hierarchical Bidirectional Scan for Efficient Video Captioning

author.name: Daichi Yashima, Shuhei Kurita, Yusuke Oda, Shuntaro Suzuki, Seitaro Otsuki, Komei Sugiura

entry.summary: Proposes ABMamba, a multimodal LLM using state-space models instead of transformers for efficient video captioning with linear computational complexity and aligned hierarchical bidirectional scan.

entry.title: EditCaption: Human-Aligned Instruction Synthesis for Image Editing via Supervised Fine-Tuning and Direct Preference Optimization

author.name: Xiangyuan Wang, Honghao Cai, Yunhao Bai, Tianze Zhou, Haohua Chen, Yao Hu, Xu Tang, Yibo Chen, Wei Zhu

entry.summary: Proposes EditCaption, a two-stage pipeline (SFT + DPO) to fix systematic errors in VLM-generated image editing instructions, finding that over 47% of baseline VLM instructions contain critical errors like orientation inconsistency.

entry.title: Fundus-R1: Training a Fundus-Reading MLLM with Knowledge-Aware Reasoning on Public Data

author.name: Yuchuan Deng, Qijie Wei, Kaiheng Qian, Jiazhen Liu, Zijie Xin, Bangxiang Lan, Jingyu Liu, Jianfeng Dong, Xirong Li

entry.summary: Introduces Fundus-R1, a reasoning-enhanced MLLM for fundus image understanding trained entirely on public data using RLVR, addressing the barrier of proprietary clinical data in ophthalmic AI.

entry.title: BLaDA: Bridging Language to Functional Dexterous Actions within 3DGS Fields

author.name: Fan Yang, Wenrui Chen, Guorun Yan, Ruize Liao, Wanjun Jia, Dongsheng Luo, Kailun Yang, Zhiyong Li, Yaonan Wang

entry.summary: Proposes BLaDA, a zero-shot framework for functional dexterous grasping that bridges language instructions to 3D Gaussian splat fields for interpretable manipulation through semantic-pose coupling.

entry.title: UniversalVTG: A Universal and Lightweight Foundation Model for Video Temporal Grounding

author.name: Joungbin An, Agrim Jain, Kristen Grauman

entry.summary: Presents UniversalVTG, a lightweight universal video temporal grounding model using cross-dataset pretraining with a Query Unifier that canonicalizes heterogeneous query formats to reduce linguistic mismatch.

entry.title: A Physical Agentic Loop for Language-Guided Grasping with Execution-State Monitoring

author.name: Wenze Wang, Mehdi Hosseinzadeh, Feras Dayoub

entry.summary: Reformulates language-guided robotic grasping as a bounded embodied agent loop with execution-state monitoring (Watchdog), enabling structured failure detection and retry for grasp primitives.

entry.title: WorldMAP: Bootstrapping Vision-Language Navigation Trajectory Prediction with Generative World Models

author.name: Hongjin Chen, Shangyun Jiang, Tonghua Su, Chen Gao, Xinlei Chen, Yong Li, Zhibo Chen

entry.summary: Proposes WorldMAP, a teacher-student framework that converts world model-generated futures into supervision for VLM-based trajectory prediction in vision-language navigation.

entry.title: When Switching Algorithms Helps: A Theoretical Study of Online Algorithm Selection

author.name: Denis Antipov, Carola Doerr
