entry.summary: Provides the first theoretical proof that online algorithm selection (switching between algorithms) can yield asymptotic speedups over any single algorithm, demonstrated on OneMax with (1+λ) EA and (1+λ,λ) GA.

entry.title: Planning Task Shielding: Detecting and Repairing Flaws in Planning Tasks through Turning them Unsolvable

author.name: Alberto Pozanco, Marianela Morales, Pietro Totis, Daniel Borrajo

entry.summary: Introduces planning task shielding — detecting and repairing flaws in planning tasks by making flawed states unreachable. Proposes an optimal algorithm that minimally modifies actions to render planning tasks unsolvable.

entry.title: Learning Debt and Cost-Sensitive Bayesian Retraining: A Forecasting Operations Framework

author.name: Harrison Katz

entry.summary: Defines 'learning debt' as divergence between deployed and updated Bayesian posteriors, and derives a one-step Bayes retraining rule. Shows debt-filter outperforms fixed calendar baselines for determining when to retrain models.

entry.title: Needle in a Haystack -- One-Class Representation Learning for Detecting Rare Malignant Cells in Computational Cytology

author.name: Swarnadip Chatterjee, Vladimir Basic, Arrigo Capitanio, Orcun Goksel, Joakim Lindblad

entry.summary: Explores one-class representation learning for detecting rare malignant cells in computational cytology, training only on normal cells to handle extreme class imbalance in whole-slide images.

entry.title: Reinforcement-Guided Synthetic Data Generation for Privacy-Sensitive Identity Recognition

author.name: Xuemei Jia, Jiawei Du, Hui Wei, Jun Chen, Joey Tianyi Zhou, Zheng Wang

entry.summary: Proposes a reinforcement-guided synthetic data generation framework for privacy-sensitive identity recognition that adapts general-domain generative priors to restricted data domains.

entry.title: Few-Shot Incremental 3D Object Detection in Dynamic Indoor Environments

author.name: Yun Zhu, Jianjun Qian, Jian Yang, Jin Xie, Na Zhao

entry.summary: Proposes FI3Det, a few-shot incremental 3D object detection framework that uses VLMs to learn unseen categories with minimal novel-class annotations in dynamic indoor environments.

entry.title: DinoRADE: Full Spectral Radar-Camera Fusion with Vision Foundation Model Features for Multi-class Object Detection in Adverse Weather

author.name: Christof Leitgeb, Thomas Puchleitner, Max Peter Ronecker, Daniel Watzenig

entry.summary: Presents DinoRADE, a radar-centered detection pipeline fusing dense radar tensors with DINOv2 vision features for multi-class object detection in adverse weather, specifically addressing VRU detection.

entry.title: SyncBreaker:Stage-Aware Multimodal Adversarial Attacks on Audio-Driven Talking Head Generation

author.name: Wenli Zhang, Xianglong Shi, Sirui Zhao, Xinqi Chen, Guo Cheng, Yifan Xu, Tong Xu, Yong Liao

entry.summary: Proposes SyncBreaker, a multimodal adversarial protection framework against diffusion-based talking-head generation that jointly perturbs portrait and audio inputs to prevent misuse like fraud.

entry.title: CrashSight: A Phase-Aware, Infrastructure-Centric Video Benchmark for Traffic Crash Scene Understanding and Reasoning

author.name: Rui Gan, Junyi Ma, Pei Li, Xingyou Yang, Kai Chen, Sikai Chen, Bin Ran

entry.summary: Presents CrashSight, a benchmark for traffic crash understanding from infrastructure-perspective video, with 250 crash videos and 13K QA pairs evaluating VLMs on safety-critical traffic scene reasoning.

entry.title: When Numbers Speak: Aligning Textual Numerals and Visual Instances in Text-to-Video Diffusion Models

author.name: Zhengyang Sun, Yu Chen, Xin Zhou, Xiaofan Li, Xiwu Chen, Dingkang Liang, Xiang Bai

entry.summary: Introduces NUMINA, a training-free framework for improving numerical alignment in text-to-video diffusion models by identifying and correcting prompt-layout inconsistencies through attention head analysis.

entry.title: ESOM: Efficiently Understanding Streaming Video Anomalies with Open-world Dynamic Definitions

author.name: Zihao Liu, Xiaoyu Wu, Wenna Li, Jianqin Wu, Linlin Yang

entry.summary: Proposes ESOM, a training-free efficient streaming model for open-world video anomaly detection with dynamic definitions, including definition normalization and context-aware processing.

entry.title: Bridging Time and Space: Decoupled Spatio-Temporal Alignment for Video Grounding

author.name: Xuezhen Tu, Jingyu Wu, Fangyu Kang, Qingpeng Nong, Kaijin Zhang, Chaoyue Niu, Fan Wu

entry.summary: Proposes Bridge-STG for spatio-temporal video grounding that decouples temporal and spatial localization to address entangled alignment and dual-domain visual token redundancy in MLLMs.

entry.title: 3DrawAgent: Teaching LLM to Draw in 3D with Early Contrastive Experience

author.name: Hongcan Xiao, Xinyue Xiao, Yilin Wang, Yue Zhang, Yonggang Qi

entry.summary: Introduces 3DrawAgent, a training-free framework using LLMs to generate 3D Bezier curve sketches via sequential drawing with geometric feedback, adapting GRPO for relative experience optimization.

entry.title: OV-Stitcher: A Global Context-Aware Framework for Training-Free Open-Vocabulary Semantic Segmentation

author.name: Seungjae Moon, Seunghyun Oh, Youngmin Ro

entry.summary: Proposes OV-Stitcher for training-free open-vocabulary semantic segmentation that stitches fragmented sub-image features from sliding-window processing to enable global context reasoning.

entry.title: Weakly-Supervised Lung Nodule Segmentation via Training-Free Guidance of 3D Rectified Flow

author.name: Richard Petersen, Fredrik Kahl, Jennifer Alv\'en

entry.summary: Proposes weakly-supervised lung nodule segmentation using training-free guidance of a 3D rectified flow model, requiring only image-level labels rather than expensive voxel-wise annotations.

entry.title: RoboAgent: Chaining Basic Capabilities for Embodied Task Planning

author.name: Peiran Xu, Jiaqi Zheng, Yadong Mu

entry.summary: Proposes RoboAgent, a capability-driven planning pipeline for embodied AI where a VLM agent actively invokes sub-capabilities, each maintaining its own context for multi-turn interaction and long-horizon reasoning.

entry.title: KD-MARL: Resource-Aware Knowledge Distillation in Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning

author.name: Monirul Islam Pavel, Siyi Hu, Muhammad Anwar Masum, Mahardhika Pratama, Ryszard Kowalczyk, Zehong Jimmy Cao

entry.summary: Proposes KD-MARL, a two-stage knowledge distillation framework for multi-agent RL that transfers coordinated behavior from centralized experts to lightweight decentralized agents, accounting for non-uniform agent capabilities.

entry.title: A-MBER: Affective Memory Benchmark for Emotion Recognition

author.name: Deliang Wen, Ke Sun, Yu Wang

entry.summary: Introduces A-MBER, a benchmark for evaluating whether AI can use remembered interaction history to interpret a user's present emotional state, bridging the gap between emotion datasets and memory benchmarks.

entry.title: VenusBench-Mobile: A Challenging and User-Centric Benchmark for Mobile GUI Agents with Capability Diagnostics

author.name: Yichen Gong, Zhuohan Cai, Sunhao Dai, Yuqi Zhou, Zhangxuan Gu, Changhua Meng, Shuheng Shen

entry.summary: Introduces VenusBench-Mobile, a challenging benchmark for mobile GUI agents with user-intent-driven task design and capability-oriented annotation for fine-grained agent behavior analysis.

entry.title: SensorPersona: An LLM-Empowered System for Continual Persona Extraction from Longitudinal Mobile Sensor Streams

author.name: Bufang Yang, Lilin Xu, Yixuan Li, Kaiwei Liu, Xiaofan Jiang, Zhenyu Yan

entry.summary: Introduces SensorPersona, an LLM-empowered system that continuously infers user personas from multimodal longitudinal mobile sensor data rather than chat histories, enabling richer personalization.

entry.title: Incentive-Aware Multi-Fidelity Optimization for Generative Advertising in Large Language Models

author.name: Jiayuan Liu, Barry Wang, Jiarui Gan, Tonghan Wang, Leon Xie, Mingyu Guo, Vincent Conitzer

entry.summary: Introduces IAMFM, a framework coupling VCG incentive mechanisms with multi-fidelity optimization for LLM-based generative advertising. Proposes Active Counterfactual Optimization for efficient payment computation.

entry.title: BiScale-GTR: Fragment-Aware Graph Transformers for Multi-Scale Molecular Representation Learning

author.name: Yi Yang, Ovidiu Daescu

entry.summary: Introduces BiScale-GTR, a framework for self-supervised molecular representation learning that combines chemically grounded fragment tokenization with adaptive multi-scale reasoning in Graph Transformers.

entry.title: From Load Tests to Live Streams: Graph Embedding-Based Anomaly Detection in Microservice Architectures

author.name: Srinidhi Madabhushi, Pranesh Vyas, Swathi Vaidyanathan, Mayur Kurup, Elliott Nash, Yegor Silyutin

entry.summary: Amazon Prime Video presents a graph-based anomaly detection system using GCN-GAE embeddings to identify service behaviors missed during load testing that appear during real live events like Thursday Night Football.

entry.title: TwinLoop: Simulation-in-the-Loop Digital Twins for Online Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning

author.name: Nan Zhang, Zishuo Wang, Shuyu Huang, Georgios Diamantopoulos, Nikos Tziritas, Panagiotis Oikonomou, Georgios Theodoropoulos

entry.summary: Proposes TwinLoop, a simulation-in-the-loop digital twin framework for online multi-agent RL, where digital twins perform accelerated policy improvement via what-if analysis before synchronizing to physical agents.

entry.title: ChemVLR: Prioritizing Reasoning in Perception for Chemical Vision-Language Understanding

author.name: Xuanle Zhao, Xinyuan Cai, Xiang Cheng, Xiuyi Chen, Bo Xu

entry.summary: Introduces ChemVLR, a chemical VLM that prioritizes reasoning within perception by explicitly identifying chemical descriptors (functional groups) before answering, producing interpretable reasoning chains.

entry.title: Evaluating Repository-level Software Documentation via Question Answering and Feature-Driven Development

author.name: Xinchen Wang, Ruida Hu, Cuiyun Gao, Pengfei Gao, Chao Peng

entry.summary: Introduces SWD-Bench, a benchmark for evaluating repository-level software documentation by measuring an LLM's ability to understand and implement functionalities using the documentation, rather than using LLM-as-a-judge.

entry.title: AgentCity: Constitutional Governance for Autonomous Agent Economies via Separation of Power

author.name: Anbang Ruan, Xing Zhang

entry.summary: Proposes AgentCity, a constitutional governance architecture for autonomous AI agent economies using blockchain-based separation of powers (legislative, executive, judicial) to prevent unchecked agent behavior.

entry.title: Mixed-Initiative Context: Structuring and Managing Context for Human-AI Collaboration

author.name: Haichang Li, Qinshi Zhang, Piaohong Wang, Zhicong Lu

entry.summary: Proposes Mixed-Initiative Context, a framework for structuring and managing context in human-AI collaboration that allows dynamic organization based on lifecycle, hierarchy, and relevance rather than flat chronological sequences.

entry.title: Contraction-Aligned Analysis of Soft Bellman Residual Minimization with Weighted Lp-Norm for Markov Decision Problem

author.name: Hyukjun Yang, Han-Dong Lim, Donghwan Lee

entry.summary: Analyzes soft Bellman residual minimization with weighted Lp-norm for MDPs under function approximation, showing how increasing p aligns the optimization with the contraction geometry of the Bellman operator. Derives performance error bounds for the generalized formulation.

entry.title: Multi-Turn Reasoning LLMs for Task Offloading in Mobile Edge Computing

author.name: Ning Yang, Chuangxin Cheng, Haijun Zhang

entry.summary: Uses multi-turn reasoning LLMs for task offloading decisions in mobile edge computing, applying RL fine-tuning to develop non-myopic policies that account for queue dynamics. Addresses limitations of both heuristics and standard DRL approaches.

entry.title: SL-FAC: A Communication-Efficient Split Learning Framework with Frequency-Aware Compression

author.name: Zehang Lin, Miao Yang, Haihan Zhu, Zheng Lin, Jianhao Huang, Jing Yang, Guangjin Pan, Dianxin Luan, Zihan Fang, Shunzhi Zhu, Wei Ni, John Thompson

entry.summary: Proposes SL-FAC for communication-efficient split learning using frequency-aware compression of activations and gradients. Combines adaptive frequency decomposition with frequency-based quantization to reduce transmission overhead in distributed training.

entry.title: A Generalized Sinkhorn Algorithm for Mean-Field Schr\"odinger Bridge

author.name: Asmaa Eldesoukey, Yongxin Chen, Abhishek Halder

entry.summary: Proposes a generalized Sinkhorn algorithm for mean-field Schrödinger bridges, designing minimum-effort controllers for diffusion processes with nonlocal interaction. Uses generalized Hopf-Cole transforms to solve the associated integro-PDEs.

entry.title: ExplainFuzz: Explainable and Constraint-Conditioned Test Generation with Probabilistic Circuits

author.name: Anna\"elle Baiget, Jaron Maene, Seongmin Lee, Benjie Wang, Guy Van den Broeck, Miryung Kim

entry.summary: ExplainFuzz introduces a test generation framework using Probabilistic Circuits to learn structured distributions over grammar-based test inputs, enabling interpretable and controllable fuzzing. It addresses limitations of existing approaches like grammar-based fuzzers, pCFGs, and LLMs in producing realistic, explainable test inputs.

entry.title: DDP-SA: Scalable Privacy-Preserving Federated Learning via Distributed Differential Privacy and Secure Aggregation

author.name: Wenjing Wei, Farid Nait-Abdesselam, Alla Jammine

entry.summary: DDP-SA combines client-side local differential privacy with additive secret sharing for federated learning, providing two-stage privacy protection through noise perturbation followed by secret share decomposition across multiple servers.

entry.title: A solver-in-the-loop framework for end-to-end differentiable coastal hydrodynamics

author.name: Elsa Cardoso-Bihlo, Alex Bihlo

entry.summary: AegirJAX is a fully differentiable hydrodynamic solver for coastal wave simulation built entirely within JAX's automatic differentiation framework, enabling gradient-based inverse problems like bathymetry estimation and source inversion.

entry.title: Beyond Loss Values: Robust Dynamic Pruning via Loss Trajectory Alignment

author.name: Huaiyuan Qin, Muli Yang, Gabriel James Goenawan, Kai Wang, Zheng Wang, Peng Hu, Xi Peng, Hongyuan Zhu

entry.summary: AlignPrune proposes a noise-robust dynamic data pruning module using Dynamic Alignment Score based on loss trajectories, enabling better identification of noisy samples and improving pruning effectiveness under label noise.

entry.title: EMSDialog: Synthetic Multi-person Emergency Medical Service Dialogue Generation from Electronic Patient Care Reports via Multi-LLM Agents

author.name: Xueren Ge, Sahil Murtaza, Anthony Cortez, Homa Alemzadeh

entry.summary: EMSDialog presents a multi-agent pipeline to generate synthetic multi-speaker EMS conversations from electronic patient care reports, producing 4,414 annotated dialogues with 43 diagnoses for conversational diagnosis prediction.

entry.title: AtomEval: Atomic Evaluation of Adversarial Claims in Fact Verification

author.name: Hongyi Cen, Mingxin Wang, Yule Liu, Jingyi Zheng, Hanze Jia, Tan Tang, Yingcai Wu

entry.summary: AtomEval introduces validity-aware evaluation of adversarial fact-checking rewrites by decomposing claims into subject-relation-object-modifier atoms, detecting factual corruption beyond surface similarity metrics.

entry.title: Rag Performance Prediction for Question Answering

author.name: Or Dado, David Carmel. Oren Kurland

entry.summary: Proposes methods to predict whether RAG will improve question answering performance before or after retrieval. A novel supervised predictor that models semantic relationships among question, passages, and generated answer achieves the best prediction quality. Useful for deciding when to use RAG vs. direct generation.

entry.title: PASK: Toward Intent-Aware Proactive Agents with Long-Term Memory

author.name: Zhifei Xie, Zongzheng Hu, Fangda Ye, Xin Zhang, Haobo Chai, Zihang Liu, Pengcheng Wu, Guibin Zhang, Yue Liao, Xiaobin Hu, Deheng Ye, Chunyan Miao, Shuicheng Yan

entry.summary: Introduces PASK, a framework for proactive AI agents with long-term memory that infers latent user needs from streaming context. Proposes DD-MM-PAS paradigm with streaming IntentFlow model and hybrid memory architecture.

entry.title: Can Vision Language Models Judge Action Quality? An Empirical Evaluation

author.name: Miguel Monte e Freitas, Rui Henriques, Ricardo Rei, Pedro Henrique Martins

entry.summary: Evaluates state-of-the-art VLMs on action quality assessment tasks across sports and fitness domains. Finds that even top models (Gemini 3.1 Pro, Qwen3-VL) perform only marginally above random chance on AQA.

entry.title: sciwrite-lint: Verification Infrastructure for the Age of Science Vibe-Writing

author.name: Sergey V Samsonau

entry.summary: Introduces sciwrite-lint, an open-source linter for scientific manuscripts that runs locally to verify citations, check claims, and detect AI-generated text. Positioned as a third quality assurance option between journal gatekeeping and open science.

entry.title: AVGen-Bench: A Task-Driven Benchmark for Multi-Granular Evaluation of Text-to-Audio-Video Generation

author.name: Ziwei Zhou, Zeyuan Lai, Rui Wang, Yifan Yang, Zhen Xing, Yuqing Yang, Qi Dai, Lili Qiu, Chong Luo

entry.summary: Introduces AVGen-Bench for text-to-audio-video generation evaluation with multi-granular framework combining specialist models and MLLMs. Covers 11 real-world categories with evaluation from perceptual quality to semantic controllability.

entry.title: Weight Group-wise Post-Training Quantization for Medical Foundation Model

author.name: Yineng Chen, Peng Huang, Aozhong Zhang, Hui Guo, Penghang Yin, Shu Hu, Shao Lin, Xin Li, Tzu-Jen Kao, Balakrishnan Prabhakaran, MingChing Chang, Xin Wang

entry.summary: Proposes Permutation-COMQ, a post-training quantization method for medical foundation models that uses weight-aware reordering and simple operations (dot products, rounding) to avoid backpropagation and hyperparameter tuning.

entry.title: FireSenseNet: A Dual-Branch CNN with Cross-Attentive Feature Interaction for Next-Day Wildfire Spread Prediction

author.name: Jinzhen Han, JinByeong Lee, Hak Han, YeonJu Na, Jae-Joon Lee

entry.summary: Proposes FireSenseNet, a dual-branch CNN for next-day wildfire spread prediction that explicitly separates static fuel/terrain features from dynamic weather conditions using a cross-attentive feature interaction module.

entry.title: Image-Guided Geometric Stylization of 3D Meshes

author.name: Changwoon Choi, Hyunsoo Lee, Cl\'ement Jambon, Yael Vinker, Young Min Kim

entry.summary: Proposes a geometric stylization framework that deforms 3D meshes to express the style of input images, using pre-trained diffusion models for abstract style representation with a coarse-to-fine pipeline.

entry.title: Shortcut Learning in Glomerular AI: Adversarial Penalties Hurt, Entropy Helps

author.name: Mohammad Daouk, Jan Ulrich Becker, Neeraja Kambham, Anthony Chang, Hien Nguyen, Chandra Mohan

entry.summary: Investigates shortcut learning in lupus nephritis glomerular classifiers, finding that stain is a major shortcut. Shows adversarial stain penalties hurt while entropy-based regularization helps.

entry.title: Rotation Equivariant Convolutions in Deformable Registration of Brain MRI

author.name: Arghavan Rezvani, Kun Han, Anthony T. Wu, Pooya Khosravi, Xiaohui Xie

entry.summary: Integrates rotation-equivariant convolutions into deformable brain MRI registration networks, demonstrating improved accuracy, better generalization to unseen datasets, and enhanced rotation robustness.

entry.title: Brain3D: EEG-to-3D Decoding of Visual Representations via Multimodal Reasoning

author.name: Emanuele Balloni, Emanuele Frontoni, Chiara Matti, Marina Paolanti, Roberto Pierdicca, Emiliano Santarnecchi

entry.summary: Proposes Brain3D for EEG-to-3D reconstruction, extending neural decoding from 2D images to 3D representations through progressive transformation with geometry-aware generative reasoning.

entry.title: PolySLGen: Online Multimodal Speaking-Listening Reaction Generation in Polyadic Interaction

author.name: Zhi-Yi Lin, Thomas Markhorst, Jouh Yeong Chew, Xucong Zhang

entry.summary: Proposes PolySLGen for online multimodal reaction generation in polyadic (group) interactions, generating both speaking and listening reactions including speech, body motion, and speaking state.

entry.title: Face-D(^2)CL: Multi-Domain Synergistic Representation with Dual Continual Learning for Facial DeepFake Detection

author.name: Yushuo Zhang, Yu Cheng, Yongkang Hu, Jiuan Zhou, Jiawei Chen, Yuan Xie, Zhaoxia Yin

entry.summary: Introduces Face-D²CL, a deepfake detection framework combining multi-domain (spatial + frequency) feature fusion with dual continual learning to address catastrophic forgetting as forgery techniques evolve.

entry.title: Revisiting Radar Perception With Spectral Point Clouds

author.name: Hamza Alsharif, Jing Gu, Pavol Jancura, Satish Ravindran, Gijs Dubbelman

entry.summary: Introduces spectral point clouds for radar perception, arguing that point clouds enriched with spectral information serve as strong, sensor-agnostic input representations that match or exceed dense spectra performance.

entry.title: OVS-DINO: Open-Vocabulary Segmentation via Structure-Aligned SAM-DINO with Language Guidance

author.name: Haoxi Zeng, Qiankun Liu, Yi Bin, Haiyue Zhang, Yujuan Ding, Guoqing Wang, Deqiang Ouyang, Heng Tao Shen

entry.summary: Proposes OVS-DINO for open-vocabulary segmentation, discovering that DINO's boundary awareness attenuates in deeper layers and designing structure-aligned features with SAM integration for precise edge perception.

entry.title: When Fine-Tuning Changes the Evidence: Architecture-Dependent Semantic Drift in Chest X-Ray Explanations

author.name: Kabilan Elangovan, Daniel Ting

entry.summary: Studies how fine-tuning changes visual evidence in medical image classifiers, defining 'semantic drift' as systematic shifts in attribution structure despite stable classification accuracy.

entry.title: FIT: A Large-Scale Dataset for Fit-Aware Virtual Try-On

author.name: Johanna Karras, Yuanhao Wang, Yingwei Li, Ira Kemelmacher-Shlizerman

entry.summary: Presents FIT, a large-scale dataset for fit-aware virtual try-on that includes garment and body size information, enabling models to realistically depict ill-fitting garments rather than always generating well-fitted results.

entry.title: The Principle of Maximum Heterogeneity Optimises Productivity in Distributed Production Systems Across Biology, Economics, and Computing

author.name: Guillhem Artis, Danyal Akarca, Jascha Achterberg

entry.summary: Proposes a 'Distributed Production System' model showing that agent heterogeneity optimizes productivity across biology, economics, and computing, unifying insights from comparative advantage, neural coding, and biodiversity.

entry.title: ATANT: An Evaluation Framework for AI Continuity

author.name: Samuel Sameer Tanguturi

entry.summary: Introduces ATANT, a framework for evaluating AI continuity — the ability to persist, update, and reconstruct context across time. Defines 7 required properties and a 10-checkpoint evaluation methodology with 250 narrative test stories.

entry.title: Implantable Adaptive Cells: A Novel Enhancement for Pre-Trained U-Nets in Medical Image Segmentation

author.name: Emil Benedykciuk, Marcin Denkowski, Grzegorz W\'ojcik

entry.summary: Introduces Implantable Adaptive Cells (IACs) — small NAS-identified modules injected into skip connections of pre-trained U-Nets to improve medical image segmentation without full retraining. Shows ~5 percentage point accuracy gains.

entry.title: EviSnap: Faithful Evidence-Cited Explanations for Cold-Start Cross-Domain Recommendation

author.name: Yingjun Dai, Ahmed El-Roby

entry.summary: Introduces EviSnap, a cold-start cross-domain recommender that provides evidence-cited explanations by construction, using LLM-distilled facet cards and a domain-agnostic concept bank.

entry.title: Front-End Ethics for Sensor-Fused Health Conversational Agents: An Ethical Design Space for Biometrics

author.name: Hansoo Lee, Rafael A. Calvo

entry.summary: Argues that sensor-fused LLM health agents create an 'illusion of objectivity' through biometric data that amplifies hallucination risks, and identifies a critical ethical gap at the front end where sensor data is translated into user-facing language.

entry.title: Tool-MCoT: Tool Augmented Multimodal Chain-of-Thought for Content Safety Moderation

author.name: Shutong Zhang, Dylan Zhou, Yinxiao Liu, Yang Yang, Huiwen Luo, Wenfei Zou

entry.summary: Introduces Tool-MCoT, a small language model fine-tuned on tool-augmented chain-of-thought data from LLMs for content safety moderation, showing that SLMs can learn to use external tools effectively for this task.

entry.title: Learning the Stellar Structure Equations via Self-supervised Physics-Informed Neural Networks

author.name: Manuel Ballester, Santiago Lopez-Tapia, Seth Gossage, Patrick Koller, Philipp M. Srivastava, Ugur Demir, Yongseok Jo, Almudena P. Marquez, Christoph Wuersch, Souvik Chakraborty, Vicky Kalogera, Aggelos Katsaggelos

entry.summary: Develops a self-supervised physics-informed neural network (PINN) to solve stellar structure equations, providing a mesh-free alternative to traditional solvers like MESA for large-scale stellar population synthesis. Could enable orders of magnitude speedup for astrophysical simulations.

entry.title: Bi-Level Optimization for Single Domain Generalization

author.name: Marzi Heidari, Hanping Zhang, Hao Yan, Yuhong Guo

entry.summary: Proposes BiSDG, a bi-level optimization framework for single domain generalization that decouples task learning from domain modeling using surrogate domains and feature-wise linear modulation.

entry.title: CubeGraph: Efficient Retrieval-Augmented Generation for Spatial and Temporal Data

author.name: Mingyu Yang, Wentao Li, Wei Wang

entry.summary: Proposes CubeGraph, a novel indexing framework that natively integrates vector search with spatial-temporal constraints for RAG systems, avoiding the fragmentation issues of nested index architectures.

entry.title: Restoring Heterogeneity in LLM-based Social Simulation: An Audience Segmentation Approach

author.name: Xiaoyou Qin, Zhihong Li, Xiaoxiao Cheng

entry.summary: Introduces audience segmentation as a systematic approach for restoring heterogeneity in LLM-based social simulations, comparing six segmentation configurations across two open-weight LLMs on climate opinion data.

entry.title: Fine-grained Approaches for Confidence Calibration of LLMs in Automated Code Revision

author.name: Hong Yi Lin, Chunhua Liu, Haoyu Gao, Patanamon Thongtanunam, Christoph Treude

entry.summary: Proposes fine-grained confidence calibration approaches for LLMs in automated code revision, addressing the need for instance-level calibrated scores that reflect likelihood of correctness.

entry.title: Sparse-Aware Neural Networks for Nonlinear Functionals: Mitigating the Exponential Dependence on Dimension

author.name: Jianfei Li, Shuo Huang, Han Feng, Ding-Xuan Zhou, Gitta Kutyniok

entry.summary: Proposes sparse-aware neural networks for learning nonlinear functionals over infinite-dimensional function spaces, using convolutional architectures for sparse feature extraction to mitigate the curse of dimensionality.

entry.title: KITE: Keyframe-Indexed Tokenized Evidence for VLM-Based Robot Failure Analysis

author.name: Mehdi Hosseinzadeh, King Hang Wong, Feras Dayoub

entry.summary: Presents KITE, a training-free front-end that converts long robot execution videos into compact tokenized evidence for VLMs, using keyframe extraction with bird's-eye-view representations for robot failure analysis.

entry.title: AV-SQL: Decomposing Complex Text-to-SQL Queries with Agentic Views

author.name: Minh Tam Pham, Trinh Pham, Tong Chen, Hongzhi Yin, Quoc Viet Hung Nguyen, Thanh Tam Nguyen

entry.summary: Introduces AV-SQL, a framework for complex Text-to-SQL that decomposes queries using agentic views, creating intermediate virtual tables to handle multi-step reasoning over large schemas.

entry.title: Flow Motion Policy: Manipulator Motion Planning with Flow Matching Models

author.name: Davood Soleymanzadeh, Xiao Liang, Minghui Zheng

entry.summary: Introduces Flow Motion Policy, an end-to-end neural motion planner for robotic manipulators using flow matching to model distributions over feasible paths, enabling multi-modal planning and inference-time optimization.

entry.title: Region-Graph Optimal Transport Routing for Mixture-of-Experts Whole-Slide Image Classification

author.name: Xin Tian, Jiuliu Lu, Ephraim Tsalik, Bart Wanders, Colleen Knoth, Julian Knight

entry.summary: Proposes ROAM, a Mixture-of-Experts approach for whole-slide image classification that uses optimal transport routing to achieve spatially-aware, balanced expert utilization in computational pathology.

entry.title: Syntax Is Easy, Semantics Is Hard: Evaluating LLMs for LTL Translation

author.name: Priscilla Kyei Danso, Mohammad Saqib Hasan, Niranjan Balasubramanian, Omar Chowdhury

entry.summary: Evaluates multiple LLMs' ability to translate natural language into Linear Temporal Logic (LTL) formulas, finding syntax generation is relatively easy but semantic correctness remains challenging.

entry.title: AE-ViT: Stable Long-Horizon Parametric Partial Differential Equations Modeling

author.name: Iva Miku\v{s}, Boris Muha, Domagoj Vlah

entry.summary: Introduces AE-ViT for stable long-horizon parametric PDE modeling, combining autoencoders with Vision Transformers. Addresses limitations of existing deep learning reduced-order models that struggle with long-range spatial interactions and difficulty evolving compressed latent representations.

entry.title: Lumbermark: Resistant Clustering by Chopping Up Mutual Reachability Minimum Spanning Trees

author.name: Marek Gagolewski

entry.summary: Introduces Lumbermark, a robust divisive clustering algorithm that iteratively chops limbs from mutual reachability minimum spanning trees. Positions as an alternative to HDBSCAN that produces user-specified partition sizes, with open-source implementation.

entry.title: Spatiotemporal Gaussian representation-based dynamic reconstruction and motion estimation framework for time-resolved volumetric MR imaging (DREME-GSMR)

author.name: Jiacheng Xie, Hua-Chieh Shao, Can Wu, Ricardo Otazo, Jie Deng, Mu-Han Lin, Tsuicheng Chiu, Jacob Buatti, Viktor Iakovenko, You Zhang

entry.summary: Develops DREME-GSMR for time-resolved volumetric MRI reconstruction using 3D Gaussian representations for anatomy and motion fields, enabling sub-second reconstruction for motion-adaptive radiotherapy without prior models.

entry.title: Holistic Optimal Label Selection for Robust Prompt Learning under Partial Labels

author.name: Yaqi Zhao, Haoliang Sun, Yating Wang, Yongshun Gong, Yilong Yin

entry.summary: HopS addresses prompt learning under partial labels by combining local density-based filtering with optimal transport-based global label selection to disambiguate partial labels for vision-language model adaptation.

entry.title: Energy-Regularized Spatial Masking: A Novel Approach to Enhancing Robustness and Interpretability in Vision Models

author.name: Tom Devynck Bilal Faye Djamel Bouchaffra Nadjib Lazaar Hanane Azzag Mustapha Lebbah

entry.summary: ERSM reformulates spatial feature selection in CNNs as a differentiable energy minimization problem, assigning scalar energies to visual tokens via unary importance costs and pairwise spatial coherence penalties for improved robustness and interpretability.

entry.title: Continuous-Time Dynamics of the Difference-of-Convex Algorithm

author.name: Yi-Shuai Niu

entry.summary: Analyzes the continuous-time structure of the difference-of-convex algorithm (DCA), showing classical DCA is an explicit Euler discretization in dual coordinates. Proves convergence rates under KL conditions and a global linear rate under a metric DC-PL inequality.

entry.title: DINO-QPM: Adapting Visual Foundation Models for Globally Interpretable Image Classification

author.name: Robert Zimmermann, Thomas Norrenbrock, Bodo Rosenhahn

entry.summary: DINO-QPM adapts the Quadratic Programming Enhanced Model to operate on frozen DINOv2 features, converting complex representations into contrastive, class-independent representations for globally interpretable image classification.

entry.title: Gaussian Approximation for Asynchronous Q-learning

author.name: Artemy Rubtsov, Sergey Samsonov, Vladimir Ulyanov, Alexey Naumov

entry.summary: Derives convergence rates for Polyak-Ruppert averaged asynchronous Q-learning with polynomial stepsizes, establishing high-dimensional CLT results for the algorithm's iterates.

entry.title: HCRE: LLM-based Hierarchical Classification for Cross-Document Relation Extraction with a Prediction-then-Verification Strategy

author.name: Guoqi Ma, Liang Zhang, Hongyao Tu, Hao Fu, Hui Li, Yujie Lin, Longyue Wang, Weihua Luo, Jinsong Su

entry.summary: HCRE applies hierarchical classification with a prediction-then-verification strategy for cross-document relation extraction using LLMs, addressing the challenge of numerous predefined relations that degrades LLM performance.

entry.title: Prune-Quantize-Distill: An Ordered Pipeline for Efficient Neural Network Compression

author.name: Longsheng Zhou, Yu Shen

entry.summary: Studies ordered compression pipeline (prune-quantize-distill) targeting measured CPU latency rather than parameter count or FLOPs. Shows INT8 quantization provides dominant runtime speedup while unstructured sparsity can fail to accelerate inference despite reducing storage.

entry.title: FORGE:Fine-grained Multimodal Evaluation for Manufacturing Scenarios

author.name: Xiangru Jian, Hao Xu, Wei Pang, Xinjian Zhao, Chengyu Tao, Qixin Zhang, Xikun Zhang, Chao Zhang, Guanzhi Deng, Alex Xue, Juan Du, Tianshu Yu, Garth Tarr, Linqi Song, Qiuzhuang Sun, Dacheng Tao

entry.summary: Introduces FORGE, a fine-grained multimodal evaluation benchmark for manufacturing combining 2D images and 3D point clouds. Evaluates 18 MLLMs on workpiece verification, surface inspection, and assembly verification, revealing significant gaps.

entry.title: Monocular Depth Estimation From the Perspective of Feature Restoration: A Diffusion Enhanced Depth Restoration Approach

author.name: Huibin Bai, Shuai Li, Hanxiao Zhai, Yanbo Gao, Chong Lv, Yibo Wang, Haipeng Ping, Wei Hua, Xingyu Gao

entry.summary: Proposes a diffusion-enhanced approach to monocular depth estimation that treats depth prediction as feature restoration, improving encoder features through a diffusion-based process.

entry.title: PanoSAM2: Lightweight Distortion- and Memory-aware Adaptions of SAM2 for 360 Video Object Segmentation

author.name: Dingwen Xiao, Weiming Zhang, Shiqi Wen, Lin Wang

entry.summary: Proposes PanoSAM2, lightweight adaptations of SAM2 for 360° video object segmentation addressing projection distortion, semantic inconsistency, and sparse memory issues.

entry.title: Tarot-SAM3: Training-free SAM3 for Any Referring Expression Segmentation

author.name: Weiming Zhang, Dingwen Xiao, Songyue Guo, Guangyu Xiang, Shiqi Wen, Minwei Zhao, Lei Chen, Lin Wang

entry.summary: Proposes Tarot-SAM3, a training-free framework for referring expression segmentation that addresses SAM3's limitations with long/implicit expressions through a confidence-aware fusion strategy.

entry.title: SAT: Selective Aggregation Transformer for Image Super-Resolution

author.name: Dinh Phu Tran, Thao Do, Saad Wazir, Seongah Kim, Seon Kwon Kim, Daeyoung Kim

entry.summary: Proposes Selective Aggregation Transformer (SAT) for image super-resolution that reduces key-value tokens by 97% through density-driven token aggregation while maintaining long-range dependency modeling.

entry.title: EEG2Vision: A Multimodal EEG-Based Framework for 2D Visual Reconstruction in Cognitive Neuroscience

author.name: Emanuele Balloni, Emanuele Frontoni, Chiara Matti, Marina Paolanti, Roberto Pierdicca, Emiliano Santarnecchi

entry.summary: Presents EEG2Vision, a framework for reconstructing visual stimuli from EEG across different electrode configurations (128-24 channels), enhanced by prompt-guided post-reconstruction boosting.

entry.title: Tensor-Augmented Convolutional Neural Networks: Enhancing Expressivity with Generic Tensor Kernels

author.name: Chia-Wei Hsing, Wei-Lin Tu

entry.summary: Proposes tensor-augmented CNN (TACNN) replacing convolution kernels with generic tensors motivated by quantum state representations for richer expressivity in shallow architectures.

entry.title: PrivFedTalk: Privacy-Aware Federated Diffusion with Identity-Stable Adapters for Personalized Talking-Head Generation

entry.title: CAFP: A Post-Processing Framework for Group Fairness via Counterfactual Model Averaging

author.name: Irina Ar\'evalo, Marcos Oliva

entry.title: Consistency-Guided Decoding with Proof-Driven Disambiguation for Three-Way Logical Question Answering

entry.title: Governing frontier general-purpose AI in the public sector: adaptive risk management and policy capacity under uncertainty through 2030

author.name: Fabio Correa Xavier

entry.summary: Argues that public governance for frontier AI should be based on adaptive risk management rather than static rules, discussing policy capacity under uncertainty through 2030.

entry.title: A Novel Automatic Framework for Speaker Drift Detection in Synthesized Speech

author.name: Jia-Hong Huang, Seulgi Kim, Yi Chieh Liu, Yixian Shen, Hongyi Zhu, Prayag Tiwari, Stevan Rudinac, Evangelos Kanoulas

entry.title: MorphDistill: Distilling Unified Morphological Knowledge from Pathology Foundation Models for Colorectal Cancer Survival Prediction

entry.title: SubFLOT: Submodel Extraction for Efficient and Personalized Federated Learning via Optimal Transport

author.name: Zheng Jiang, Nan He, Yiming Chen, Lifeng Sun

entry.title: Instance-Adaptive Parametrization for Amortized Variational Inference

entry.title: Information as Structural Alignment: A Dynamical Theory of Continual Learning

author.name: Radu Negulescu

entry.title: CSA-Graphs: A Privacy-Preserving Structural Dataset for Child Sexual Abuse Research

author.name: Carlos Caetano, Camila Laranjeira, Clara Ernesto, Artur Barros, Jo\~ao Macedo, Leo S. F. Ribeiro, Jefersson A. dos Santos, Sandra Avila

entry.title: Busemann energy-based attention for emotion analysis in Poincar\'e discs

entry.title: CASE: Cadence-Aware Set Encoding for Large-Scale Next Basket Repurchase Recommendation

author.name: Miguel A. DelaCruz, Patricia Mae Santos, Rafael T. Navarro

author.name: Andoni Irazusta Garmendia

entry.title: Mixture Proportion Estimation and Weakly-supervised Kernel Test for Conditional Independence

author.name: Yushi Hirose, Akito Narahara, Takafumi Kanamori

entry.summary: Proposes novel mixture proportion estimation assumptions based on conditional independence instead of irreducibility, with method of moments estimators and weakly-supervised kernel tests for validation.

entry.title: A Systematic Study of Retrieval Pipeline Design for Retrieval-Augmented Medical Question Answering

author.name: Nusrat Sultana, Abdullah Muhammad Moosa, Kazi Afzalur Rahman, Sajal Chandra Banik

entry.title: Beyond the Mean: Modelling Annotation Distributions in Continuous Affect Prediction

author.name: Kosmas Pinitas, Ilias Maglogiannis

entry.title: Efficient Provably Secure Linguistic Steganography via Range Coding

Advances the trade-off between embedding capacity and imperceptibility in language-model-based steganography.

entry.title: Graph Neural Networks for Misinformation Detection: Performance-Efficiency Trade-offs

author.name: Soveatin Kuntur, Maciej Krzywda, Anna Wr\'oblewska, Marcin Paprzycki, Maria Ganzha, Szymon {\L}ukasik, Amir H. Gandomi

entry.summary: Benchmarks graph neural networks against non-graph ML methods for misinformation detection across seven multilingual datasets, using identical TF-IDF features to isolate the impact of relational structure. Finds GNNs offer marginal F1 gains but at lower computational cost.

entry.title: An Agentic Evaluation Architecture for Historical Bias Detection in Educational Textbooks

author.name: Gabriel Stefan, Adrian-Marius Dumitran

entry.summary: Proposes an agentic architecture for detecting historical bias in educational textbooks, using a multimodal screening agent, five evaluative agents, and a meta-agent. Includes Source Attribution Protocol to prevent misattribution of quoted sources.

entry.title: What They Saw, Not Just Where They Looked: Semantic Scanpath Similarity via VLMs and NLP metric

author.name: Mohamed Amine Kerkouri, Marouane Tliba, Bin Wang, Aladine Chetouani, Ulas Bagci, Alessandro Bruno

entry.summary: Proposes a semantic scanpath similarity framework integrating VLMs into eye-tracking analysis. Encodes fixations as textual descriptions and computes similarity using NLP metrics, going beyond spatial/temporal alignment.

entry.title: Training-free Spatially Grounded Geometric Shape Encoding (Technical Report)

author.name: Yuhang He

entry.summary: Introduces XShapeEnc, a training-free encoding strategy for 2D geometric shapes that produces compact representations with five favorable properties including invertibility and adaptivity. Extends positional encoding concepts to spatial geometric shapes.

entry.title: Event-Level Detection of Surgical Instrument Handovers in Videos with Interpretable Vision Models

author.name: Katerina Katsarou, George Zountsas, Karam Tomotaki-Dawoud, Alexander Ehrenhoefer, Paul Chojecki, David Przewozny, Igor Maximilian Sauer, Amira Mouakher, Sebastian Bosse

entry.summary: Proposes a ViT+LSTM framework for detecting and classifying surgical instrument handovers in surgical videos, addressing occlusions and temporal dynamics in operating room settings.

entry.title: Beyond Pedestrians: Caption-Guided CLIP Framework for High-Difficulty Video-based Person Re-Identification

author.name: Shogo Hamano, Shunya Wakasugi, Tatsuhito Sato, Sayaka Nakamura

entry.summary: Proposes CG-CLIP, a caption-guided CLIP framework for video person re-identification in high-difficulty scenarios like sports and dance, using MLLM-generated captions for identity refinement.

entry.title: Cross-Modal Emotion Transfer for Emotion Editing in Talking Face Video

author.name: Chanhyuk Choi, Taesoo Kim, Donggyu Lee, Siyeol Jung, Taehwan Kim

entry.summary: Proposes cross-modal emotion transfer for editing emotions in talking face videos, enabling flexible emotion control by disentangling emotions from speech and leveraging multiple modalities.

entry.title: Beyond Mamba: Enhancing State-space Models with Deformable Dilated Convolutions for Multi-scale Traffic Object Detection

author.name: Jun Li, Yingying Shi, Zhixuan Ruan, Nan Guo, Jianhua Xu

entry.summary: Proposes MDDCNet combining Mamba with deformable dilated convolutions for multi-scale traffic object detection, addressing Mamba's limitations in capturing small objects with local details.

entry.title: Adapting Foundation Models for Annotation-Efficient Adnexal Mass Segmentation in Cine Images

author.name: Francesca Fati, Alberto Rota, Adriana V. Gregory, Anna Catozzo, Maria C. Giuliano, Mrinal Dhar, Luigi De Vitis, Annie T. Packard, Francesco Multinu, Elena De Momi, Carrie L. Langstraat, Timothy L. Kline

entry.summary: Adapts DINOv3 foundation model backbone with DPT decoder for annotation-efficient segmentation of adnexal masses in ultrasound cine images, requiring fewer pixel-level annotations.

entry.title: Generalization Under Scrutiny: Cross-Domain Detection Progresses, Pitfalls, and Persistent Challenges

author.name: Saniya M. Deshmukh, Kailash A. Hambarde, Hugo Proen\c{c}a

entry.summary: Comprehensive survey of cross-domain object detection (CDOD), providing a unified perspective on domain shift challenges and adaptation strategies across the detection pipeline.

entry.title: DBMF: A Dual-Branch Multimodal Framework for Out-of-Distribution Detection

author.name: Jiangbei Yue, Sharib Ali

entry.summary: Proposes DBMF, a dual-branch multimodal framework for out-of-distribution detection in clinical settings, combining text-image and vision branches to better identify OOD medical samples.

entry.title: MegaStyle: Constructing Diverse and Scalable Style Dataset via Consistent Text-to-Image Style Mapping

author.name: Junyao Gao, Sibo Liu, Jiaxing Li, Yanan Sun, Yuanpeng Tu, Fei Shen, Weidong Zhang, Cairong Zhao, Jun Zhang

entry.summary: Presents MegaStyle, a scalable pipeline for curating style datasets using consistent text-to-image style mapping, creating MegaStyle-1.4M and training a style encoder for expressive style representations.

entry.title: AgentGate: A Lightweight Structured Routing Engine for the Internet of Agents

author.name: Yujun Cheng, Enfang Cui, Hao Qin, Zhiyuan Liang, Qi Xu

entry.summary: Presents AgentGate, a lightweight routing engine for dispatching requests to specialized AI agents. Decomposes routing into action decision and structural grounding stages under latency, privacy, and cost constraints.

entry.title: Extracting Breast Cancer Phenotypes from Clinical Notes: Comparing LLMs with Classical Ontology Methods

author.name: Abdullah Bin Faiz, Arbaz Khan Shehzad, Asad Afzal, Momin Tariq, Muhammad Siddiqi, Muhammad Usamah Shahid, Maryam Noor Awan, Muddassar Farooq

entry.summary: Reports an LLM-based framework for extracting cancer phenotypes from unstructured oncology clinical notes, comparing with classical ontology-based methods for breast cancer data.

entry.title: From experimentation to engagement: on the paradox of participatory AI and power in contexts of forced displacement and humanitarian crises

author.name: Stella Suge (Executive Director, FilmAid Kenya), Sarah W. Spencer (Senior Researcher, The Distributed AI Research Institute), Nyalleng Moorosi (Senior Researcher, The Distributed AI Research Institute), Helen McElhinney (Executive Director, The CDAC Network), Geoff Loane (Chair, The CDAC Network), Sue Black (Professor of Computer Science, Technology Evangelist, Durham University)

entry.summary: Critically examines participatory AI methods in humanitarian crises and forced displacement contexts, arguing that power dynamics in these settings create unique challenges not addressed by standard participatory frameworks.

entry.title: GS-Surrogate: Deformable Gaussian Splatting for Parameter Space Exploration of Ensemble Simulations

author.name: Ziwei Li, Rumali Perera, Angus Forbes, Ken Moreland, Dave Pugmire, Scott Klasky, Wei-Lun Chao, Han-Wei Shen

entry.summary: Introduces GS-Surrogate, a deformable Gaussian Splatting-based visualization surrogate for parameter-space exploration of ensemble simulations, offering explicit 3D representations with interactive rendering.

entry.title: TeamLLM: A Human-Like Team-Oriented Collaboration Framework for Multi-Step Contextualized Tasks

author.name: Xiangyu Wang, Jin Wu, Haoran Shi, Wei Xia, Jiarui Yu, Chanjin Zheng

entry.summary: Proposes TeamLLM, a multi-LLM collaboration framework that emulates human team roles across four distinct positions with three-phase collaboration for multi-step contextualized tasks. Includes a new CGPST benchmark.

entry.title: AEROS: A Single-Agent Operating Architecture with Embodied Capability Modules

author.name: Xue Qin, Simin Luan, Cong Yang, Zhijun Li

entry.summary: Proposes AEROS, a single-agent robot operating architecture where capabilities are provided through installable Embodied Capability Modules (ECMs), formalizing robot identity and control authority.

entry.title: SMT-AD: a scalable quantum-inspired anomaly detection approach

author.name: Apimuk Sornsaeng, Si Min Chan, Wenxuan Zhang, Swee Liang Wong, Joshua Lim, Dario Poletti

entry.summary: Proposes SMT-AD, a quantum-inspired tensor network approach for anomaly detection using superposition of bond-dimension-1 matrix product operators with Fourier-assisted feature embedding.

entry.title: Bridging Theory and Practice in Crafting Robust Spiking Reservoirs

author.name: Ruggero Freddi, Nicolas Seseri, Diana Nigrisoli, Alessio Basti

entry.summary: Introduces the 'robustness interval' concept for spiking reservoir computing, measuring the hyperparameter range maintaining above-threshold performance. Shows consistent monotonic trends in robustness across network configurations for LIF architectures, bridging criticality theory and practical stability.

entry.title: Mining Electronic Health Records to Investigate Effectiveness of Ensemble Deep Clustering

author.name: Manar D. Samad, Yina Hou, Shrabani Ghosh

entry.summary: Investigates effectiveness of ensemble deep clustering vs traditional methods on EHR data for heart failure patient cohorts. Finds traditional clustering methods perform robustly because deep learning approaches designed for images differ substantially from EHR data characteristics.

entry.title: Adversarial Robustness of Time-Series Classification for Crystal Collimator Alignment

author.name: Xaver Fink, Borja Fernandez Adiego, Daniele Mirarchi, Eloise Matheson, Alvaro Garcia Gonzales, Gianmarco Ricci, Joost-Pieter Katoen

entry.summary: Analyzes adversarial robustness of a CNN used for crystal collimator alignment at CERN's LHC, formalizing local robustness properties and implementing preprocessing-aware adversarial wrappers for time-series classification.

entry.title: Splats under Pressure: Exploring Performance-Energy Trade-offs in Real-Time 3D Gaussian Splatting under Constrained GPU Budgets

author.name: Muhammad Fahim Tajwar, Arthur Wuhrlin, Bhojan Anand

entry.summary: Investigates real-time 3D Gaussian Splatting performance on edge devices by emulating different GPU tiers through frequency/power capping, analyzing power-performance tradeoffs across varying scene complexities.

entry.title: CAMO: A Class-Aware Minority-Optimized Ensemble for Robust Language Model Evaluation on Imbalanced Data

author.name: Mohamed Ehab (Faculty of Computer Science, October University for Modern Science & Arts, Giza, Egypt), Ali Hamdi (Faculty of Computer Science, October University for Modern Science & Arts, Giza, Egypt), Khaled Shaban (Department of Computer Science and Engineering, Qatar University, Doha, Qatar)

entry.summary: CAMO is an ensemble technique for imbalanced classification that dynamically boosts underrepresented classes through hierarchical vote distributions, confidence calibration, and inter-model uncertainty across language models.

entry.title: Behavior-Aware Item Modeling via Dynamic Procedural Solution Representations for Knowledge Tracing

author.name: Jun Seo, Sangwon Ryu, Heejin Do, Hyounghun Kim, Gary Geunbae Lee

entry.summary: Proposes BAIM framework for knowledge tracing that enriches item representations using LLM-generated procedural solution decompositions based on Polya's problem-solving stages. Captures dynamic behavioral signals beyond surface features.

entry.title: PeReGrINE: Evaluating Personalized Review Fidelity with User Item Graph Context

author.name: Steven Au, Baihan Lin

entry.summary: Introduces PeReGrINE, a benchmark for personalized review generation using graph-structured user-item evidence with temporal consistency. Computes User Style Parameters to represent persistent preferences.

entry.title: Object-Centric Stereo Ranging for Autonomous Driving: From Dense Disparity to Census-Based Template Matching

author.name: Qihao Huang

entry.summary: Presents a comprehensive stereo ranging system for autonomous driving integrating dense BM/SGM disparity, Census-based template matching, and monocular priors for long-range vehicle detection.

entry.title: EPIR: An Efficient Patch Tokenization, Integration and Representation Framework for Micro-expression Recognition

author.name: Junbo Wang, Liangyu Fu, Yuke Li, Yining Zhu, Xuecheng Wu, Kun Hu

entry.summary: Proposes EPIR framework for micro-expression recognition balancing performance and efficiency through dual norm shifted tokenization and efficient patch integration.

entry.title: MonoUNet: A Robust Tiny Neural Network for Automated Knee Cartilage Segmentation on Point-of-Care Ultrasound Devices

author.name: Alvin Kimbowa, Arjun Parmar, Ibrahim Mujtaba, Will Wei, Maziar Badii, Matthew Harkey, David Liu, Ilker Hacihaliloglu

entry.summary: Presents MonoUNet, an ultra-compact U-Net with monogenic feature extraction for automated knee cartilage segmentation on point-of-care ultrasound devices across multiple device types.

entry.title: Analysis of Search Heuristics in the Multi-Armed Bandit Setting

author.name: Jasmin Brandt, Barbara Hammer, Timo K\"otzing, Jurek Sander

entry.summary: Analyzes evolutionary algorithms in the dueling bandits setting, showing they are poor at identifying Condorcet winners, with runtime bounds suggesting fundamental exploration/exploitation limitations.

entry.title: TurboAgent: An LLM-Driven Autonomous Multi-Agent Framework for Turbomachinery Aerodynamic Design

author.name: Juan Du, Yueteng Wu, Pan Zhao, Yuze Liu, Min Zhang, Xiaobin Xu, Xinglong Zhang

entry.summary: Proposes TurboAgent, an LLM-driven multi-agent framework for turbomachinery aerodynamic design that coordinates specialized agents for geometry generation, performance prediction, optimization, and physics validation.

entry.title: EVGeoQA: Benchmarking LLMs on Dynamic, Multi-Objective Geo-Spatial Exploration

author.name: Jianfei Wu, Zhichun Wang, Zhensheng Wang, Zhiyu He

entry.summary: Introduces EVGeoQA, a benchmark for evaluating LLMs on dynamic geo-spatial exploration using EV charging scenarios with location-anchored, dual-objective queries.

entry.title: Harf-Speech: A Clinically Aligned Framework for Arabic Phoneme-Level Speech Assessment

author.name: Asif Azad, MD Sadik Hossain Shanto, Mohammad Sadat Hossain, Bdour Alwuqaysi, Sabri Boughorbel, Yahya Bokhari, Abdulrhman Aljouie, Ayah Othman Sindi, Ehsan Hoque

entry.summary: Presents Harf-Speech, a modular system for Arabic phoneme-level pronunciation assessment validated against certified speech-language pathologists, achieving strong correlation with clinical scores.

entry.title: The Human Condition as Reflected in Contemporary Large Language Models

author.name: W. Russell Neuman

entry.summary: Explores what LLMs reveal about human culture by analyzing parallel responses from six models, finding convergent themes including narrative meaning-making, affect-first cognition, coalition psychology, and moral rationalization.

entry.title: Code Sharing In Prediction Model Research: A Scoping Review

author.name: Thomas Sounack, Raffaele Giancotti, Catherine A. Gao, Lasai Barre\~nada, Hyeonhoon Lee, Hyung-Chul Lee, Leo Anthony Celi, Karel G. M. Moons, Gary S. Collins, Charlotta Lindvall, Tom Pollard

entry.summary: Scoping review of code-sharing practices in prediction model research citing TRIPOD guidelines, finding limited code availability and informing development of TRIPOD-Code reporting guidelines.

entry.title: FLeX: Fourier-based Low-rank EXpansion for multilingual transfer

author.name: Gaurav Narasimhan

entry.summary: Proposes FLeX, a Fourier-based regularization technique for LoRA fine-tuning to improve cross-lingual code generation transfer from Python to Java using Code Llama 7B. Compares Adam and Sophia optimizers on small datasets.

entry.title: MO-RiskVAE: A Multi-Omics Variational Autoencoder for Survival Risk Modeling in Multiple MyelomaMO-RiskVAE

author.name: Zixuan Chen, Heng Zhang, YuPeng Qin, WenPeng Xing, Qiang Wang, Da Wang, Changting Lin, Meng Han

entry.summary: Investigates latent modeling choices for multimodal survival prediction in multiple myeloma using variational autoencoders, systematically isolating regularization scale, posterior family, and aggregation strategy.

entry.title: DietDelta: A Vision-Language Approach for Dietary Assessment via Before-and-After Images

author.name: Gautham Vinod, Siddeshwar Raghavan, Bruce Coburn, Fengqing Zhu

entry.summary: Proposes a vision-language framework for food-item-level nutritional analysis using paired before-and-after eating images, estimating consumption by predicting weight differences from RGB images and natural language prompts.

entry.title: Continual Visual Anomaly Detection on the Edge: Benchmark and Efficient Solutions

author.name: Manuel Barusco, Francesco Borsatti, David Petrovic, Davide Dalle Pezze, Gian Antonio Susto

entry.summary: Benchmarks visual anomaly detection methods for edge deployment with continual learning, characterizing trade-offs between memory, inference cost, and detection performance under joint constraints.

entry.title: URMF: Uncertainty-aware Robust Multimodal Fusion for Multimodal Sarcasm Detection

author.name: Zhenyu Wang, Weichen Cheng, Weijia Li, Junjie Mou, Zongyou Zhao, Guoying Zhang

entry.summary: Proposes URMF, a framework for multimodal sarcasm detection that explicitly models modality reliability during fusion, addressing the problem of noisy or irrelevant visual content in social media posts.

entry.title: Digital Skin, Digital Bias: Uncovering Tone-Based Biases in LLMs and Emoji Embeddings

author.name: Mingchen Li, Wajdi Aljedaani, Yingjie Liu, Navyasri Meka, Xuan Lu, Xinyue Ye, Junhua Ding, Yunhe Feng

entry.summary: Presents the first large-scale comparative study of bias in skin-toned emoji representations across emoji embedding models and modern LLMs, revealing performance gaps and bias patterns.

author.name: Milad Moradi, Ke Yan, David Colwell, Rhona Asgari

entry.summary: Comprehensive empirical study on LoRA-based fine-tuning of multiple LLM families for automated test case generation from natural language requirements.

entry.title: Validated Intent Compilation for Constrained Routing in LEO Mega-Constellations

author.name: Yuanhang Li

entry.summary: Presents an end-to-end system for LEO mega-constellation routing that combines a GNN cost-to-go router with an LLM intent compiler that translates natural language constraints to routing specifications.

entry.title: CADENCE: Context-Adaptive Depth Estimation for Navigation and Computational Efficiency

author.name: Timothy K Johnsen, Marco Levorato

entry.summary: Presents CADENCE, an adaptive system that dynamically scales monocular depth estimation complexity based on navigation needs and environmental context for resource-constrained autonomous vehicles.

entry.title: Toward a Tractability Frontier for Exact Relevance Certification

author.name: Tristan Simas

entry.summary: Proves a meta-impossibility theorem for efficiently checkable structural predicates for exact relevance certification in coordinate-structured decision problems.

entry.title: A comparative analysis of machine learning models in SHAP analysis

author.name: Justin Lin, Julia Fukuyama

entry.summary: Compares machine learning models in SHAP analysis, examining how SHAP values and their interpretation vary across different model types. Provides insight into when SHAP analysis is reliable and how model choice affects explainability.

entry.title: Research Summary: April 09, 2026

author.name: AATF AI News Aggregator

entry.summary:
Today's research spotlights fundamental limitations in LLM reasoning and agentic RL, alongside major applied contributions in medical AI and efficient architectures.

  • RAGEN-2 (Fei-Fei Li, Yejin Choi et al.) identifies template collapse in RL-trained multi-turn agents—models produce input-agnostic reasoning that mimics diversity but fails to condition on observations
  • The Depth Ceiling tests GPT-5.4 and frontier models on latent multi-step planning, finding hard limits on reasoning depth without supervision
  • The Detection-Extraction Gap reveals 52–88% of chain-of-thought tokens are generated after the answer is already internally recoverable, quantifying massive reasoning inefficiency
  • The Illusion of Stochasticity demonstrates LLMs fundamentally cannot perform reliable stochastic sampling, a critical failure mode for agent deployment

MedGemma 1.5 from Google extends medical AI to 3D imaging (CT/MRI volumes, whole-slide histopathology). The ATOM Report documents Chinese open models (Qwen, DeepSeek) overtaking US models in global adoption. PoM (Polynomial Mixer) proposes a linear-complexity attention replacement with universal approximation guarantees.

  • LLM Spirals of Delusion reveals significant safety behavioral differences between API and chat interfaces—a critical methodological warning for evaluators
  • Fast-dVLM converts autoregressive VLMs to block-diffusion models for KV-cache-free parallel generation on edge devices
  • TraceSafe introduces the first benchmark evaluating safety guardrails on intermediate steps of multi-step tool-calling agent trajectories

Steiner, Can Kirmizibayrak, Daniel Golden

Shows significant gains including 11% improvement in 3D MRI classification.

entry.title: RAGEN-2: Reasoning Collapse in Agentic RL

author.name: Zihan Wang, Chi Gui, Xing Jin, Qineng Wang, Licheng Liu, Kangrui Wang, Shiqi Chen, Linjie Li, Zhengyuan Yang, Pingyue Zhang, Yiping Lu, Jiajun Wu, Li Fei-Fei, Lijuan Wang, Yejin Choi, Manling Li

entry.summary: Identifies 'template collapse' in RL-trained multi-turn LLM agents, where models produce input-agnostic reasoning that looks diverse but doesn't actually respond to different inputs. Proposes mutual information proxies to diagnose this failure mode that entropy metrics miss entirely.

entry.title: PoM: A Linear-Time Replacement for Attention with the Polynomial Mixer

author.name: David Picard, Nicolas Dufour, Lucas Degeorge, Arijit Ghosh, Davide Allegro, Tom Ravaud, Yohann Perron, Corentin Sautier, Zeynep Sonat Baltaci, Fei Meng, Syrine Kalleli, Marta L\'opez-Rauhut, Thibaut Loiseau, S\'egol\`ene Albouy, Raphael Baena, Elliot Vincent, Loic Landrieu

entry.title: Select-then-Solve: Paradigm Routing as Inference-Time Optimization for LLM Agents

author.name: Heng Zhou, Zelin Tan, Zhemeng Zhang, Yutao Fan, Yibing Lin, Li Kang, Xiufeng Song, Rui Li, Songtao Huang, Ao Yu, Yuchen Fan, Yanxu Chen, Kaixin Xu, Xiaohong Liu, Yiran Qin, Philip Torr, Chen Zhang, Zhenfei Yin

author.name: Yingwei Ma, Yue Liu, Xinlong Yang, Yanhao Li, Kelin Fu, Yibo Miao, Yuchong Xie, Zhexu Wang, Shing-Chi Cheung

entry.summary: Proposes scaling coding agents via 'atomic skills' — five fundamental capabilities (code localization, editing, unit-test generation, issue reproduction, code review) — trained with joint RL instead of composite task benchmarks, enabling better generalization.

entry.title: Broken by Default: A Formal Verification Study of Security Vulnerabilities in AI-Generated Code

author.name: Dominik Blain, Maxime Noiseux

entry.summary: Formal verification study of 3,500 code artifacts from seven LLMs finding 55.8% contain vulnerabilities proven via Z3 SMT solver witnesses. GPT-4o leads at 62.4% vulnerable artifacts.

entry.title: LLM Reasoning as Trajectories: Step-Specific Representation Geometry and Correctness Signals

author.name: Lihao Sun, Hang Dong, Bo Qiao, Qingwei Lin, Dongmei Zhang, Saravan Rajmohan

entry.summary: Shows that LLM chain-of-thought reasoning traverses functionally ordered, step-specific subspaces in representation space, with correct and incorrect solutions diverging systematically at late stages, enabling mid-reasoning correctness prediction (ROC-AUC 0.87).

entry.title: Spectral Edge Dynamics Reveal Functional Modes of Learning

author.name: Yongzhong Xu

entry.summary: Shows that training dynamics during grokking concentrate along spectral edge directions that standard interpretability tools miss, revealing low-dimensional functional modes. For modular addition, all leading directions collapse to a single Fourier mode.

entry.title: The Illusion of Superposition? A Principled Analysis of Latent Thinking in Language Models

author.name: Michael Rizvi-Martel, Guillaume Rabusseau, Marius Mosbach

entry.summary: Investigates whether language models actually leverage superposition (maintaining multiple candidate solutions simultaneously) when reasoning with latent chain-of-thought, testing across training-free, fine-tuned, and from-scratch regimes.

entry.title: Reason in Chains, Learn in Trees: Self-Rectification and Grafting for Multi-turn Agent Policy Optimization

author.name: Yu Li, Sizhe Tang, Tian Lan

entry.summary: T-STAR proposes a tree-structured framework for multi-turn LLM agent reinforcement learning that consolidates independent trajectories into a unified Cognitive Tree, enabling better credit assignment at critical reasoning steps. Addresses the sparse reward problem in multi-step agent tasks.

entry.title: WRAP++: Web discoveRy Amplified Pretraining

author.name: Jiang Zhou, Yunhao Wang, Xing Wu, Tinghao Yu, Feng Zhang

entry.summary: Proposes WRAP++, which improves LLM pretraining by discovering cross-document relationships via web hyperlinks and synthesizing joint QA over document pairs, going beyond single-document rephrasing.

entry.title: A Formal Security Framework for MCP-Based AI Agents: Threat Taxonomy, Verification Models, and Defense Mechanisms

author.name: Nirajan Acharya, Gaurav Kumar Gupta

entry.summary: MCPSHIELD provides the first unified formal security framework for MCP-based AI agents, including a threat taxonomy, verification models, and defense mechanisms for the rapidly adopted Model Context Protocol ecosystem.

entry.title: LLMs Should Express Uncertainty Explicitly

author.name: Junyu Guo, Shangding Gu, Ming Jin, Costas Spanos, Javad Lavaei

entry.summary: Proposes that LLMs should be trained to express uncertainty explicitly through two interfaces: global (verbalized confidence scores) and local (explicit markers during high-risk reasoning states). Shows both improve calibration and reduce errors.

entry.title: Attention Editing: A Versatile Framework for Cross-Architecture Attention Conversion

author.name: Zhen Cheng, Hao-Bo Yang, Wan-Yi Huang, Jin-Long Li

entry.summary: Attention Editing is a framework for converting pre-trained LLMs to use new attention architectures (MLA, sliding-window) without retraining from scratch, using a learnable adapter that replaces original attention modules.

entry.title: Personalized RewardBench: Evaluating Reward Models with Human Aligned Personalization

author.name: Qiyao Ma, Dechen Gao, Rui Cai, Boqi Zhao, Hanchu Zhou, Junshan Zhang, Zhe Zhao

entry.summary: Personalized RewardBench introduces a benchmark for evaluating reward models' ability to capture individual user preferences rather than aggregate quality, constructing preference pairs based on user-specific rubrics.

entry.title: On the Step Length Confounding in LLM Reasoning Data Selection

author.name: Bing Wang, Rui Miao, Chen Shen, Shaotian Yan, Kaiyuan Liu, Ximing Li, Xiaosong Yuan, Sinan Fan, Jun Zhang, Jieping Ye

entry.summary: Identifies a confounding factor in reasoning data selection: naturalness-based selection systematically prefers longer reasoning steps rather than higher-quality ones, and proposes a fix.

entry.title: A mathematical theory of evolution for self-designing AIs

author.name: Kenneth D Harris

entry.summary: Develops a mathematical model of evolution in self-designing AI systems, replacing random mutations with directed design trees. Models how current AI programs determine descendant design while human selection shapes population-level traits.

entry.title: Can Large Language Models Reinvent Foundational Algorithms?

author.name: Jian Zhao, Haoren Luo, Yu Wang, Yuhan Cao, Pingyue Sheng, Tianxing He

entry.summary: Tests whether LLMs can reinvent foundational algorithms (Dijkstra's, Euclid's) after targeted unlearning. Uses GRPO-based on-policy unlearning and finds models can partially reinvent algorithms with appropriate hints.

entry.title: Beyond Compromise: Pareto-Lenient Consensus for Efficient Multi-Preference LLM Alignment

author.name: Renxuan Tan, Rongpeng Li, Zhifeng Zhao, Honggang Zhang

entry.summary: Proposes Pareto-Lenient Consensus (PLC), a game-theoretic framework for aligning LLMs with multiple diverse human preferences simultaneously. It addresses limitations of existing multi-objective alignment methods that prematurely converge to conservative compromises by allowing transient local trade-offs to achieve better global Pareto improvements.

entry.title: Vintix II: Decision Pre-Trained Transformer is a Scalable In-Context Reinforcement Learner

author.name: Andrei Polubarov, Lyubaykin Nikita, Alexander Derevyagin, Artyom Grishin, Igor Saprygin, Aleksandr Serkov, Mark Averchenko, Daniil Tikhonov, Maksim Zhdanov, Alexander Nikulin, Ilya Zisman, Albina Klepach, Alexey Zemtsov, Vladislav Kurenkov

entry.summary: Extends Decision Pre-Trained Transformer (DPT) for in-context RL to multi-domain environments using Flow Matching, demonstrating scalability of Bayesian posterior sampling interpretation for training generalist agents that acquire tasks at inference time.

entry.title: Not All Turns Are Equally Hard: Adaptive Thinking Budgets For Efficient Multi-Turn Reasoning

author.name: Neharika Jali, Anupam Nayak, Gauri Joshi

entry.summary: Formulates multi-turn reasoning as a sequential compute allocation problem modeled as a multi-objective MDP. Proposes TAB (Turn-Adaptive Budgets) trained via GRPO to allocate thinking tokens across turns while respecting global per-problem constraints.

entry.title: 3DTurboQuant: Training-Free Near-Optimal Quantization for 3D Reconstruction Models

author.name: Jae Joong Lee

entry.summary: 3DTurboQuant shows that parameter vectors in 3D reconstruction models (3DGS, NeRF, DUSt3R) can be quantized using precomputed, data-independent Lloyd-Max codebooks after a random rotation, eliminating the need for per-scene fine-tuning. This is within 2.7x of the information-theoretic lower bound.

entry.title: SnapFlow: One-Step Action Generation for Flow-Matching VLAs via Progressive Self-Distillation

author.name: Wuyang Luan, Junhui Li, Weiguang Zhao, Wenjian Zhang, Tieru Wu, Rui Ma

entry.summary: SnapFlow compresses multi-step denoising in flow-matching VLA models (pi0, pi0.5, SmolVLA) into a single forward pass via self-distillation, eliminating 80% of inference latency from denoising steps in robotic manipulation.

entry.title: Toward Consistent World Models with Multi-Token Prediction and Latent Semantic Enhancement

author.name: Qimin Zhong, Hao Liao, Haiming Qin, Mingyang Zhou, Rui Mao, Wei Chen, Naipeng Chao

entry.summary: Provides theoretical analysis showing Multi-Token Prediction promotes convergent internal representations through gradient coupling, but reveals 'structural hallucinations' where discrete token supervision creates illegal shortcuts. Proposes latent semantic enhancement to address this.

entry.title: AdaBoost Does Not Always Cycle: A Computer-Assisted Counterexample

author.name: Erik Y. Wang

entry.summary: Provides a computer-assisted counterexample to the open COLT 2012 question of whether AdaBoost always converges to a finite cycle, using a block-product gadget with irrational asymptotic frequency. Certified by exact rational arithmetic. Developed with GPT-5.4 Pro and Claude Opus 4.6.

entry.title: The Stepwise Informativeness Assumption: Why are Entropy Dynamics and Reasoning Correlated in LLMs?

author.name: Mar Gonz\`alez I Catal\`a, Haitz S\'aez de Oc\'ariz Borde, George D. Monta\~nez, Pietro Li\`o

entry.summary: Formalizes why internal entropy dynamics in LLMs correlate with reasoning correctness through the Stepwise Informativeness Assumption (SIA), showing that correct reasoning prefixes accumulate answer-relevant information progressively.

entry.title: $k$-server-bench: Automating Potential Discovery for the $k$-Server Conjecture

author.name: Kirill Brilliantov, Etienne Bamas, Emmanuel Abb\'e

entry.summary: Introduces k-server-bench, a code-based challenge for automated mathematical discovery targeting the k-server conjecture, a central open problem in competitive analysis. The task is to discover potential functions satisfying linear inequality systems.

entry.title: How Long Reasoning Chains Influence LLMs' Judgment of Answer Factuality

author.name: Minzhu Tu, Shiyu Ni, Keping Bi

entry.summary: Investigates how exposing reasoning chains to LLM judges affects their factuality assessments. Finds that weak judges are easily swayed by reasoning chains while stronger judges benefit from them, revealing important dynamics in LLM-as-judge evaluation.

entry.title: Do We Need Distinct Representations for Every Speech Token? Unveiling and Exploiting Redundancy in Large Speech Language Models

author.name: Bajian Xiang, Tingwei Guo, Xuan Chen, Yang Han

entry.summary: Reveals structured redundancy in Large Speech Language Models where deep layers allow aggressive compression. Introduces Affinity Pooling, a training-free token merging mechanism that significantly reduces inference costs.

entry.title: OpenSpatial: A Principled Data Engine for Empowering Spatial Intelligence

author.name: Jianhui Liu, Haoze Sun, Wenbo Li, Yanbing Zhang, Rui Yang, Zhiliang Zhu, Yijun Yang, Shenghe Zheng, Nan Jiang, Jiaxiu Jiang, Haoyang Huang, Tien-Tsin Wong, Nan Duan, Xiaojuan Qi

entry.summary: Introduces OpenSpatial, an open-source data engine for generating high-quality spatial understanding data using 3D bounding boxes as primitives across five foundational spatial tasks.

entry.title: CODESTRUCT: Code Agents over Structured Action Spaces

author.name: Myeongsoo Kim, Joe Hsu, Dingmin Wang, Shweta Garg, Varun Kumar, Murali Krishna Ramanathan

entry.summary: Proposes CODESTRUCT, which reframes codebases as structured action spaces where agents operate on named AST entities rather than text spans. Improves Pass@1 by 1.2-5.0% on SWE-Bench Verified while reducing tokens by 12-38%.

entry.title: Label Effects: Shared Heuristic Reliance in Trust Assessment by Humans and LLM-as-a-Judge

author.name: Xin Sun, Di Wu, Sijing Qin, Isao Echizen, Abdallah El Ali, Saku Sugawara

entry.summary: Shows that both humans and LLM judges assign higher trust to content labeled as human-authored versus the same content labeled as AI-generated. Eye-tracking data reveals humans rely on source labels as heuristic cues, and LLM attention patterns mirror this bias.

entry.title: The Illusion of Latent Generalization: Bi-directionality and the Reversal Curse

author.name: Julian Coda-Forno, Jane X. Wang, Arslan Chaudhry

entry.summary: Extends evaluation of the reversal curse in LLMs, comparing bidirectional objectives including vanilla MLM. Finds that reversal accuracy requires explicit training signal making the source entity a prediction target, with little evidence for latent bidirectional generalization.

entry.title: Cactus: Accelerating Auto-Regressive Decoding with Constrained Acceptance Speculative Sampling

author.name: Yongchang Hao, Lili Mou

entry.summary: Proposes Cactus, a constrained acceptance speculative sampling method that formalizes the acceptance criterion through constrained optimization, allowing more tokens to be accepted than standard speculative sampling while maintaining output quality guarantees.

entry.title: On the Role of Fault Localization Context for LLM-Based Program Repair

author.name: Melika Sepidband, Hung Viet Pham, Hadi Hemmati

entry.summary: Large-scale empirical study on 500 SWE-bench instances examining how fault localization context affects LLM-based program repair. Finds file-level localization is the dominant factor (15-17x improvement), while more granular context doesn't consistently help.

entry.title: Social Dynamics as Critical Vulnerabilities that Undermine Objective Decision-Making in LLM Collectives

author.name: Changgeon Ko, Jisu Shin, Hoyun Song, Huije Lee, Eui Jun Hwang, Jong C. Park

entry.summary: Studies how social dynamics (conformity, perceived expertise, dominant speakers, rhetoric) undermine objective decision-making in LLM agent collectives, showing systematic accuracy decline under social pressure.

entry.title: ForkKV: Scaling Multi-LoRA Agent Serving via Copy-on-Write Disaggregated KV Cache

author.name: Shao Wang, Rui Ren, Lin Gui

entry.summary: Presents ForkKV, a serving system for multi-LoRA agent workflows that uses copy-on-write disaggregated KV cache to avoid redundant memory usage when multiple LoRA agents share the same context.

entry.title: Emergent decentralized regulation in a purely synthetic society

author.name: Md Motaleb Hossen Manik, Ge Wang

entry.summary: Studies emergent self-regulation in a purely synthetic AI agent society on Moltbook (agent-only social network), analyzing 39K posts by 14.5K agents using Directive Intensity metrics and finding corrective signaling patterns emerge without human intervention.

entry.title: Language Bias under Conflicting Information in Multilingual LLMs

author.name: Robert \"Ostling, Murathan Kurfal{\i}

entry.summary: Studies language bias in multilingual LLMs when processing conflicting information, finding all models (including GPT-5.2) confidently assert only one answer and show consistent bias toward English-language sources.

entry.title: Benchmarking LLM Tool-Use in the Wild

author.name: Peijie Yu, Wei Liu, Yifan Yang, Jinjian Li, Zelong Zhang, Xiao Feng, Feng Zhang

entry.summary: Introduces WildToolBench, a benchmark for LLM tool-use that captures real-world challenges including compositional tasks, implicit intent, and instruction transitions that existing benchmarks overlook.

entry.title: DISSECT: Diagnosing Where Vision Ends and Language Priors Begin in Scientific VLMs

author.name: Dikshant Kukreja, Kshitij Sah, Karan Goyal, Mukesh Mohania, Vikram Goyal

entry.summary: Introduces DISSECT, a 12,000-question diagnostic benchmark exposing the perception-integration gap in scientific VLMs where models can extract visual information but fail to reason about it.

entry.title: AI #163: Mythos Quest

author.name: Zvi

entry.summary: Zvi's weekly AI newsletter covering Claude Mythos launch, Project Glasswing (cybersecurity vulnerability patching), and the broader AI landscape. Mythos has discovered critical safety vulnerabilities in every major OS and browser.

entry.title: ClawsBench: Evaluating Capability and Safety of LLM Productivity Agents in Simulated Workspaces

author.name: Xiangyi Li, Kyoung Whan Choe, Yimin Liu, Xiaokun Chen, Chujun Tao, Bingran You, Wenbo Chen, Zonglin Di, Jiankai Sun, Shenghan Zheng, Jiajun Bao, Yuanli Wang, Weixiang Yan, Yiyuan Li, Han-chung Lee

entry.summary: Introduces ClawsBench, a benchmark for evaluating LLM productivity agents across five mock services (Gmail, Slack, Calendar, Docs, Drive) with 44 structured tasks covering single-service, cross-service, and safety-critical scenarios with deterministic state management.

entry.title: TRACE: Capability-Targeted Agentic Training

author.name: Hangoo Kang, Tarun Suresh, Jon Saad-Falcon, Azalia Mirhoseini
