entry.summary: Introduces TRACE, a system for environment-specific agent self-improvement that identifies capability deficits by contrasting successful and failed trajectories, then generates targeted training environments to address those specific weaknesses.

entry.title: ETR: Entropy Trend Reward for Efficient Chain-of-Thought Reasoning

author.name: Xuan Xiong, Huan Liu, Li Gu, Zhixiang Chi, Yue Qiu, Yuanhao Yu, Yang Wang

entry.summary: Proposes Entropy Trend Reward (ETR), which encourages progressive uncertainty reduction in chain-of-thought reasoning rather than simply penalizing length or reducing global entropy. Shows that dominant downward entropy trends correlate with shorter, more efficient CoTs.

entry.title: MARL-GPT: Foundation Model for Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning

author.name: Maria Nesterova, Mikhail Kolosov, Anton Andreychuk, Egor Cherepanov, Oleg Bulichev, Alexey Kovalev, Konstantin Yakovlev, Aleksandr Panov, Alexey Skrynnik

entry.summary: Proposes MARL-GPT, a single GPT-based foundation model trained on expert trajectories (up to 1B) across diverse MARL environments including StarCraft, Google Research Football, and POGEMA, achieving competitive performance without task-specific tuning.

entry.title: Epistemic Blinding: An Inference-Time Protocol for Auditing Prior Contamination in LLM-Assisted Analysis

author.name: Michael Cuccarese

entry.summary: Introduces 'epistemic blinding,' an inference-time protocol that replaces entity names with anonymous codes before prompting LLMs to distinguish data-driven inference from memorized priors. Applied to drug target prioritization, it provides a practical method for auditing prior contamination in LLM-assisted analysis.

entry.title: Phase-Associative Memory: Sequence Modeling in Complex Hilbert Space

author.name: Gowrav Vishwakarma, Christopher J. Agostino

entry.summary: Proposes Phase-Associative Memory (PAM), a recurrent sequence model using complex-valued representations and matrix-state outer-product associations. At ~100M parameters, achieves perplexity within 10% of a matched transformer on WikiText-103.

entry.title: Beyond LLM-as-a-Judge: Deterministic Metrics for Multilingual Generative Text Evaluation

author.name: Firoj Alam, Gagan Bhatia, Sahinur Rahman Laskar, Shammur Absar Chowdhury

entry.summary: Proposes OmniScore, a family of deterministic learned metrics (<1B parameters) trained on ~564K instances in 107 languages that approximate LLM-judge behavior for evaluating generated text, addressing cost and reproducibility issues with LLM-as-judge.

entry.title: Exemplar Retrieval Without Overhypothesis Induction: Limits of Distributional Sequence Learning in Early Word Learning

author.name: Jon-Paul Cacioli

entry.summary: Tests whether autoregressive transformers can learn second-order generalizations (overhypotheses) about word meaning from distributional data alone. Finds models achieve perfect first-order exemplar retrieval but zero second-order generalization, suggesting distributional learning alone is insufficient.

entry.title: What Models Know, How Well They Know It: Knowledge-Weighted Fine-Tuning for Learning When to Say "I Don't Know"

author.name: Joosung Lee, Hwiyeol Jo, Donghyeon Ko, Kyubyung Chae, Cheonbok Park, Jeonghoon Kim

entry.summary: Proposes knowledge-weighted fine-tuning that estimates instance-level knowledge scores via multi-sampled inference, scaling learning signals by existing knowledge and teaching models to say 'I don't know' for out-of-scope queries.

entry.title: The Model Agreed, But Didn't Learn: Diagnosing Surface Compliance in Large Language Models

author.name: Xiaojie Gu, Ziying Huang, Weicong Hong, Jian Xie, Renze Lou, Kai Zhang

entry.summary: Diagnoses 'surface compliance' in LLM knowledge editing — where models appear to accept edits on standard benchmarks but haven't genuinely internalized the new knowledge, using a simple diagnostic framework with probing under varied conditions.

entry.title: Neural Computers

author.name: Mingchen Zhuge, Changsheng Zhao, Haozhe Liu, Zijian Zhou, Shuming Liu, Wenyi Wang, Ernie Chang, Gael Le Lan, Junjie Fei, Wenxuan Zhang, Yasheng Sun, Zhipeng Cai, Zechun Liu, Yunyang Xiong, Yining Yang, Yuandong Tian, Yangyang Shi, Vikas Chandra, J\"urgen Schmidhuber

entry.summary: Proposes Neural Computers (NCs), a new paradigm that unifies computation, memory, and I/O in a learned runtime state, aiming to make the model itself a running computer. Studies whether NC primitives can be learned from I/O traces alone.

entry.title: OmniTabBench: Mapping the Empirical Frontiers of GBDTs, Neural Networks, and Foundation Models for Tabular Data at Scale

author.name: Dihong Jiang, Ruoqi Cao, Zhiyuan Dang, Li Huang, Qingsong Zhang, Zhiyu Wang, Shihao Piao, Shenggao Zhu, Jianlong Chang, Zhouchen Lin, Qi Tian

entry.summary: Introduces OmniTabBench, the largest tabular benchmark (3030 datasets) for evaluating GBDTs, neural networks, and foundation models. Conducts large-scale empirical evaluation revealing nuanced performance patterns across model families.

entry.title: On the Price of Privacy for Language Identification and Generation

author.name: Xiaoyu Li, Andi Han, Jiaojiao Jiang, Junbin Gao

entry.summary: Establishes fundamental privacy-utility tradeoffs for differentially private language identification and generation, showing that approximate DP with constant epsilon recovers non-private rates while pure DP degrades exponents by min{1,epsilon}.

entry.title: Foundry: Template-Based CUDA Graph Context Materialization for Fast LLM Serving Cold Start

author.name: Xueshen Liu, Yongji Wu, Yuncheng Yao, Danyang Zhuo, Ion Stoica, Z. Morley Mao

entry.summary: Presents Foundry, a system for fast LLM serving cold start by enabling template-based CUDA graph context materialization, reducing startup from tens of seconds to seconds for autoscaling scenarios.

entry.title: Dynamic Context Evolution for Scalable Synthetic Data Generation

author.name: Ryan Lingo, Rajeev Chhajer

entry.summary: Introduces Dynamic Context Evolution (DCE), a framework addressing 'cross-batch mode collapse' in synthetic data generation from LLMs, where independent prompting leads to repetitive outputs. Uses verbalized tail sampling, semantic memory, and contrastive reframing to maintain diversity.

entry.title: MoRight: Motion Control Done Right

author.name: Shaowei Liu, Xuanchi Ren, Tianchang Shen, Huan Ling, Saurabh Gupta, Shenlong Wang, Sanja Fidler, Jun Gao

entry.summary: MoRight introduces a framework for motion-controlled video generation that disentangles camera and object motion and models motion causality (actions triggering coherent reactions), addressing two fundamental limitations of existing methods.

entry.title: Multi-objective Evolutionary Merging Enables Efficient Reasoning Models

author.name: Mario Iacobelli, Adrian Robert Minut, Tommaso Mencattini, Donato Crisostomi, Andrea Santilli, Iacopo Masi, Emanuele Rodol\`a

entry.summary: Evo-L2S uses multi-objective evolutionary model merging to optimize the trade-off between reasoning accuracy and output length in Long-to-Short reasoning, finding Pareto-optimal model merges that outperform fixed-hyperparameter approaches.

entry.title: To Lie or Not to Lie? Investigating The Biased Spread of Global Lies by LLMs

author.name: Zohaib Khan, Mustafa Dogan, Ifeoma Okoh, Pouya Sadeghi, Siddhartha Shrestha, Sergius Justus Nyah, Mahmoud O. Mokhiamar, Michael J. Ryan, Tarek Naous

entry.summary: GlobalLies introduces a multilingual dataset of 440 misinformation templates across 8 languages and 195 countries, showing LLMs generate more misinformation about lower-resource countries, revealing systematic geographic bias.

entry.title: StructKV: Preserving the Structural Skeleton for Scalable Long-Context Inference

author.name: Zhirui Chen, Peiyang Liu, Ling Shao

entry.summary: StructKV proposes structure-aware KV cache compression that preserves global information hub tokens across network depth rather than relying on local saliency at a single layer, addressing a systematic flaw in existing compression methods.

entry.title: The AI Skills Shift: Mapping Skill Obsolescence, Emergence, and Transition Pathways in the LLM Era

author.name: Rudra Jadhav, Janhavi Danve

entry.summary: Introduces the Skill Automation Feasibility Index (SAFI), benchmarking LLMs across 263 tasks spanning O*NET skills taxonomy, and proposes an AI Impact Matrix classifying skills by displacement risk and augmentation potential.

entry.title: MTA-Agent: An Open Recipe for Multimodal Deep Search Agents

author.name: Xiangyu Peng, Can Qin, An Yan, Xinyi Yang, Zeyuan Chen, Ran Xu, Chien-Sheng Wu

entry.summary: Proposes MTA-Agent for constructing multi-hop vision-language training data using tool-augmented evidence retrieval and verification, producing structured question-answer trajectories for deep search agents.

entry.title: The Geometry of Forgetting

author.name: Sambartha Ray Barman, Andrey Starenky, Sophia Bodnar, Nikhil Narasimhan, Ashwin Gopinath

entry.summary: Shows that high-dimensional embedding spaces with noise and interference reproduce quantitative signatures of human memory (power-law forgetting, false memories) without phenomenon-specific engineering, suggesting forgetting arises from geometry rather than biology alone.

entry.title: Squeez: Task-Conditioned Tool-Output Pruning for Coding Agents

author.name: \'Ad\'am Kov\'acs

entry.summary: Introduces Squeez, a task-conditioned tool-output pruning method for coding agents that fine-tunes a small model (Qwen 3.5 2B) to identify relevant evidence blocks, removing 92% of input tokens while maintaining 0.86 recall.

entry.title: Walk the Talk: Bridging the Reasoning-Action Gap for Thinking with Images via Multimodal Agentic Policy Optimization

author.name: Wenhao Yang, Yu Xia, Jinlong Huang, Shiyin Lu, Qing-Guo Chen, Zhao Xu, Weihua Luo, Kaifu Zhang, Yuchen Zhou, Xiaobo Xia, Yuanyu Wan, Lijun Zhang, Tat-Seng Chua

entry.summary: Introduces Multimodal Agentic Policy Optimization (MAPO) that addresses the reasoning-action gap in MLLMs that think with images. Identifies that textual plausibility can mask executive failure in visual tool use during multi-turn reasoning.

entry.title: PaperOrchestra: A Multi-Agent Framework for Automated AI Research Paper Writing

author.name: Yiwen Song, Yale Song, Tomas Pfister, Jinsung Yoon

entry.summary: Introduces PaperOrchestra, a multi-agent framework for automated AI research paper writing from unstructured materials, plus PaperWritingBench, a benchmark of 200 reverse-engineered papers from top conferences. Includes literature synthesis and visual generation.

entry.title: Attribution Bias in Large Language Models

author.name: Eliza Berman, Bella Chang, Daniel B. Neill, Emily Black

entry.summary: Introduces AttriBench, the first fame- and demographically-balanced quote attribution benchmark, and evaluates 11 LLMs finding large systematic disparities in attribution accuracy across race, gender, and intersectional groups.

entry.title: LatentAudit: Real-Time White-Box Faithfulness Monitoring for Retrieval-Augmented Generation with Verifiable Deployment

author.name: Zhe Yu, Wenpeng Xing, Meng Han

entry.summary: Introduces LatentAudit, a white-box faithfulness auditor for RAG systems that measures Mahalanobis distance of mid-to-late residual-stream activations to evidence representations. Requires no auxiliary judge model and runs at generation time.

entry.title: TFRBench: A Reasoning Benchmark for Evaluating Forecasting Systems

author.name: Md Atik Ahamed, Mihir Parmar, Palash Goyal, Yiwen Song, Long T. Le, Qiang Cheng, Chun-Liang Li, Hamid Palangi, Jinsung Yoon, Tomas Pfister

entry.summary: Introduces TFRBench, the first benchmark for evaluating reasoning capabilities of forecasting systems, with a multi-agent framework for synthesizing numerically grounded reasoning traces across ten datasets in five domains. Authors include Google researchers.

entry.title: PRISM-MCTS: Learning from Reasoning Trajectories with Metacognitive Reflection

author.name: Siyuan Cheng, Bozhong Tian, YanChao Hao, Zheng Wei

entry.summary: Proposes PRISM-MCTS, which enhances Monte Carlo Tree Search for LLM reasoning by introducing metacognitive reflection that connects rollout outcomes across trajectories rather than treating each as isolated. Accepted at ACL 2026 Findings.

entry.title: Claw-Eval: Toward Trustworthy Evaluation of Autonomous Agents

author.name: Bowen Ye, Rang Li, Qibin Yang, Yuanxin Liu, Linli Yao, Hanglong Lv, Zhihui Xie, Chenxin An, Lei Li, Lingpeng Kong, Qi Liu, Zhifang Sui, Tong Yang

entry.summary: Introduces Claw-Eval, a comprehensive evaluation suite for autonomous agents with 300 human-verified tasks across 9 categories. Addresses three gaps: trajectory-opaque grading, underspecified safety evaluation, and narrow modality coverage, using three independent evidence channels.

entry.title: Self-Supervised Foundation Model for Calcium-imaging Population Dynamics

author.name: Xinhong Xu, Yimeng Zhang, Qichen Qian, Yuanlong Zhang

entry.summary: Proposes CalM, a self-supervised foundation model for calcium imaging neural data that uses a high-performance tokenizer and dual-axis autoregressive transformer to model dependencies across neurons and time, adaptable to forecasting and decoding tasks.

entry.title: This Treatment Works, Right? Evaluating LLM Sensitivity to Patient Question Framing in Medical QA

author.name: Hye Sun Yun, Geetika Kapoor, Michael Mackert, Ramez Kouzy, Wei Xu, Junyi Jessy Li, Byron C. Wallace

entry.summary: Systematically evaluates LLM sensitivity to patient question framing in medical QA settings, examining how positive vs. negative framing and technical vs. plain language affect responses even when grounded in the same evidence through RAG.

entry.title: $\pi^2$: Structure-Originated Reasoning Data Improves Long-Context Reasoning Ability of Large Language Models

author.name: Quyet V. Do, Thinh Pham, Nguyen Nguyen, Sha Li, Pratibha Zunjare, Tu Vu

entry.summary: Proposes π², a pipeline for curating reasoning data from structured tables to improve long-context reasoning in LLMs. Generates multi-hop analytical questions verified through dual-path code execution, with back-translated reasoning traces.

entry.title: Planning to Explore: Curiosity-Driven Planning for LLM Test Generation

author.name: Alfonso Amayuelas, Firas Laakom, Piotr Pi\k{e}kos, Wenyi Wang, Yifan Xu, Yuhui Wang, J\"urgen Schmidhuber, William Wang

entry.summary: Proposes CovQValue, a curiosity-driven planning approach for LLM-based test generation that treats the program's branch structure as an unknown environment and uses Bayesian exploration principles to reach deep branches requiring multi-step setup.

entry.title: Learning What Matters: Dynamic Dimension Selection and Aggregation for Interpretable Vision-Language Reward Modeling

author.name: Qiyuan Chen, Hongsen Huang, Jiahe Chen, Qian Shao, Jintai Chen, Hongxia Xu, Renjie Hua, Chuan Ren, Jian Wu

entry.summary: VL-MDR proposes a vision-language reward model that dynamically decomposes evaluation into 21 interpretable dimensions (e.g., Hallucination, Reasoning) using a visual-aware gating mechanism, bridging the gap between interpretable-but-slow generative and fast-but-opaque discriminative reward models.

entry.title: Foundations for Agentic AI Investigations from the Forensic Analysis of OpenClaw

author.name: Jan Gruber, Jan-Niclas Hilgert

entry.summary: First systematic forensic analysis of an agentic AI system (OpenClaw), examining what traces are recoverable from agent interactions and proposing a forensic framework for investigating AI agent behavior.

entry.title: Rectified Schr\"odinger Bridge Matching for Few-Step Visual Navigation

author.name: Wuyang Luan, Junhui Li, Weiguang Zhao, Wenjian Zhang, Tieru Wu, Rui Ma

entry.summary: Rectified Schrödinger Bridge Matching (RSBM) enables few-step visual navigation by bridging maximum-entropy stochastic transport and deterministic optimal transport through a shared velocity-field structure, reducing integration steps for real-time robotic control.

entry.title: Hackers or Hallucinators? A Comprehensive Analysis of LLM-Based Automated Penetration Testing

author.name: Jiaren Peng, Zeqin Li, Chang You, Yan Wang, Hanlin Sun, Xuan Tian, Shuqiao Zhang, Junyi Liu, Jianguo Zhao, Renyang Liu, Haoran Ou, Yuqiang Sun, Jiancheng Zhang, Yutong Jiao, Kunshu Song, Chao Zhang, Fan Shi, Hongda Sun, Rui Yan, Cheng Huang

entry.summary: First Systematization of Knowledge (SoK) for LLM-based automated penetration testing, reviewing frameworks across six dimensions and conducting large-scale empirical evaluation, finding significant hallucination issues and overreliance on prior knowledge.

entry.title: Polynomial-Time Algorithm for Thiele Voting Rules with Voter Interval Preferences

author.name: Pasin Manurangsi, Krzysztof Sornat

entry.summary: Presents a polynomial-time algorithm for computing optimal committees under Thiele voting rules when voters have interval preferences, resolving a 10-year-old open problem from IJCAI 2015.

entry.title: Does Pass Rate Tell the Whole Story? Evaluating Design Constraint Compliance in LLM-based Issue Resolution

author.name: Kai Yu, Zhenhao Zhou, Junhao Zeng, Ying Wang, Xueying Du, Zhiqiang Yuan, Junwei Liu, Ziyu Zhou, Yujia Wang, Chong Wang, Xin Peng

entry.summary: Introduces design-aware issue resolution evaluation that goes beyond test pass rates to measure compliance with project-specific design constraints (architecture conventions, error-handling policies) mined from real pull requests.

entry.title: Drifting Fields are not Conservative

author.name: Leonard Franz, Sebastian Hoffmann, Georg Martius

entry.summary: Proves that drift fields in one-step generative models are generally not conservative (not gradients of any scalar potential), with the Gaussian kernel being the unique exception. Proposes a 'sharp kernel' normalization that restores conservatism.

entry.title: Distributed Interpretability and Control for Large Language Models

author.name: Dev Arpan Desai, Shaoyi Huang, Zining Zhu

entry.summary: Presents a practical implementation of activation-level interpretability (logit lens) and steering vectors that scales to multi-GPU LLMs, reducing activation memory by 7x and increasing throughput by 41x. Tested on LLaMA-3.1 and Qwen-3 models.

entry.title: Improving Robustness In Sparse Autoencoders via Masked Regularization

author.name: Vivek Narayanaswamy, Kowshik Thopalli, Bhavya Kailkhura, Wesam Sakla

entry.summary: Proposes masking-based regularization for sparse autoencoders used in mechanistic interpretability, addressing feature absorption where general features are subsumed by specific ones. Improves OOD robustness.

entry.title: SHAPE: Stage-aware Hierarchical Advantage via Potential Estimation for LLM Reasoning

author.name: Zhengyang Ai, Zikang Shan, Xiaodong Ai, Jingxian Tang, Hangkai Hu, Pinyan Lu

entry.summary: Introduces SHAPE, a process supervision framework for LLM reasoning that uses stage-aware hierarchical advantage estimation based on empirical solvability. Prioritizes efficient breakthroughs in low-potential states at segment level and uses entropy-driven redistribution at token level.

entry.title: Diffusion Processes on Implicit Manifolds

author.name: Victor Kawasaki-Borruat, Clara Grotehans, Pierre Vandergheynst, Adam Gosztolai

entry.summary: Develops data-driven stochastic differential equations for performing intrinsic diffusion on manifolds using only point cloud data, without requiring charts or projections. Shows convergence guarantees as sample size grows.

entry.title: Weakly Supervised Distillation of Hallucination Signals into Transformer Representations

author.name: Shoaib Sadiq Salehmohamed, Jinal Prashant Thakkar, Hansika Aredla, Shaik Mohammed Omar, Shalmali Ayachit

entry.summary: Introduces a weak supervision framework to distill hallucination detection signals into LLM internal representations, enabling detection from activations alone at inference without external verification. Achieves 87.8% accuracy on probing.

entry.title: FedSpy-LLM: Towards Scalable and Generalizable Data Reconstruction Attacks from Gradients on LLMs

author.name: Syed Irfan Ali Meerza, Feiyi Wang, Jian Liu

entry.summary: Proposes FedSpy-LLM, a scalable gradient-based data reconstruction attack against federated LLMs using parameter-efficient fine-tuning, extending attacks to handle large batches, long sequences, and multiple architectures.

entry.title: Revisiting Fairness Impossibility with Endogenous Behavior

author.name: Elizabeth Maggie Penn, John W. Patty

entry.summary: Revisits algorithmic fairness impossibility results by incorporating endogenous behavioral responses to classification stakes, showing that when people adjust behavior based on classification consequences, classic impossibility results may not hold.

entry.title: Beyond Pessimism: Offline Learning in KL-regularized Games

author.name: Yuheng Zhang, Claire Chen, Nan Jiang

entry.summary: Develops a pessimism-free algorithm for offline learning in KL-regularized two-player zero-sum games, achieving the first O(1/n) sample complexity bound, improving over the prior O(1/sqrt(n)) rate.

entry.title: NestPipe: Large-Scale Recommendation Training on 1,500+ Accelerators via Nested Pipelining

author.name: Zhida Jiang, Zhaolong Xing, Huichao Chai, Tianxing Sun, Qiang Peng, Baopeng Yuan, Jiaxing Wang, Hua Du, Zhixin Wu, Xuemiao Li, Yikui Cao, Xinyu Liu, Yongxiang Feng, Zhen Chen, Ke Zhang

entry.summary: Presents NestPipe, a large-scale decentralized framework for training trillion-parameter recommendation models on 1500+ accelerators, using nested pipelining to overcome embedding lookup and communication bottlenecks.

entry.title: ReDAct: Uncertainty-Aware Deferral for LLM Agents

author.name: Dzianis Piatrashyn, Nikita Kotelevskii, Kirill Grishchenkov, Nikita Glazkov, Ivan Nasonov, Ilya Makarov, Timothy Baldwin, Preslav Nakov, Roman Vashurin, Maxim Panov

entry.summary: Proposes ReDAct, a dual-LLM agent framework where a cheap small model handles default actions and defers to an expensive large model when uncertainty exceeds a calibrated threshold, balancing cost and reliability.

entry.title: Measurement of Generative AI Workload Power Profiles for Whole-Facility Data Center Infrastructure Planning

author.name: Roberto Vercellino (National Laboratory of the Rockies), Jared Willard (National Laboratory of the Rockies), Gustavo Campos (National Laboratory of the Rockies), Weslley da Silva Pereira (National Laboratory of the Rockies), Olivia Hull (National Laboratory of the Rockies), Matthew Selensky (National Laboratory of the Rockies), Juliane Mueller (National Laboratory of the Rockies)

entry.summary: Presents methodology for measuring power consumption of generative AI workloads (training, fine-tuning, inference) at 0.1-second resolution on H100 GPUs, linking workload profiles to whole-facility energy planning.

entry.title: Blending Human and LLM Expertise to Detect Hallucinations and Omissions in Mental Health Chatbot Responses

author.name: Khizar Hussain, Bradley A. Malin, Zhijun Yin, Susannah Leigh Rose, Murat Kantarcioglu

entry.summary: Proposes a framework combining human expertise with LLMs to detect hallucinations and omissions in mental health chatbot responses, showing that LLM judges alone achieve only 52% accuracy on this domain.

entry.title: STDec: Spatio-Temporal Stability Guided Decoding for dLLMs

author.name: Yuzhe Chen, Jiale Cao, Xuyang Liu, Jin Xie, Aiping Yang, Yanwei Pang

entry.summary: STDec proposes spatio-temporal stability guided decoding for diffusion LLMs, exploiting the observation that decoded tokens show spatial and temporal consistency patterns across denoising steps.

entry.title: ART: Attention Replacement Technique to Improve Factuality in LLMs

author.name: Ziqin Luo, Yihao Quan, Xiaofeng Zhang, Xiaosong Yuan, Chen Shen

entry.summary: ART analyzes attention patterns across LLM layers and finds shallow layers use uniform attention leading to hallucinations. Proposes replacing these uniform patterns with more focused attention to improve factuality.

entry.title: State-of-the-Art Arabic Language Modeling with Sparse MoE Fine-Tuning and Chain-of-Thought Distillation

author.name: Navan Preet Singh, Anurag Garikipati, Ahmed Abulkhair, Jyani Akshay Jagdishbhai, Atul Yaduvanshi, Amarendra Chaudhary, Madalina Ciobanu, Qingqing Mao, Ritankar Das

entry.summary: Arabic-DeepSeek-R1 is an Arabic LLM using sparse MoE with four-phase CoT distillation, achieving new SOTA across the entire Open Arabic LLM Leaderboard, surpassing GPT-5.1 on grammar benchmarks.

entry.title: Learning to Interrupt in Language-based Multi-agent Communication

author.name: Danqing Wang, Da Yin, Ruta Desai, Lei Li, Asli Celikyilmaz, Ansong Ni

entry.summary: Proposes an interruptible communication framework for multi-agent LLM systems where listening agents can interrupt verbose speakers, training a lightweight interrupt classifier to reduce computational costs while maintaining performance.

entry.title: Feedback Adaptation for Retrieval-Augmented Generation

author.name: Jihwan Bang, Seunghan Yang, Kyuhong Shim, Simyung Chang, Juntae Lee, Sungha Choi

entry.summary: Introduces feedback adaptation as a problem setting for RAG systems, proposing correction lag and post-feedback performance metrics to measure how effectively corrective feedback propagates to future queries.

entry.title: Cognitive Loop of Thought: Reversible Hierarchical Markov Chain for Efficient Mathematical Reasoning

author.name: Jia-Chen Zhang, Zheng Zhou, Yu-Jie Xiong

entry.summary: Proposes CLoT, a chain-of-thought framework based on Reversible Hierarchical Markov Chains that addresses memorylessness and limited backward reasoning in existing Markov chain-based CoT compression methods.

entry.title: AGSC: Adaptive Granularity and Semantic Clustering for Uncertainty Quantification in Long-text Generation

author.name: Guanran Luo, Wentao Qiu, Wanru Zhao, Wenhan Lv, Zhongquan Jian, Meihong Wang, Qingqiang Wu

entry.summary: Proposes AGSC, an uncertainty quantification framework for long-form LLM generation that uses adaptive granularity and GMM-based semantic clustering, distinguishing irrelevance from genuine uncertainty.

entry.title: MedDialBench: Benchmarking LLM Diagnostic Robustness under Parametric Adversarial Patient Behaviors

author.name: Xiaotian Luo, Xun Jiang, Jiangcheng Wu

entry.summary: Introduces MedDialBench, a benchmark for testing LLM diagnostic robustness against graded adversarial patient behaviors across five dimensions with dose-response characterization.

entry.title: Say Something Else: Rethinking Contextual Privacy as Information Sufficiency

author.name: Yunze Xiao, Wenkai Li, Xiaoyuan Wu, Ningshan Ma, Yueqi Song, Weihao Xuan

entry.summary: Formalizes privacy-preserving LLM communication as an Information Sufficiency task, introduces free-text pseudonymization as a strategy beyond suppression/generalization, and proposes conversational evaluation.

entry.title: Argus: Reorchestrating Static Analysis via a Multi-Agent Ensemble for Full-Chain Security Vulnerability Detection

author.name: Zi Liang, Qipeng Xie, Jun He, Bohuan Xue, Weizheng Wang, Yuandao Cai, Fei Luo, Boxian Zhang, Haibo Hu, Kaishun Wu

entry.summary: Presents Argus, a multi-agent system that reorchestrates static analysis by integrating LLMs with existing SAST tools for full-chain security vulnerability detection, reducing false positives and hallucinations.

entry.title: How Much LLM Does a Self-Revising Agent Actually Need?

author.name: Seongwoo Jeong, Seonil Son

entry.summary: Studies what part of LLM agent competence comes from the LLM vs explicit structure by introducing a declarative reflective runtime protocol that externalizes agent state, evaluated on Collaborative Battleship.

entry.title: Evolution of Video Generative Foundations

author.name: Teng Hu, Jiangning Zhang, Hongrui Huang, Ran Yi, Zihan Su, Jieyu Weng, Zhucun Xue, Lizhuang Ma, Ming-Hsuan Yang, Dacheng Tao

entry.summary: Comprehensive survey of video generation foundations from GANs through diffusion models to world models, covering proprietary (Sora, Veo3) and open-source systems with a unified taxonomy.

entry.title: FlowInOne:Unifying Multimodal Generation as Image-in, Image-out Flow Matching

author.name: Junchao Yi, Rui Zhao, Jiahao Tang, Weixian Lei, Linjie Li, Qisheng Su, Zhengyuan Yang, Lijuan Wang, Xiaofeng Zhu, Alex Jinpeng Wang

entry.summary: Presents FlowInOne, a framework that reformulates all multimodal generation (text-to-image, layout-guided, editing, etc.) as a purely visual flow matching pipeline where all inputs are converted to visual prompts.

entry.title: GenLCA: 3D Diffusion for Full-Body Avatars from In-the-Wild Videos

author.name: Yiqian Wu, Rawal Khirodkar, Egor Zakharov, Timur Bagautdinov, Lei Xiao, Zhaoen Su, Shunsuke Saito, Xiaogang Jin, Junxuan Li

entry.summary: Presents GenLCA, a diffusion-based model for generating photorealistic full-body avatars from text and images, trained on millions of real-world videos using a pretrained avatar reconstruction model as an animatable 3D tokenizer.

entry.title: Excerpts and Notes on Mythos Model Card

author.name: williawa

entry.summary: Detailed excerpts and analysis of the Claude Mythos model card, covering capabilities (n=18 survey on drop-in replacement potential), hallucination improvements, and safety evaluations.

entry.title: IntentScore: Intent-Conditioned Action Evaluation for Computer-Use Agents

author.name: Rongqian Chen, Yu Li, Zeyu Fang, Sizhe Tang, Weidong Cao, Tian Lan

entry.summary: Proposes IntentScore, a plan-aware reward model trained on 398K offline GUI interaction steps across three operating systems to score candidate actions for computer-use agents. Uses contrastive alignment and margin ranking, achieving 97.5% pairwise accuracy.

entry.title: Graph of Skills: Dependency-Aware Structural Retrieval for Massive Agent Skills

author.name: Dawei Li, Zongxia Li, Hongyang Du, Xiyang Wu, Shihang Gui, Yongbei Kuang, Lichao Sun

entry.summary: Presents Graph of Skills (GoS), a structural retrieval system for large agent skill libraries that constructs dependency-aware skill graphs offline and retrieves bounded subgraphs at inference time, reducing context window saturation and hallucination.

entry.title: Auditable Agents

author.name: Yi Nian, Aojie Yuan, Haiyue Zhang, Jiate Li, Yue Zhao

entry.summary: Introduces a framework for auditable AI agents, defining five dimensions of agent auditability (action recoverability, lifecycle coverage, policy checkability, responsibility traceability, and one more) and distinguishing accountability from auditability.

entry.title: HybridKV: Hybrid KV Cache Compression for Efficient Multimodal Large Language Model Inference

author.name: Bowen Zeng, Feiyang Ren, Jun Zhang, Xiaoling Gu, Ke Chen, Lidan Shou, Huan Li

entry.summary: Proposes HybridKV, a KV cache compression method for multimodal LLMs that addresses heterogeneous attention behaviors across tokens, layers, and heads with a hybrid compression strategy going beyond fixed budget allocation.

entry.title: TDA-RC: Task-Driven Alignment for Knowledge-Based Reasoning Chains in Large Language Models

author.name: Jiaquan Zhang, Qigan Sun, Chaoning Zhang, Xudong Wang, Zhenzhen Huang, Yitian Zhou, Pengcheng Zheng, Chi-lok Andy Tai, Sung-Ho Bae, Zeyu Ma, Caiyan Qin, Jinyu Guo, Yang Yang, Hengtao Shen

entry.summary: Proposes TDA-RC, a method that uses persistent homology (topological data analysis) to embed effective reasoning patterns from expensive multi-round paradigms (ToT, GoT) into lightweight single-round Chain-of-Thought prompting.

entry.title: Synthetic Trust Attacks: Modeling How Generative AI Manipulates Human Decisions in Social Engineering Fraud

author.name: Muhammad Tahir Ashraf

entry.summary: Proposes Synthetic Trust Attacks (STAs) as a formal threat category and introduces STAM, an eight-stage operational framework modeling how generative AI enables social engineering fraud at scale, motivated by real incidents like the $25M Hong Kong deepfake fraud.

entry.title: PRIME: Prototype-Driven Multimodal Pretraining for Cancer Prognosis with Missing Modalities

author.name: Kai Yu, Shuang Zhou, Yiran Song, Zaifu Zhan, Jie Peng, Kaixiong Zhou, Tianlong Chen, Feng Xie, Meng Wang, Huazhu Fu, Mingquan Lin, Rui Zhang

entry.summary: Proposes PRIME, a missing-aware multimodal self-supervised pretraining framework for cancer prognosis that handles partially observed clinical cohorts by mapping heterogeneous modality embeddings into a unified token space with a shared prototype memory bank.

entry.title: EffiPair: Improving the Efficiency of LLM-generated Code with Relative Contrastive Feedback

author.name: Samira Hajizadeh, Suman Jana

entry.summary: Proposes EffiPair with Relative Contrastive Feedback (RCF), an inference-time framework that improves LLM code efficiency by comparing pairs of similar programs and highlighting efficiency-relevant differences, requiring no model fine-tuning.

entry.title: AI and Collective Decisions: Strengthening Legitimacy and Losers' Consent

author.name: Suyash Fulay, Prerna Ravi, Emily Kubin, Shrestha Mohanty, Michiel Bakker, Deb Roy

entry.summary: This paper explores how AI can support procedural legitimacy in collective decision-making, particularly 'losers' consent' — whether participants who don't get their preferred outcome still accept it as fair. They built a system using AI interviews and interactive visualizations.

entry.title: Who Governs the Machine? A Machine Identity Governance Taxonomy (MIGT) for AI Systems Operating Across Enterprise and Geopolitical Boundaries

author.name: Andrew Kurtz, Klaudia Krawiecka

entry.summary: Introduces the Machine Identity Governance Taxonomy (MIGT) for AI systems, addressing the critical gap where machine identities (API tokens, service accounts) outnumber human identities 80:1 but lack governance frameworks.

entry.title: $S^3$: Stratified Scaling Search for Test-Time in Diffusion Language Models

author.name: Ahsan Bilal, Muhammad Ahmed Mohsin, Muhammad Umer, Asad Aali, Muhammad Usman Khanzada, Muhammad Usman Rafique, Zihao He, Emily Fox, Dean F. Hougen

entry.summary: S³ proposes Stratified Scaling Search for test-time compute scaling in diffusion language models, using verifier-guided search during denoising rather than naive best-of-K sampling at the output stage.

entry.title: Limits of Difficulty Scaling: Hard Samples Yield Diminishing Returns in GRPO-Tuned SLMs

author.name: Suraj Yadav, Siddharth Yadav, Parth Goyal

entry.summary: Shows that when applying GRPO with LoRA to small language models for math reasoning, harder training samples yield diminishing returns. Training only on easier problems matches full-dataset accuracy while using ~45% of training steps.

entry.title: FP4 Explore, BF16 Train: Diffusion Reinforcement Learning via Efficient Rollout Scaling

author.name: Yitong Li, Junsong Chen, Shuchen Xue, Pengcuo Zeren, Siyuan Fu, Dinghao Yang, Yangyang Tang, Junjie Bai, Ping Luo, Song Han, Enze Xie

entry.summary: Proposes Sol-RL for scaling RL-based post-training of diffusion models by using FP4 quantization during rollouts while maintaining BF16 for training. Identifies and addresses performance degradation from naive quantized rollouts.

entry.title: How Does Machine Learning Manage Complexity?

author.name: Lance Fortnow

entry.summary: Provides a computational complexity theory perspective on machine learning, modeling ML as producing P/poly-computable distributions with bounded max-entropy. Shows connections between learning computable distributions and managing complexity.

entry.title: Android Coach: Improve Online Agentic Training Efficiency with Single State Multiple Actions

author.name: Guo Gan, Yuxuan Ding, Cong Chen, Yuwei Ren, Yin Huang, Hong Zhou

entry.summary: Proposes Android Coach, an RL framework that shifts from single-state-single-action to single-state-multiple-actions for training Android agents, significantly improving sample efficiency by better exploiting each costly emulator state.

entry.title: Telescope: Learnable Hyperbolic Foveation for Ultra-Long-Range Object Detection

author.name: Parker Ewen, Dmitriy Rivkin, Mario Bijelic, Felix Heide

entry.summary: Introduces Telescope, a two-stage detection model for ultra-long range (500m+) object detection in autonomous driving, using learnable hyperbolic foveation to handle tiny objects in high-resolution images.

entry.title: WebSP-Eval: Evaluating Web Agents on Website Security and Privacy Tasks

author.name: Guruprasad Viswanathan Ramesh, Asmit Nayak, Basieem Siddique, Kassem Fawaz

entry.summary: Introduces WebSP-Eval, a benchmark for evaluating web agents on security and privacy tasks like managing cookie preferences, configuring account settings, and revoking sessions across 28 websites.

entry.title: CSA-Graphs: A Privacy-Preserving Structural Dataset for Child Sexual Abuse Research

author.name: Carlos Caetano, Camila Laranjeira, Clara Ernesto, Artur Barros, Jo\~ao Macedo, Leo S. F. Ribeiro, Jefersson A. dos Santos, Sandra Avila

entry.summary: CSA-Graphs introduces a privacy-preserving dataset for child sexual abuse imagery classification using structural representations (scene graphs and skeleton graphs) instead of actual images, enabling research while respecting legal and ethical constraints. Experiments show these representations retain useful classification signal.

entry.title: Hallucination as output-boundary misclassification: a composite abstention architecture for language models

author.name: Angelina Hintsanen

entry.summary: Frames LLM hallucination as output-boundary misclassification and proposes a composite abstention architecture combining instruction-based refusal with a structural gate using self-consistency, paraphrase stability, and citation coverage signals.

entry.title: In-Context Learning in Speech Language Models: Analyzing the Role of Acoustic Features, Linguistic Structure, and Induction Heads

author.name: Charlotte Pouw, Hosein Mohebbi, Afra Alishahi, Willem Zuidema

entry.summary: Investigates how acoustic and linguistic features affect in-context learning in Speech Language Models for TTS, finding speaking rate strongly influences ICL performance while pitch and intensity have less impact, with induction heads identified as key mechanisms.

entry.title: DataSTORM: Deep Research on Large-Scale Databases using Exploratory Data Analysis and Data Storytelling

author.name: Shicheng Liu, Yucheng Jiang, Sajid Farook, Camila Nicollier Sanchez, David Fernando Castro Pena, Monica S. Lam

entry.summary: DataSTORM is an LLM-based agentic system for deep research over large-scale structured databases, combining iterative hypothesis generation, quantitative reasoning over schemas, and convergence toward analytical narratives.

entry.title: Does a Global Perspective Help Prune Sparse MoEs Elegantly?

author.name: Zeliang Zhang, Nikhil Ghosh, Jiani Liu, Bin Yu, Xiaodong Liu

entry.summary: GRAPE proposes global redundancy-aware pruning for sparse MoE models that dynamically allocates pruning budgets across layers based on cross-layer redundancy, unlike uniform pruning approaches.

entry.title: TEC: A Collection of Human Trial-and-error Trajectories for Problem Solving

author.name: Xinkai Zhang, Jingtao Zhan, Yiqun Liu, Qingyao Ai

entry.summary: TEC introduces a data annotation platform and dataset collecting complete human trial-and-error trajectories with reflections, providing detailed records of how humans iteratively solve complex problems.

entry.title: Beyond Accuracy: Diagnosing Algebraic Reasoning Failures in LLMs Across Nine Complexity Dimensions

author.name: Parth Patil, Dhruv Kumar, Yash Sinha, Murari Mandal

entry.summary: Introduces a nine-dimensional algebraic complexity framework for diagnosing specific failure modes in LLM algebraic reasoning, going beyond single accuracy scores to attribute failures to specific causes.

entry.title: Gemma 4, Phi-4, and Qwen3: Accuracy-Efficiency Tradeoffs in Dense and MoE Reasoning Language Models

author.name: Md Motaleb Hossen Manik, Ge Wang

entry.summary: Benchmarks seven recent reasoning models (Gemma-4, Phi-4, Qwen3) comparing dense vs MoE architectures across four benchmarks under three prompting strategies, analyzing accuracy-efficiency tradeoffs.

entry.title: Joint Optimization of Reasoning and Dual-Memory for Self-Learning Diagnostic Agent

author.name: Bingxuan Li, Simo Du, Yue Guo

entry.summary: Proposes SEA, a self-learning diagnostic agent with cognitively inspired dual-memory and reinforcement training for joint optimization of reasoning and memory management, achieving 92.46% accuracy on medical diagnosis.

entry.title: PhysHead: Simulation-Ready Gaussian Head Avatars

author.name: Berna Kabadayi, Vanessa Sklyarova, Wojciech Zielonka, Justus Thies, Gerard Pons-Moll

entry.summary: Introduces PhysHead, a hybrid representation for animatable head avatars with realistic physics-simulated hair dynamics learned from multi-view video, combining 3D Gaussian primitives with strand-based hair.

entry.title: Making MLLMs Blind: Adversarial Smuggling Attacks in MLLM Content Moderation

author.name: Zhiheng Li, Zongyang Ma, Yuntong Pan, Ziqi Zhang, Xiaolei Lv, Bo Li, Jun Gao, Jianing Zhang, Chunfeng Yuan, Bing Li, Weiming Hu

entry.summary: Uncovers adversarial smuggling attacks on MLLM content moderators that encode harmful content in human-readable visual formats that evade AI detection. Classifies attacks into perceptual blindness and reasoning blockade pathways.

entry.title: INSPATIO-WORLD: A Real-Time 4D World Simulator via Spatiotemporal Autoregressive Modeling

author.name: InSpatio Team, Donghui Shen, Guofeng Zhang, Haomin Liu, Haoyu Ji, Hujun Bao, Hongjia Zhai, Jialin Liu, Jing Guo, Nan Wang, Siji Pan, Weihong Pan, Weijian Xie, Xianbin Liu, Xiaojun Xiang, Xiaoyu Zhang, Xinyu Chen, Yifu Wang, Yipeng Chen, Zhenzhou Fan, Zhewen Le, Zhichao Ye, Ziqiang Zhao

entry.summary: Presents INSPATIO-WORLD, a real-time 4D world simulator using Spatiotemporal Autoregressive (STAR) architecture that generates high-fidelity dynamic interactive scenes from a single reference video.

entry.title: Harnessing Hyperbolic Geometry for Harmful Prompt Detection and Sanitization

author.name: Igor Maljkovic, Maria Rosaria Briglia, Iacopo Masi, Antonio Emanuele Cin\`a, Fabio Roli

entry.summary: Proposes HyPE and HyPS, two complementary components using hyperbolic geometry to detect and sanitize harmful prompts in Vision-Language Models. The approach is lightweight compared to classifier-based systems and more robust than blacklist filters against embedding-level attacks.

entry.title: BiDexGrasp: Coordinated Bimanual Dexterous Grasps across Object Geometries and Sizes

author.name: Mu Lin, Yi-Lin Wei, Jiaxuan Chen, Yuhao Lin, Shuoyu Chen, Jiangran Lyu, Jiayi Chen, Yansong Tang, He Wang, Wei-Shi Zheng

entry.summary: Proposes BiDexGrasp, a large-scale bimanual dexterous grasp dataset and generation model using a two-stage synthesis pipeline with region-based initialization and force-closure optimization for 10,000+ objects.

entry.title: Why was cybersecurity automated before AI R&D?

author.name: loops

entry.summary: Analyzes why AI systems (specifically Claude Mythos Preview) have automated cybersecurity vulnerability research before AI R&D itself, drawing on the author's own white-box security research experience. Argues cybersecurity involves more pattern-matching on well-defined attack surfaces, while AI R&D requires open-ended creative reasoning in less structured domains.

entry.title: Simulating the Evolution of Alignment and Values in Machine Intelligence

author.name: Jonathan Elsworth Eicher

entry.summary: Uses evolutionary simulation to examine how iterative alignment testing can fix deceptive beliefs in model populations over time, even when testing accuracy correlates strongly with true value. Shows alignment in a vacuum may be insufficient.

entry.title: From Retinal Evidence to Safe Decisions: RETINA-SAFE and ECRT for Hallucination Risk Triage in Medical LLMs

author.name: Zhe Yu, Wenpeng Xing, Meng Han

entry.summary: Introduces RETINA-SAFE, a 12,522-sample benchmark for hallucination detection in medical LLMs for diabetic retinopathy, and ECRT, a two-stage white-box framework for evidence-conditioned risk triage distinguishing contradiction-driven vs evidence-gap risks.

entry.title: Can We Trust a Black-box LLM? LLM Untrustworthy Boundary Detection via Bias-Diffusion and Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning

author.name: Xiaotian Zhou, Di Tang, Xiaofeng Wang, Xiaozhong Liu

entry.summary: Introduces GMRL-BD, an algorithm using multi-agent RL on a Wikipedia-derived knowledge graph to identify topic boundaries where a black-box LLM generates untrustworthy responses, working within query constraints.

entry.title: Thinking Diffusion: Penalize and Guide Visual-Grounded Reasoning in Diffusion Multimodal Language Models

author.name: Keuntae Kim, Mingyu Kang, Yong Suk Choi

entry.summary: Identifies two critical issues in diffusion multimodal LLMs with chain-of-thought reasoning: premature answer generation and visual grounding failures. Proposes penalties and guidance mechanisms to improve reasoning in diffusion-based multimodal models.

entry.title: ResearchEVO: An End-to-End Framework for Automated Scientific Discovery and Documentation

author.name: Zhe Zhao, Haibin Wen, Jiaming Ma, Jiachang Zhan, Tianyi Xu, Ye Wei, Qingfu Zhang

entry.summary: Presents ResearchEVO, an end-to-end framework for automated scientific discovery that uses LLM-guided bi-dimensional co-evolution to search code implementations by fitness, then autonomously generates research papers explaining the findings.

entry.title: When Do We Need LLMs? A Diagnostic for Language-Driven Bandits

author.name: Uljad Berdica, Fernando Acero, Anton Ipsen, Parisa Zehtabi, Michael Cashmore, Manuela Veloso

entry.summary: Introduces LLMP-UCB, a bandit algorithm deriving uncertainty estimates from LLMs via repeated inference, but finds that lightweight numerical bandits on text embeddings match or exceed LLM performance for language-driven contextual bandits.

entry.title: MG$^2$-RAG: Multi-Granularity Graph for Multimodal Retrieval-Augmented Generation

author.name: Sijun Dai, Qiang Huang, Xiaoxing You, Jun Yu

entry.summary: Proposes MG²-RAG, a multi-granularity graph RAG framework that constructs hierarchical multimodal knowledge graphs combining textual parsing with entity-driven visual grounding, improving cross-modal reasoning in retrieval-augmented generation.

entry.title: Comparative Characterization of KV Cache Management Strategies for LLM Inference

author.name: Oteo Mamo, Olga Kogiou, Hyunjin Yi, Weikuan Yu

entry.summary: Provides comparative analysis of KV cache management strategies for LLM inference, benchmarking memory consumption and performance trade-offs across varying request sizes and context lengths.

entry.title: StarVLA: A Lego-like Codebase for Vision-Language-Action Model Developing

author.name: StarVLA Community

entry.summary: Presents StarVLA, an open-source modular codebase for Vision-Language-Action model research, supporting multiple VLM backbones and action heads with standardized evaluation protocols for embodied agent development.

entry.title: Edit, But Verify: An Empirical Audit of Instructed Code-Editing Benchmarks

author.name: Amir M. Ebrahimi, Gopi Krishnan Rajbahadur

entry.summary: Audits instructed code-editing benchmarks, finding only two (CanItEdit and EDIT-Bench) properly evaluate this capability. Analysis reveals both concentrate >90% evaluation on Python and have limited test coverage, with specific recommendations for improvement.

entry.title: Compiled AI: Deterministic Code Generation for LLM-Based Workflow Automation

author.name: Geert Trooskens (XY.AI Labs, Palo Alto, CA), Aaron Karlsberg (XY.AI Labs, Palo Alto, CA), Anmol Sharma (XY.AI Labs, Palo Alto, CA), Lamara De Brouwer (XY.AI Labs, Palo Alto, CA), Max Van Puyvelde (Stanford University School of Medicine, Stanford, CA), Matthew Young (XY.AI Labs, Palo Alto, CA), John Thickstun (Cornell University, Ithaca, NY), Gil Alterovitz (Brigham and Women's Hospital / Harvard Medical School, Boston, MA), Walter A. De Brouwer (Stanford University School of Medicine, Stanford, CA)

entry.summary: Studies 'compiled AI,' where LLMs generate executable code during a compilation phase, after which workflows run deterministically without further model invocation. Focuses on healthcare settings where reliability and auditability are critical.

entry.title: LSRM: High-Fidelity Object-Centric Reconstruction via Scaled Context Windows

author.name: Zhengqin Li, Cheng Zhang, Jakob Engel, Zhao Dong

entry.summary: Introduces Large Sparse Reconstruction Model (LSRM) studying how scaling transformer context windows impacts feed-forward 3D reconstruction, using native sparse attention to substantially increase active tokens for high-fidelity object reconstruction.

entry.title: XMark: Reliable Multi-Bit Watermarking for LLM-Generated Texts

author.name: Jiahao Xu, Rui Hu, Olivera Kotevska, Zikai Zhang

entry.summary: Proposes XMark, a multi-bit watermarking method for LLM-generated text that improves encoding/decoding of binary messages with better trade-offs between text quality and decoding accuracy, especially for limited token counts.

entry.title: ALTO: Adaptive LoRA Tuning and Orchestration for Heterogeneous LoRA Training Workloads

author.name: Jingwei Zuo, Xinze Feng, Zien Liu, Kaijian Wang, Fanjiang Ye, Ye Cao, Zhuang Wang, Yuke Wang

entry.summary: ALTO is a system that co-optimizes LoRA hyperparameter tuning and GPU cluster sharing across heterogeneous tasks, enabling early termination of weak candidates and efficient multi-tenant resource utilization.

entry.title: FastDiSS: Few-step Match Many-step Diffusion Language Model on Sequence-to-Sequence Generation--Full Version

author.name: Dat Nguyen-Cong, Tung Kieu, Hoang Thanh-Tung

entry.summary: FastDiSS addresses the problem of degraded self-conditioning in few-step diffusion language models by perturbing self-conditioning signals during training to match inference noise, plus introducing a new distillation approach for sequence-to-sequence generation.

entry.title: Generating Synthetic Doctor-Patient Conversations for Long-form Audio Summarization

author.name: Yanis Labrak, David Gr\"unert, S\'everin Baroudi, Jiyun Chun, Pawel Cyrta, Sergio Burdisso, Ahmed Hassoon, David Liu, Adam Rothschild, Reed Van Deusen, Petr Motlicek, Andrew Perrault, Ricard Marxer, Thomas Schaaf

entry.summary: Proposes a fully open-weight pipeline for generating synthetic doctor-patient conversations with SOAP notes, including persona-driven dialogue, multi-speaker audio synthesis with realistic artifacts, and LLM-based reference generation.

entry.title: ODE-free Neural Flow Matching for One-Step Generative Modeling

author.name: Xiao Shou

entry.summary: Proposes OT-NFM, an ODE-free generative framework enabling true one-step generation by directly learning the transport map using optimal transport pairings. Proves that consistent coupling is necessary to avoid mean collapse.

entry.title: Optimal Rates for Pure {\varepsilon}-Differentially Private Stochastic Convex Optimization with Heavy Tails

author.name: Andrew Lowy

entry.summary: Characterizes the minimax optimal excess-risk rate for pure ε-differential privacy stochastic convex optimization with heavy-tailed gradients, resolving an open question. Achieves the rate in polynomial time.

entry.title: MedRoute: RL-Based Dynamic Specialist Routing in Multi-Agent Medical Diagnosis

author.name: Ashmal Vayani, Parth Parag Kulkarni, Joseph Fioresi, Song Wang, Mubarak Shah

entry.summary: Proposes MedRoute, an RL-based dynamic routing framework for multi-agent medical diagnosis where specialized LMM agents are dynamically selected based on the medical condition, mimicking real clinical specialist referral.

entry.title: Distributional Open-Ended Evaluation of LLM Cultural Value Alignment Based on Value Codebook

author.name: Jaehyeok Lee, Xiaoyuan Yi, Jing Yao, Hyunjin Hwang, Roy Ka-Wei Lee, Xing Xie, JinYeong Bak

entry.summary: Introduces DOVE, a distributional evaluation framework for assessing LLM cultural value alignment by comparing human-written and LLM-generated text distributions using a value codebook constructed via rate-distortion optimization.

entry.title: Stochastic Auto-conditioned Fast Gradient Methods with Optimal Rates

author.name: Yao Ji, Guanghui Lan

entry.summary: Achieves optimal convergence rates for stochastic composite convex optimization without prior knowledge of problem parameters, extending auto-conditioned fast gradient methods to the stochastic setting.

entry.title: Steering the Verifiability of Multimodal AI Hallucinations

author.name: Jianhong Pang, Ruoxi Cheng, Ziyi Ye, Xingjun Ma, Zuxuan Wu, Xuanjing Huang, Yu-Gang Jiang

entry.summary: Introduces a framework for steering the verifiability of multimodal AI hallucinations, distinguishing between obvious and elusive hallucinations and controlling this property for different security/usability demands.

entry.title: FedDetox: Robust Federated SLM Alignment via On-Device Data Sanitization

author.name: Shunan Zhu, Jiawei Chen, Yonghao Yu, Hideya Ochiai

entry.summary: Proposes FedDetox for robust federated alignment of small language models, using knowledge distillation from safety-aligned teachers to create lightweight on-device classifiers that sanitize toxic client data.

entry.title: The Theory and Practice of Highly Scalable Gaussian Process Regression with Nearest Neighbours

author.name: Robert Allison, Tomasz Maciazek, Anthony Stephenson

entry.summary: Develops theoretical framework for Nearest Neighbour Gaussian Process regression, deriving pointwise convergence results for MSE, calibration, and coverage under mild assumptions, filling a gap in large-n theory for this practical scalable GP method.

entry.title: Fast Spatial Memory with Elastic Test-Time Training

author.name: Ziqiao Ma, Xueyang Yu, Haoyu Zhen, Yuncong Yang, Joyce Chai, Chuang Gan

entry.summary: Proposes Elastic Test-Time Training that stabilizes fast-weight updates in large chunk test-time training using Fisher-weighted elastic priors, addressing catastrophic forgetting and enabling processing of arbitrarily long 3D sequences.

entry.title: Depression Detection at the Point of Care: Automated Analysis of Linguistic Signals from Routine Primary Care Encounters

author.name: Feng Chen, Manas Bedmutha, Janice Sabin, Andrea Hartzler, Nadir Weibel, Trevor Cohen

entry.summary: Investigates automated depression detection from 1,108 recorded primary care encounters, finding that zero-shot GPT-OSS outperformed supervised methods (AUPRC=0.510), with combined dyadic features showing promise.

entry.title: Invisible Influences: Investigating Implicit Intersectional Biases through Persona Engineering in Large Language Models

author.name: Nandini Arimanda, Achyuth Mukund, Sakthi Balan Muthiah, Rajesh Sharma

entry.summary: Introduces BADx metric for measuring persona-induced bias amplification in LLMs, showing that existing static embedding tests fail to capture dynamic intersectional biases that emerge when models adopt social roles.

entry.title: When to Call an Apple Red: Humans Follow Introspective Rules, VLMs Don't

author.name: Jonathan Nemitz, Carsten Eickhoff, Junyi Jessy Li, Kyle Mahowald, Michal Golovanevsky, William Rudman

entry.summary: GCA dataset evaluates whether VLMs follow their own introspective rules for color attribution, finding humans are faithful to their stated thresholds while VLMs systematically deviate from their self-reported decision rules.

entry.title: Scientific Knowledge-driven Decoding Constraints Improving the Reliability of LLMs

author.name: Maotian Ma, Zheni Zeng, Zhenghao Liu, Yukun Yan

entry.summary: SciDC integrates scientific knowledge as strong constraints during LLM generation by converting domain knowledge into multi-layered standardized rules, reducing hallucination on domain tasks.

entry.title: DiffuMask: Diffusion Language Model for Token-level Prompt Pruning

author.name: Caleb Zheng, Jyotika Singh, Fang Tu, Weiyi Sun, Sujeeth Bharadwaj, Yassine Benajiba, Sujith Ravi, Eli Shlizerman, Dan Roth

entry.summary: DiffuMask uses a diffusion-based framework for prompt compression that enables parallel token pruning via iterative mask prediction, substantially accelerating compression while preserving reasoning quality.

entry.title: To Adapt or not to Adapt, Rethinking the Value of Medical Knowledge-Aware Large Language Models

author.name: Ane G. Domingo-Aldama, Iker De La Iglesia, Maitane Urruela, Aitziber Atutxa, Ander Barrena

entry.summary: Systematically compares general vs clinical LLMs on medical QA in English and Spanish, introducing perturbation-based evaluation. Finds domain-adapted models don't consistently outperform general-purpose ones.

entry.title: Are Non-English Papers Reviewed Fairly? Language-of-Study Bias in NLP Peer Reviews

author.name: Ehsan Barkhordar, Abdulfattah Safa, Verena Blaschke, Erika Lombart, Marie-Catherine de Marneffe, G\"ozde G\"ul \c{S}ahin

entry.summary: Systematically characterizes language-of-study bias in NLP peer reviews, distinguishing positive and negative forms, and introduces the LOBSTER dataset for detecting such bias.

entry.title: Robustness Risk of Conversational Retrieval: Identifying and Mitigating Noise Sensitivity in Qwen3-Embedding Model

author.name: Weishu Chen, Zhouhui Hou, Mingjie Zhan, Zhicheng Zhao, Fei Su

entry.summary: Identifies a robustness vulnerability in Qwen3-embedding models where structured conversational noise becomes disproportionately retrievable under realistic dialogue-like queries without query prompting.

entry.title: From Perception to Autonomous Computational Modeling: A Multi-Agent Approach

author.name: Daniel N. Wilke

entry.summary: Presents a solver-agnostic framework where LLM agents autonomously execute the complete computational mechanics workflow from visual perception to engineering report generation with uncertainty quantification.

entry.title: Mem3R: Streaming 3D Reconstruction with Hybrid Memory via Test-Time Training

author.name: Changkun Liu, Jiezhi Yang, Zeman Li, Yuan Deng, Jiancong Guo, Luca Ballan

entry.summary: Proposes Mem3R for streaming 3D reconstruction with a hybrid memory that decouples camera tracking (using test-time trained MLP) from geometric mapping (using explicit point memory) for improved temporal consistency.

entry.title: From Blobs to Spokes: High-Fidelity Surface Reconstruction via Oriented Gaussians

author.name: Diego Gomez, Antoine Gu\'edon, Nissim Maruani, Bingchen Gong, Maks Ovsjanikov

entry.summary: Derives a principled occupancy field for 3D Gaussian Splatting by introducing learnable oriented normals and adapted attenuation, enabling extraction of highly accurate watertight meshes from complex scenes.

entry.title: RoSHI: A Versatile Robot-oriented Suit for Human Data In-the-Wild

author.name: Wenjing Margaret Mao, Jefferson Ng, Luyang Hu, Daniel Gehrig, Antonio Loquercio

entry.summary: Introduces RoSHI, a wearable system fusing sparse IMUs with Project Aria glasses for estimating full 3D pose and body shape in global coordinates from egocentric perception, designed for collecting human demonstration data for robot learning.

entry.title: From Governance Norms to Enforceable Controls: A Layered Translation Method for Runtime Guardrails in Agentic AI

author.name: Christopher Koch

entry.summary: Proposes a layered translation method connecting governance standards (ISO/IEC 42001, NIST AI RMF) to four implementable control layers for agentic AI: governance objectives, design-time constraints, runtime mechanisms, and audit hooks.

entry.title: Breakthrough the Suboptimal Stable Point in Value-Factorization-Based Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning

author.name: Lesong Tao, Yifei Wang, Haodong Jing, Jingwen Fu, Miao Kang, Shitao Chen, Nanning Zheng

entry.summary: Provides theoretical analysis of why value factorization methods in MARL converge to suboptimal solutions by introducing the concept of 'stable points', and proposes an iterative filtering method to eliminate non-optimal stable points.

entry.title: Towards Effective In-context Cross-domain Knowledge Transfer via Domain-invariant-neurons-based Retrieval

author.name: Jianzhi Yan, Zhiming Li, Le Liu, Zike Yuan, Shiwei Chen, Youcheng Pan, Buzhou Tang, Yang Xiang, Danny Dongning Sun

entry.summary: Proposes Domain-Invariant-Neurons-based Retrieval for cross-domain in-context learning, demonstrating that domain-invariant neurons in LLMs can be used to retrieve useful cross-domain demonstrations that boost reasoning performance.

entry.title: COSMO-Agent: Tool-Augmented Agent for Closed-loop Optimization,Simulation,and Modeling Orchestration

author.name: Liyuan Deng, Shujian Deng, Yongkang Chen, Yongkang Dai, Zhihang Zhong, Linyang Li, Xiao Sun, Yilei Shi, Huaxi Huang

entry.summary: Proposes COSMO-Agent, a tool-augmented RL framework that teaches LLMs to perform closed-loop CAD-CAE optimization, casting geometry generation, simulation, and revision as an interactive RL environment with multi-constraint rewards.

entry.title: Hierarchical Reinforcement Learning with Augmented Step-Level Transitions for LLM Agents

author.name: Shuai Zhen, Yanhua Yu, Ruopei Guo, Nan Cheng, Yang Deng

entry.summary: Proposes STEP-HRL, a hierarchical RL framework for LLM agents that enables step-level learning from single-step transitions rather than full interaction histories, using subtask completion for global progress tracking.

entry.title: Vision-Guided Iterative Refinement for Frontend Code Generation

author.name: Hannah Sansford, Derek H. C. Law, Wei Liu, Abhishek Tripathi, Niresh Agarwal, Gerrit J. J. van den Burg

entry.summary: Presents a vision-guided iterative refinement framework for frontend code generation where a vision-language model serves as visual critic providing structured feedback on rendered webpages, achieving 17.8% improvement over three refinement cycles.

entry.title: Context-Value-Action Architecture for Value-Driven Large Language Model Agents

author.name: TianZe Zhang, Sirui Sun, Yuhang Xie, Xin Zhang, Zhiqiang Wu, Guojie Song

entry.summary: Proposes Context-Value-Action (CVA) architecture for LLM agents grounded in Schwartz's Theory of Basic Human Values, revealing that increasing prompt-driven reasoning intensity causes value polarization and collapses population diversity.

entry.title: CURE:Circuit-Aware Unlearning for LLM-based Recommendation

author.name: Ziheng Chen, Jiali Cheng, Zezhong Fan, Hadi Amiri, Yunzhi Yao, Xiangguo Sun, Yang Zhang

entry.summary: Proposes CURE, a circuit-aware unlearning method for LLM-based recommendation systems that identifies and targets specific model circuits for forgetting, avoiding gradient conflicts between forgetting and retaining objectives.

entry.title: Learning Stable Predictors from Weak Supervision under Distribution Shift

author.name: Mehrdad Shoeibi, Elias Hossain, Ivan Garibay, Niloofar Yousefi

entry.summary: Formalizes 'supervision drift' — changes in the relationship between weak labels and ground truth across contexts — and studies it using CRISPR-Cas13d experiments, proposing methods for learning stable predictors under distribution shift with weak supervision.

entry.title: Dynamic Linear Coregionalization for Realistic Synthetic Multivariate Time Series

author.name: Annita Vapsi, Penghang Liu, Saheed Obitayo, Aakriti, Manoj Cherukumalli, Prathamesh Patil, Amit Varshney, Nicolas Marchesotti, Elizabeth Fons, Vamsi K. Potluru, Manuela Veloso

entry.summary: Introduces DynLMC, a Dynamic Linear Model of Coregionalization for generating synthetic multivariate time series with time-varying correlations. Fine-tuning foundation models on DynLMC data yields zero-shot forecasting improvements across nine benchmarks.

entry.title: OrthoFuse: Training-free Riemannian Fusion of Orthogonal Style-Concept Adapters for Diffusion Models

author.name: Ali Aliev, Kamil Garifullin, Nikolay Yudin, Vera Soboleva, Alexander Molozhavenko, Ivan Oseledets, Aibek Alanov, Maxim Rakhuba

entry.summary: Derives training-free adapter merging formulas for Orthogonal Fine-Tuning (OFT) adapters by exploiting the geometric properties of the orthogonal manifold, enabling combination of style and concept adapters without retraining.

entry.title: RoboPlayground: Democratizing Robotic Evaluation through Structured Physical Domains

author.name: Yi Ru Wang, Carter Ung, Evan Gubarev, Christopher Tan, Siddhartha Srinivasa, Dieter Fox

entry.summary: Introduces RoboPlayground, a framework enabling users to author executable robotic manipulation tasks using natural language within structured physical domains, reframing evaluation as a language-driven process.

entry.title: Region-R1: Reinforcing Query-Side Region Cropping for Multi-Modal Re-Ranking

author.name: Chan-Wei Hu, Zhengzhong Tu

entry.summary: Proposes Region-R1, a query-side region cropping framework for multimodal re-ranking that learns to dynamically crop discriminative image regions using region-aware GRPO, reducing the impact of visual distractors.

entry.title: VideoStir: Understanding Long Videos via Spatio-Temporally Structured and Intent-Aware RAG

author.name: Honghao Fu, Miao Xu, Yiwei Wang, Dailing Zhang, Liu Jun, Yujun Cai

entry.summary: VideoStir proposes a RAG framework for long video understanding that structures videos as spatio-temporal graphs and performs multi-hop retrieval to capture both explicit and implicit query-relevant evidence across distant video segments.

entry.title: Context-Agent: Dynamic Discourse Trees for Non-Linear Dialogue

author.name: Junan Hu, Shudan Guo, Wenqi Liu, Jianhua Yin, Yinwei Wei

entry.summary: Context-Agent models multi-turn dialogue as a dynamic tree structure rather than a flat linear sequence, enabling better handling of topic shifts, instruction refinements, and non-linear conversation flows in LLMs.

entry.title: MMEmb-R1: Reasoning-Enhanced Multimodal Embedding with Pair-Aware Selection and Adaptive Control

author.name: Yuchi Wang, Haiyang Yu, Weikang Bian, Jiefeng Long, Xiao Liang, Chao Feng, Hongsheng Li

entry.summary: MMEmb-R1 introduces adaptive reasoning for multimodal embeddings, using pair-aware selection to determine when chain-of-thought reasoning helps embedding quality and adaptive control to avoid it when counterproductive.

entry.title: Probabilistic Language Tries: A Unified Framework for Compression, Decision Policies, and Execution Reuse

author.name: Gregory Magarshak

entry.summary: Introduces Probabilistic Language Tries (PLTs), a unified data structure making explicit the prefix structure of generative models, serving as compressor, policy representation, and memoization index simultaneously.

entry.title: Inference-Time Code Selection via Symbolic Equivalence Partitioning

author.name: David Cho, Yifan Wang, Fanping Sui, Ananth Grama

entry.summary: Proposes Symbolic Equivalence Partitioning for LLM code generation, using symbolic execution to group candidate programs by semantic behavior and select from the dominant partition. Uses SMT constraints to reduce path explosion.

entry.title: Geometric Properties of the Voronoi Tessellation in Latent Semantic Manifolds of Large Language Models

author.name: Marshall Brett

entry.summary: Studies Voronoi tessellation in LLM representation spaces on Qwen3.5-4B, validating a linear scaling law of the expressibility gap (R²=0.9997) and identifying a 'geometric ambiguity regime' in middle layers before crystallization at the final layer.

entry.title: Graph Neural ODE Digital Twins for Control-Oriented Reactor Thermal-Hydraulic Forecasting Under Partial Observability

author.name: Akzhol Almukhametov, Doyeong Lim, Rui Hu, Yang Liu

entry.summary: Presents a physics-informed Graph Neural Network coupled with Neural ODEs for real-time thermal-hydraulic forecasting in nuclear reactors under partial observability. Achieves millisecond-scale inference for control applications.

entry.title: Visual prompting reimagined: The power of the Activation Prompts

author.name: Yihua Zhang, Hongkang Li, Yuguang Yao, Aochuan Chen, Shuai Zhang, Pin-Yu Chen, Meng Wang, Sijia Liu

entry.summary: Introduces activation prompts (AP) that extend visual prompting from input-level to intermediate activation-level perturbations, narrowing the performance gap between visual prompting and conventional fine-tuning.

entry.title: Anticipating tipping in spatiotemporal systems with machine learning

author.name: Smita Deb, Zheng-Meng Zhai, Mulugeta Haile, Ying-Cheng Lai

entry.summary: Applies machine learning with non-negative matrix factorization and reservoir computing to predict tipping points in spatiotemporal dynamical systems, including forecasting the precise timing of critical transitions.

entry.title: Controller Design for Structured State-space Models via Contraction Theory

author.name: Muhammad Zakwan, Vaibhav Gupta, Alireza Karimi, Efe C. Balta, Giancarlo Ferrari-Trecate

entry.summary: Provides first analysis of controllability and observability for Structured State-space Models (SSMs), enabling scalable controller design via LMIs with contraction theory and a separation principle.

entry.title: Non-identifiability of Explanations from Model Behavior in Deep Networks of Image Authenticity Judgments

author.name: Icaro Re Depaolini, Uri Hasson

entry.summary: Demonstrates that deep neural networks predicting human image authenticity judgments produce inconsistent explanations (attribution maps) within and across architectures, despite achieving similar prediction accuracy, highlighting non-identifiability of explanations from model behavior.

entry.title: Making Room for AI: Multi-GPU Molecular Dynamics with Deep Potentials in GROMACS

author.name: Luca Pennati, Andong Hu, Ivy Peng, Lukas M\"ullender, Stefano Markidis

entry.summary: Integrates DeePMD-kit (ML interatomic potentials) into GROMACS for multi-GPU molecular dynamics simulations, enabling domain-decomposed GPU-accelerated neural network inference across multi-node systems.

entry.title: Beyond Facts: Benchmarking Distributional Reading Comprehension in Large Language Models

author.name: Pei-Fu Guo, Ya-An Tsai, Chun-Chia Hsu, Kai-Xin Chen, Yun-Da Tsai, Kai-Wei Chang, Nanyun Peng, Mi-Yen Yeh, Shou-De Lin

entry.summary: Text2DistBench benchmarks LLMs' ability to infer distributional information (population-level trends, proportions) from collections of text rather than extracting factual answers, using YouTube comments about entertainment entities.

entry.title: SensorPersona: An LLM-Empowered System for Continual Persona Extraction from Longitudinal Mobile Sensor Streams

author.name: Bufang Yang, Lilin Xu, Yixuan Li, Kaiwei Liu, Xiaofan Jiang, Zhenyu Yan

entry.summary: SensorPersona continuously infers user personas from multimodal mobile sensor streams (not just chat histories) using LLMs, performing person-oriented context encoding on sensor data to enable richer personalization.

entry.title: ValueGround: Evaluating Culture-Conditioned Visual Value Grounding in MLLMs

author.name: Zhipin Wang, Christoph Leiter, Christian Frey, Mohamed Hesham Ibrahim Abdalla, Josif Grabocka, Steffen Eger

entry.summary: ValueGround benchmarks culture-conditioned visual value grounding in MLLMs using World Values Survey questions with contrastive image pairs, testing whether models can match images to country-specific cultural values.

entry.title: MedConclusion: A Benchmark for Biomedical Conclusion Generation from Structured Abstracts

author.name: Weiyue Li, Ruizhi Qian, Yi Li, Yongce Li, Yunfan Long, Jiahui Cai, Yan Luo, Mengyu Wang

entry.summary: MedConclusion provides a 5.7M structured abstract dataset for evaluating LLMs' ability to generate biomedical conclusions from evidence, with journal-level metadata enabling subgroup analysis.

entry.title: A Parameter-Efficient Transfer Learning Approach through Multitask Prompt Distillation and Decomposition for Clinical NLP

author.name: Cheng Peng, Mengxian Lyu, Ziyi Chen, Yonghui Wu

entry.summary: Multitask prompt distillation framework that learns a shared metaprompt from 21 clinical source tasks and adapts to unseen tasks with <0.05% trainable parameters, evaluated across 5 clinical NLP task types.

entry.title: SemEval-2026 Task 9: Detecting Multilingual, Multicultural and Multievent Online Polarization

author.name: Usman Naseem, Robert Geislinger, Juan Ren, Sarah Kohail, Rudy Garrido Veliz, P Sam Sahil, Yiran Zhang, Marco Antonio Stranisci, Idris Abdulmumin, \"Ozge Ala\c{c}am, Cengiz Acart\"urk, Aisha Jabr, Saba Anwar, Abinew Ali Ayele, Elena Tutubalina, Aung Kyaw Htet, Xintong Wang, Surendrabikram Thapa, Tanmoy Chakraborty, Dheeraj Kodati, Sahar Moradizeyveh, Firoj Alam, Ye Kyaw Thu, Shantipriya Parida, Ihsan Ayyub Qazi, Lilian Wanzare, Nelson Odhiambo Onyango, Clemencia Siro, Ibrahim Said Ahmad, Adem Chanie Ali, Martin Semmann, Chris Biemann, Shamsuddeen Hassan Muhammad, Seid Muhie Yimam

entry.summary: Presents SemEval-2026 Task 9 on multilingual online polarization detection covering 22 languages with 110K annotated instances, attracting 67 teams. Reports baseline results and best system analyses.

entry.title: iTAG: Inverse Design for Natural Text Generation with Accurate Causal Graph Annotations

author.name: Wenshuo Wang, Boyu Cao, Nan Zhuang, Wei Li

entry.summary: Proposes iTAG, which generates natural text with accurate causal graph annotations by framing concept-to-node assignment as an inverse problem, addressing the lack of causally annotated text data.

entry.title: The Impact of Steering Large Language Models with Persona Vectors in Educational Applications

author.name: Yongchao Wu, Aron Henriksson

entry.summary: Studies persona vectors for activation-based steering of LLMs in educational applications, finding that persona steering generally lowers answer quality, with interpretive tasks being up to 11x more sensitive than factual ones.

entry.title: MorphDistill: Distilling Unified Morphological Knowledge from Pathology Foundation Models for Colorectal Cancer Survival Prediction

author.name: Hikmat Khan, Usama Sajjad, Metin N. Gurcan, Anil Parwani, Wendy L. Frankel, Wei Chen, Muhammad Khalid Khan Niazi

entry.summary: Proposes MorphDistill, a framework distilling knowledge from ten pathology foundation models into a compact CRC-specific encoder using dimension-agnostic multi-teacher relational distillation.

entry.title: Exploring 6D Object Pose Estimation with Deformation

author.name: Zhiqiang Liu, Rui Song, Duanmu Chuangqi, Jiaojiao Li, David Ferstl, Yinlin Hu

entry.summary: Introduces DeSOPE, a large-scale dataset for 6DoF pose estimation of deformed objects, featuring 3D scans of 26 object categories in canonical and deformed states with 133K RGB-D frames and 665K pose annotations.

entry.title: KITE: Keyframe-Indexed Tokenized Evidence for VLM-Based Robot Failure Analysis

author.name: Mehdi Hosseinzadeh, King Hang Wong, Feras Dayoub

entry.summary: Presents KITE, a training-free front-end that converts long robot execution videos into compact tokenized evidence for VLMs, using keyframe selection with bird's-eye-view representations for robot failure analysis including detection, identification, and correction.

entry.title: Generalization error bounds for two-layer neural networks with Lipschitz loss function

author.name: Jiang Yu Nguwi, Nicolas Privault

entry.summary: Derives generalization error bounds for two-layer neural networks with Lipschitz loss functions without assuming bounded loss, achieving dimension-free O(n^{-1/2}) rate for independent test data using Wasserstein distance estimates.

entry.title: How Well Do Vision-Language Models Understand Sequential Driving Scenes? A Sensitivity Study

author.name: Roberto Brusnicki, Mattia Piccinini, Johannes Betz

entry.summary: Introduces VENUSS, a framework for systematic sensitivity analysis of VLM performance on sequential driving scenes. Reveals that even top VLMs achieve only 57% accuracy on temporal driving scene understanding, far below human performance.

entry.title: MAR-GRPO: Stabilized GRPO for AR-diffusion Hybrid Image Generation

author.name: Xiaoxiao Ma, Jiachen Lei, Tianfei Ren, Jie Huang, Siming Fu, Aiming Hao, Jiahong Wu, Xiangxiang Chu, Feng Zhao

entry.summary: Proposes MAR-GRPO, a stabilized RL framework for masked autoregressive image generation models (MAR) that addresses noisy gradients from diffusion heads through multi-trajectory expectation and conservative optimization.

entry.title: AnchorSplat: Feed-Forward 3D Gaussian SplattingWith 3D Geometric Priors

author.name: Xiaoxue Zhang, Xiaoxu Zheng, Yixuan Yin, Tiao Zhao, Kaihua Tang, Michael Bi Mi, Zhan Xu, Dave Zhenyu Chen

entry.summary: Proposes AnchorSplat, a feed-forward 3DGS framework that represents scenes directly in 3D space using anchor-aligned Gaussians guided by geometric priors, reducing required Gaussians and improving efficiency.

entry.title: LiveStre4m: Feed-Forward Live Streaming of Novel Views from Unposed Multi-View Video

author.name: Pedro Quesado, Erkut Akdag, Yasaman Kashefbahrami, Willem Menu, Egor Bondarev

entry.summary: Introduces LiveStre4m, a feed-forward model for real-time novel view synthesis from unposed multi-view video. Combines a multi-view vision transformer with a diffusion-transformer interpolation module and camera pose prediction.

entry.title: ReVEL: Multi-Turn Reflective LLM-Guided Heuristic Evolution via Structured Performance Feedback

author.name: Cuong Van Duc, Minh Nguyen Dinh Tuan, Tam Vu Duc, Tung Vu Duy, Son Nguyen Van, Hanh Nguyen Thi, Binh Huynh Thi Thanh

entry.summary: Proposes ReVEL, a framework that embeds LLMs as multi-turn reasoners within an evolutionary algorithm for designing heuristics for NP-hard combinatorial optimization. Uses performance-profile grouping and structured feedback to guide iterative heuristic improvement.

entry.title: MMORF: A Multi-agent Framework for Designing Multi-objective Retrosynthesis Planning Systems

author.name: Frazier N. Baker, Trieu Nguyen, Reza Averly, Botao Yu, Daniel Adu-Ampratwum, Huan Sun, Xia Ning

entry.summary: Presents MMORF, a modular multi-agent framework for multi-objective retrosynthesis planning in chemistry, balancing quality, safety, and cost objectives. Includes a new benchmark of 218 multi-objective retrosynthesis problems.

entry.title: PECKER: A Precisely Efficient Critical Knowledge Erasure Recipe For Machine Unlearning in Diffusion Models

author.name: Zhiyong Ma, Zhitao Deng, Huan Tang, Jialin Chen, Zhijun Zheng, Zhengping Li, Qingyuan Chuai

entry.summary: Proposes PECKER, an efficient machine unlearning approach for diffusion models that uses saliency masks to prioritize updates to parameters most responsible for targeted data, reducing training time while maintaining unlearning efficacy.

entry.title: Deep Researcher Agent: An Autonomous Framework for 24/7 Deep Learning Experimentation with Zero-Cost Monitoring

author.name: Xiangyue Zhang
