entry.summary: Introduces Deep Researcher Agent, an open-source framework for autonomous deep learning experimentation with zero-cost monitoring (no LLM API calls during training), two-tier constant-size memory, and full experiment lifecycle management.

entry.title: ACE-Bench: Agent Configurable Evaluation with Scalable Horizons and Controllable Difficulty under Lightweight Environments

author.name: Wang Yang, Chaoda Song, Xinpeng Li, Debargha Ganguly, Chuang Ma, Shouren Wang, Zhihao Dou, Yuli Zhou, Vipin Chaudhary, Xiaotian Han

entry.summary: Proposes ACE-Bench, an agent evaluation benchmark with fine-grained control over task difficulty and horizon length through a unified grid-based planning task. Addresses limitations of existing benchmarks including high environment overhead and imbalanced difficulty distributions.

entry.title: Architecture Without Architects: How AI Coding Agents Shape Software Architecture

author.name: Phongsakon Mark Konrad, Tim Lukas Adam, Riccardo Terrenzi, Serkan Ayvaz

entry.summary: Identifies five mechanisms by which AI coding agents make implicit architectural decisions and proposes six 'prompt-architecture coupling patterns.' Coins the term 'vibe architecture' for the phenomenon of prompt wording producing structurally different systems.

entry.title: Nidus: Externalized Reasoning for AI-Assisted Engineering

author.name: Danil Gorinevski (cybiont GmbH, Sch\"ubelbach, Switzerland)

entry.summary: Presents Nidus, a governance runtime that mechanizes the V-model for AI-assisted software delivery, where three LLM families delivered a 100,000-line system under proof obligations verified on every commit. The system governed its own construction.

entry.title: CritBench: A Framework for Evaluating Cybersecurity Capabilities of Large Language Models in IEC 61850 Digital Substation Environments

author.name: Gustav Keppler, Moritz Gst\"ur, Veit Hagenmeyer

entry.summary: CritBench evaluates LLM cybersecurity capabilities in IEC 61850 digital substation (OT) environments across 81 tasks including configuration analysis, network reconnaissance, and live VM interaction, testing GPT-5 and open-weight models.

entry.title: A Multi-Stage Validation Framework for Trustworthy Large-scale Clinical Information Extraction using Large Language Models

author.name: Maria Mahbub, Gregory M. Dams, Josh Arnold, Caitlin Rizy, Sudarshan Srinivasan, Elliot M. Fielstein, Minu A. Aghevli, Kamonica L. Craig, Elizabeth M. Oliva, Joseph Erdos, Jodie Trafton, Ioana Danciu

entry.summary: Proposes a multi-stage validation framework for LLM-based clinical information extraction that enables assessment under weak supervision through prompt calibration, plausibility filtering, semantic grounding, and LLM-as-judge confirmatory evaluation.

entry.title: Scientific Graphics Program Synthesis via Dual Self-Consistency Reinforcement Learning

author.name: Juekai Lin, Yun Zhu, Honglin Lin, Sijing Li, Tianwei Lin, Zheng Liu, Xiaoyang Wang, Wenqiao Zhang, Lijun Wu

entry.summary: Presents a framework for scientific graphics program synthesis (image-to-TikZ) including SciTikZ-230K dataset and dual self-consistency reinforcement learning for structural and visual fidelity.

entry.title: LAG-XAI: A Lie-Inspired Affine Geometric Framework for Interpretable Paraphrasing in Transformer Latent Spaces

author.name: Olexander Mazurets, Olexander Barmak, Leonid Bedratyuk, Iurii Krak

entry.summary: LAG-XAI models paraphrasing as affine transformations in embedding space using Lie group theory, decomposing paraphrase transitions into rotation, deformation, and translation components for interpretability.

entry.title: AgentOpt v0.1 Technical Report: Client-Side Optimization for LLM-Based Agent

author.name: Wenyue Hua, Sripad Karne, Qian Xie, Armaan Agrawal, Nikos Pagonas, Kostis Kaffes, Tianyi Peng

entry.summary: Introduces AgentOpt, a framework for client-side optimization of LLM-based agents, addressing how developers should allocate resources (model choice, tools, API budget) across pipeline stages subject to quality, cost, and latency constraints.

entry.title: Discrete Flow Matching Policy Optimization

author.name: Maojiang Su, Po-Chung Hsieh, Weimin Wu, Mingcheng Lu, Jiunhau Chen, Jerry Yao-Chieh Hu, Han Liu

entry.summary: Introduces DoMinO, a framework for RL fine-tuning of Discrete Flow Matching models by viewing the DFM sampling procedure as a multi-step MDP. Includes total-variation regularizers to prevent policy collapse.

entry.title: MoBiE: Efficient Inference of Mixture of Binary Experts under Post-Training Quantization

author.name: Zhixiong Zhao, Zukang Xu, Zhixuan Chen, Dawei Yang

entry.summary: Proposes MoBiE, the first binarization framework specifically designed for MoE-based LLMs, using joint SVD decomposition, global loss-aware importance estimation, and routing-aware error constraints.

entry.title: MoE Routing Testbed: Studying Expert Specialization and Routing Behavior at Small Scale

author.name: Tobias Falke, Nicolas Anastassacos, Samson Tan, Chankrisna Richy Meas, Chandana Satya Prakash, Nitesh Sekhar, M Saiful Bari, Krishna Kompella, Gamaleldin F. Elsayed

entry.summary: Proposes an MoE Routing Testbed that gives clearer visibility into routing dynamics at small scale while using realistic data, pairing distinguishable domain data with established metrics for expert specialization assessment.

entry.title: Improving Semantic Uncertainty Quantification in Language Model Question-Answering via Token-Level Temperature Scaling

author.name: Tom A. Lamb, Desi R. Ivanova, Philip H. S. Torr, Tim G. J. Rudner

entry.summary: Shows that optimizing a single scalar temperature dramatically improves semantic uncertainty calibration in LLM question-answering, outperforming complex fixed-temperature heuristics. Provides systematic evaluation of both calibration and discrimination.

entry.title: Tracking Adaptation Time: Metrics for Temporal Distribution Shift

author.name: Lorenzo Iovine, Giacomo Ziffer, Emanuele Della Valle

entry.summary: Proposes three new metrics for evaluating model behavior under temporal distribution shift that distinguish between a model's failure to adapt versus inherently harder data. Reveals adaptation patterns hidden by existing metrics.

entry.title: Incentive-Aware Multi-Fidelity Optimization for Generative Advertising in Large Language Models

author.name: Jiayuan Liu, Barry Wang, Jiarui Gan, Tonghan Wang, Leon Xie, Mingyu Guo, Vincent Conitzer

entry.summary: Proposes IAMFM, a framework for generative advertising in LLM responses that combines VCG auction mechanisms with multi-fidelity optimization to handle advertiser strategic behavior and costly stochastic generations.

entry.title: ProofSketcher: Hybrid LLM + Lightweight Proof Checker for Reliable Math/Logic Reasoning

author.name: Kranthi Kommuru, Kunal Khanvilkar, Gaurav Parekh

entry.summary: Proposes ProofSketcher, a hybrid system combining LLM proof generation with a lightweight formal proof checker to catch subtle errors in mathematical and logical reasoning that LLMs typically miss.

entry.title: Attention Flows: Tracing LLM Conceptual Engagement via Story Summaries

author.name: Rebecca M. M. Hicke, Sil Hamilton, David Mimno, Ross Deans Kristensen-McLachlan

entry.summary: Evaluates LLM novel summarization by comparing human and LLM-authored summaries, measuring conceptual engagement through chapter-level alignment. Finds LLMs diverge from human patterns of narrative importance.

entry.title: Learning Debt and Cost-Sensitive Bayesian Retraining: A Forecasting Operations Framework

author.name: Harrison Katz

entry.summary: Defines 'learning debt' as divergence between deployed and updated posteriors, and derives a Bayes-optimal retraining rule that outperforms fixed calendar-based retraining schedules across multiple shift scenarios.

entry.title: Towards Robust Content Watermarking Against Removal and Forgery Attacks

author.name: Yifan Zhu, Yihan Wang, Xiao-Shan Gao

entry.summary: Introduces ISTS, a watermarking paradigm for text-to-image diffusion models that resists both removal and forgery attacks through instance-specific dynamic watermark injection and two-sided detection.

entry.title: A solver-in-the-loop framework for end-to-end differentiable coastal hydrodynamics

author.name: Elsa Cardoso-Bihlo, Alex Bihlo

entry.summary: AegirJAX is a fully differentiable hydrodynamic solver for coastal simulation built within a reverse-mode automatic differentiation framework, enabling gradient-based inverse problems like bathymetry estimation and structural optimization. This bridges physics simulation with modern ML differentiable programming paradigms.

entry.title: Amortized Filtering and Smoothing with Conditional Normalizing Flows

author.name: Tiangang Cui, Xiaodong Feng, Chenlong Pei, Xiaoliang Wan, Tao Zhou

entry.summary: AFSF proposes a unified amortized framework for Bayesian filtering and smoothing using conditional normalizing flows, with a recurrent encoder mapping observation histories to fixed-dimensional summary statistics regardless of time series length.

entry.title: Beyond Loss Values: Robust Dynamic Pruning via Loss Trajectory Alignment

author.name: Huaiyuan Qin, Muli Yang, Gabriel James Goenawan, Kai Wang, Zheng Wang, Peng Hu, Xi Peng, Hongyuan Zhu

entry.summary: AlignPrune proposes a noise-robust dynamic data pruning method using Dynamic Alignment Score based on loss trajectories rather than raw loss values, better identifying noisy samples for pruning under label noise.

entry.title: Gaussian Approximation for Asynchronous Q-learning

author.name: Artemy Rubtsov, Sergey Samsonov, Vladimir Ulyanov, Alexey Naumov

entry.summary: Derives convergence rates for the central limit theorem applied to Polyak-Ruppert averaged iterates of asynchronous Q-learning, establishing rates up to n^{-1/6} over hyper-rectangles.

entry.title: Closing the Speech-Text Gap with Limited Audio for Effective Domain Adaptation in LLM-Based ASR

author.name: Thibault Ba\~neras-Roux, Sergio Burdisso, Esa\'u Villatoro-Tello, Dairazalia S\'anchez-Cort\'es, Shiran Liu, Severin Baroudi, Shashi Kumar, Hasindri Watawana, Manjunath K E, Kadri Hacioglu, Petr Motlicek, Andreas Stolcke

entry.summary: Investigates domain adaptation for LLM-based ASR with limited audio, showing that mixed batching of text-only and paired speech-text data with just 10% speech consistently improves performance, closing the modality gap.

entry.title: GCoT-Decoding: Unlocking Deep Reasoning Paths for Universal Question Answering

author.name: Guanran Luo, Wentao Qiu, Zhongquan Jian, Meihong Wang, Qingqiang Wu

entry.summary: Proposes GCoT-decoding, extending CoT-decoding to open-ended QA tasks using Fibonacci sampling, heuristic error backtracking, and path confidence aggregation without requiring manual prompts.

entry.title: Continuous Interpretive Steering for Scalar Diversity

author.name: Ye-eun Cho

entry.summary: Introduces Continuous Interpretive Steering (CIS), a method that probes graded pragmatic inference in LLMs by treating activation steering strength as a continuous variable, along with a new scalar diversity dataset.

entry.title: Multilingual Embedding Probes Fail to Generalize Across Learner Corpora

author.name: Laurits Lyngbaek, Ross Deans Kristensen-McLachlan

entry.summary: Trains probes on Qwen3-Embedding activations to predict CEFR proficiency levels across nine corpora and seven languages. Finds strong in-distribution performance but complete collapse in cross-corpus evaluation.

entry.title: Evaluating In-Context Translation with Synchronous Context-Free Grammar Transduction

author.name: Jackson Petty, Jaulie Goe, Tal Linzen

entry.summary: Evaluates LLMs' ability to perform in-context translation using formal synchronous context-free grammars as a controlled analogue, isolating the skill of inferring language rules from descriptions.

entry.title: WebExpert: domain-aware web agents with critic-guided expert experience for high-precision search

author.name: Yuelin Hu, Zhengxue Cheng, Ronghua Wu, Qunshan Gu, Hongwei Hu, Wei Liu, Qiao Liang, Li Song

entry.summary: Presents WebExpert, a domain-aware web agent for specialized search in finance/biomedicine with sentence-level experience retrieval, facet induction, and preference-optimized planning.

entry.title: Automating Database-Native Function Code Synthesis with LLMs

author.name: Wei Zhou, Xuanhe Zhou, Qikang He, Guoliang Li, Bingsheng He, Quanqing Xu, Fan Wu

entry.summary: Proposes DBCooker, an LLM-based system for automatically synthesizing database-native functions, handling complexities like multi-unit registration, internal reference linking, and logic implementation.

entry.title: Evidence-Based Actor-Verifier Reasoning for Echocardiographic Agents

author.name: Peng Huang, Yiming Wang, Yineng Chen, Liangqiao Gui, Hui Guo, Bo Peng, Shu Hu, Xi Wu, Tsao Connie, Hongtu Zhu, Balakrishnan Prabhakaran, Xin Wang

entry.summary: Proposes EchoTrust, an evidence-driven Actor-Verifier framework for trustworthy echocardiographic reasoning in VLM-based agents, avoiding template shortcuts and spurious explanations.

entry.title: Continual Visual Anomaly Detection on the Edge: Benchmark and Efficient Solutions

author.name: Manuel Barusco, Francesco Borsatti, David Petrovic, Davide Dalle Pezze, Gian Antonio Susto

entry.summary: Benchmarks visual anomaly detection methods under joint edge deployment and continual learning constraints, characterizing tradeoffs between memory, inference cost, and detection performance.

entry.title: Controllable Generative Video Compression

author.name: Ding Ding, Daowen Li, Ying Chen, Yixin Gao, Ruixiao Dong, Kai Li, Li Li

entry.summary: Proposes Controllable Generative Video Compression (CGVC) that uses generative modeling to reconstruct non-keyframes guided by coded keyframes and per-frame control priors. Addresses the perception-fidelity trade-off in video compression.

entry.title: VGGT-SLAM++

author.name: Avilasha Mandal, Rajesh Kumar, Sudarshan Sunil Harithas, Chetan Arora

entry.summary: Presents VGGT-SLAM++, a visual SLAM system leveraging the VGGT transformer with local bundle adjustment, DEM-based graph construction, and Sim(3) optimization for large-scale mapping with bounded memory.

entry.title: Q-Zoom: Query-Aware Adaptive Perception for Efficient Multimodal Large Language Models

author.name: Yuheng Shi, Xiaohuan Pei, Linfeng Wen, Minjing Dong, Chang Xu

entry.summary: Proposes Q-Zoom, a query-aware adaptive perception framework for MLLMs that dynamically bypasses high-resolution processing when unnecessary and precisely identifies regions requiring fine-grained attention.

entry.title: Distilling Photon-Counting CT into Routine Chest CT through Clinically Validated Degradation Modeling

author.name: Junqi Liu, Xinze Zhou, Wenxuan Li, Scott Ye, Arkadiusz Sitek, Xiaofeng Yang, Yucheng Tang, Daguang Xu, Kai Ding, Kang Wang, Yang Yang, Alan L. Yuille, Zongwei Zhou

entry.summary: Proposes SUMI, a method to bridge the gap between limited photon-counting CT availability and conventional CT by learning to enhance EICT images using PCCT as reference, with clinically validated degradation modeling.

entry.title: TC-AE: Unlocking Token Capacity for Deep Compression Autoencoders

author.name: Teng Li, Ziyuan Huang, Cong Chen, Yangfu Li, Yuanhuiyi Lyu, Dandan Zheng, Chunhua Shen, Jun Zhang

entry.summary: Proposes TC-AE, a ViT-based deep compression autoencoder that addresses latent representation collapse at high compression ratios by scaling token numbers and introducing token-to-latent compression innovations.

entry.title: Towards foundation-style models for energy-frontier heterogeneous neutrino detectors via self-supervised pre-training

author.name: Sa\'ul Alonso-Monsalve, Fabio Cufino, Umut Kose, Anna Mascellani, Andr\'e Rubbia

entry.summary: Presents a sparse Vision Transformer framework for neutrino detector data, using self-supervised pre-training (masked autoencoder + relational objectives) to learn reusable representations from heterogeneous detector signatures at TeV-scale energies.

entry.title: Conformal Prediction with Time-Series Data via Sequential Conformalized Density Regions

author.name: M. Sampson, K. S. Chan

entry.summary: Proposes Sequential Conformalized Density Regions (SCDR) for conformal prediction on time series data, providing asymptotic conditional coverage guarantees while supporting disconnected prediction sets to capture bifurcations.

entry.title: Elementary Condensation

author.name: Jan

entry.summary: A technical exploration of the 'Condensation' paper (Eisenstat 2025), which formalizes when two agents analyzing the same data must converge on the same concepts. The author attempts to implement the theoretical framework computationally, connecting it to Wentworth's natural abstractions hypothesis and infra-Bayesianism.

entry.title: Enhancing MLLM Spatial Understanding via Active 3D Scene Exploration for Multi-Perspective Reasoning

author.name: Jiahua Chen, Qihong Tang, Weinong Wang, Qi Fan

entry.summary: Proposes a training-free framework enhancing MLLM spatial understanding through Visual Chain-of-Thought grounded in explicit 3D reconstruction. Reconstructs 3D mesh from single images using MLLM-guided processing for multi-perspective reasoning.

entry.title: DOC-GS: Dual-Domain Observation and Calibration for Reliable Sparse-View Gaussian Splatting

author.name: Hantang Li, Qiang Zhu, Xiandong Meng, Debin Zhao, Xiaopeng Fan

entry.summary: Proposes DOC-GS for sparse-view 3D Gaussian Splatting that identifies the core challenge as unobservability of Gaussian primitive reliability. Uses dual-domain observation (image and frequency) and calibration to detect and correct unreliable Gaussians.

entry.title: RefineAnything: Multimodal Region-Specific Refinement for Perfect Local Details

author.name: Dewei Zhou, You Li, Zongxin Yang, Yi Yang

entry.summary: Introduces RefineAnything for region-specific image refinement that restores fine-grained details (text, logos, thin structures) in user-specified regions while keeping non-edited pixels unchanged.

entry.title: Energy-based Tissue Manifolds for Longitudinal Multiparametric MRI Analysis

author.name: Kartikay Tehlan, Lukas F\"orner, Nico Schmutzenhofer, Michael Fr\"uhwald, Matthias Wagner, Nassir Navab, Thomas Wendler

entry.summary: Proposes a geometric framework for longitudinal MRI analysis using patient-specific energy modeling in multi-parametric sequence space, with energy landscapes providing differential-geometric tissue characterization without segmentation labels.

entry.title: PhyEdit: Towards Real-World Object Manipulation via Physically-Grounded Image Editing

author.name: Ruihang Xu, Dewei Zhou, Xiaolong Shen, Fan Ma, Yi Yang

entry.summary: Presents PhyEdit, an image editing framework that uses explicit geometric simulation as 3D-aware visual guidance for physically accurate object manipulation, combined with joint 2D-3D supervision.

entry.title: BRIDGE: Multimodal-to-Text Retrieval via Reinforcement-Learned Query Alignment

author.name: Mohamed Darwish Mounis, Mohamed Mahmoud, Shaimaa Sedek, Mahmoud Abdalla, Mahmoud SalahEldin Kasem, Abdelrahman Abdallah, Hyun-Soo Kang

entry.summary: Proposes BRIDGE, a two-component system for multimodal-to-text retrieval using reinforcement learning to distill noisy multimodal queries into retrieval-optimized text, eliminating the need for multimodal encoders during retrieval.

entry.title: Vision-Language Model-Guided Deep Unrolling Enables Personalized, Fast MRI

author.name: Fangmao Ju, Yuzhu He, Zhiwen Xue, Chunfeng Lian, Jianhua Ma

entry.summary: Introduces PASS, an MRI framework that uses a Vision-Language Model to guide deep unrolling for personalized, task-oriented accelerated MRI with patient-specific k-space trajectory optimization.

entry.title: Grounded Forcing: Bridging Time-Independent Semantics and Proximal Dynamics in Autoregressive Video Synthesis

author.name: Jintao Chen, Chengyu Bai, Junjun hu, Xinda Xue, Mu Xu

entry.summary: Introduces Grounded Forcing for autoregressive video synthesis that bridges time-independent semantics and proximal dynamics through a Dual Memory KV Cache, addressing semantic forgetting, visual drift, and controllability loss.

entry.title: Learning to Search: A Decision-Based Agent for Knowledge-Based Visual Question Answering

author.name: Zhuohong Chen, Zhenxian Wu, Yunyao Yu, Hangrui Xu, Zirui Liao, Zhifang Liu, Xiangwen Deng, Pen Jiao, Haoqian Wang

entry.summary: Reformulates knowledge-based VQA as a search-agent problem where the model decides when to search, how to refine queries, and when to stop, rather than using a fixed retrieval-then-answer pipeline.

entry.title: Region-Graph Optimal Transport Routing for Mixture-of-Experts Whole-Slide Image Classification

author.name: Xin Tian, Jiuliu Lu, Ephraim Tsalik, Bart Wanders, Colleen Knoth, Julian Knight

entry.summary: Proposes ROAM, a Mixture-of-Experts approach for whole-slide image classification using region-graph optimal transport routing to ensure balanced expert utilization and spatial awareness in computational pathology.

entry.title: Uncertainty-Guided Latent Diagnostic Trajectory Learning for Sequential Clinical Diagnosis

author.name: Xuyang Shen, Haoran Liu, Dongjin Song, Martin Renqiang Min

entry.summary: Proposes LDTL, a framework for sequential clinical diagnosis that models evidence acquisition as a latent trajectory learning problem using a planning LLM agent. Addresses the challenge that clinical datasets rarely provide supervision for optimal diagnostic paths.

entry.title: HYVE: Hybrid Views for LLM Context Engineering over Machine Data

author.name: Jian Tan, Fan Bu, Yuqing Gao, Dev Khanolkar, Jason Mackay, Boris Sobolev, Lei Jin, Li Zhang

entry.summary: Presents HYVE, a framework for LLM context engineering with machine data payloads, using database management principles to handle long, nested, repetitive structured data like JSON and logs more effectively.

entry.title: Market-Bench: Benchmarking Large Language Models on Economic and Trade Competition

author.name: Yushuo Zheng (Affiliation 1, Affiliation 2), Huiyu Duan (Affiliation 1), Zicheng Zhang (Affiliation 1, Affiliation 2), Yucheng Zhu (Affiliation 1), Xiongkuo Min (Affiliation 1), Guangtao Zhai (Affiliation 1, Affiliation 2)

entry.summary: Introduces Market-Bench, a benchmark evaluating LLMs as economic agents in a configurable multi-agent supply chain model with procurement auctions and retail pricing, logging complete transaction histories for analysis.

entry.title: Beyond Behavior: Why AI Evaluation Needs a Cognitive Revolution

author.name: Amir Konigsberg

entry.summary: Argues that AI evaluation needs to move beyond behavioral testing (Turing test paradigm) to consider internal processes, mechanisms, and organization, drawing parallels with cognitive psychology's revolution against behaviorism.

entry.title: Towards Trustworthy Report Generation: A Deep Research Agent with Progressive Confidence Estimation and Calibration

author.name: Yi Yuan, Xuhong Wang, Shanzhe Lei

entry.summary: Proposes a deep research agent with progressive confidence estimation and calibration for trustworthy report generation, addressing the gap between subjective quality evaluation and epistemic confidence in generated content.

entry.title: Web Retrieval-Aware Chunking (W-RAC) for Efficient and Cost-Effective Retrieval-Augmented Generation Systems

author.name: Uday Allu, Sonu Kedia, Tanmay Odapally, Biddwan Ahmed

entry.summary: Proposes Web Retrieval-Aware Chunking (W-RAC), a cost-efficient chunking framework for RAG systems that decouples text extraction from semantic chunk planning using structured, ID-addressable units and LLM-based chunk boundary identification.

entry.title: EduIllustrate: Towards Scalable Automated Generation Of Multimodal Educational Content

author.name: Shuzhen Bi, Mingzi Zhang, Zhuoxuan Li, Xiaolong Wang, keqian Li, Aimin Zhou

entry.summary: Introduces EduIllustrate, a benchmark for evaluating LLMs on generating interleaved text-diagram explanations for K-12 STEM problems, with 230 problems across five subjects and an 8-dimension evaluation rubric.

entry.title: From Use to Oversight: How Mental Models Influence User Behavior and Output in AI Writing Assistants

author.name: Shalaleh Rismani, Su Lin Blodgett, Q. Vera Liao, Alexandra Olteanu, AJung Moon

entry.summary: Studies how users' mental models (functional vs. structural) of AI writing assistants affect their control behavior and oversight. Finds structural mental models increase critical assessment while functional models affect automation trust differently.

entry.title: Modality-Aware and Anatomical Vector-Quantized Autoencoding for Multimodal Brain MRI

author.name: Mingjie Li, Edward Kim, Yue Zhao, Ehsan Adeli, Kilian M. Pohl

entry.summary: Proposes NeuroQuant, a modality-aware 3D vector-quantized VAE for reconstructing multi-modal brain MRIs that separates modality-specific and shared anatomical representations using factorized multi-axis attention.

entry.title: Neural Network Pruning via QUBO Optimization

author.name: Osama Orabi, Artur Zagitov, Hadi Salloum, Viktor A. Lobachev, Kasymkhan Khubiev, Yaroslav Kholodov

entry.summary: Proposes a hybrid QUBO framework for neural network pruning that integrates gradient-aware sensitivity metrics (Taylor, Fisher) into the optimization, bridging heuristic importance estimation with global combinatorial optimization.

entry.title: Stories of Your Life as Others: A Round-Trip Evaluation of LLM-Generated Life Stories Conditioned on Rich Psychometric Profiles

author.name: Ben Wigler, Maria Tsfasman, Tiffany Matej Hrkalovic

entry.summary: Tests whether LLMs conditioned on real psychometric profiles from 290 participants can generate life stories that preserve personality differences, using round-trip evaluation beyond simple questionnaire self-report.

entry.title: DiffHDR: Re-Exposing LDR Videos with Video Diffusion Models

author.name: Zhengming Yu, Li Ma, Mingming He, Leo Isikdogan, Yuancheng Xu, Dmitriy Smirnov, Pablo Salamanca, Dao Mi, Pablo Delgado, Ning Yu, Julien Philip, Xin Li, Wenping Wang, Paul Debevec

entry.summary: DiffHDR formulates LDR-to-HDR video conversion as generative radiance inpainting in the latent space of a video diffusion model, operating in Log-Gamma color space for realistic detail restoration in over/underexposed regions.

entry.title: TalkLoRA: Communication-Aware Mixture of Low-Rank Adaptation for Large Language Models

author.name: Lin Mu, Haiyang Wang, Li Ni, Lei Sang, Zhize Wu, Peiquan Jin, Yiwen Zhang

entry.summary: Proposes TalkLoRA, which adds inter-expert communication to Mixture-of-Experts LoRA frameworks before routing decisions. A lightweight Talking Module enables information exchange across expert subspaces for more stable routing.

entry.title: Weighted Bayesian Conformal Prediction

author.name: Xiayin Lou, Peng Luo

entry.summary: Generalizes Bayesian conformal prediction to handle distribution shift by replacing the uniform Dirichlet prior with a weighted Dirichlet, combining the data-conditional guarantees of BQ-CP with the distributional flexibility of weighted conformal prediction.

entry.title: VLMShield: Efficient and Robust Defense of Vision-Language Models against Malicious Prompts

author.name: Peigui Qi, Kunsheng Tang, Yanpu Yu, Jialin Wu, Yide Song, Wenbo Zhou, Zhicong Huang, Cheng Hong, Weiming Zhang, Nenghai Yu

entry.summary: Proposes VLMShield, a lightweight safety detector for Vision-Language Models that identifies multimodal malicious attacks using CLIP-based feature extraction (MAFE framework) as a plug-and-play solution.

entry.title: Are Stochastic Multi-objective Bandits Harder than Single-objective Bandits?

author.name: Changkun Guan, Mengfan Xu

entry.summary: Resolves a question about whether stochastic multi-objective bandits are harder than single-objective ones, showing that Pareto regret need not increase with dimensionality in the stochastic setting, contradicting prior work.

entry.title: Selective Neuron Amplification for Training-Free Task Enhancement

author.name: Ryyan Akhtar

entry.summary: Proposes Selective Neuron Amplification (SNA), amplifying task-relevant neurons at inference time without changing model parameters. Shows this helps mainly when the model is uncertain, suggesting some failures are due to weak activation rather than missing capability.

entry.title: Mixture Proportion Estimation and Weakly-supervised Kernel Test for Conditional Independence

author.name: Yushi Hirose, Akito Narahara, Takafumi Kanamori

entry.summary: Proposes novel conditional independence assumptions for mixture proportion estimation (MPE) that ensure identifiability even when the standard irreducibility assumption fails. Develops method of moments estimators and weakly-supervised kernel tests for validating assumptions.

entry.title: Calibration of a neural network ocean closure for improved mean state and variability

author.name: Pavel Perezhogin, Alistair Adcroft, Laure Zanna

entry.summary: Uses Ensemble Kalman Inversion to calibrate neural network parameterizations of mesoscale ocean eddies, reducing errors in mean state and variability by roughly 2x compared to unparameterized or offline-trained models.

entry.title: A Generalized Sinkhorn Algorithm for Mean-Field Schr\"odinger Bridge

author.name: Asmaa Eldesoukey, Yongxin Chen, Abhishek Halder

entry.summary: Proposes a generalized Sinkhorn algorithm for mean-field Schrödinger bridge problems involving interacting agents, using a novel Hopf-Cole transform to handle the nonconvexity from nonlocal interactions.

entry.title: Variational Feature Compression for Model-Specific Representations

author.name: Zinan Guo, Zihan Wang, Chuan Yan, Liuhuo Wan, Ethan Ma, Guangdong Bai

entry.summary: Proposes a variational feature extraction framework that suppresses cross-model transfer while preserving accuracy for a designated classifier, preventing unauthorized model repurposing of submitted data.

entry.title: Adaptive Prompt Structure Factorization: A Framework for Self-Discovering and Optimizing Compositional Prompt Programs

author.name: Haoyue Liu, Zhichao Wang, Yongxin Guo, Haoran Shou, Xiaoying Tang

entry.summary: Proposes aPSF, a framework for automated prompt optimization that decomposes monolithic prompts into semantic factors and performs interventional single-factor updates with error-guided selection.

entry.title: Temporally Phenotyping GLP-1RA Case Reports with Large Language Models: A Textual Time Series Corpus and Risk Modeling

author.name: Sayantan Kumar, Jeremy C. Weiss

entry.summary: Develops a textual time-series corpus of 136 PubMed case reports involving GLP-1 drugs with clinical events mapped to reference times, evaluating LLM timeline extraction against expert annotations. Notes GPT5 achieves 0.871 event coverage.

entry.title: Tool-MCoT: Tool Augmented Multimodal Chain-of-Thought for Content Safety Moderation

author.name: Shutong Zhang, Dylan Zhou, Yinxiao Liu, Yang Yang, Huiwen Luo, Wenfei Zou

entry.summary: Tool-MCoT fine-tunes a small language model for content safety moderation using tool-augmented chain-of-thought data generated by LLMs, showing SLMs can learn to use external tools for improved reasoning in moderation tasks.

entry.title: CCD-CBT: Multi-Agent Therapeutic Interaction for CBT Guided by Cognitive Conceptualization Diagram

author.name: Chang Liu, Changsheng Ma, Yongfeng Tao, Bin Hu, Minqiang Yang

entry.summary: CCD-CBT introduces a multi-agent framework for CBT therapy simulation with dynamically reconstructed cognitive conceptualization diagrams and information-asymmetric therapist-client interaction, releasing CCDCHAT dataset.

entry.title: SQLStructEval: Structural Evaluation of LLM Text-to-SQL Generation

author.name: Yixi Zhou, Fan Zhang, Zhiqiao Guo, Yu Chen, Haipeng Zhang, Preslav Nakov, Zhuohan Xie

entry.summary: SQLStructEval analyzes structural behavior of LLM-generated SQL via canonical AST representations, finding LLMs produce structurally diverse queries even for correct results, with variance triggered by surface-level input changes.

entry.title: HingeMem: Boundary Guided Long-Term Memory with Query Adaptive Retrieval for Scalable Dialogues

author.name: Yijie Zhong, Yunfan Gao, Haofen Wang

entry.summary: Proposes HingeMem, a long-term memory system for dialogue based on event segmentation theory, using boundary-triggered hyperedges over person/time/location/topic elements with adaptive retrieval.

entry.title: Sell More, Play Less: Benchmarking LLM Realistic Selling Skill

author.name: Xuanbo Su, Wenhao Hu, Le Zhan, Yanqi Yang, Leo Huang

entry.summary: Introduces SalesLLM, a bilingual benchmark for evaluating LLMs in sales dialogues with controllable difficulty, automatic evaluation pipeline, and a trained customer simulator for realistic interactions.

entry.title: Yale-DM-Lab at ArchEHR-QA 2026: Deterministic Grounding and Multi-Pass Evidence Alignment for EHR Question Answering

author.name: Elyas Irankhah, Samah Fodeh

entry.summary: Describes a system for EHR question answering using model ensembles (o3, GPT-5.2, GPT-5.1, DeepSeek-R1) with few-shot prompting and voting, finding model diversity consistently improves performance.

entry.title: Digital Skin, Digital Bias: Uncovering Tone-Based Biases in LLMs and Emoji Embeddings

author.name: Mingchen Li, Wajdi Aljedaani, Yingjie Liu, Navyasri Meka, Xuan Lu, Xinyue Ye, Junhua Ding, Yunhe Feng

entry.summary: First large-scale study of bias in skin-toned emoji representations across emoji embedding models and four LLMs, revealing critical performance gaps in older emoji embedding models.

entry.title: DesigNet: Learning to Draw Vector Graphics as Designers Do

author.name: Tomas Guija-Valiente, Iago Su\'arez

entry.summary: Presents DesigNet, a hierarchical Transformer-VAE for generating vector graphics (SVG) that mimics human designer tools like axis alignment and continuity control. Introduces differentiable modules for continuity self-refinement at curve junctions.

entry.title: RePL: Pseudo-label Refinement for Semi-supervised LiDAR Semantic Segmentation

author.name: Donghyeon Kwon, Taegyu Park, Suha Kwak

entry.summary: Introduces RePL for semi-supervised LiDAR semantic segmentation that refines pseudo-labels through masked reconstruction. Provides theoretical analysis of when pseudo-label refinement is beneficial.

entry.title: Compression as an Adversarial Amplifier Through Decision Space Reduction

author.name: Lewis Evans, Harkrishan Jandu, Zihan Ye, Yang Lu, Shreyank N Gowda

entry.summary: Shows that image compression can act as an adversarial amplifier for deep classifiers, with compression-aware attacks being substantially more effective than pixel-space attacks under identical perturbation budgets.

entry.title: Not all tokens contribute equally to diffusion learning

author.name: Guoqing Zhang, Lu Shi, Wanru Xu, Linna Zhang, Sen Wang, Fangfang Wang, Yigang Cen

entry.summary: Proposes DARE, a framework addressing the issue that diffusion models neglect semantically important tokens during inference, due to distributional bias from long-tailed token frequency and spatial misalignment in cross-attention.

entry.title: Bridging MRI and PET physiology: Untangling complementarity through orthogonal representations

author.name: Sonja Adomeit, Kartikay Tehlan, Lukas F\"orner, Katharina Weisser, Helen Scholtiseek, David Kaufmann, Julie Steinestel, Constantin Lapa, Thomas Kr\"oncke, Thomas Wendler

entry.summary: Proposes a subspace decomposition framework for MRI-PET fusion that separates PSMA PET uptake into an MRI-explainable component and an orthogonal residual capturing information beyond MRI features.

entry.title: Geo-EVS: Geometry-Conditioned Extrapolative View Synthesis for Autonomous Driving

author.name: Yatong Lan, Rongkui Tang, Lei He

entry.summary: Proposes Geo-EVS for extrapolative novel view synthesis in autonomous driving, using geometry-conditioned reprojection from VGGT-reconstructed point clouds to handle out-of-trajectory views.
