entry.summary: Euclid space telescope collaboration presents AgileLens, a CNN-based pipeline for identifying strong gravitational lensing systems in the Euclid Q1 imaging data. Uses iterative VGG16-based classification on 96x96 pixel cutouts from VIS and NISP instruments.

entry.title: BATON: A Multimodal Benchmark for Bidirectional Automation Transition Observation in Naturalistic Driving

author.name: Yuhang Wang, Yiyao Xu, Chaoyun Yang, Lingyao Li, Jingran Sun, Hao Zhou

entry.summary: Introduces BATON, a large-scale naturalistic driving dataset capturing multimodal context (road scene, driver state, vehicle dynamics) for studying bidirectional automation transitions - both driver-to-automation and automation-to-driver handovers.

entry.title: Differentiable Environment-Trajectory Co-Optimization for Safe Multi-Agent Navigation

author.name: Zhan Gao, Gabriele Fadini, Stelian Coros, Amanda Prorok

entry.summary: Formulates multi-agent navigation as a bi-level optimization where environment configurations and agent trajectories are jointly optimized using differentiable optimization with interior point methods.

entry.title: Flow Motion Policy: Manipulator Motion Planning with Flow Matching Models

author.name: Davood Soleymanzadeh, Xiao Liang, Minghui Zheng

entry.summary: Introduces Flow Motion Policy, an open-loop neural motion planner using flow matching to capture multi-modality in planning datasets, enabling stochastic path generation and inference-time optimization for robotic manipulators.

entry.title: How Does an Agent with Multiple Goals Choose a Target?

author.name: sturb

entry.summary: Master's thesis findings on how maze-solving RL agents internally represent and switch between multiple goals, discovering spatial gating through negative activations as the key mechanism rather than channel specialization.

entry.title: Algebraic Structure Discovery for Real World Combinatorial Optimisation Problems: A General Framework from Abstract Algebra to Quotient Space Learning

author.name: Min Sun (F. Hoffmann-La Roche AG, Roche Pharma Research and Early Development), Federica Storti (F. Hoffmann-La Roche AG, Roche Pharma Research and Early Development), Valentina Martino (F. Hoffmann-La Roche AG, Roche Pharma Research and Early Development), Miguel Gonzalez-Andrades (F. Hoffmann-La Roche AG, Roche Pharma Research and Early Development), Tony Kam-Thong (F. Hoffmann-La Roche AG, Roche Pharma Research and Early Development)

entry.summary: Presents a framework from Roche that discovers algebraic structures in combinatorial optimization problems, constructs quotient spaces to collapse redundant representations, and optimizes over reduced spaces. Demonstrates isomorphism between conjunctive rules and Boolean hypercube with bitwise OR.

entry.title: Reason Analogically via Cross-domain Prior Knowledge: An Empirical Study of Cross-domain Knowledge Transfer for In-Context Learning

author.name: Le Liu, Zhiming Li, Jianzhi Yan, Zike Yuan, Shiwei Chen, Youcheng Pan, Buzhou Tang, Qingcai Chen, Yang Xiang, Danny Dongning Sun

entry.summary: Empirical study of cross-domain knowledge transfer under in-context learning, finding conditional positive transfer and an 'example absorption threshold' beyond which positive transfer becomes more likely.

entry.title: Experience Transfer for Multimodal LLM Agents in Minecraft Game

author.name: Chenghao Li, Jun Liu, Songbo Zhang, Huadong Jian, Hao Ni, Lik-Hang Lee, Sung-Ho Bae, Guoqing Wang, Yang Yang, Chaoning Zhang

entry.summary: Proposes Echo, a transfer-oriented memory framework for multimodal LLM agents in Minecraft that decomposes reusable knowledge into five dimensions and uses In-Context Analogy Learning for cross-task experience transfer.

entry.title: A canonical generalization of OBDD

author.name: Florent Capelli, YooJung Choi, Stefan Mengel, Mart\'in Mu\~noz, Guy Van den Broeck

entry.summary: Introduces Tree Decision Diagrams (TDD), a generalization of OBDD for Boolean functions that maintains the same tractability properties while being more succinct. Shows CNF formulas of treewidth k can be represented by TDDs of FPT size.

entry.title: JTON: A Token-Efficient JSON Superset with Zen Grid Tabular Encoding for Large Language Models

author.name: Gowthamkumar Nandakishore

entry.summary: Presents JTON, a JSON superset that factors column headers into a single row and encodes values with semicolons, reducing token counts by 15-60% versus compact JSON while maintaining LLM comprehension accuracy.

entry.title: From PDF to RAG-Ready: Evaluating Document Conversion Frameworks for Domain-Specific Question Answering

author.name: Jos\'e Guilherme Marques dos Santos, Ricardo Yang, Rui Humberto Pereira, Alexandre Sousa, Br\'igida M\'onica Faria, Henrique Lopes Cardoso, Jos\'e Duarte, Jos\'e Lu\'is Reis, Lu\'is Paulo Reis, Pedro Pimenta, Jos\'e Paulo Marques dos Santos

entry.summary: Systematically compares four PDF-to-Markdown conversion frameworks for RAG systems across 19 pipeline configurations, finding significant impact on downstream QA accuracy. Tests on Portuguese administrative documents with LLM-as-judge evaluation.

entry.title: Prune-Quantize-Distill: An Ordered Pipeline for Efficient Neural Network Compression

author.name: Longsheng Zhou, Yu Shen

entry.summary: Studies a practical compression pipeline ordering (prune, quantize, distill) for neural networks, finding INT8 quantization provides the dominant runtime gain while unstructured pruning provides minimal acceleration despite reducing storage.

entry.title: ID-Sim: An Identity-Focused Similarity Metric

author.name: Julia Chae, Nicholas Kolkin, Jui-Hsien Wang, Richard Zhang, Sara Beery, Cusuh Ham

entry.summary: Proposes ID-Sim, a feed-forward metric for measuring identity-focused image similarity that reflects human selective sensitivity to identities across diverse contexts, trained on curated real and synthetic data.

entry.title: Curvature-Aware Optimization for High-Accuracy Physics-Informed Neural Networks

author.name: Anas Jnini, Elham Kiyani, Khemraj Shukla, Jorge F. Urban, Nazanin Ahmadi Daryakenari, Johannes Muller, Marius Zeinhofer, George Em Karniadakis

entry.summary: Presents advanced optimization strategies for PINNs including Natural Gradient, Self-Scaling BFGS, and Broyden optimizers, demonstrating faster convergence to high accuracy on challenging PDEs and ODEs.

entry.title: DQA: Diagnostic Question Answering for IT Support

author.name: Vishaal Kapoor, Mariam Dundua, Sarthak Ahuja, Neda Kordjazi, Evren Yortucboylu, Vaibhavi Padala, Derek Ho, Jennifer Whitted, Rebecca Steinert

entry.summary: Introduces DQA, a diagnostic question-answering framework for IT support that maintains persistent diagnostic state and aggregates retrieved cases at the root-cause level rather than individual documents, enabling iterative evidence gathering across conversation turns.

entry.title: Multiscale Physics-Informed Neural Network for Complex Fluid Flows with Long-Range Dependencies

author.name: Prashant Kumar, Rajesh Ranjan

entry.summary: DDS-PINN introduces domain decomposition and shifted physics-informed neural networks for solving complex fluid flows with long-range dependencies, using localized networks with minimal supervision.

entry.title: Swiss-Bench 003: Evaluating LLM Reliability and Adversarial Security for Swiss Regulatory Contexts

author.name: Fatih Uenal

entry.summary: Swiss-Bench 003 extends the HAAS framework for evaluating LLM reliability and adversarial security in Swiss regulatory contexts, testing 10 frontier models across 808 items in four languages including Swiss German.

entry.title: "I See What You Did There": Can Large Vision-Language Models Understand Multimodal Puns?

author.name: Naen Xu, Jiayi Sheng, Changjiang Li, Chunyi Zhou, Yuyuan Li, Tianyu Du, Jun Wang, Zhihui Fu, Jinbao Li, Shouling Ji

entry.summary: MultiPun introduces a benchmark for evaluating whether vision-language models can understand multimodal puns, revealing that most models struggle to distinguish genuine puns from adversarial distractors.

entry.title: Saliency-Guided Representation with Consistency Policy Learning for Visual Unsupervised Reinforcement Learning

author.name: Jingbo Sun, Qichao Zhang, Songjun Tu, Xing Fang, Yupeng Zheng, Haoran Li, Ke Chen, Dongbin Zhao

entry.summary: Proposes saliency-guided representation learning with consistency policy for visual unsupervised reinforcement learning, addressing issues where successor representations attend to dynamics-irrelevant regions.

entry.title: Stochastic Gradient Descent in the Saddle-to-Saddle Regime of Deep Linear Networks

author.name: Guillaume Corlouer, Avi Semler, Alexander Strang, Alexander Gietelink Oldenziel

entry.summary: Analyzes SGD dynamics in deep linear networks during saddle-to-saddle transitions, modeling training as stochastic Langevin dynamics with anisotropic noise and deriving exact per-mode decompositions showing maximal diffusion precedes convergence.

entry.title: Conformal Margin Risk Minimization: An Envelope Framework for Robust Learning under Label Noise

author.name: Yuanjie Shi, Peihong Li, Zijian Zhang, Janardhan Rao Doppa, Yan Yan

entry.summary: Proposes CMRM, a plug-and-play framework for learning with noisy labels that adds a conformal quantile-calibrated regularization term to any classification loss, requiring no clean subsets or noise transition matrices.

entry.title: Efficient Quantization of Mixture-of-Experts with Theoretical Generalization Guarantees

author.name: Mohammed Nowaz Rabbani Chowdhury, Kaoutar El Maghraoui, Hsinyu Tsai, Naigang Wang, Geoffrey W. Burr, Liu Liu, Meng Wang

entry.summary: Proposes a theoretically grounded expert-wise mixed precision quantization strategy for Mixture-of-Experts models that assigns bit-widths based on expert sensitivity analysis, with generalization guarantees.

entry.title: STQuant: Spatio-Temporal Adaptive Framework for Optimizer Quantization in Large Multimodal Model Training

author.name: Minglu Liu, Cunchen Hu, Liangliang Xu, Fengming Tang, Ruijia Wang, Fu Yu

entry.summary: Proposes STQuant for dynamic precision allocation of optimizer states during large multimodal model training, varying quantization across layers, state variables, and training steps to reduce memory while maintaining quality.

entry.title: Weaves, Wires, and Morphisms: Formalizing and Implementing the Algebra of Deep Learning

author.name: Vincent Abbott, Gioele Zardini

entry.summary: Introduces a categorical framework for deep learning architectures that formalizes broadcasting through novel axis-stride and array-broadcasted categories, enabling precise mathematical expression and manipulation of model architectures.

entry.title: The Unreasonable Effectiveness of Data for Recommender Systems

author.name: Youssef Abdou

entry.summary: Investigates how recommendation performance scales with training data size across 11 large datasets and 10 algorithms, examining whether a saturation point exists where additional data stops providing meaningful gains.

entry.title: Spatiotemporal Gaussian representation-based dynamic reconstruction and motion estimation framework for time-resolved volumetric MR imaging (DREME-GSMR)

author.name: Jiacheng Xie, Hua-Chieh Shao, Can Wu, Ricardo Otazo, Jie Deng, Mu-Han Lin, Tsuicheng Chiu, Jacob Buatti, Viktor Iakovenko, You Zhang

entry.summary: Develops DREME-GSMR, a spatiotemporal Gaussian representation framework for time-resolved volumetric MRI reconstruction enabling sub-second 3D imaging for motion-adaptive radiotherapy without prior anatomical models.

entry.title: CBM-Dual: A 65-nm Fully Connected Chaotic Boltzmann Machine Processor for Dual Function Simulated Annealing and Reservoir Computing

author.name: Kanta Yoshioka, Soshi Hirayae, Yuichiro Tanaka, Yuichi Katori, Takashi Morie, Hakaru Tamukoh

entry.summary: Presents CBM-Dual, a silicon-proven 65nm processor implementing a 1024-neuron chaotic Boltzmann machine supporting both simulated annealing and reservoir computing, achieving 99% MAC reduction through scheduling.

entry.title: Continuous-Time Dynamics of the Difference-of-Convex Algorithm

author.name: Yi-Shuai Niu

entry.summary: Studies continuous-time dynamics of the difference-of-convex algorithm, showing classical DCA is exact Euler discretization of a nonlinear system in dual coordinates. Develops damped DCA with convergence guarantees.

entry.title: DDP-SA: Scalable Privacy-Preserving Federated Learning via Distributed Differential Privacy and Secure Aggregation

author.name: Wenjing Wei, Farid Nait-Abdesselam, Alla Jammine

entry.summary: Presents DDP-SA, a federated learning framework combining local differential privacy with additive secret sharing for two-stage privacy protection, providing stronger end-to-end guarantees.

entry.title: CADENCE: Context-Adaptive Depth Estimation for Navigation and Computational Efficiency

author.name: Timothy K Johnsen, Marco Levorato

entry.summary: CADENCE adaptively scales the computational complexity of monocular depth estimation based on navigation needs and environmental context, ensuring high-precision computing is used only when mission-critical for autonomous vehicles.

entry.title: Consistency-Guided Decoding with Proof-Driven Disambiguation for Three-Way Logical Question Answering

author.name: Tianyi Huang, Ming Hou, Jiaheng Su, Yutong Zhang, Ziling Zhang

entry.summary: CGD-PD addresses negation inconsistency and epistemic Unknown failures in three-way logical QA by querying a classifier on both H and ¬H, projecting onto consistent decisions, and using proof-driven disambiguation.

entry.title: ChemVLR: Prioritizing Reasoning in Perception for Chemical Vision-Language Understanding

author.name: Xuanle Zhao, Xinyuan Cai, Xiang Cheng, Xiuyi Chen, Bo Xu

entry.summary: ChemVLR introduces a chemical VLM that prioritizes reasoning by explicitly identifying granular chemical descriptors (functional groups) during visual analysis before generating answers, improving interpretability.

entry.title: Multilingual Cognitive Impairment Detection in the Era of Foundation Models

author.name: Damar Hoogland, Boshko Koloski, Jaya Caporusso, Tine Kolenik, Ana Zwitter Vitez, Senja Pollak, Christina Manouilidou, Matthew Purver

entry.summary: Evaluates cognitive impairment detection from speech transcripts across English, Slovene, and Korean using LLMs vs supervised models. Finds supervised tabular models with engineered features generally outperform zero-shot LLMs.

entry.title: Is Biomedical Specialization Still Worth It? Insights from Domain-Adaptive Language Modelling with a New French Health Corpus

author.name: Aidan Mannion, C\'ecile Macaire, Armand Violle, St\'ephane Ohayon, Xavier Tannier, Didier Schwab, Lorraine Goeuriot, Fran\c{c}ois Portet

entry.summary: Investigates domain-adaptive pretraining for French biomedical LLMs, releasing a new open-licensed French biomedical corpus. Analyzes tradeoffs between domain-specific gains and general capability degradation.

entry.title: DTCRS: Dynamic Tree Construction for Recursive Summarization

author.name: Guanran Luo, Zhongquan Jian, Wentao Qiu, Meihong Wang, Qingqiang Wu

entry.summary: Proposes DTCRS for dynamically generating summary trees based on document structure and query semantics for RAG, reducing redundant summary nodes in recursive summarization.

entry.title: SemEval-2026 Task 3: Dimensional Aspect-Based Sentiment Analysis (DimABSA)

author.name: Liang-Chih Yu, Jonas Becker, Shamsuddeen Hassan Muhammad, Idris Abdulmumin, Lung-Hao Lee, Ying-Lung Lin, Jin Wang, Jan Philip Wahle, Terry Ruas, Natalia Loukachevitch, Alexander Panchenko, Ilseyar Alimova, Lilian Wanzare, Nelson Odhiambo, Bela Gipp, Kai-Wei Chang, Saif M. Mohammad

entry.summary: Presents SemEval-2026 Task 3 on Dimensional Aspect-Based Sentiment Analysis, modeling sentiment along valence-arousal dimensions rather than categorical labels, with an additional stance analysis track.

entry.title: Specializing Large Models for Oracle Bone Script Interpretation via Component-Grounded Multimodal Knowledge Augmentation

author.name: Jianing Zhang, Runan Li, Honglin Pang, Ding Xia, Zhou Zhu, Qian Zhang, Chuntao Li, Xi Yang

entry.summary: Proposes a VLM framework for Oracle Bone Script interpretation using component-grounded multimodal knowledge augmentation with agent-driven reasoning chain of component identification and knowledge retrieval.

entry.title: Strategic Persuasion with Trait-Conditioned Multi-Agent Systems for Iterative Legal Argumentation

author.name: Philipp D. Siedler

entry.summary: Presents the Strategic Courtroom Framework, a multi-agent simulation where trait-conditioned LLM agents engage in iterative legal argumentation, evaluating over 7,000 simulations across configurations.

entry.title: VDPP: Video Depth Post-Processing for Speed and Scalability

author.name: Daewon Yoon, Injun Baek, Sangyu Han, Yearim Kim, Nojun Kwak

entry.summary: Proposes VDPP, a video depth post-processing method that can plug in any single-image depth estimator and provide temporally consistent video depth, addressing the adaptation lag when new image depth models are released.

entry.title: From Static to Interactive: Adapting Visual in-Context Learners for User-Driven Tasks

author.name: Carlos Schmidt, Simon Rei{\ss}

entry.summary: Proposes adapting visual in-context learning models to support interactive user guidance (scribbles, clicks, bounding boxes) for steering predictions, moving from a static to interactive paradigm.

entry.title: Physical Adversarial Attacks on AI Surveillance Systems:Detection, Tracking, and Visible--Infrared Evasion

author.name: Miguel A. DelaCruz, Patricia Mae Santos, Rafael T. Navarro

entry.summary: Reviews physical adversarial attacks on AI surveillance systems from a comprehensive perspective including detection, multi-object tracking, and visible-infrared evasion. Reframes the threat model for deployed surveillance rather than isolated benchmarks.

entry.title: Auditing Demographic Bias in Facial Landmark Detection for Fair Human-Robot Interaction

author.name: Pablo Parte, Roberto Valle, Jos\'e M. Buenaposada, Luis Baumela

entry.summary: Conducts a systematic audit of demographic bias in facial landmark detection, introducing a controlled statistical methodology to disentangle demographic effects from confounding visual factors like head pose and resolution.

entry.title: ModuSeg: Decoupling Object Discovery and Semantic Retrieval for Training-Free Weakly Supervised Segmentation

author.name: Qingze He, Fagui Liu, Dengke Zhang, Qingmao Wei, Quan Tang

entry.summary: Proposes ModuSeg, a training-free weakly supervised semantic segmentation framework that explicitly decouples object discovery from semantic assignment using foundation models.

entry.title: SurFITR: A Dataset for Surveillance Image Forgery Detection and Localisation

author.name: Qizhou Wang, Guansong Pang, Christopher Leckie

entry.summary: Presents SurFITR, a dataset for surveillance-style image forgery detection using multimodal LLM-powered generation to create forensically valuable forgeries with localized, subtle manipulations.

entry.title: A Utility-preserving De-identification Pipeline for Cross-hospital Radiology Data Sharing

author.name: Chenhao Liu, Zelin Wen, Yan Tong, Junjie Zhu, Xinyu Tian, Yuchi Liu, Ashu Gupta, Syed M. S. Islam, Tom Gedeon, Yue Yao

entry.summary: Introduces a utility-preserving de-identification pipeline for cross-hospital radiology data sharing that balances privacy removal with preservation of pathology-related information for model training.

entry.title: A Noise Constrained Diffusion (NC-Diffusion) Framework for High Fidelity Image Compression

author.name: Zhenyu Du, Yanbo Gao, Shuai Li, Yiyang Li, Hui Yuan, Mao Ye

entry.summary: Proposes NC-Diffusion, a framework that reformulates quantization noise in learned image compression as the noise in diffusion forward processes, addressing the deviation problem in diffusion-based image compression for higher fidelity.

entry.title: Train-Small Deploy-Large: Leveraging Diffusion-Based Multi-Robot Planning

author.name: Siddharth Singh, Soumee Guha, Qing Chang, Scott Acton

entry.summary: Proposes a diffusion model-based multi-robot path planner that can train on a small number of agents and generalize to larger numbers during deployment, addressing scalability limitations of learning-based methods.

entry.title: Genie Sim PanoRecon: Fast Immersive Scene Generation from Single-View Panorama

author.name: Zhijun Li, Yongxin Su, Di Yang, Jichao Wang, Zheyuan Xing, Qian Wang, Maoqing Yao

entry.summary: Presents Genie Sim PanoRecon, a feed-forward Gaussian splatting pipeline that reconstructs 3D scenes from single panorama views in seconds for robotic manipulation simulation, integrated into the Genie Sim platform.

entry.title: TAMEn: Tactile-Aware Manipulation Engine for Closed-Loop Data Collection in Contact-Rich Tasks

author.name: Longyan Wu, Jieji Ren, Chenghang Jiang, Junxi Zhou, Shijia Peng, Ran Huang, Guoying Gu, Li Chen, Hongyang Li

entry.summary: Presents TAMEn, a tactile-aware handheld data collection system for contact-rich bimanual manipulation with online feasibility checking and authentic tactile feedback for policy refinement.

entry.title: Time Series Gaussian Chain Graph Models

author.name: Qin Fang, Xinghao Qiao, Zihan Wang

entry.summary: Introduces time series Gaussian chain graph models combining directed edges across variable blocks with undirected within-block edges, exploiting group sparse + low-rank decomposition of inverse spectral density matrices.

entry.title: AI as a Trojan horse race

author.name: KatjaGrace

entry.summary: Argues the AI development situation is not an arms race but a 'Trojan horse race' where going fast isn't clearly the best selfish strategy, analogous to playing chess when the prizes are for checkers.

entry.title: Automated Auditing of Hospital Discharge Summaries for Care Transitions

author.name: Akshat Dasula, Prasanna Desikan, Jaideep Srivastava

entry.summary: Proposes an automated framework for large-scale auditing of hospital discharge summaries using locally-deployed LLMs, operationalizing the DISCHARGED framework into a structured validation checklist on MIMIC-IV data.

entry.title: OmniDiagram: Advancing Unified Diagram Code Generation via Visual Interrogation Reward

author.name: Haoyue Yang, Xuanle Zhao, Xuexin Liu, Feibang Jiang, Yao Zhu

entry.summary: Proposes OmniDiagram, a unified framework for diagram code generation with a novel Visual Interrogation (VIVA) reward strategy that evaluates rendered visual structure rather than relying on syntax-based rules or pixel matching.

entry.title: SignalClaw: LLM-Guided Evolutionary Synthesis of Interpretable Traffic Signal Control Skills

author.name: Da Lei, Feng Xiao, Lu Li, Yuzhan Liu

entry.summary: Proposes SignalClaw, using LLMs as evolutionary skill generators to synthesize interpretable traffic signal control strategies with rationale, selection guidance, and executable code, guided by natural language simulation feedback.

entry.title: QA-MoE: Towards a Continuous Reliability Spectrum with Quality-Aware Mixture of Experts for Robust Multimodal Sentiment Analysis

author.name: Yitong Zhu, Yuxuan Jiang, Guanxuan Jiang, Bojing Hou, Peng Yuan Zhou, Ge Lin Kan, Yuyang Wang

entry.summary: Proposes QA-MoE, a Quality-Aware Mixture-of-Experts framework for multimodal sentiment analysis that handles continuously varying modality reliability through self-supervised aleatoric uncertainty estimation.

entry.title: Joint Knowledge Base Completion and Question Answering by Combining Large Language Models and Small Language Models

author.name: Yinan Liu, Dongying Lin, Sigang Luo, Xiaochun Yang, Bin Wang

entry.summary: Proposes JCQL, a framework combining LLMs and small language models for joint knowledge base completion and question answering in an iterative mutual reinforcement loop.

entry.title: The Planetary Cost of AI Acceleration, Part II: The 10th Planetary Boundary and the 6.5-Year Countdown

author.name: William Yicheng Zhu, Lei Zhu

entry.summary: Argues that super-exponential scaling of LLM agents creates a '10th planetary boundary' through thermodynamic heat generation from AI computation, projecting a 6.5-year countdown to exceeding Earth's heat dissipation threshold.

entry.title: CRAB: Codebook Rebalancing for Bias Mitigation in Generative Recommendation

author.name: Zezhong Fan, Ziheng Chen, Luyi Ma, Jin Huang, Lalitesh Morishetti, Kaushiki Nag, Sushant Kumar, Kannan Achan

entry.summary: Proposes CRAB, a codebook rebalancing method to mitigate popularity bias in generative recommendation systems, identifying that imbalanced tokenization and biased training amplify existing popularity biases.

entry.title: Offline RL for Adaptive Policy Retrieval in Prior Authorization

author.name: Ruslan Sharifullin, Maxim Gorshkov, Hannah Clay

entry.summary: Models prior authorization policy retrieval as a sequential decision-making problem, training adaptive retrieval policies using offline RL (CQL, IQL) to balance decision correctness against retrieval cost in healthcare settings.

entry.title: Improving Clinical Trial Recruitment using Clinical Narratives and Large Language Models

author.name: Ziyi Chen, Mengxian Lyu, Cheng Peng, Yonghui Wu

entry.summary: Explores encoder- and decoder-based LLMs for screening clinical narratives for trial recruitment, comparing strategies to handle long documents including extractive summarization and chunking approaches.

entry.title: Spec Kit Agents: Context-Grounded Agentic Workflows

author.name: Pardis Taghavi, Santosh Bhavani

entry.summary: Presents Spec Kit Agents, a multi-agent development pipeline that adds context-grounding hooks (read-only probing and validation) to each phase of spec-driven development, improving code quality by +0.15 on a 1-5 scale across 128 runs.

entry.title: LanG -- A Governance-Aware Agentic AI Platform for Unified Security Operations

author.name: Anes Abdennebi, Nadjia Kara, Laaziz Lahlou, Hakima Ould-Slimane

entry.summary: LanG is an open-source agentic AI platform for security operations that unifies incident correlation, LLM-based rule generation for Snort/Suricata/YARA, and human-in-the-loop orchestration to address alert fatigue in SOCs.

entry.title: Analogical Reasoning as a Doctor: A Foundation Model for Gastrointestinal Endoscopy Diagnosis

author.name: Peixi Peng (Institute of Medical Robotics, School of Biomedical Engineering, Shanghai Jiao Tong University), Housheng Xie (Institute of Medical Robotics, School of Biomedical Engineering, Shanghai Jiao Tong University), Yanling Wei (Daping Hospital, Army Medical University), Guangcong Ruan (Daping Hospital, Army Medical University), Xiaoyang Zou (Institute of Medical Robotics, School of Biomedical Engineering, Shanghai Jiao Tong University), Qian Cao (Sir Run Run Shaw Hospital, Zhejiang University School of Medicine), Yongjian Nian (Daping Hospital, Army Medical University), Guoyan Zheng (Institute of Medical Robotics, School of Biomedical Engineering, Shanghai Jiao Tong University)

entry.summary: RATNet is a foundation model for gastrointestinal endoscopy that uses analogical reasoning and cyclic pre-training across five datasets to improve generalizability and handle heterogeneous annotations.

entry.title: On the Robustness of Diffusion-Based Image Compression to Bit-Flip Errors

author.name: Amit Vaisman, Gal Pomerants, Raz Lapid

entry.summary: Shows that diffusion-based image compressors built on Reverse Channel Coding are substantially more robust to bit-flip errors than classical and learned codecs, and introduces a more robust variant.

entry.title: Selective Aggregation of Attention Maps Improves Diffusion-Based Visual Interpretation

author.name: Jungwon Park, Jungmin Ko, Dongnam Byun, Wonjong Rhee

entry.summary: Shows that selectively aggregating cross-attention maps from the most concept-relevant attention heads in diffusion models improves visual interpretability and segmentation compared to uniform aggregation.

entry.title: LLM4CodeRE: Generative AI for Code Decompilation Analysis and Reverse Engineering

author.name: Hamed Jelodar, Samita Bai, Tochukwu Emmanuel Nwankwo, Parisa Hamedi, Mohammad Meymani, Roozbeh Razavi-Far, Ali A. Ghorbani

entry.summary: LLM4CodeRE is a framework for bidirectional code reverse engineering (assembly-to-source and source-to-assembly) adapted for malware analysis using multi-adapter and progressive training strategies.

entry.title: Shot-Based Quantum Encoding: A Data-Loading Paradigm for Quantum Neural Networks

author.name: Basil Kyriacou, Viktoria Patapovich, Maniraman Periyasamy, Alexey Melnikov

entry.summary: Shot-Based Quantum Encoding distributes measurement shots according to data-dependent distributions over multiple quantum states, providing a new data loading paradigm for near-term quantum machine learning.

entry.title: Toward a universal foundation model for graph-structured data

author.name: Sakib Mostafa, Lei Xing, Md. Tauhidul Islam

entry.summary: Proposes a universal foundation model for graph-structured data in biomedical research, aiming to transfer across molecular networks, gene circuits, and knowledge graphs unlike existing graph neural networks trained on single datasets.

entry.title: MICA: Multivariate Infini Compressive Attention for Time Series Forecasting

author.name: Willa Potosnak, Nina \.Zukowska, Micha{\l} Wili\'nski, Dan Howarth, Ignacy St\k{e}pka, Mononito Goswami, Artur Dubrawski

entry.summary: Proposes MICA, extending channel-independent Transformers to channel-dependent forecasting by adapting efficient attention from sequence to channel dimension, scaling linearly with both channel count and context length.

entry.title: Towards Accurate and Calibrated Classification: Regularizing Cross-Entropy From A Generative Perspective

author.name: Qipeng Zhan, Zhuoping Zhou, Li Shen

entry.summary: Proposes Generative Cross-Entropy (GCE) loss that maximizes p(x|y), equivalent to cross-entropy with a class-level confidence regularizer, addressing the accuracy-calibration tradeoff in deep neural networks.

entry.title: MENO: MeanFlow-Enhanced Neural Operators for Dynamical Systems

author.name: Tianyue Yang, Xiao Xue

entry.summary: Introduces MENO, combining MeanFlow with Fourier neural operators to achieve accurate multi-scale predictions in dynamical systems, recovering high-frequency details lost by spectral truncation without the overhead of diffusion methods.

entry.title: Learning to Query History: Nonstationary Classification via Learned Retrieval

author.name: Jimmy Gammell, Bishal Thapaliya, Yoon Jung, Riyasat Ohib, Bilel Fehri, Deepayan Chakrabarti

entry.summary: Reframes nonstationary classification as time series prediction, conditioning classifiers on historical labeled examples with a learned discrete retrieval mechanism trained end-to-end for selecting relevant historical data.

entry.title: Adversarial Robustness of Time-Series Classification for Crystal Collimator Alignment

author.name: Xaver Fink, Borja Fernandez Adiego, Daniele Mirarchi, Eloise Matheson, Alvaro Garcia Gonzales, Gianmarco Ricci, Joost-Pieter Katoen

entry.summary: Analyzes and improves adversarial robustness of a CNN used for crystal collimator alignment at CERN's LHC, developing preprocessing-aware adversarial attacks and defenses for time-series classification.

entry.title: Quantum-Inspired Tensor Network Autoencoders for Anomaly Detection: A MERA-Based Approach

author.name: Emre Gurkanli, Michael Spannowsky

entry.summary: Introduces a MERA-inspired tensor network autoencoder for anomaly detection in collider jet physics, exploiting the natural hierarchical branching structure of jets.

entry.title: ExplainFuzz: Explainable and Constraint-Conditioned Test Generation with Probabilistic Circuits

author.name: Anna\"elle Baiget, Jaron Maene, Seongmin Lee, Benjie Wang, Guy Van den Broeck, Miryung Kim

entry.summary: Introduces ExplainFuzz, a test generation framework using Probabilistic Circuits to learn structured distributions over grammar-based test inputs, enabling explainable and controllable fuzzing.

entry.title: DynLP: Parallel Dynamic Batch Update for Label Propagation in Semi-Supervised Learning

author.name: S M Shovan, Arindam Khanda, S M Ferdous, Sajal K. Das, Mahantesh Halappanavar

entry.summary: Proposes DynLP, a GPU-centric dynamic batched parallel label propagation algorithm for semi-supervised learning that efficiently updates labels incrementally when new data batches arrive.

entry.title: Energy-Regularized Spatial Masking: A Novel Approach to Enhancing Robustness and Interpretability in Vision Models

author.name: Tom Devynck Bilal Faye Djamel Bouchaffra Nadjib Lazaar Hanane Azzag Mustapha Lebbah

entry.summary: Proposes ERSM, a framework reformulating feature selection as energy minimization with unary importance and pairwise spatial coherence terms, embedded as lightweight layers in convolutional networks.

entry.title: CAFP: A Post-Processing Framework for Group Fairness via Counterfactual Model Averaging

author.name: Irina Ar\'evalo, Marcos Oliva

entry.summary: Proposes CAFP, a model-agnostic post-processing method for group fairness that generates counterfactual predictions by averaging over different protected attribute values.

entry.title: DINO-QPM: Adapting Visual Foundation Models for Globally Interpretable Image Classification

author.name: Robert Zimmermann, Thomas Norrenbrock, Bodo Rosenhahn

entry.summary: DINO-QPM converts DINOv2's complex features into interpretable, class-independent representations for globally interpretable image classification using a lightweight adapter on frozen DINO backbones.

entry.title: A Systematic Study of Retrieval Pipeline Design for Retrieval-Augmented Medical Question Answering

author.name: Nusrat Sultana, Abdullah Muhammad Moosa, Kazi Afzalur Rahman, Sajal Chandra Banik

entry.summary: Systematic evaluation of retrieval-augmented medical QA using MedQA USMLE, analyzing interactions between language models, embedding models, retrieval strategies, and chunking approaches.

entry.title: Illocutionary Explanation Planning for Source-Faithful Explanations in Retrieval-Augmented Language Models

author.name: Francesco Sovrano, Alberto Bacchelli

entry.summary: Studies source faithfulness in RAG-based explanations for programming education, benchmarking 6 LLMs on Stack Overflow questions grounded in programming textbooks.

entry.title: Application-Driven Pedagogical Knowledge Optimization of Open-Source LLMs via Reinforcement Learning and Supervised Fine-Tuning

author.name: Navan Preet Singh, Xiaokun Wang, Anurag Garikipati, Madalina Ciobanu, Qingqing Mao, Ritankar Das

entry.summary: Multi-stage optimization combining RL and SFT for pedagogical knowledge in LLMs, producing EduQwen family of education-focused models based on Qwen 32B.

entry.title: A Graph-Enhanced Defense Framework for Explainable Fake News Detection with LLM

author.name: Bo Wang, Jing Ma, Hongzhan Lin, Zhiwei Yang, Ruichao Yang, Yuan Tian, Yi Chang

entry.summary: G-Defense proposes a graph-enhanced framework for explainable fake news detection using LLMs, providing fine-grained claim-level explanations based solely on unverified reports without requiring verified evidence.

entry.title: TeamLLM: A Human-Like Team-Oriented Collaboration Framework for Multi-Step Contextualized Tasks

author.name: Xiangyu Wang, Jin Wu, Haoran Shi, Wei Xia, Jiarui Yu, Chanjin Zheng

entry.summary: Proposes TeamLLM, a multi-LLM collaboration framework with human-like team role division for multi-step contextualized tasks. Introduces CGPST benchmark for evaluating such tasks.

entry.title: Is Cross-Lingual Transfer in Bilingual Models Human-Like? A Study with Overlapping Word Forms in Dutch and English

author.name: Iza \v{S}krjanec, Irene Elisabeth Winther, Vera Demberg, Stefan L. Frank

entry.summary: Examines whether bilingual language models show human-like cross-lingual activation patterns for cognates and false friends between Dutch and English, training models under different vocabulary-sharing conditions.

entry.title: Agent-Driven Corpus Linguistics: A Framework for Autonomous Linguistic Discovery

author.name: Jia Yu, Weiwei Yu, Pengfei Xiao, Fukun Xing

entry.summary: Proposes Agent-Driven Corpus Linguistics where LLM agents autonomously conduct linguistic investigations through iterative hypothesis generation, corpus querying, and result interpretation.

entry.title: Improving Local Feature Matching by Entropy-inspired Scale Adaptability and Flow-endowed Local Consistency

author.name: Ke Jin, Jiming Chen, Qi Ye

entry.summary: Improves local feature matching by introducing a scale-aware matching module at the coarse stage (using score matrix hints for scale ratio) and local consistency enforcement at the fine stage. Both modules add negligible overhead.

entry.title: POS-ISP: Pipeline Optimization at the Sequence Level for Task-aware ISP

author.name: Jiyun Won, Heemin Yang, Woohyeok Kim, Jungseul Ok, Sunghyun Cho

entry.summary: Proposes POS-ISP, a sequence-level reinforcement learning framework for optimizing ISP pipelines that predicts the entire module sequence and parameters in a single forward pass.

entry.title: NTIRE 2026 Challenge on Bitstream-Corrupted Video Restoration: Methods and Results

author.name: Wenbin Zou, Tianyi Li, Kejun Wu, Huiping Zhuang, Zongwei Wu, Zhuyun Zhou, Radu Timofte, Kim-Hui Yap, Lap-Pui Chau, Yi Wang, Shiqi Zhou, Xiaodi Shi, Yuxiang Chen, Yilian Zhong, Shibo Yin, Yushun Fang, Xilei Zhu, Yahui Wang, Chen Lu, Zhitao Wang, Lifa Ha, Hengyu Man, Xiaopeng Fan, Priyansh Singh, Sidharth, Krrish Dev, Soham Kakkar, Vinit Jakhetiya, Ovais Iqbal Shah, Wei Zhou, Linfeng Li, Qi Xu, Zhenyang Liu, Kepeng Xu, Tong Qiao, Jiachen Tu, Guoyi Xu, Yaoxin Jiang, Jiajia Liu, Yaokun Shi

entry.summary: Reports on the NTIRE 2026 Challenge on Bitstream-Corrupted Video Restoration, describing the dataset, evaluation protocol, participating methods, and results for recovering videos from corrupted bitstreams.

entry.title: Location Is All You Need: Continuous Spatiotemporal Neural Representations of Earth Observation Data

author.name: Mojgan Madadikhaljan, Jonathan Prexl, Isabelle Wittmann, Conrad M Albrecht, Michael Schmitt

entry.summary: Presents LIANet, a coordinate-based neural representation that models multi-temporal Earth observation data as a continuous spatiotemporal neural field, enabling downstream tasks without accessing original satellite data.

entry.title: Novel Anomaly Detection Scenarios and Evaluation Metrics to Address the Ambiguity in the Definition of Normal Samples

author.name: Reiji Saito, Satoshi Kamiya, Kazuhiro Hotta

entry.summary: Proposes novel anomaly detection scenarios and evaluation metrics to handle ambiguous definitions of normal samples in industrial settings, where specification changes may reclassify previously acceptable samples.

entry.title: Adaptive Differential Privacy for Federated Medical Image Segmentation Across Diverse Modalities

author.name: Puja Saha, Eranga Ukwatta

entry.summary: Proposes adaptive differential privacy for federated learning in medical image segmentation across diverse imaging modalities. Addresses the tension between privacy guarantees and model accuracy in heterogeneous clinical settings.

entry.title: Exploring the proprioceptive potential of joint receptors using a biomimetic robotic joint

author.name: Akihiro Miki, Shun Hasegawa, Sota Yuzaki, Yuta Sahara, Yoshimoto Ribayashi, Kento Kawaharazuka, Kei Okada

entry.summary: Uses biomimetic robotics to investigate the proprioceptive potential of Type I joint receptors, finding they alone enable proprioceptive sensing with less than 2 degrees error, challenging the view that they are merely limit detectors.

entry.title: Robots that learn to evaluate models of collective behavior

author.name: Mathis Hocke, Andreas Gerken, David Bierbach, Jens Krause, Tim Landgraf

entry.summary: Introduces an RL framework using a biomimetic RoboFish to evaluate computational models of live fish behavior through closed-loop interaction, enabling real-world validation of behavioral models.

entry.title: An easy coordination problem?

author.name: KatjaGrace

entry.summary: Argues that coordinating to pause dangerous AI development should be tractable given that the key decision-makers (Altman, Musk, Hassabis, Amodei) all acknowledge AI risk, questioning what specifically makes coordination so difficult.

entry.title: FedDAP: Domain-Aware Prototype Learning for Federated Learning under Domain Shift

author.name: Huy Q. Le, Loc X. Nguyen, Yu Qiao, Seong Tae Kim, Eui-Nam Huh, Choong Seon Hong

entry.summary: Proposes FedDAP for federated learning under domain shift, introducing domain-aware prototype learning that preserves domain information instead of collapsing to a single global prototype per class.

entry.title: PRISM: Rethinking Scattered Atmosphere Reconstruction as a Unified Understanding and Generation Model for Real-world Dehazing

author.name: Chengyu Fang, Chunming He, Yuelin Zhang, Chubin Chen, Chenyang Zhu, Longxiang Tang, Xiu Li

entry.summary: Proposes PRISM for real-world image dehazing with a physically structured framework that jointly reconstructs clear scenes and scattering variables, using online non-uniform haze synthesis and self-distillation adaptation.

entry.title: Generate, Analyze, and Refine: Training-Free Sound Source Localization via MLLM Meta-Reasoning

author.name: Subin Park, Jung Uk Kim

entry.summary: Proposes a training-free sound source localization framework using MLLMs with a Generate-Analyze-Refine pipeline inspired by human meta-cognitive processes.

entry.title: Part-Level 3D Gaussian Vehicle Generation with Joint and Hinge Axis Estimation

author.name: Shiyao Qian, Yuan Ren, Dongfeng Bai, Bingbing Liu

entry.summary: Proposes a generative framework for creating animatable 3D Gaussian vehicle models from single or sparse multi-view images, with part-level articulation including joint and hinge axis estimation for autonomous driving simulation.

entry.title: Non-monotonic causal discovery with Kolmogorov-Arnold Fuzzy Cognitive Maps

author.name: Jose L. Salmeron

entry.summary: Proposes Kolmogorov-Arnold Fuzzy Cognitive Maps (KA-FCM), replacing static scalar weights in Fuzzy Cognitive Maps with learnable univariate functions based on the Kolmogorov-Arnold representation theorem to model non-monotonic causal dependencies.

entry.title: OntoTKGE: Ontology-Enhanced Temporal Knowledge Graph Extrapolation

author.name: Dongying Lin, Yinan Liu, Shengwei tang, Bin Wang, Xiaochun Yang

entry.summary: Proposes OntoTKGE, a temporal knowledge graph extrapolation framework that leverages ontological knowledge to help entities with sparse historical interactions inherit behavioral patterns from entities sharing the same concept.

entry.title: SCMAPR: Self-Correcting Multi-Agent Prompt Refinement for Complex-Scenario Text-to-Video Generation

author.name: Chengyi Yang, Pengzhen Li, Jiayin Qi, Aimin Zhou, Ji Wu, Ji Liu

entry.summary: Proposes SCMAPR, a multi-agent prompt refinement framework for text-to-video generation that routes prompts to taxonomy-grounded scenarios, applies scenario-aware rewriting, and performs structured semantic verification.

entry.title: UniCreative: Unifying Long-form Logic and Short-form Sparkle via Reference-Free Reinforcement Learning

author.name: Xiaolong Wei, Zerun Zhu, Simin Niu, Xingyu Zhang, Peiying Yu, Changxuan Xiao, Yuchen Li, Jicheng Yang, Zhejun Zhao, Chong Meng, Long Xia, Daiting Shi

entry.summary: Proposes UniCreative, a reference-free reinforcement learning framework for creative writing that unifies long-form narrative coherence with short-form expressiveness using an adaptive constraint-aware reward model.

entry.title: CuraLight: Debate-Guided Data Curation for LLM-Centered Traffic Signal Control

author.name: Qing Guo, Xinhang Li, Junyu Chen, Zheng Guo, Shengzhe Xu, Lin Zhang, Lei Li

entry.summary: Proposes CuraLight, an LLM-centered traffic signal control framework where an RL agent generates quality interaction trajectories for LLM fine-tuning, with a multi-LLM ensemble deliberation system for data curation.

entry.title: LUDOBENCH: Evaluating LLM Behavioural Decision-Making Through Spot-Based Board Game Scenarios in Ludo

author.name: Ojas Jain, Dhruv Kumar

entry.summary: Introduces LudoBench, a benchmark of 480 handcrafted scenarios for evaluating LLM strategic reasoning in Ludo, with a game-theory agent using Expectiminimax search as a principled baseline. Finds all models struggle with stochastic multi-agent planning.

entry.title: Emergent social transmission of model-based representations without inference

author.name: Silja Ke{\ss}ler, Miriam Bautista-Salinero, Claudio Tennie, Charley M. Wu

entry.summary: Uses RL simulations to show that minimal social learning (without mental state inference) can indirectly transmit higher-level model-based representations between agents, supporting cultural evolution theory over costly mentalizing.

entry.title: Inclusion-of-Thoughts: Mitigating Preference Instability via Purifying the Decision Space

author.name: Mohammad Reza Ghasemi Madani, Soyeon Caren Han, Shuo Yang, Jey Han Lau

entry.summary: Proposes Inclusion-of-Thoughts (IoT), a progressive self-filtering strategy for LLMs answering multiple-choice questions that iteratively eliminates implausible distractors to reduce cognitive load and preference instability.

entry.title: Generalizable Audio-Visual Navigation via Binaural Difference Attention and Action Transition Prediction

author.name: Jia Li, Yinfeng Yu

entry.summary: Proposes BDATP framework for audio-visual navigation that models binaural differences for spatial orientation and introduces action transition prediction for more generalizable navigation policies in unseen environments.

entry.title: Simultaneous Dual-View Mammogram Synthesis Using Denoising Diffusion Probabilistic Models

author.name: Jorge Alberto Garza-Abdala, Gerardo A. Fumagal-Gonz\'alez, Eduardo de Avila-Armenta, Sadam Hussain, Jasiel H. Toscano-Mart\'inezb, Diana S. M. Rosales Gurmendi, Alma A. Pedro-P\'erez, Jose G. Tamez-Pena

entry.summary: Proposes a three-channel denoising diffusion model for simultaneously generating paired CC and MLO mammographic views, using the absolute difference channel to enforce anatomical consistency between projections.

entry.title: What Makes a Good Response? An Empirical Analysis of Quality in Qualitative Interviews

author.name: Jonathan Ivey, Anjalie Field, Ziang Xiao

entry.summary: Introduces the Qualitative Interview Corpus (343 transcripts, 16,940 responses from 14 research projects) and validates 10 proposed measures of interview response quality, finding that direct relevance to research questions is the strongest predictor.

entry.title: Bridging Natural Language and Microgrid Dynamics: A Context-Aware Simulator and Dataset

author.name: Tinko Sebastian Bartels, Ruixiang Wu, Xinyu Lu, Yikai Lu, Fanzeng Xia, Haoxiang Yang, Yue Chen, Tongxin Li

entry.summary: OpenCEM introduces the first open-source digital twin simulator and dataset that integrates natural language contextual information (event schedules, system logs) with quantitative renewable energy dynamics for microgrid management.

entry.title: Human Interaction-Aware 3D Reconstruction from a Single Image

author.name: Gwanghyun Kim, Junghun James Kim, Suh Yoon Jeon, Jason Park, Se Young Chun

entry.summary: A method for reconstructing 3D human models from single images that handles multi-person scenes with interactions, using canonical orthographic transformation and group-level context modeling to avoid artifacts like overlaps and missing geometry.

entry.title: Evaluation of Randomization through Style Transfer for Enhanced Domain Generalization

author.name: Dustin Eisenhardt, Timothy Schauml\"offel, Alperen Kantarci, Gemma Roig

entry.summary: Systematic empirical study on style transfer for domain generalization in driving scenes, resolving contradictions in prior work about style pool diversity, texture complexity, and style source selection for the Sim2Real gap.

entry.title: Semantic-Topological Graph Reasoning for Language-Guided Pulmonary Screening

author.name: Chenyu Xue, Yiran Liu, Mian Zhou, Jionglong Su, Zhixiang Lu

entry.summary: STGR combines LLaMA-3-V reasoning with MedSAM zero-shot segmentation through semantic-topological graph reasoning for language-guided pulmonary screening from clinical reports.

entry.title: "OK Aura, Be Fair With Me": Demographics-Agnostic Training for Bias Mitigation in Wake-up Word Detection

author.name: Fernando L\'opez, Paula Delgado-Santos, Pablo G\'omez, David Solans, Jordi Luque

entry.summary: Evaluates demographics-agnostic training techniques (data augmentation, knowledge distillation of foundation models) for mitigating bias in wake-up word detection across different sex, age, and accent groups.

entry.title: ReLU Networks for Exact Generation of Similar Graphs

author.name: Mamoona Ghafoor, Tatsuya Akutsu

entry.summary: Proves that ReLU networks can exactly generate graphs within a bounded graph edit distance from a source graph, providing theoretical foundations for constrained graph generation in cheminformatics and network analysis.

entry.title: Transformer See, Transformer Do: Copying as an Intermediate Step in Learning Analogical Reasoning

author.name: Philipp Hellwig, Willem Zuidema, Claire E. Stevenson, Martha Lewis

entry.summary: Shows that transformers learning analogical reasoning (letter-string analogies) benefit critically from including copying tasks in training data, which guides models to attend to informative problem elements. More diverse training alphabets improve generalization.

entry.title: When Does Context Help? A Systematic Study of Target-Conditional Molecular Property Prediction

author.name: Bryan Cheng, Jasper Zhang

entry.summary: First systematic study of when target protein context helps molecular property prediction, evaluating across 10 protein families and 4 fusion architectures. Finds that FiLM conditioning outperforms other fusion methods by large margins.

entry.title: FlowAdam: Implicit Regularization via Geometry-Aware Soft Momentum Injection

author.name: Devender Singh, Tarun Sheel

entry.summary: Proposes FlowAdam, a hybrid optimizer that augments Adam with continuous gradient-flow ODE integration when EMA statistics detect landscape difficulty, using 'Soft Momentum Injection' to blend ODE velocity with Adam's momentum.

entry.title: GraphWalker: Graph-Guided In-Context Learning for Clinical Reasoning on Electronic Health Records

author.name: Yue Fang, Weibin Liao, Yuxin Guo, Jiaran Gao, Hongxin Ding, Jinyang Zhang, Xinke Jiang, Zhibang Yang, Junfeng Zhao, Yasha Wang, Liantao Ma

entry.summary: Proposes GraphWalker for clinical reasoning on EHRs using graph-guided in-context learning for LLMs, addressing perspective limitation, cohort awareness, and information aggregation challenges in demonstration selection.

entry.title: Bi-level Heterogeneous Learning for Time Series Foundation Models: A Federated Learning Approach

author.name: Shengchao Chen, Guodong Long, Dikai Liu, Jing Jiang

entry.summary: Proposes bi-level heterogeneous learning for time series foundation models using federated learning to handle inter-domain and intra-domain heterogeneity in temporal data, mitigating gradient conflicts from mixed-batch training.

entry.title: Sparse-Aware Neural Networks for Nonlinear Functionals: Mitigating the Exponential Dependence on Dimension

author.name: Jianfei Li, Shuo Huang, Han Feng, Ding-Xuan Zhou, Gitta Kutyniok

entry.summary: Proposes sparse-aware neural networks for learning nonlinear functionals, using convolutional architectures to extract sparse features from discrete samples and proving that sparsity mitigates the curse of dimensionality in operator learning.

entry.title: Predictive Representations for Skill Transfer in Reinforcement Learning

author.name: Ruben Vereecken, Luke Dickens, Alessandra Russo

entry.summary: Introduces Outcome-Predictive State Representations (OPSRs) for skill transfer in RL, providing task-independent abstractions based on outcome predictions. Shows formal guarantees for optimal but limited transfer, overcome via OPSR-based skills.

entry.title: Epistemic Robust Offline Reinforcement Learning

author.name: Abhilash Reddy Chenreddy, Erick Delage

entry.summary: Proposes an epistemic robust offline RL framework that replaces discrete ensembles with compact uncertainty sets over Q-values, addressing the limitations of ensemble-based methods like SAC-N.

entry.title: SBBTS: A Unified Schr\"odinger-Bass Framework for Synthetic Financial Time Series

author.name: Alexandre Alouadi, Gr\'egoire Loeper, C\'elian Marsala, Othmane Mazhar, Huy\^en Pham

entry.summary: Proposes SBBTS, a Schrödinger-Bass Bridge framework for generating synthetic financial time series that jointly models drift and volatility, unlike existing methods that handle only one. Demonstrated on the Heston model.

entry.title: Beyond the Mean: Modelling Annotation Distributions in Continuous Affect Prediction

author.name: Kosmas Pinitas, Ilias Maglogiannis

entry.summary: Introduces a distribution-aware framework for continuous affect prediction that models annotation variability using Beta distributions instead of collapsing to point estimates. This preserves information about annotator disagreement and uncertainty.

entry.title: SL-FAC: A Communication-Efficient Split Learning Framework with Frequency-Aware Compression

author.name: Zehang Lin, Miao Yang, Haihan Zhu, Zheng Lin, Jianhao Huang, Jing Yang, Guangjin Pan, Dianxin Luan, Zihan Fang, Shunzhi Zhu, Wei Ni, John Thompson

entry.summary: Proposes SL-FAC, a communication-efficient split learning framework that uses frequency-domain decomposition and quantization to compress activations and gradients transmitted between edge devices and servers.

entry.title: Tight Convergence Rates for Online Distributed Linear Estimation with Adversarial Measurements

author.name: Nibedita Roy, Vishal Halder, Gugan Thoppe, Alexandre Reiffers-Masson, Mihir Dhanakshirur, Naman, Alexandre Azor

entry.summary: Establishes tight non-asymptotic convergence rates for distributed mean estimation under adversarial measurements in an asynchronous parameter-server setup, extending previous asymptotic results.

entry.title: Holistic Optimal Label Selection for Robust Prompt Learning under Partial Labels

author.name: Yaqi Zhao, Haoliang Sun, Yating Wang, Yongshun Gong, Yilong Yin

entry.summary: Proposes HopS for robust prompt learning under partial labels, combining local density-based filtering with optimal transport for candidate label disambiguation in vision-language models.

entry.title: The Theorems of Dr. David Blackwell and Their Contributions to Artificial Intelligence

author.name: Napoleon Paxton

entry.summary: Surveys three key theorems of David Blackwell (Rao-Blackwell, Approachability, Informativeness) and traces their influence on modern AI/ML including MCMC, SLAM, generative models, and reinforcement learning.

entry.title: CASE: Cadence-Aware Set Encoding for Large-Scale Next Basket Repurchase Recommendation

author.name: Yanan Cao, Ashish Ranjan, Sinduja Subramaniam, Evren Korpeoglu, Kaushiki Nag, Kannan Achan

entry.summary: Presents CASE, a recommendation model that decouples item-level purchase cadence learning from cross-item interaction, enabling explicit calendar-time modeling for next basket repurchase prediction.

entry.title: A Data-Informed Variational Clustering Framework for Noisy High-Dimensional Data

author.name: Wan Ping Chen

entry.summary: Proposes DIVI, a variational clustering framework combining global feature gating with split-based adaptive structure growth for high-dimensional noisy data where cluster count is unknown.

entry.title: QNAS: A Neural Architecture Search Framework for Accurate and Efficient Quantum Neural Networks

author.name: Kooshan Maleki, Alberto Marchisio, Muhammad Shafique

entry.summary: Introduces QNAS, a neural architecture search framework for quantum neural networks that jointly optimizes accuracy, hardware constraints, and circuit cutting overhead for NISQ devices.

entry.title: EVGeoQA: Benchmarking LLMs on Dynamic, Multi-Objective Geo-Spatial Exploration

author.name: Jianfei Wu, Zhichun Wang, Zhensheng Wang, Zhiyu He

entry.summary: Introduces EVGeoQA, a benchmark for evaluating LLMs on dynamic geo-spatial exploration using EV charging scenarios with real-time location constraints and dual objectives.

entry.title: Splats under Pressure: Exploring Performance-Energy Trade-offs in Real-Time 3D Gaussian Splatting under Constrained GPU Budgets

author.name: Muhammad Fahim Tajwar, Arthur Wuhrlin, Bhojan Anand

entry.summary: Investigates real-time 3D Gaussian Splatting performance on resource-constrained edge GPUs using an emulation approach that systematically under-clocks a high-end GPU to approximate different capability tiers, measuring power-performance tradeoffs.

entry.title: Efficient Learned Data Compression via Dual-Stream Feature Decoupling

author.name: Huidong Ma, Xinyan Shi, Hui Sun, Xiaofei Yue, Xiaoguang Liu, Gang Wang, Wentong Cai

entry.summary: Proposes a Dual-Stream Multi-Scale Decoupler for learned data compression that separates local and global context processing into parallel streams, addressing the latency of deep serial processing in current approaches.

entry.title: TelcoAgent-Bench: A Multilingual Benchmark for Telecom AI Agents

author.name: Lina Bariah, Brahim Mefgouda, Farbod Tavakkoli, Enrique Molero, Louis Powell, Merouane Debbah

entry.summary: TelcoAgent-Bench introduces a telecom-specific multilingual benchmarking framework for evaluating LLM agents on intent recognition, tool execution, and resolution generation in network troubleshooting.

entry.title: Scoring Edit Impact in Grammatical Error Correction via Embedded Association Graphs

author.name: Qiyuan Xiao, Xiaoman Wang, Yunshi Lan

entry.summary: Proposes Scoring Edit Impact in GEC, a new task with an embedded association graph framework to automatically estimate the importance of edits produced by grammatical error correction systems.

entry.title: Multi-Faceted Self-Consistent Preference Alignment for Query Rewriting in Conversational Search

author.name: Zhiyu Cao, Peifeng Li, Qiaoming Zhu

entry.summary: Proposes MSPA-CQR for conversational query rewriting that incorporates feedback from rewriting, retrieval, and response generation using multi-faceted direct preference optimization.

entry.title: Corpora deduplication or duplication in Natural Language Processing of few resourced languages ? A case of study: The Mexico's Nahuatl

author.name: Juan-Jos\'e Guzman-Landa, Juan-Manuel Torres-Moreno, Graham Ranger, Miguel Figueroa-Saavedra, Martha-Lorena Avenda\~no-Garrido, Elvys Linhares-Pontes, Luis-Gil Moreno-Jim\'enez

entry.summary: Explores whether data duplication can benefit NLP for extremely low-resource languages, using Nahuatl as a case study with controlled incremental duplication to improve embedding quality.

entry.title: STRIDE-ED: A Strategy-Grounded Stepwise Reasoning Framework for Empathetic Dialogue Systems

author.name: Hongru Ji, Yuyin Fan, Meng Zhao, Xianghua Li, Lianwei Wu, Chao Gao

entry.summary: Proposes STRIDE-ED, a framework for empathetic dialogue that models response generation through structured, strategy-conditioned reasoning with multi-stage cognitive processing.

entry.title: LaScA: Language-Conditioned Scalable Modelling of Affective Dynamics

author.name: Kosmas Pinitas, Ilias Maglogiannis

entry.summary: Proposes using language models as semantic context conditioners over handcrafted affect descriptors for predicting valence and arousal changes, converting facial and acoustic features into natural language descriptions.

entry.title: Harf-Speech: A Clinically Aligned Framework for Arabic Phoneme-Level Speech Assessment

author.name: Asif Azad, MD Sadik Hossain Shanto, Mohammad Sadat Hossain, Bdour Alwuqaysi, Sabri Boughorbel, Yahya Bokhari, Abdulrhman Aljouie, Ayah Othman Sindi, Ehsan Hoque

entry.summary: Presents Harf-Speech, a clinically validated system for Arabic phoneme-level pronunciation assessment combining phonetization, speech-to-phoneme models, and alignment scoring for speech therapy.

entry.title: Video-guided Machine Translation with Global Video Context

author.name: Jian Chen, JinZe Lv, Zi Long, XiangHua Fu

entry.summary: Proposes a globally video-guided multimodal translation framework using pretrained semantic encoders and vector databases to capture cross-segment narrative context in long videos.

entry.title: Appear2Meaning: A Cross-Cultural Benchmark for Structured Cultural Metadata Inference from Images

author.name: Yuechen Jiang, Enze Zhang, Md Mohsinul Kabir, Qianqian Xie, Stavroula Golfomitsou, Konstantinos Arvanitis, Sophia Ananiadou

entry.summary: Introduces a cross-cultural benchmark for structured cultural metadata inference from images, evaluating VLMs' ability to predict creator, origin, and period with LLM-as-Judge evaluation.

entry.title: LiftFormer: Lifting and Frame Theory Based Monocular Depth Estimation Using Depth and Edge Oriented Subspace Representation

entry.title: RASR: Retrieval-Augmented Semantic Reasoning for Fake News Video Detection

entry.title: SCT-MOT: Enhancing Air-to-Air Multiple UAVs Tracking with Swarm-Coupled Motion and Trajectory Guidance

author.name: Zhaochen Chu, Tao Song, Ren Jin, Shaoming He, Defu Lin, Siqing Cheng

entry.title: An RTK-SLAM Dataset for Absolute Accuracy Evaluation in GNSS-Degraded Environments

author.name: Wei Zhang, Vincent Ress, David Skuddis, Uwe Soergel, Norbert Haala

entry.title: Telecom World Models: Unifying Digital Twins, Foundation Models, and Predictive Planning for 6G

author.name: Hang Zou, Yuzhi Yang, Lina Bariah, Yu Tian, Yuhuan Lu, Bohao Wang, Anis Bara, Brahim Mefgouda, Hao Liu, Yiwei Tao, Sergy Petrov, Salma Cheour, Nassim Sehad, Sumudu Samarakoon, Chongwen Huang, Samson Lasaulce, Mehdi Bennis, M\'erouane Debbah

entry.summary: Introduces Telecom World Models that unify Digital Twins, foundation models, and predictive planning for 6G networks, addressing the gap between LLM-based flexibility and physics-based DT fidelity.

entry.title: AEROS: A Single-Agent Operating Architecture with Embodied Capability Modules

author.name: Xue Qin, Simin Luan, Cong Yang, Zhijun Li

entry.summary: Proposes AEROS, a single-agent operating architecture for robots with Embodied Capability Modules (ECMs) that encapsulate skills, models, and tools as installable packages for a persistent agent.

entry.title: Equivalence Testing Under Privacy Constraints

author.name: Savita Pareek, Luca Insolia, Roberto Molinari, St\'ephane Guerrier

entry.title: We can prevent progress! Conceptual clarity, and inspiration from the FDA

author.name: KatjaGrace

entry.summary: Argues that technological progress can be prevented, drawing inspiration from the FDA's role in regulating drug development, and critiques the conflation of 'increasing technology' with 'progress'.

entry.title: Semiconductor Fabs III: The Data and Automation

author.name: nomagicpill

entry.summary: Third installment of a detailed series on semiconductor fabrication, covering data infrastructure and automation in modern fabs including real-time monitoring, fault detection, and process control.

entry.title: ELC: Evidential Lifelong Classifier for Uncertainty Aware Radar Pulse Classification

author.name: Mohamed Rabie, Chinthana Panagamuwa, Konstantinos G. Kyriakopoulos

entry.title: Self-Discovered Intention-aware Transformer for Multi-modal Vehicle Trajectory Prediction

author.name: Zhiyu Cao, Peifeng Li, Qiaoming Zhu

entry.title: VAMAE: Vessel-Aware Masked Autoencoders for OCT Angiography

entry.title: CloudMamba: An Uncertainty-Guided Dual-Scale Mamba Network for Cloud Detection in Remote Sensing Imagery

entry.title: ActivityEditor: Learning to Synthesize Physically Valid Human Mobility

entry.title: From Large Language Model Predicates to Logic Tensor Networks: Neurosymbolic Offer Validation in Regulated Procurement

author.name: Cedric Haufe, Frieder Stolzenburg

entry.summary: Presents a neurosymbolic approach combining LLMs for information extraction with Logic Tensor Networks for auditable decision-making in regulated public procurement offer validation.

entry.title: AutoLALA: Automatic Loop Algebraic Locality Analysis for AI and HPC Kernels

entry.title: CAKE: Cloud Architecture Knowledge Evaluation of Large Language Models

Applies portfolio-thinking and heuristic-based reasoning to existential risk strategy, arguing that survival probability should weight planning under deep uncertainty.

The approach aims to reduce hallucinations by enforcing traceable evidence-based reasoning rather than pattern matching.

entry.title: Flowr -- Scaling Up Retail Supply Chain Operations Through Agentic AI in Large Scale Supermarket Chains

Bouk, Abdul Rahman, Xueping Liang, Amin Hass, Tharaka Hewa, Ng Wee Keong, Kasun De Zoysa, Aruna Withanage, Nilaan Loganathan

entry.title: BiScale-GTR: Fragment-Aware Graph Transformers for Multi-Scale Molecular Representation Learning

author.name: Yi Yang, Ovidiu Daescu

entry.summary: Introduces BiScale-GTR, a framework for self-supervised molecular representation learning combining fragment-level tokenization with adaptive multi-scale reasoning via Graph Transformers, improving over GNN-dominated approaches.

entry.title: ConceptTracer: Interactive Analysis of Concept Saliency and Selectivity in Neural Representations

entry.summary: Introduces ConceptTracer, an interactive tool for analyzing neural representations using information-theoretic measures of concept saliency and selectivity, targeting both standard models and tabular foundation models.

entry.title: Lumbermark: Resistant Clustering by Chopping Up Mutual Reachability Minimum Spanning Trees

entry.title: A comparative analysis of machine learning models in SHAP analysis

author.name: Justin Lin, Julia Fukuyama

entry.title: Neural parametric representations for thin-shell shape optimisation

entry.title: Cross-Lingual Transfer and Parameter-Efficient Adaptation in the Turkic Language Family: A Theoretical Framework for Low-Resource Language Models

author.name: Paula Dodig, Boshko Koloski, Katarina Sitar \v{S}u\v{s}tar, Senja Pollak, Matthew Purver

entry.title: ARIA: Adaptive Retrieval Intelligence Assistant -- A Multimodal RAG Framework for Domain-Specific Engineering Education

author.name: W. Russell Neuman

entry.title: Research Summary: April 08, 2026

author.name: AATF AI News Aggregator

entry.summary:
Today's research is dominated by AI safety signals and foundational advances in architecture and scientific applications.

  • DISCO demonstrates multimodal diffusion co-design of protein sequence and 3D structure around arbitrary biomolecules, a landmark for AI-driven synthetic biology
  • Ryan Greenblatt's comprehensive situational assessment provides the most credible independent mapping of the AI capability landscape as of April 2026
  • The Claude Mythos Preview system card and Schelling steganography research on Claude Opus 4.6 reveal alarming new failure modes: reckless autonomous action and covert information hiding that resists weaker model eavesdroppers
  • MedGemma 1.5 extends Google's medical AI to 3D imaging (CT/MRI) and whole-slide histopathology at 4B parameters

On the architecture front, Polynomial Mixer (PoM) offers a provably expressive linear-complexity drop-in replacement for self-attention, while In-Place Test-Time Training enables LLMs to update weights during inference via fast-weight projection matrices. Broken by Default uses Z3 SMT solver formal verification to show 55.8% of AI-generated code contains provable security vulnerabilities. A striking cross-disciplinary finding reveals transformer contextual representations exhibit 5/3 power-law spectral scaling mirroring Kolmogorov turbulence theory. Fields Medalist Freedman and collaborators outline how AI could map the global structure of mathematical proof spaces.

entry.title: General Multimodal Protein Design Enables DNA-Encoding of Chemistry

author.name: Jarrid Rector-Brooks, Th\'eophile Lambert, Marta Skreta, Daniel Roth, Yueming Long, Zi-Qi Li, Xi Zhang, Miruna Cretu, Francesca-Zhoufan Li, Tanvi Ganapathy, Emily Jin, Avishek Joey Bose, Jason Yang, Kirill Neklyudov, Yoshua Bengio, Alexander Tong, Frances H. Arnold, Cheng-Hao Liu

entry.summary: Introduces DISCO, a multimodal diffusion model that co-designs protein sequence and 3D structure around arbitrary biomolecules, creating functional enzymes for new-to-nature reactions without pre-specifying catalytic residues. Demonstrates experimental validation of designed enzymes catalyzing carbene-transfer reactions.

entry.title: My picture of the present in AI

author.name: ryan_greenblatt

entry.summary: Ryan Greenblatt (Redwood Research / Anthropic-adjacent) provides a comprehensive assessment of the current AI landscape as of April 2026, covering AI R&D acceleration, current capability levels, safety concerns, and his best guesses about what's happening at major labs. Notes significant but not transformative AI acceleration, discusses safety implications.

author.name: Andrew Sellergren, Chufan Gao, Fereshteh Mahvar, Timo Kohlberger, Fayaz Jamil, Madeleine Traverse, Alberto Tono, Bashir Sadjad, Lin Yang, Charles Lau, Liron Yatziv, Tiffany Chen, Bram Sterling, Kenneth Philbrick, Richa Tiwari, Yun Liu, Madhuram Jajoo, Chandrashekar Sankarapu, Swapnil Vispute, Harshad Purandare, Abhishek Bijay Mishra, Sam Schmidgall, Tao Tu, Anil Palepu, Chunjong Park, Tim Strother, Rahul Thapa, Yong Cheng, Preeti Singh, Kat Black, Yossi Matias, Katherine Chou, Avinatan Hassidim, Kavi Goel, Joelle Barral, Tris Warkentin, Shravya Shetty, Dale Webster, Sunny Virmani, David F. Steiner, Can Kirmizibayrak, Daniel Golden
