entry.summary: MMEmb-R1 adaptively incorporates chain-of-thought reasoning into multimodal embedding learning with pair-aware selection (choosing when to reason) and adaptive control (preventing shortcut behavior from structural misalignment).

entry.title: Improving Sparse Memory Finetuning

author.name: Satyam Goyal, Anirudh Kanchi, Garv Shah, Prakhar Gupta

entry.summary: Presents an open-source pipeline for retrofitting pretrained LLMs with sparse memory modules for continual learning, addressing catastrophic forgetting by localizing updates to small parameter subsets.

entry.title: Bivariate Causal Discovery Using Rate-Distortion MDL: An Information Dimension Approach

author.name: Tiago Brogueira, M\'ario A. T. Figueiredo

entry.summary: Proposes a rate-distortion theory approach to bivariate causal discovery that properly accounts for the description length of the cause variable, addressing a flaw in existing MDL-based methods.

entry.title: On Dominant Manifolds in Reservoir Computing Networks

author.name: Noa Kaplan, Alberto Padoan, Anastasia Bizyaeva

entry.summary: Studies how training shapes low-dimensional dominant manifolds in Reservoir Computing networks, connecting trained reservoir modes to Koopman eigenfunctions of the underlying dynamical system.

entry.title: Governance-Aware Agent Telemetry for Closed-Loop Enforcement in Multi-Agent AI Systems

author.name: Anshul Pathak, Nishant Jain

entry.summary: Presents GAAT, a reference architecture for governance-aware multi-agent AI systems that closes the loop between telemetry collection and automated policy enforcement, extending OpenTelemetry with governance attributes.

entry.title: CUE-R: Beyond the Final Answer in Retrieval-Augmented Generation

author.name: Siddharth Jain, Venkat Narayan Vedam

entry.summary: Introduces CUE-R, an intervention-based framework for measuring per-evidence-item utility in RAG systems through remove/replace/duplicate perturbations along three utility axes.

entry.title: Gradient-Controlled Decoding: A Safety Guardrail for LLMs with Dual-Anchor Steering

author.name: Purva Chiniya, Kevin Scaria, Sagar Chaturvedi

entry.summary: Introduces Gradient-Controlled Decoding (GCD), a training-free safety guardrail using dual anchor tokens ('Sure' and 'Sorry') for LLM safety, improving on GradSafe's single-anchor approach with tighter decision boundaries and deterministic safety guarantees during decoding.

entry.title: Do Domain-specific Experts exist in MoE-based LLMs?

author.name: Giang Do, Hung Le, Truyen Tran

entry.summary: Investigates whether domain-specific experts exist in MoE-based LLMs across ten models (3.8B-120B), providing empirical evidence for domain specialization and building on it for practical applications.

entry.title: Multi-Drafter Speculative Decoding with Alignment Feedback

author.name: Taehyeon Kim, Hojung Jung, Se-Young Yun

entry.summary: Proposes MetaSD, a framework for multi-drafter speculative decoding that dynamically allocates computation across heterogeneous drafters using alignment feedback and multi-armed bandit selection.

entry.title: Cross-Modal Coreference Alignment: Enabling Reliable Information Transfer in Omni-LLMs

author.name: Hongcheng Liu, Yuhao Wang, Zhe Chen, Pingjie Wang, Zhiyuan Zhu, Yixuan Hou, Yanfeng Wang, Yu Wang

entry.summary: Formalizes cross-modal coreference as a problem for Omni-LLMs, introducing CrossOmni dataset with nine tasks requiring models to localize referents across modalities. Reveals fundamental limitations in cross-modal reasoning.

entry.title: See the Forest for the Trees: Loosely Speculative Decoding via Visual-Semantic Guidance for Efficient Inference of Video LLMs

author.name: Yicheng Ji, Jun Zhang, Jinpeng Chen, Cong Wang, Lidan Shou, Gang Chen, Huan Li

entry.summary: Proposes LVSpec, the first training-free loosely speculative decoding framework for Video-LLMs, using visual-semantic guidance to distinguish visual-relevant anchor tokens (requiring strict verification) from visual-irrelevant fillers (allowing loose verification).

entry.title: BOSCH: Black-Box Binary Optimization for Short-Context Attention-Head Selection in LLMs

author.name: Abbas Ghaddar, Ivan Kobyzev, Boxing Chen, Yufei Cui

entry.summary: Proposes BOSCH, a training-free method for selecting which attention heads in LLMs to replace with sliding-window attention, formulated as a binary optimization problem solved via Large Neighborhood Search.

entry.title: Weather-Conditioned Branch Routing for Robust LiDAR-Radar 3D Object Detection

author.name: Hongsheng Li, Lingfeng Zhang, Zexian Yang, Liang Li, Rong Yin, Xiaoshuai Hao, Wenbo Ding

entry.summary: Reformulates multi-modal 3D detection as weather-conditioned branch routing, maintaining three parallel feature streams (LiDAR, radar, fusion) with a lightweight router that dynamically adjusts modality preferences based on environmental conditions.

entry.title: CRISP: Rank-Guided Iterative Squeezing for Robust Medical Image Segmentation under Domain Shift

author.name: Yizhou Fang, Pujin Cheng, Yixiang Liu, Xiaoying Tang, Longxi Zhou

entry.summary: Introduces CRISP for robust medical image segmentation under domain shift, based on an empirical law that the relative rank of predicted probabilities for positive voxels remains stable under distribution shift.

entry.title: Few-Shot Semantic Segmentation Meets SAM3

author.name: Yi-Jen Tsai, Yen-Yu Lin, Chien-Yao Wang

entry.summary: Explores using SAM3 as a training-free solution for few-shot semantic segmentation by spatially concatenating support and query images, achieving competitive results without any fine-tuning.

entry.title: Cross-Resolution Diffusion Models via Network Pruning

author.name: Jiaxuan Ren, Junhan Zhu, Huan Wang

entry.summary: Proposes CR-Diff, a method that improves cross-resolution generation in diffusion models by pruning resolution-dependent parameters that become adverse when spatial scales shift from training resolution.

entry.title: EchoAgent: Towards Reliable Echocardiography Interpretation with "Eyes","Hands" and "Minds"

author.name: Qin Wang, Zhiqing He, Yu Liu, Bowen Guo, Zeju Li, Miao Zhao, Wenhao Ju, Zhiling Luo, Xianhong Shu, Yi Guo, Yuanyuan Wang

entry.summary: Proposes EchoAgent, an agentic system for end-to-end echocardiography interpretation that coordinates visual observation, manual measurement, and expert reasoning capabilities, mimicking clinical workflow.

entry.title: PanopticQuery: Unified Query-Time Reasoning for 4D Scenes

author.name: Ruilin Tang, Yang Zhou, Zhong Ye, Wenxi Liu, Yan Huang, Shengfeng He

entry.summary: Introduces PanopticQuery for unified query-time reasoning in 4D scenes, combining 4D Gaussian Splatting with multi-view semantic consensus for language-grounded dynamic scene understanding.

entry.title: Activity-Dependent Plasticity in Morphogenetically-Grown Recurrent Networks

author.name: Sergii Medvid, Andrii Valenia, Mykola Glybovets

entry.summary: Characterizes Hebbian and anti-Hebbian plasticity across 50,000 morphogenetically grown recurrent networks (5M+ configurations), finding that anti-Hebbian plasticity significantly outperforms Hebbian for competent networks. Co-evolutionary experiments show evolution can independently recover beneficial plasticity patterns.

entry.title: GaussFly: Contrastive Reinforcement Learning for Visuomotor Policies in 3D Gaussian Fields

author.name: Yuhang Zhang, Mingsheng Li, Yujing Shang, Zhuoyuan Yu, Chao Yan, Jiaping Xiao, Mir Feroskhan

entry.summary: GaussFly proposes a framework for learning drone visuomotor policies that decouples representation learning from policy optimization via 3D Gaussian Splatting scene reconstruction. Bridges sim-to-real transfer for monocular vision-based autonomous flight.

entry.title: GraspSense: Physically Grounded Grasp and Grip Planning for a Dexterous Robotic Hand via Language-Guided Perception and Force Maps

author.name: Elizaveta Semenyakina, Ivan Snegirev, Mariya Lezina, Miguel Altamirano Cabrera, Safina Gulyamova, Dzmitry Tsetserukou

entry.summary: GraspSense presents a dexterous grasp planning pipeline that accounts for spatially non-uniform mechanical properties of objects, using language-guided perception, 3D reconstruction, and physics-informed force maps to select grasps and regulate forces appropriately.

entry.title: Uncertainty-Guided Latent Diagnostic Trajectory Learning for Sequential Clinical Diagnosis

author.name: Xuyang Shen, Haoran Liu, Dongjin Song, Martin Renqiang Min

entry.summary: Proposes a Latent Diagnostic Trajectory Learning framework that formulates sequential clinical diagnosis as learning latent evidence-acquisition paths using a planning LLM agent, addressing the challenge that clinical datasets lack explicit supervision for diagnostic trajectories.

entry.title: From Retinal Evidence to Safe Decisions: RETINA-SAFE and ECRT for Hallucination Risk Triage in Medical LLMs

author.name: Zhe Yu, Wenpeng Xing, Meng Han

entry.summary: RETINA-SAFE is a medical LLM hallucination benchmark for diabetic retinopathy with 12,522 samples across three evidence-relation tasks. ECRT provides a two-stage white-box framework for detecting and triaging hallucination risks.

entry.title: Can We Trust a Black-box LLM? LLM Untrustworthy Boundary Detection via Bias-Diffusion and Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning

author.name: Xiaotian Zhou, Di Tang, Xiaofeng Wang, Xiaozhong Liu

entry.summary: GMRL-BD identifies 'untrustworthy boundaries' of black-box LLMs using multi-agent reinforcement learning agents navigating a Wikipedia-derived knowledge graph to find topics where the LLM generates unreliable responses.

entry.title: Auditable Agents

author.name: Yi Nian, Aojie Yuan, Haiyue Zhang, Jiate Li, Yue Zhao

entry.summary: Defines five dimensions of agent auditability (action recoverability, lifecycle coverage, policy checkability, responsibility traceability, and one more) and argues that no agent system can be accountable without auditability.

entry.title: Thinking Diffusion: Penalize and Guide Visual-Grounded Reasoning in Diffusion Multimodal Language Models

author.name: Keuntae Kim, Mingyu Kang, Yong Suk Choi

entry.summary: Identifies two critical issues in diffusion multimodal LLMs with CoT reasoning: premature answer generation and visual token hallucination during initial timesteps. Proposes penalization and guidance mechanisms.

entry.title: HybridKV: Hybrid KV Cache Compression for Efficient Multimodal Large Language Model Inference

author.name: Bowen Zeng, Feiyang Ren, Jun Zhang, Xiaoling Gu, Ke Chen, Lidan Shou, Huan Li

entry.summary: HybridKV compresses KV caches in multimodal LLMs by combining token-level, layer-level, and head-level compression strategies, accounting for heterogeneous behaviors across visual and text tokens.

entry.title: TDA-RC: Task-Driven Alignment for Knowledge-Based Reasoning Chains in Large Language Models

author.name: Jiaquan Zhang, Qigan Sun, Chaoning Zhang, Xudong Wang, Zhenzhen Huang, Yitian Zhou, Pengcheng Zheng, Chi-lok Andy Tai, Sung-Ho Bae, Zeyu Ma, Caiyan Qin, Jinyu Guo, Yang Yang, Hengtao Shen

entry.summary: Proposes TDA-RC, a topology-based method for optimizing reasoning chains in LLMs. Uses persistent homology to map different reasoning paradigms (CoT, ToT, GoT) into topological spaces and embeds effective topological patterns into the lightweight CoT paradigm.

entry.title: Comparative Characterization of KV Cache Management Strategies for LLM Inference

author.name: Oteo Mamo, Olga Kogiou, Hyunjin Yi, Weikuan Yu

entry.summary: Provides a comparative characterization of KV cache management strategies for LLM inference, examining trade-offs in memory consumption and performance under varying request sizes and context lengths across multiple frameworks.

entry.title: Edit, But Verify: An Empirical Audit of Instructed Code-Editing Benchmarks

author.name: Amir M. Ebrahimi, Gopi Krishnan Rajbahadur

entry.summary: Audits existing instructed code-editing benchmarks (CanItEdit and EDIT-Bench), finding that both concentrate over 90% of evaluation on Python and have limited test coverage. Compares against real-world distributions from Copilot Arena and GitHub Octoverse.

entry.title: OrthoFuse: Training-free Riemannian Fusion of Orthogonal Style-Concept Adapters for Diffusion Models

author.name: Ali Aliev, Kamil Garifullin, Nikolay Yudin, Vera Soboleva, Alexander Molozhavenko, Ivan Oseledets, Aibek Alanov, Maxim Rakhuba

entry.summary: Proposes OrthoFuse, a training-free method for merging orthogonal fine-tuning (OFT) adapters for diffusion models. Derives closed-form formulas for adapter merging using the geometric properties of the orthogonal manifold.

entry.title: RoboPlayground: Democratizing Robotic Evaluation through Structured Physical Domains

author.name: Yi Ru Wang, Carter Ung, Evan Gubarev, Christopher Tan, Siddhartha Srinivasa, Dieter Fox

entry.summary: Presents RoboPlayground, a framework enabling users to author manipulation tasks using natural language within structured physical domains. Compiles language instructions into reproducible task specifications for evaluating robotic manipulation policies.

entry.title: AI and Collective Decisions: Strengthening Legitimacy and Losers' Consent

author.name: Suyash Fulay, Prerna Ravi, Emily Kubin, Shrestha Mohanty, Michiel Bakker, Deb Roy

entry.summary: This paper explores how AI can support procedural legitimacy in collective decision-making by eliciting personal experiences through AI interviews and visualizing predicted policy support. It studies whether exposure to others' experiences increases trust and acceptance even when participants disagree with outcomes.

entry.title: FastDiSS: Few-step Match Many-step Diffusion Language Model on Sequence-to-Sequence Generation--Full Version

author.name: Dat Nguyen-Cong, Tung Kieu, Hoang Thanh-Tung

entry.summary: FastDiSS addresses the degradation of self-conditioning in diffusion language models when using few denoising steps, proposing perturbed self-conditioning during training and distribution matching for faster inference.

entry.title: A Multi-Stage Validation Framework for Trustworthy Large-scale Clinical Information Extraction using Large Language Models

author.name: Maria Mahbub, Gregory M. Dams, Josh Arnold, Caitlin Rizy, Sudarshan Srinivasan, Elliot M. Fielstein, Minu A. Aghevli, Kamonica L. Craig, Elizabeth M. Oliva, Joseph Erdos, Jodie Trafton, Ioana Danciu

entry.summary: Multi-stage validation framework for LLM-based clinical information extraction that combines prompt calibration, rule-based filtering, semantic grounding, and LLM-as-judge evaluation to enable trustworthy deployment at population scale.

entry.title: Who Governs the Machine? A Machine Identity Governance Taxonomy (MIGT) for AI Systems Operating Across Enterprise and Geopolitical Boundaries

author.name: Andrew Kurtz, Klaudia Krawiecka

entry.summary: Proposes Machine Identity Governance Taxonomy (MIGT) for AI systems, enumerating 37 risk sub-categories across eight domains. Highlights that machine identities outnumber human identities 80:1 in enterprises.

entry.title: FNO$^{\angle \theta}$: Extended Fourier neural operator for learning state and optimal control of distributed parameter systems

author.name: Zhexian Li, Ketan Savla

entry.summary: Extends Fourier Neural Operators to complex-domain frequency variables for learning state and optimal control of PDE-governed systems, motivated by the Ehrenpreis-Palamodov fundamental principle.

entry.title: Channel-wise Retrieval for Multivariate Time Series Forecasting

author.name: Junhyeok Kang, Jun Seo, Soyeon Park, Sangjun Han, Seohui Bae, Hyeokjun Choe, Soonyoung Lee

entry.summary: Proposes CRAFT, a channel-wise retrieval-augmented forecasting framework that performs retrieval independently for each variable in multivariate time series, using sparse relation graphs and spectral similarity for efficient candidate selection.

entry.title: A machine learning framework for uncovering stochastic nonlinear dynamics from noisy data

author.name: Matteo Bosso, Giovanni Franzese, Kushal Swamy, Maarten Theulings, Alejandro M. Arag\'on, Farbod Alijani

entry.summary: Proposes a hybrid symbolic regression-probabilistic framework combining equation discovery with Gaussian process uncertainty quantification for learning stochastic differential equations from noisy data.

entry.title: Towards Predicting Multi-Vulnerability Attack Chains in Software Supply Chains from Software Bill of Materials Graphs

author.name: Laura Baird, Armin Moin

entry.summary: Proposes learning multi-vulnerability attack chains from SBOM dependency graphs using heterogeneous graph learning, treating vulnerability interactions as a graph structure rather than independent records.

entry.title: An Actor-Critic Framework for Continuous-Time Jump-Diffusion Controls with Normalizing Flows

author.name: Liya Guo, Ruimeng Hu, Xu Yang, Yi Zhu

entry.summary: Proposes an actor-critic framework for continuous-time stochastic control with jump-diffusion dynamics, using normalizing flows for expressive stochastic policies and a time-inhomogeneous q-function formulation.

entry.title: CoStream: Codec-Guided Resource-Efficient System for Video Streaming Analytics

author.name: Yulin Zou, Yan Chen, Wenyan Chen, JooYoung Park, Shivaraman Nitin, Luo Tao, Francisco Romero, Dmitrii Ustiugov

entry.summary: Presents CoStream, a video streaming analytics system that uses video codec information to guide efficient VLM inference, exploiting temporal and spatial redundancy already identified by codecs. Avoids costly online redundancy detection.

entry.title: Don't Act Blindly: Robust GUI Automation via Action-Effect Verification and Self-Correction

author.name: Yuzhe Zhang, Xianwei Xue, Xingyong Wu, Mengke Chen, Chen Liu, Xinran He, Run Shao, Feiran Liu, Huanmin Xu, Qiutong Pan, Haiwei Wang

entry.summary: Proposes VeriGUI, a GUI automation agent that explicitly models action outcomes and recovery under noisy environments, using a Thinking-Verification-Action-Expectation paradigm to handle real-world failures.

entry.title: Efficient Inference for Large Vision-Language Models: Bottlenecks, Techniques, and Prospects

author.name: Jun Zhang, Yicheng Ji, Feiyang Ren, Yihang Li, Bowen Zeng, Zonghao Chen, Ke Chen, Lidan Shou, Gang Chen, Huan Li

entry.summary: Provides a systematic taxonomy of efficiency techniques for Large Vision-Language Model inference, organized around the encoding-prefilling-decoding lifecycle. Analyzes how upstream decisions create downstream bottlenecks.

entry.title: Controlling Distributional Bias in Multi-Round LLM Generation via KL-Optimized Fine-Tuning

author.name: Yanbei Jiang, Amr Keleg, Ryandito Diandaru, Jey Han Lau, Lea Frermann, Biaoyan Fang, Fajri Koto

entry.summary: Proposes KL-optimized fine-tuning to control distributional bias in multi-round LLM generation, ensuring outputs match target distributions for attributes like gender, race, and sentiment across repeated prompting.

entry.title: AgentGL: Towards Agentic Graph Learning with LLMs via Reinforcement Learning

author.name: Yuanfu Sun, Kang Li, Dongzhe Fan, Jiajin Liu, Qiaoyu Tan

entry.summary: Introduces AgentGL, the first RL-driven framework for Agentic Graph Learning that equips LLM agents with graph-native tools for topology-aware navigation and inference on graph-structured data.

entry.title: DetailVerifyBench: A Benchmark for Dense Hallucination Localization in Long Image Captions

author.name: Xinran Wang, Yuxuan Zhang, Xiao Zhang, Haolong Yan, Muxi Diao, Songyu Xu, Zhonghao Yan, Hongbing Li, Kongming Liang, Zhanyu Ma

entry.summary: Introduces DetailVerifyBench, a benchmark of 1,000 images across five domains for evaluating fine-grained hallucination localization in long image captions, requiring models to pinpoint specific erroneous spans.

entry.title: Coverage Optimization for Camera View Selection

author.name: Timothy Chen, Adam Dai, Maximilian Adang, Grace Gao, Mac Schwager

entry.summary: Proposes COVER, a coverage-based view selection metric derived from Fisher Information Gain for active camera placement in 3D reconstruction. Provides a principled, lightweight criterion that avoids expensive transmittance estimation.

entry.title: VLA-InfoEntropy: A Training-Free Vision-Attention Information Entropy Approach for Vision-Language-Action Models Inference Acceleration and Success

author.name: Chuhang Liu, Yayun He, Zuheng Kang, Xiaoyang Qu, Jianzong Wang

entry.summary: Proposes VLA-InfoEntropy, a training-free approach to accelerate Vision-Language-Action model inference by using image entropy and attention entropy to identify and prune redundant visual tokens.

entry.title: Beyond Semantic Search: Towards Referential Anchoring in Composed Image Retrieval

author.name: Yuxin Yang, Yinan Zhou, Yuxin Chen, Ziqi Zhang, Zongyang Ma, Chunfeng Yuan, Bing Li, Jun Gao, Weiming Hu

entry.summary: Proposes Object-Anchored Composed Image Retrieval (OACIR), requiring strict instance-level consistency rather than just semantic matching. Constructs OACIRR benchmark with 160K+ quadruples across multiple domains.

entry.title: Benchmarking Vision-Language Models under Contradictory Virtual Content Attacks in Augmented Reality

author.name: Yanming Xiu, Zhengayuan Jiang, Neil Zhenqiang Gong, Maria Gorlatova

entry.summary: Introduces ContrAR, a benchmark for evaluating VLM robustness against contradictory virtual content attacks in augmented reality, with 312 real-world AR videos validated by human participants.

entry.title: ID-Selection: Importance-Diversity Based Visual Token Selection for Efficient LVLM Inference

author.name: Zhaohong Huang, Wenjing Liu, Yuxin Zhang, Fei Chao, Rongrong Ji

entry.summary: Proposes ID-Selection, a visual token selection strategy for LVLMs that couples importance estimation with diversity-aware iterative selection, balancing token informativeness and coverage under high reduction ratios.

entry.title: Probing Intrinsic Medical Task Relationships: A Contrastive Learning Perspective

author.name: Jonas Muth, Zdravko Marinov, Simon Rei{\ss}

entry.summary: Explores intrinsic relationships between 30 medical vision tasks across 39 datasets using contrastive learning, investigating whether a data-driven representation space can capture task structure across diverse medical imaging modalities.

entry.title: FoleyDesigner: Immersive Stereo Foley Generation with Precise Spatio-Temporal Alignment for Film Clips

author.name: Mengtian Li, Kunyan Dai, Yi Ding, Ruobing Ni, Ying Zhang, Wenwu Wang, Zhifeng Xie

entry.summary: Proposes FoleyDesigner, a framework for generating spatio-temporally aligned stereo Foley audio for film, using multi-agent architecture for analysis and latent diffusion with LLM-driven mechanisms for audio generation.

entry.title: PDMP: Rethinking Balanced Multimodal Learning via Performance-Dominant Modality Prioritization

author.name: Shicai Wei, Chunbo Luo, Qiang Zhu, Yang Luo

entry.summary: Argues that balanced multimodal learning is not optimal, proposing PDMP which prioritizes the performance-dominant modality. Claims under-optimization is caused by insufficient learning of the stronger modality.

entry.title: CI-ICM: Channel Importance-driven Learned Image Coding for Machines

author.name: Yun Zhang, Junle Liu, Huan Zhang, Zhaoqing Pan, Gangyi Jiang, Weisi Lin

entry.summary: CI-ICM proposes a learned image compression method optimized for machine vision tasks rather than human perception. Introduces channel importance quantification and non-uniform feature channel grouping to allocate bitrate based on what matters for downstream machine tasks.

entry.title: ZipFold: Modular Actuators for Scaleable Adaptive Robots

author.name: Niklas Hagemann, Daniela Rus

entry.summary: ZipFold introduces modular deployable actuators that achieve reversible scale and stiffness transformations through compound folding and zipping of flexible 3D-printed strips. Enables shape-changing robots that can transition between compact/flexible and expanded/rigid states.

entry.title: Effective Dynamics and Transition Pathways from Koopman-Inspired Neural Learning of Collective Variables

author.name: Alexander Sikorski, Luca Donati, Marcus Weber, Christof Sch\"utte

entry.summary: Integrates Koopman operator theory with neural networks (ISOKANN) to extract collective variables and effective dynamics from molecular systems, connecting to transition rates, committor functions, and transition pathways for understanding metastable transitions.

entry.title: Token-Level Forking Paths in Reasoning Traces: Some Examples

author.name: Rob D

entry.summary: An exploratory investigation into how individual tokens in LLM reasoning traces affect final outputs, building on recent papers about 'thought anchors' and 'forking paths.' The author resamples reasoning traces token-by-token to identify critical decision points where the model's trajectory diverges.

entry.title: Foundations for Agentic AI Investigations from the Forensic Analysis of OpenClaw

author.name: Jan Gruber, Jan-Niclas Hilgert

entry.summary: First systematic forensic analysis of an agentic AI assistant (OpenClaw), examining what traces can be recovered from the agent's internal state and actions during digital investigations.

entry.title: Data Distribution Valuation Using Generalized Bayesian Inference

author.name: Cuong N. Nguyen, Cuong V. Nguyen

entry.summary: Develops Generalized Bayes Valuation, a framework for data distribution valuation using generalized Bayesian inference with transferability-measure-based losses, applicable to annotator evaluation and data augmentation.

entry.title: Scalar Federated Learning for Linear Quadratic Regulator

author.name: Mohammadreza Rostami, Shahriar Talebi, Solmaz S. Kia

entry.summary: Proposes ScalarFedLQR, a communication-efficient federated algorithm for LQR control where each agent communicates only a scalar projection, reducing per-agent communication from O(d) to O(1).

entry.title: MEC: Machine-Learning-Assisted Generalized Entropy Calibration for Semi-Supervised Mean Estimation

author.name: Se Yoon Lee, Jae Kwang Kim

entry.summary: Introduces MEC, a machine-learning-assisted generalized entropy calibration method for semi-supervised mean estimation that improves upon prediction-powered inference through calibration weighting and cross-fitting.

entry.title: Optimal Centered Active Excitation in Linear System Identification

author.name: Kaito Ito, Alexandre Proutiere

entry.summary: Proposes an optimal active learning algorithm for linear system identification with centered noise excitation, achieving matching upper and lower bounds on sample complexity.

entry.title: MMORF: A Multi-agent Framework for Designing Multi-objective Retrosynthesis Planning Systems

author.name: Frazier N. Baker, Trieu Nguyen, Reza Averly, Botao Yu, Daniel Adu-Ampratwum, Huan Sun, Xia Ning

entry.summary: MMORF is a modular multi-agent framework for multi-objective retrosynthesis planning in chemistry, balancing quality, safety, and cost. Constructs and compares different multi-agent system designs on a curated 218-problem benchmark.

entry.title: From Governance Norms to Enforceable Controls: A Layered Translation Method for Runtime Guardrails in Agentic AI

author.name: Christopher Koch

entry.summary: Proposes a layered method translating governance standards (ISO, NIST) into implementable runtime guardrails for agentic AI across four control layers: governance objectives, design-time constraints, runtime mechanisms, and audit/feedback.

entry.title: Breakthrough the Suboptimal Stable Point in Value-Factorization-Based Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning

author.name: Lesong Tao, Yifei Wang, Haodong Jing, Jingwen Fu, Miao Kang, Shitao Chen, Nanning Zheng

entry.summary: Introduces the concept of 'stable points' to explain why value factorization in MARL converges to suboptimal solutions. Proposes iterative filtering of non-optimal stable points to improve performance.

entry.title: COSMO-Agent: Tool-Augmented Agent for Closed-loop Optimization,Simulation,and Modeling Orchestration

author.name: Liyuan Deng, Shujian Deng, Yongkang Chen, Yongkang Dai, Zhihang Zhong, Linyang Li, Xiao Sun, Yilei Shi, Huaxi Huang

entry.summary: COSMO-Agent uses tool-augmented RL to teach LLMs to orchestrate the full CAD-CAE (design-simulation) closed loop, addressing the semantic gap between simulation feedback and valid geometric edits.

entry.title: ResearchEVO: An End-to-End Framework for Automated Scientific Discovery and Documentation

author.name: Zhe Zhao, Haibin Wen, Jiaming Ma, Jiachang Zhan, Tianyi Xu, Ye Wei, Qingfu Zhang

entry.summary: ResearchEVO automates scientific discovery with a two-phase approach: LLM-guided evolutionary search for algorithmic solutions (without understanding them), followed by automated paper writing to explain the discoveries.

entry.title: Hierarchical Reinforcement Learning with Augmented Step-Level Transitions for LLM Agents

author.name: Shuai Zhen, Yanhua Yu, Ruopei Guo, Nan Cheng, Yang Deng

entry.summary: STEP-HRL proposes hierarchical RL for LLM agents that conditions on single-step transitions rather than full interaction histories, using subtask completion to represent global progress.

entry.title: Vision-Guided Iterative Refinement for Frontend Code Generation

author.name: Hannah Sansford, Derek H. C. Law, Wei Liu, Abhishek Tripathi, Niresh Agarwal, Gerrit J. J. van den Burg

entry.summary: Presents a vision-guided iterative refinement framework for frontend code generation where a vision-language model serves as a visual critic, achieving 17.8% improvement over 3 refinement cycles on WebDev Arena.

entry.title: ACE-Bench: Agent Configurable Evaluation with Scalable Horizons and Controllable Difficulty under Lightweight Environments

author.name: Wang Yang, Chaoda Song, Xinpeng Li, Debargha Ganguly, Chuang Ma, Shouren Wang, Zhihao Dou, Yuli Zhou, Vipin Chaudhary, Xiaotian Han

entry.summary: Proposes ACE-Bench, an agent evaluation benchmark with fine-grained control over task difficulty and horizon length through a unified grid-based planning task. Addresses limitations of existing benchmarks including high evaluation overhead and imbalanced difficulty distributions.

entry.title: ID-Sim: An Identity-Focused Similarity Metric

author.name: Julia Chae, Nicholas Kolkin, Jui-Hsien Wang, Richard Zhang, Sara Beery, Cusuh Ham

entry.summary: Proposes ID-Sim, a feed-forward metric for identity-focused image similarity that reflects human selective sensitivity to identities across varied contexts. Uses curated real-world data augmented with synthetic variations for training.

entry.title: Nidus: Externalized Reasoning for AI-Assisted Engineering

author.name: Danil Gorinevski (cybiont GmbH, Sch\"ubelbach, Switzerland)

entry.summary: Presents Nidus, a governance runtime for AI-assisted software delivery that mechanizes the V-model with proof obligations verified on every commit. Three LLM families delivered a 100,000-line self-hosting system under formal engineering constraints.

entry.title: From Use to Oversight: How Mental Models Influence User Behavior and Output in AI Writing Assistants

author.name: Shalaleh Rismani, Su Lin Blodgett, Q. Vera Liao, Alexandra Olteanu, AJung Moon

entry.summary: Studies how users' mental models (functional vs. structural understanding) of AI writing assistants affect their control behavior and critical oversight. Finds that structural mental models improve users' detection of ungrammatical AI suggestions.

entry.title: Curvature-Aware Optimization for High-Accuracy Physics-Informed Neural Networks

author.name: Anas Jnini, Elham Kiyani, Khemraj Shukla, Jorge F. Urban, Nazanin Ahmadi Daryakenari, Johannes Muller, Marius Zeinhofer, George Em Karniadakis

entry.summary: Presents advanced optimization strategies for physics-informed neural networks (PINNs) including Natural Gradient, Self-Scaling BFGS, and Broyden optimizers. Demonstrates rapid convergence on challenging PDEs and ODEs.

entry.title: Context-Agent: Dynamic Discourse Trees for Non-Linear Dialogue

author.name: Junan Hu, Shudan Guo, Wenqi Liu, Jianhua Yin, Yinwei Wei

entry.summary: Context-Agent models multi-turn dialogue history as a dynamic tree structure rather than a flat sequence, better reflecting the non-linear, branching nature of real conversations for improved context utilization and coherence.

entry.title: CritBench: A Framework for Evaluating Cybersecurity Capabilities of Large Language Models in IEC 61850 Digital Substation Environments

author.name: Gustav Keppler, Moritz Gst\"ur, Veit Hagenmeyer

entry.summary: CritBench evaluates LLM cybersecurity capabilities in IEC 61850 digital substation (OT) environments across 81 domain-specific tasks, testing GPT-5 and open-weight models on configuration analysis, network reconnaissance, and VM interaction.

entry.title: Stories of Your Life as Others: A Round-Trip Evaluation of LLM-Generated Life Stories Conditioned on Rich Psychometric Profiles

author.name: Ben Wigler, Maria Tsfasman, Tiffany Matej Hrkalovic

entry.summary: Conditions LLMs on real psychometric profiles of 290 participants to generate life stories, then evaluates whether personality traits can be recovered from the generated text, testing if LLMs produce psychometrically meaningful personality representations.

entry.title: Scientific Graphics Program Synthesis via Dual Self-Consistency Reinforcement Learning

author.name: Juekai Lin, Yun Zhu, Honglin Lin, Sijing Li, Tianwei Lin, Zheng Liu, Xiaoyang Wang, Wenqiao Zhang, Lijun Wu

entry.summary: Presents SciTikZ-230K dataset and dual self-consistency reinforcement learning for converting scientific figures to editable TikZ code, addressing data quality and evaluation gaps in graphics program synthesis.

entry.title: Cross-fitted Proximal Learning for Model-Based Reinforcement Learning

author.name: Nishanth Venkatesh, Andreas A. Malikopoulos

entry.summary: Proposes cross-fitted proximal learning for model-based RL in offline settings with hidden confounding, addressing bias in partially observable MDPs through conditional moment restrictions and bridge functions.

entry.title: Training Without Orthogonalization, Inference With SVD: A Gradient Analysis of Rotation Representations

author.name: Chris Choy

entry.summary: Provides a detailed gradient analysis of SVD orthogonalization for rotation estimation, explaining why training without orthogonalization and applying SVD only at inference improves performance through exact Jacobian spectrum characterization.

entry.title: Same Graph, Different Likelihoods: Calibration of Autoregressive Graph Generators via Permutation-Equivalent Encodings

author.name: Laurits Fredsgaard, Aaron Thomas, Michael Riis Andersen, Mikkel N. Schmidt, Mahito Sugiyama

entry.summary: Studies consistency of likelihood assignments in autoregressive graph generators across different linearizations of the same graph, proposing calibration strategies using SENT linearization methods.

entry.title: Hypernetwork-Conditioned Reinforcement Learning for Robust Control of Fixed-Wing Aircraft under Actuator Failures

author.name: Dennis Marquis, Mazen Farhood

entry.summary: Presents a hypernetwork-conditioned RL controller for fixed-wing aircraft that adapts to actuator failures using FiLM and LoRA-based parameter conditioning, showing generalization to unseen failure modes.

entry.title: Identification and Inference in Nonlinear Dynamic Network Models

author.name: Diego Vallarino

entry.summary: Studies identification and inference in nonlinear dynamic network models where the interaction network is unknown, providing necessary and sufficient conditions for identification based on spectral heterogeneity.

entry.title: Learning Nonlinear Regime Transitions via Semi-Parametric State-Space Models

author.name: Prakul Sunil Hiremath

entry.summary: Proposes semi-parametric state-space models for time series with latent regime transitions, replacing fixed parametric transition functions with learned RKHS or spline functions estimated via generalized EM.

entry.title: Robust Learning of Heterogeneous Dynamic Systems

author.name: Shuoxun Xu, Zijian Guo, Brooke R. Staveland, Robert T. Knight, Lexin Li

entry.summary: Proposes a distributionally robust learning approach for modeling heterogeneous ODE systems by maximizing worst-case reward over an uncertainty class of trajectory derivatives.

entry.title: Transcriptomic Models for Immunotherapy Response Prediction Show Limited Cross-cohort Generalisability

author.name: Yuheng Liang, Lucy Chuo, Ahmadreza Argha, Nona Farbehi, Lu Chen, Roohallah Alizadehsani, Mehdi Hosseinzadeh, Amin Beheshti, Thantrira Porntaveetusm, Youqiong Ye, Hamid Alinejad-Rokny

entry.summary: Benchmarks nine transcriptomic ICI response predictors across independent cohorts, revealing that most models show limited cross-cohort generalizability despite strong within-cohort performance.

entry.title: EvolveRouter: Co-Evolving Routing and Prompt for Multi-Agent Question Answering

author.name: Jiatan Huang, Zheyuan Zhang, Kaiwen Shi, Yanfang Ye, Chuxu Zhang

entry.summary: Proposes EvolveRouter, a framework that co-evolves routing and agent quality through graph-based query routing with instruction refinement, and dynamically adapts the number of collaborating agents per query.

entry.title: Content Fuzzing for Escaping Information Cocoons on Digital Social Media

author.name: Yifeng He, Ziye Tang, Hao Chen

entry.summary: Presents ContentFuzz, a confidence-guided fuzzing framework that rewrites social media posts to alter machine-inferred stance labels while preserving human-interpreted intent, helping content escape recommendation algorithm 'information cocoons'.

entry.title: Learning to Edit Knowledge via Instruction-based Chain-of-Thought Prompting

author.name: Jinhu Fu, Yan Bai, Longzhu He, Yihang Lou, Yanxiao Zhao, Li Sun, Sen Su

entry.summary: Proposes CoT2Edit, teaching LLMs to edit knowledge via chain-of-thought reasoning, handling both structured fact triples and unstructured information. Addresses generalization and scope limitations of current knowledge editing.

entry.title: EpiBench: Benchmarking Multi-turn Research Workflows for Multimodal Agents

author.name: Xuan Dong, Huanyang Zheng, Tianhao Niu, Zhe Han, Pengzhan Li, Bofei Liu, Zhengyang Liu, Guancheng Li, Qingfu Zhu, Wanxiang Che

entry.summary: Introduces EpiBench, an episodic multi-turn multimodal benchmark for evaluating AI agents on short research workflows requiring literature navigation, evidence integration across papers, and sustained memory use.

entry.title: MedLayBench-V: A Large-Scale Benchmark for Expert-Lay Semantic Alignment in Medical Vision Language Models

author.name: Han Jang, Junhyeok Lee, Heeseong Eum, Kyu Sung Choi

entry.summary: Introduces MedLayBench-V, the first large-scale multimodal benchmark for expert-lay semantic alignment in medical VLMs, addressing the gap between professional-level model training and patient-accessible communication.

entry.title: Beyond the Beep: Scalable Collision Anticipation and Real-Time Explainability with BADAS-2.0

author.name: Roni Goldshmidt, Hamish Scott, Lorenzo Niccolini, Hernan Matzner

entry.summary: Presents BADAS-2.0, a collision anticipation system that scales V-JEPA2 fine-tuning to 178K labeled dashcam videos with long-tail benchmarking and real-time explainability for production ADAS.

entry.title: Protecting and Preserving Protest Dynamics for Responsible Analysis

author.name: Cohen Archbold, Usman Hassan, Nazmus Sakib, Sen-ching Cheung, Abdullah-Al-Zubaer Imran

entry.summary: Proposes a privacy-preserving pipeline for protest-related social media analysis that integrates privacy risk assessment with downstream analysis, addressing surveillance risks from AI systems that can cross-reference visual information.

entry.title: Unsupervised Multi-agent and Single-agent Perception from Cooperative Views

author.name: Haochen Yang, Baolu Li, Lei Li, Delin Ren, Jiacheng Guo, Minghai Qin, Tianyun Zhang, Hongkai Yu

entry.summary: Proposes UMS, an unsupervised framework that simultaneously solves multi-agent and single-agent LiDAR perception by leveraging cooperative view sharing for improved point cloud density and unsupervised guidance for single-view detection.

entry.title: Rethinking IRSTD: Single-Point Supervision Guided Encoder-only Framework is Enough for Infrared Small Target Detection

author.name: Rixiang Ni, Boyang Li, Jun Chen, Yonghao Li, Feiyu Ren, Yuji Wang, Haoyang Yuan, Wujiao He, Wei An

entry.summary: Reformulates infrared small target detection from segmentation to centroid regression, arguing that target localization is more appropriate than pixel-level segmentation for targets occupying only a few pixels. Uses single-point supervision.

entry.title: UAVReason: A Unified, Large-Scale Benchmark for Multimodal Aerial Scene Reasoning and Generation

author.name: Jintao Sun, Hu Zhang, Donglin Di, Gangyi Ding, Zhedong Zheng

entry.summary: Introduces UAVReason, the first unified large-scale multimodal benchmark for UAV aerial scene reasoning and generation, addressing domain shift challenges in VLMs when processing nadir-view imagery.

entry.title: In Depth We Trust: Reliable Monocular Depth Supervision for Gaussian Splatting

author.name: Wenhui Xiao, Ethan Goan, Rodrigo Santa Cruz, David Ahmedt-Aristizabal, Olivier Salvado, Clinton Fookes, Leo Lebrat

entry.summary: Introduces a training framework for reliably leveraging noisy monocular depth priors in Gaussian Splatting, addressing scale ambiguity, multi-view inconsistency, and local geometric inaccuracies.

entry.title: Physics-Aware Video Instance Removal Benchmark

author.name: Zirui Li, Xinghao Chen, Lingyu Jiang, Dengzhe Hou, Fangzhou Lin, Kazunori Yamada, Xiangbo Gao, Zhengzhong Tu

entry.summary: Introduces PVIR, a physics-aware benchmark for video instance removal that explicitly targets physical interactions like shadows and reflections, addressing gaps in current benchmarks that focus only on visual plausibility.

entry.title: SonoSelect: Efficient Ultrasound Perception via Active Probe Exploration

author.name: Yixin Zhang, Yunzhong Hou, Longqi Li, Zhenyue Qin, Yang Liu, Yue Yao

entry.summary: Proposes SonoSelect for active ultrasound probe exploration, formulating view selection as sequential decision-making that builds 3D spatial memory to guide adaptive probe movement.

entry.title: Toward Aristotelian Medical Representations: Backpropagation-Free Layer-wise Analysis for Interpretable Generalized Metric Learning on MedMNIST

author.name: Michael Karnes, Alper Yilmaz

entry.summary: Proposes A-ROM, a backpropagation-free framework for medical image classification that leverages pretrained Vision Transformers' metric spaces instead of traditional fine-tuning. Built on the Platonic Representation Hypothesis, it aims to be more interpretable and computationally efficient for clinical applications.

entry.title: Synergizing Efficiency and Reliability for Continuous Mobile Manipulation

author.name: Chengkai Wu, Ruilin Wang, Yixin Zeng, Jiayuan Wang, Mingjie Zhang, Guiyong Zheng, Qun Niu, Juepeng Zheng, Jun Ma, Boyu Zhou

entry.summary: Presents a unified framework for continuous mobile manipulation that balances efficiency (not stopping between tasks) with reliability (stable perception, compensation capability). Features a reliability-aware trajectory planner for seamless task transitions.

entry.title: You're Pushing My Buttons: Instrumented Learning of Gentle Button Presses

author.name: Raman Talwar, Remko Proesmans, Thomas Lips, Andreas Verleysen, Francis wyffels

entry.summary: Explores whether training-time instrumentation (a microphone fingertip for contact audio) can improve robot button-pressing policies without requiring the instrumentation at deployment. Uses privileged supervision to train an audio-based contact event detector.

entry.title: Finite-Step Invariant Sets for Hybrid Systems with Probabilistic Guarantees

author.name: Varun Madabushi, Elizabeth Dietrich, Hanna Krasowski, Maegan Tucker

entry.summary: Proposes algorithms for computing finite-step invariant sets for hybrid dynamical systems using Poincaré return maps, with probabilistic guarantees. Applicable to legged locomotion and other systems with switching behavior.

entry.title: Generating Synthetic Doctor-Patient Conversations for Long-form Audio Summarization

author.name: Yanis Labrak, David Gr\"unert, S\'everin Baroudi, Jiyun Chun, Pawel Cyrta, Sergio Burdisso, Ahmed Hassoon, David Liu, Adam Rothschild, Reed Van Deusen, Petr Motlicek, Andrew Perrault, Ricard Marxer, Thomas Schaaf

entry.summary: Pipeline for generating synthetic doctor-patient conversations with audio for training long-form audio summarization models, using persona-driven generation, multi-speaker audio synthesis with realistic artifacts, and SOAP note production.

entry.title: PromptEvolver: Prompt Inversion through Evolutionary Optimization in Natural-Language Space

author.name: Asaf Buchnick, Aviv Shamsian, Aviv Navon, Ethan Fetaya

entry.summary: Presents PromptEvolver, a genetic algorithm-based prompt inversion method that recovers natural-language prompts for faithfully reconstructing target images, guided by vision-language models.

entry.title: Belief Dynamics for Detecting Behavioral Shifts in Safe Collaborative Manipulation

author.name: Devashri Naik, Divake Kumar, Nastaran Darabi, Amit Ranjan Trivedi

entry.summary: Studies regime-switch detection in collaborative robot manipulation, showing that enabling detection reduces post-switch collisions by 52% and benchmarking ten detection methods across reliability metrics.

entry.title: Individual-heterogeneous sub-Gaussian Mixture Models

author.name: Huan Qing

entry.summary: Proposes individual-heterogeneous sub-Gaussian mixture models that assign each observation its own heterogeneity parameter, with a spectral method achieving exact recovery under mild conditions in high-dimensional settings.

entry.title: Differentiable Invariant Sets for Hybrid Limit Cycles with Application to Legged Robots

author.name: Varun Madabushi, Akash Harapanahalli, Samuel Coogan, Maegan Tucker

entry.summary: Extends parametric embedding methods for computing forward-invariant sets around nominal trajectories of hybrid limit cycles, applied to a simplified bipedal robot model. Three-step approach handles continuous flow, guard intersections, and reset maps.

entry.title: ReVEL: Multi-Turn Reflective LLM-Guided Heuristic Evolution via Structured Performance Feedback

author.name: Cuong Van Duc, Minh Nguyen Dinh Tuan, Tam Vu Duc, Tung Vu Duy, Son Nguyen Van, Hanh Nguyen Thi, Binh Huynh Thi Thanh

entry.summary: ReVEL uses LLMs as interactive multi-turn reasoners within an evolutionary algorithm to iteratively design heuristics for NP-hard combinatorial optimization problems. Introduces performance-profile grouping and structured reflective prompting.

entry.title: Towards Effective In-context Cross-domain Knowledge Transfer via Domain-invariant-neurons-based Retrieval

author.name: Jianzhi Yan, Zhiming Li, Le Liu, Zike Yuan, Shiwei Chen, Youcheng Pan, Buzhou Tang, Yang Xiang, Danny Dongning Sun

entry.summary: Proposes using domain-invariant neurons in LLMs to retrieve cross-domain demonstrations for in-context learning, enabling knowledge transfer from data-rich domains to expertise-scarce domains.

entry.title: PECKER: A Precisely Efficient Critical Knowledge Erasure Recipe For Machine Unlearning in Diffusion Models

author.name: Zhiyong Ma, Zhitao Deng, Huan Tang, Jialin Chen, Zhijun Zheng, Zhengping Li, Qingyuan Chuai

entry.summary: PECKER is an efficient machine unlearning method for diffusion models that uses saliency masks to prioritize parameter updates most relevant to forgetting targeted data, within a distillation framework.

entry.title: Deep Researcher Agent: An Autonomous Framework for 24/7 Deep Learning Experimentation with Zero-Cost Monitoring

author.name: Xiangyue Zhang

entry.summary: Deep Researcher Agent is an open-source framework for autonomous 24/7 deep learning experimentation, featuring zero-cost monitoring (no LLM API calls during training) and a two-tier constant-size memory architecture.

entry.title: When Do We Need LLMs? A Diagnostic for Language-Driven Bandits

author.name: Uljad Berdica, Fernando Acero, Anton Ipsen, Parisa Zehtabi, Michael Cashmore, Manuela Veloso

entry.summary: LLMP-UCB derives uncertainty estimates from LLMs via repeated inference for contextual bandits. Finds that lightweight numerical bandits on text embeddings match or outperform LLM-based approaches in most settings.

entry.title: From PDF to RAG-Ready: Evaluating Document Conversion Frameworks for Domain-Specific Question Answering

author.name: Jos\'e Guilherme Marques dos Santos, Ricardo Yang, Rui Humberto Pereira, Alexandre Sousa, Br\'igida M\'onica Faria, Henrique Lopes Cardoso, Jos\'e Duarte, Jos\'e Lu\'is Reis, Lu\'is Paulo Reis, Pedro Pimenta, Jos\'e Paulo Marques dos Santos

entry.summary: Systematically compares four PDF-to-Markdown conversion frameworks (Docling, MinerU, Marker, DeepSeek OCR) for RAG systems across 19 pipeline configurations, evaluating their impact on downstream question-answering accuracy using a Portuguese document benchmark.

entry.title: Learning Stable Predictors from Weak Supervision under Distribution Shift

author.name: Mehrdad Shoeibi, Elias Hossain, Ivan Garibay, Niloofar Yousefi

entry.summary: Formalizes 'supervision drift' in weak supervision settings—changes in the proxy label mechanism across domains—and studies it in CRISPR-Cas13d experiments. Provides a controlled benchmark for evaluating model robustness under distribution shift with weak labels.

entry.title: CRAB: Codebook Rebalancing for Bias Mitigation in Generative Recommendation

author.name: Zezhong Fan, Ziheng Chen, Luyi Ma, Jin Huang, Lalitesh Morishetti, Kaushiki Nag, Sushant Kumar, Kannan Achan

entry.summary: Identifies that generative recommendation systems suffer from amplified popularity bias due to imbalanced tokenization and training procedures. Proposes CRAB, a codebook rebalancing method to mitigate bias in semantic token-based recommendation.

entry.title: Modality-Aware and Anatomical Vector-Quantized Autoencoding for Multimodal Brain MRI

author.name: Mingjie Li, Edward Kim, Yue Zhao, Ehsan Adeli, Kilian M. Pohl

entry.summary: Proposes NeuroQuant, a modality-aware 3D vector-quantized VAE for reconstructing multi-modal brain MRIs. Uses factorized multi-axis attention and dual-stream encoding to separate modality-specific and shared anatomical features.

entry.title: Analogical Reasoning as a Doctor: A Foundation Model for Gastrointestinal Endoscopy Diagnosis

author.name: Peixi Peng (Institute of Medical Robotics, School of Biomedical Engineering, Shanghai Jiao Tong University), Housheng Xie (Institute of Medical Robotics, School of Biomedical Engineering, Shanghai Jiao Tong University), Yanling Wei (Daping Hospital, Army Medical University), Guangcong Ruan (Daping Hospital, Army Medical University), Xiaoyang Zou (Institute of Medical Robotics, School of Biomedical Engineering, Shanghai Jiao Tong University), Qian Cao (Sir Run Run Shaw Hospital, Zhejiang University School of Medicine), Yongjian Nian (Daping Hospital, Army Medical University), Guoyan Zheng (Institute of Medical Robotics, School of Biomedical Engineering, Shanghai Jiao Tong University)

entry.summary: RATNet is a foundation model for gastrointestinal endoscopy using analogical reasoning across five datasets with heterogeneous annotations. Uses cyclic pre-training and a similarity-distance analogy framework.

entry.title: On the Robustness of Diffusion-Based Image Compression to Bit-Flip Errors

author.name: Amit Vaisman, Gal Pomerants, Raz Lapid

entry.summary: Shows that diffusion-based image compressors using Reverse Channel Coding are substantially more robust to bit-flip errors than classical and learned codecs, and introduces a more robust variant of Turbo-DDCM.

entry.title: Neural Network Pruning via QUBO Optimization

author.name: Osama Orabi, Artur Zagitov, Hadi Salloum, Viktor A. Lobachev, Kasymkhan Khubiev, Yaroslav Kholodov

entry.summary: Proposes a hybrid QUBO framework for neural network pruning that integrates gradient-aware sensitivity metrics (Taylor, Fisher information) with combinatorial optimization, improving over greedy heuristics.

entry.title: Saliency-Guided Representation with Consistency Policy Learning for Visual Unsupervised Reinforcement Learning

author.name: Jingbo Sun, Qichao Zhang, Songjun Tu, Xing Fang, Yupeng Zheng, Haoran Li, Ke Chen, Dongbin Zhao

entry.summary: Proposes saliency-guided successor representations with consistency policy learning for visual unsupervised reinforcement learning, addressing the problem of attending to dynamics-irrelevant visual regions.

entry.title: From Uniform to Learned Knots: A Study of Spline-Based Numerical Encodings for Tabular Deep Learning

author.name: Manish Kumar, Anton Frederik Thielmann, Christoph Weisser, Benjamin S\"afken

entry.summary: Studies spline-based numerical encodings (B-splines, M-splines, I-splines) with various knot placement strategies for preprocessing continuous features in tabular deep learning.

entry.title: Contextual Control without Memory Growth in a Context-Switching Task

author.name: Song-Ju Kim

entry.summary: Proposes an intervention-based recurrent architecture for context-dependent decision-making that modifies a shared recurrent state through context-indexed operators without increasing recurrent memory size.

entry.title: StrADiff: A Structured Source-Wise Adaptive Diffusion Framework for Linear and Nonlinear Blind Source Separation

author.name: Yuan-Hao Wei

entry.summary: Presents a structured adaptive diffusion framework for blind source separation that assigns individual diffusion mechanisms to each source component, handling both linear and nonlinear mixing.

entry.title: The Hiremath Early Detection (HED) Score: A Measure-Theoretic Evaluation Standard for Temporal Intelligence

author.name: Prakul Sunil Hiremath

entry.summary: Introduces the HED Score, a measure-theoretic evaluation metric for temporal detection systems that penalizes detection latency through exponentially decaying kernels, addressing the temporal agnosticism of ROC/AUC.

entry.title: Generative Path-Law Jump-Diffusion: Sequential MMD-Gradient Flows and Generalisation Bounds in Marcus-Signature RKHS

author.name: Daniel Bloch

entry.summary: Introduces a generative framework for synthesizing forward-looking càdlàg stochastic trajectories using Marcus-sense signature kernels and sequential MMD-gradient flows on Skorokhod manifolds.

entry.title: Graph Signal Diffusion Models for Wireless Resource Allocation

author.name: Yigit Berkay Uslu, Samar Hadou, Shirin Saeedi Bidokhti, Alejandro Ribeiro

entry.summary: Applies graph signal diffusion models to wireless resource allocation, training on expert primal-dual algorithm outputs and implementing a GNN-based U-Net diffusion architecture conditioned on channel states.

entry.title: Retrieve-then-Adapt: Retrieval-Augmented Test-Time Adaptation for Sequential Recommendation

author.name: Xing Tang, Jingyang Bin, Ziqiang Cui, Xiaokun Zhang, Fuyuan Lyu, Jingyan Jiang, Dugang Liu, Chen Ma, Xiuqiang He

entry.summary: Proposes a retrieve-then-adapt framework for test-time adaptation in sequential recommendation, using retrieval augmentation to address distributional shift during inference without heavy computational overhead.

entry.title: ICR-Drive: Instruction Counterfactual Robustness for End-to-End Language-Driven Autonomous Driving

author.name: Kaiser Hamid, Can Cui, Nade Liang

entry.summary: Introduces ICR-Drive, a diagnostic framework for testing instruction-level robustness of language-conditioned autonomous driving agents across four perturbation families: paraphrase, ambiguity, noise, and misleading instructions.

entry.title: WikiSeeker: Rethinking the Role of Vision-Language Models in Knowledge-Based Visual Question Answering

author.name: Yingjian Zhu, Xinming Wang, Kun Ding, Ying Wang, Bin Fan, Shiming Xiang

entry.summary: Proposes WikiSeeker, a multi-modal RAG framework for knowledge-based VQA that redefines VLM roles as Refiner (query rewriting) and Inspector (answer verification) rather than just answer generators.

entry.title: Arch: An AI-Native Hardware Description Language for Register-Transfer Clocked Hardware Design

author.name: Shuqing Zhao

entry.summary: Introduces Arch, a hardware description language designed for AI-assisted code generation of micro-architecture specifications. It provides first-class constructs for pipelines, FSMs, FIFOs, and clock-domain crossings, converting CDC/RDC analysis into compile-time typing rules.

entry.title: Hierarchical Mesh Transformers with Topology-Guided Pretraining for Morphometric Analysis of Brain Structures

author.name: Yujian Xiong, Mohammad Farazi, Yanxi Chen, Wenhui Zhu, Xuanzhao Dong, Natasha Lepore, Yi Su, Raza Mushtaq, Stephen Foldes, Andrew Yang, Yalin Wang

entry.summary: Introduces a hierarchical transformer framework for neuroimaging that operates on spatially adaptive tree partitions of mesh data, supporting both volumetric and surface discretizations with diverse vertex-level morphometric descriptors.

entry.title: Cross-Stage Attention Propagation for Efficient Semantic Segmentation

author.name: Beoungwoo Kang

entry.summary: Proposes Cross-Stage Attention Propagation (CSAP), a decoder framework that computes attention at the deepest scale and propagates it to shallower stages, reducing redundancy in multi-scale decoders for semantic segmentation.

entry.title: MPM: Mutual Pair Merging for Efficient Vision Transformers

author.name: Simon Rav\'e, Pejman Rasti, David Rousseau

entry.summary: Proposes Mutual Pair Merging (MPM), a training-free token aggregation module for vision transformers that forms mutual nearest-neighbor pairs in cosine space for semantic segmentation acceleration.

entry.title: GaussianGrow: Geometry-aware Gaussian Growing from 3D Point Clouds with Text Guidance

author.name: Weiqi Zhang, Junsheng Zhou, Haotian Geng, Kanle Shi, Shenkun Xu, Yi Fang, Yu-Shen Liu

entry.summary: Introduces GaussianGrow, generating 3D Gaussians by growing them from point clouds with text guidance, using multi-view diffusion for consistent appearance synthesis while maintaining geometric accuracy.

entry.title: EfficientMonoHair: Fast Strand-Level Reconstruction from Monocular Video via Multi-View Direction Fusion

author.name: Da Li, Dominik Engel, Deng Luo, Ivan Viola

entry.summary: Proposes EfficientMonoHair for fast strand-level hair reconstruction from monocular video, combining implicit neural networks with multi-view geometric fusion for speed-accuracy balance.

entry.title: Appearance Decomposition Gaussian Splatting for Multi-Traversal Reconstruction

author.name: Yangyi Xiao, Siting Zhu, Baoquan Yang, Tianchen Deng, Yongbo Chen, Hesheng Wang

entry.summary: Presents ADM-GS for multi-traversal scene reconstruction using 3D Gaussian Splatting with explicit appearance decomposition to handle illumination variations across different capture times.

entry.title: ExpressMM: Expressive Mobile Manipulation Behaviors in Human-Robot Interactions

author.name: Souren Pashangpour, Haitong Wang, Matthew Lisondra, Goldie Nejat

entry.summary: ExpressMM develops a framework for mobile manipulators to communicate intent through expressive behaviors during human-robot interaction, using a vision-language model for perception and language-guided planning that handles user interruptions and modifications.

entry.title: MARS-Dragonfly: Agile and Robust Flight Control of Modular Aerial Robot Systems

author.name: Rui Huang, Zhiqian Cai, Siyu Tang, Pengxuan Wei, Lidong Li, Xin Chen, Wenhan Cao, Zhenyu Zhang, Lin Zhao

entry.summary: MARS-Dragonfly presents a modular aerial robot system with reconfigurable drone formations, featuring a compact mechanical docking system and a robust control algorithm that avoids the oscillation problems of existing approaches as the number of units scales.

entry.title: Dialogue based Interactive Explanations for Safety Decisions in Human Robot Collaboration

author.name: Yifan Xu, Xiao Zhan, Akilu Yunusa Kaltungo, Ming Shan Ng, Tsukasa Ishizawa, Kota Fujimoto, Clara Cheung

entry.summary: Presents a dialogue-based framework for robots to explain their safety decisions to human collaborators, grounding explanations in the same constraint representations that govern robot behavior. Supports causal (Why?) and counterfactual (What if?) queries.

entry.title: Delta6: A Low-Cost, 6-DOF Force-Sensing Flexible End-Effector

author.name: Yue Feng, Weicheng Huang, Chen Qiu, Huixu Dong, I-Ming Chen

entry.summary: Delta6 is a low-cost, 3D-printed 6-DOF force/torque sensor end-effector using antagonistic springs and magnetic encoders. Achieves 3.8% full-scale error with lightweight sequence models for calibration.

entry.title: A conversation with Anima Labs, part I: Phenomenology of digital minds

author.name: cube_flipper

entry.summary: Reports on a conversation with Anima Labs, a nonprofit that takes LLM phenomenology seriously — exploring whether language model self-reports and introspection can be treated as meaningful data about their internal states, in contrast to mainstream behaviorist approaches.

entry.title: Algebraic Structure Discovery for Real World Combinatorial Optimisation Problems: A General Framework from Abstract Algebra to Quotient Space Learning

author.name: Min Sun (F. Hoffmann-La Roche AG, Roche Pharma Research and Early Development), Federica Storti (F. Hoffmann-La Roche AG, Roche Pharma Research and Early Development), Valentina Martino (F. Hoffmann-La Roche AG, Roche Pharma Research and Early Development), Miguel Gonzalez-Andrades (F. Hoffmann-La Roche AG, Roche Pharma Research and Early Development), Tony Kam-Thong (F. Hoffmann-La Roche AG, Roche Pharma Research and Early Development)

entry.summary: Presents a framework from Roche that discovers algebraic structures in combinatorial optimization problems, constructs quotient spaces to collapse redundant representations, and optimizes over reduced spaces. Applied to patient subgroup discovery and molecular screening.

entry.title: Market-Bench: Benchmarking Large Language Models on Economic and Trade Competition

author.name: Yushuo Zheng (Affiliation 1, Affiliation 2), Huiyu Duan (Affiliation 1), Zicheng Zhang (Affiliation 1, Affiliation 2), Yucheng Zhu (Affiliation 1), Xiongkuo Min (Affiliation 1), Guangtao Zhai (Affiliation 1, Affiliation 2)

entry.summary: Market-Bench evaluates LLMs as economic agents in a multi-agent supply chain simulation with procurement (auction bidding) and retail (pricing, marketing) stages, logging complete transaction traces.

entry.title: Context-Value-Action Architecture for Value-Driven Large Language Model Agents

author.name: TianZe Zhang, Sirui Sun, Yuhang Xie, Xin Zhang, Zhiqiang Wu, Guojie Song

entry.summary: CVA (Context-Value-Action) architecture for LLM agents decouples action generation from cognitive reasoning using Schwartz's value theory, addressing behavioral rigidity and value polarization in simulated human behavior.

entry.title: Towards Trustworthy Report Generation: A Deep Research Agent with Progressive Confidence Estimation and Calibration

author.name: Yi Yuan, Xuhong Wang, Shanzhe Lei

entry.summary: Proposes a deep research agent with progressive confidence estimation and calibration for trustworthy report generation, addressing the gap between report quality and epistemic confidence in open-ended research.

entry.title: Web Retrieval-Aware Chunking (W-RAC) for Efficient and Cost-Effective Retrieval-Augmented Generation Systems

author.name: Uday Allu, Sonu Kedia, Tanmay Odapally, Biddwan Ahmed

entry.summary: Proposes Web Retrieval-Aware Chunking (W-RAC) for RAG systems, decoupling text extraction from semantic chunk planning by representing web content as structured ID-addressable units and using LLMs for semantic chunking decisions. Targets cost-efficiency for web-scale content.

entry.title: EduIllustrate: Towards Scalable Automated Generation Of Multimodal Educational Content

author.name: Shuzhen Bi, Mingzi Zhang, Zhuoxuan Li, Xiaolong Wang, keqian Li, Aimin Zhou

entry.summary: Introduces EduIllustrate, a benchmark for evaluating LLMs on generating interleaved text-diagram explanations for K-12 STEM problems. Contains 230 problems across five subjects with an 8-dimension evaluation rubric.

entry.title: Offline RL for Adaptive Policy Retrieval in Prior Authorization

author.name: Ruslan Sharifullin, Maxim Gorshkov, Hannah Clay

entry.summary: Models policy retrieval for prior authorization (healthcare insurance) as a sequential decision-making problem, using offline RL to adaptively select relevant policy chunks rather than fixed top-K retrieval. Trains with CQL and IQL.

entry.title: Improving Clinical Trial Recruitment using Clinical Narratives and Large Language Models

author.name: Ziyi Chen, Mengxian Lyu, Cheng Peng, Yonghui Wu

entry.summary: Explores encoder- and decoder-based LLMs for clinical trial recruitment screening, testing strategies to handle long documents including NER-based extractive summarization to address 'Lost in the Middle' issues with long clinical narratives.

entry.title: Spec Kit Agents: Context-Grounded Agentic Workflows

author.name: Pardis Taghavi, Santosh Bhavani

entry.summary: Proposes Spec Kit Agents, a multi-agent SDD pipeline with context-grounding hooks that reduce hallucinated APIs and architectural violations in AI coding agents working in large repositories. Shows +0.15 quality improvement on a 1-5 composite score.

entry.title: LanG -- A Governance-Aware Agentic AI Platform for Unified Security Operations

author.name: Anes Abdennebi, Nadjia Kara, Laaziz Lahlou, Hakima Ould-Slimane

entry.summary: LanG is an open-source agentic AI platform for security operations that combines a unified incident context record, an agentic orchestrator built on LangGraph, and an LLM-based rule generator for producing deployable Snort/Suricata/YARA rules.

entry.title: Evaluation of Randomization through Style Transfer for Enhanced Domain Generalization

author.name: Dustin Eisenhardt, Timothy Schauml\"offel, Alperen Kantarci, Gemma Roig

entry.summary: Systematic study resolving contradictions in the literature about style transfer for domain generalization, finding that style pool diversity matters more than repetition, complex textures improve robustness, and natural images outperform paintings.

entry.title: Selective Aggregation of Attention Maps Improves Diffusion-Based Visual Interpretation

author.name: Jungwon Park, Jungmin Ko, Dongnam Byun, Wonjong Rhee

entry.summary: Shows that selectively aggregating cross-attention maps from heads most relevant to a target concept improves visual interpretability of diffusion models, achieving higher IoU than standard DAAM approach.

entry.title: ReLU Networks for Exact Generation of Similar Graphs

author.name: Mamoona Ghafoor, Tatsuya Akutsu

entry.summary: Proves that ReLU networks can exactly generate graphs within a specified graph edit distance from a source graph, providing theoretical guarantees absent from data-driven graph generative models.

entry.title: Enhancing sample efficiency in reinforcement-learning-based flow control: replacing the critic with an adaptive reduced-order model

author.name: Zesheng Yao, Zhen-Hua Wan, Canjun Yang, Qingchao Xia, Mengqi Zhang

entry.summary: Replaces the critic in actor-critic RL with an adaptive reduced-order model incorporating physical insights (linear dynamics + neural ODE) for active flow control, improving sample efficiency.

entry.title: Vehicle-as-Prompt: A Unified Deep Reinforcement Learning Framework for Heterogeneous Fleet Vehicle Routing Problem

author.name: Shihong Huang, Shengjie Wang, Lei Gao, Hong Ma, Zhanluo Zhang, Feng Zhang, Weihua Zhou

entry.summary: Develops a unified deep RL framework for heterogeneous fleet vehicle routing problems using a 'vehicle-as-prompt' approach that encodes vehicle characteristics as contextual prompts for the policy network.

entry.title: Graph Topology Information Enhanced Heterogeneous Graph Representation Learning

author.name: He Zhao, Zhiwei Zeng, Yongwei Wang, Chunyan Miao

entry.summary: Proposes a graph structure learning method for heterogeneous graphs that addresses the greater impact of noisy graph structures on heterogeneous GRL models compared to homogeneous ones.

entry.title: Weight-Informed Self-Explaining Clustering for Mixed-Type Tabular Data

author.name: Lehao Li, Qiang Huang, Yihao Ang, Bryan Kian Hsiang Low, Anthony K. H. Tung, Xiaokui Xiao

entry.summary: Proposes WISE, a framework for clustering mixed-type tabular data that unifies representation, feature weighting, clustering, and interpretation through binary encoding with padding and leave-one-feature-out strategies.

entry.title: Probabilistic Tree Inference Enabled by FDSOI Ferroelectric FETs

author.name: Pengyu Ren, Xingtian Wang, Boyang Cheng, Jiahui Duan, Giuk Kim, Xuezhong Niu, Halid Mulaosmanovic, Stefan Duenkel, Sven Beyer, X. Sharon Hu, Ningyuan Cao, Kai Ni

entry.summary: Demonstrates a hardware implementation of Bayesian decision trees using FDSOI ferroelectric FETs, combining analog content-addressable memory and Gaussian random number generation on a single platform.

entry.title: Learn to Rank: Visual Attribution by Learning Importance Ranking

author.name: David Schinagl, Christian Fruhwirth-Reisinger, Alexander Prutsch, Samuel Schulter, Horst Possegger

entry.summary: Proposes a learning-based visual attribution method that trains an explainer using ranking supervision from perturbation-based methods, aiming to balance efficiency, causal grounding, and pixel-level resolution. Addresses the three-way tradeoff in attribution methods.

entry.title: Right at My Level: A Unified Multilingual Framework for Proficiency-Aware Text Simplification

author.name: Jinhong Jeong, Junghun Park, Youngjae Yu

entry.summary: Proposes Re-RIGHT, a reinforcement learning framework for adaptive multilingual text simplification at target proficiency levels across multiple language standards (CEFR, JLPT, TOPIK, HSK) without parallel corpus supervision.

entry.title: Identifying Influential N-grams in Confidence Calibration via Regression Analysis

author.name: Shintaro Ozaki, Wataru Hashimoto, Hidetaka Kamigaito, Katsuhiko Hayashi, Taro Watanabe

entry.summary: Uses regression analysis to identify specific n-grams in LLM reasoning that are associated with (over)confidence, finding linguistic expressions that correlate with miscalibration and coincide with known cue phrases.

entry.title: Measuring What Matters!! Assessing Therapeutic Principles in Mental-Health Conversation

author.name: Abdullah Mazhar, Het Riteshkumar Shah, Aseem Srivastava, Smriti Joshi, Md Shad Akhtar

entry.summary: Introduces FAIR, an evaluation framework for assessing AI therapist responses across six therapeutic principles using fine-grained ordinal scales, addressing the gap in clinically grounded evaluation of mental health AI.

entry.title: CLEAR: Cross-Lingual Enhancement in Alignment via Reverse-training

author.name: Seungyoon Lee, Minhyuk Kim, Seongtae Hong, Youngjoon Jang, Dongsuk Oh, Heuiseok Lim

entry.summary: Proposes CLEAR, a novel loss function using reverse training for cross-lingual embedding alignment that uses English passages as bridges to strengthen alignment without degrading English performance.

entry.title: SVAgent: Storyline-Guided Long Video Understanding via Cross-Modal Multi-Agent Collaboration

author.name: Zhongyu Yang, Zuhao Yang, Shuo Zhan, Tan Yue, Wei Pang, Yingfang Yuan

entry.summary: Proposes SVAgent, a multi-agent framework for video question answering that constructs storyline representations from frame-level narratives, mimicking how humans interpret videos through coherent storylines rather than just locating relevant frames.

entry.title: Indoor Asset Detection in Large Scale 360{\deg} Drone-Captured Imagery via 3D Gaussian Splatting

author.name: Monica Tang, Avideh Zakhor

entry.summary: Presents an approach for indoor asset detection in 3DGS scenes from 360° drone imagery using a 3D object codebook that leverages mask semantics and spatial information for multi-view mask association, achieving 65% F1 improvement.

entry.title: Physics-Aligned Spectral Mamba: Decoupling Semantics and Dynamics for Few-Shot Hyperspectral Target Detection

author.name: Luqi Gong, Qixin Xie, Yue Chen, Ziqiang Chen, Fanda Fan, Shuai Zhao, Chao Li

entry.summary: Proposes SpecMamba, a parameter-efficient framework for few-shot hyperspectral target detection that decouples semantic representation from spectral adaptation using DCT-based Mamba adapters on frozen Transformers.

entry.title: High-Resolution Single-Shot Polarimetric Imaging Made Easy

author.name: Shuangfan Zhou, Chu Zhou, Heng Guo, Youwei Lyu, Boxin Shi, Zhanyu Ma, Imari Sato

entry.summary: Proposes EasyPolar, a multi-view polarimetric imaging framework using three synchronized RGB cameras with different polarizer orientations, based on the insight that three measurements suffice for linear polarization characterization.

entry.title: Single-Stage Signal Attenuation Diffusion Model for Low-Light Image Enhancement and Denoising

author.name: Ying Liu, Junchao Zhang, Caiyun Wu

entry.summary: Proposes SADM, a single-stage diffusion model for low-light image enhancement that integrates signal attenuation into the diffusion process, enabling simultaneous brightness enhancement and denoising.

entry.title: AICA-Bench: Holistically Examining the Capabilities of VLMs in Affective Image Content Analysis

author.name: Dong She, Xianrong Yao, Liqun Chen, Jinghe Yu, Yang Gao, Zhanpeng Jin

entry.summary: Introduces AICA-Bench, a benchmark for affective image content analysis evaluating VLMs across emotion understanding, reasoning, and guided generation. Proposes Grounded Affective Tree prompting as training-free improvement.

entry.title: Synchronous Observer Design for Landmark-Inertial SLAM with Magnetometer and Intermittent GNSS Measurements

author.name: Arkadeep Saha, Pieter van Goor, Ravi Banavar

entry.summary: Designs a nonlinear observer for Landmark-Inertial SLAM that overcomes unobservability of global position and yaw by incorporating intermittent GNSS and magnetometer measurements. Proves almost-globally asymptotically stable error dynamics.

entry.title: High-dimensional reliability-based design optimization using stochastic emulators

author.name: M. Moustapha, B. Sudret

entry.summary: Proposes a reliability-based design optimization framework using stochastic emulators for high-dimensional settings, treating the limit-state function and input uncertainty as a unified stochastic representation rather than nested optimization-reliability problems.

entry.title: The word "agent" is ambiguous.

author.name: Jackson Hurley

entry.summary: Argues that the word 'agent' is dangerously ambiguous in AI discourse, distinguishing agents by who they serve (an agency, a principal, or themselves) and by their degree of autonomous action-taking. Maps this taxonomy to current AI systems.

entry.title: Part-Level 3D Gaussian Vehicle Generation with Joint and Hinge Axis Estimation

author.name: Shiyao Qian, Yuan Ren, Dongfeng Bai, Bingbing Liu

entry.summary: Proposes a generative framework for creating animatable 3D Gaussian vehicle models from single or sparse multi-view images, with part-level articulation and joint/hinge axis estimation for autonomous driving simulation.

entry.title: Reason Analogically via Cross-domain Prior Knowledge: An Empirical Study of Cross-domain Knowledge Transfer for In-Context Learning

author.name: Le Liu, Zhiming Li, Jianzhi Yan, Zike Yuan, Shiwei Chen, Youcheng Pan, Buzhou Tang, Qingcai Chen, Yang Xiang, Danny Dongning Sun

entry.summary: Empirical study of cross-domain knowledge transfer in in-context learning, identifying an absorption threshold beyond which positive transfer becomes likely. Companion paper to the domain-invariant neurons work.

entry.title: HYVE: Hybrid Views for LLM Context Engineering over Machine Data

author.name: Jian Tan, Fan Bu, Yuqing Gao, Dev Khanolkar, Jason Mackay, Boris Sobolev, Lei Jin, Li Zhang

entry.summary: HYVE is a framework for LLM context engineering over machine data (logs, metrics, JSON), inspired by database management principles. Uses request-scoped datastores to handle long, nested, repetitive structured payloads.

entry.title: UniCreative: Unifying Long-form Logic and Short-form Sparkle via Reference-Free Reinforcement Learning

author.name: Xiaolong Wei, Zerun Zhu, Simin Niu, Xingyu Zhang, Peiying Yu, Changxuan Xiao, Yuchen Li, Jicheng Yang, Zhejun Zhao, Chong Meng, Long Xia, Daiting Shi

entry.summary: UniCreative proposes a reference-free RL framework for creative writing that reconciles global coherence in long-form narratives with local expressiveness in short-form text, using an adaptive constraint-aware reward model.

entry.title: Experience Transfer for Multimodal LLM Agents in Minecraft Game

author.name: Chenghao Li, Jun Liu, Songbo Zhang, Huadong Jian, Hao Ni, Lik-Hang Lee, Sung-Ho Bae, Guoqing Wang, Yang Yang, Chaoning Zhang

entry.summary: Echo introduces a transfer-oriented memory framework for Minecraft LLM agents that decomposes reusable knowledge into five dimensions (structure, attribute, process, function, interaction) for cross-task experience transfer.

entry.title: SignalClaw: LLM-Guided Evolutionary Synthesis of Interpretable Traffic Signal Control Skills

author.name: Da Lei, Feng Xiao, Lu Li, Yuzhan Liu

entry.summary: SignalClaw uses LLMs as evolutionary skill generators for traffic signal control, producing interpretable control policies with rationale, selection guidance, and executable code. Natural language feedback guides evolution.

entry.title: JTON: A Token-Efficient JSON Superset with Zen Grid Tabular Encoding for Large Language Models

author.name: Gowthamkumar Nandakishore

entry.summary: JTON (JSON Tabular Object Notation) is a strict JSON superset that reduces token counts by 15-60% for tabular data by factoring column headers into a single row, with minimal impact on LLM comprehension.

entry.title: Prune-Quantize-Distill: An Ordered Pipeline for Efficient Neural Network Compression

author.name: Longsheng Zhou, Yu Shen

entry.summary: Studies a practical ordered compression pipeline (prune-quantize-distill) for neural networks, finding that INT8 quantization provides the dominant runtime speedup while unstructured pruning mainly helps storage without reliably accelerating CPU inference.

entry.title: DQA: Diagnostic Question Answering for IT Support

author.name: Vishaal Kapoor, Mariam Dundua, Sarthak Ahuja, Neda Kordjazi, Evren Yortucboylu, Vaibhavi Padala, Derek Ho, Jennifer Whitted, Rebecca Steinert

entry.summary: Introduces DQA, a diagnostic question-answering framework for IT support that maintains persistent diagnostic state and aggregates retrieved cases by root causes rather than individual documents, improving multi-turn diagnostic accuracy.

entry.title: Human Interaction-Aware 3D Reconstruction from a Single Image

author.name: Gwanghyun Kim, Junghun James Kim, Suh Yoon Jeon, Jason Park, Se Young Chun
