author.name: Zheng Li, Jerry Cheng, Huanying Helen Gu

entry.summary: StableTTA is a training-free test-time adaptation method achieving 96% top-1 accuracy on ImageNet-1K, enabling lightweight models to outperform ViT while using <5% parameters.

entry.title: PassiveQA: A Three-Action Framework for Epistemically Calibrated Question Answering via Supervised Finetuning

author.name: Madhav S Baidya

entry.summary: Proposes PassiveQA, a framework where LLMs must decide whether to Answer, Ask for clarification, or Abstain, addressing the problem of overconfident responses to incomplete queries.

entry.title: Training-Free Refinement of Flow Matching with Divergence-based Sampling

author.name: Yeonwoo Cha, Jaehoon Yoo, Semin Kim, Yunseo Park, Jinhyeon Kwon, Seunghoon Hong

entry.summary: Proposes Flow Divergence Sampler (FDS), a training-free method that refines intermediate states during flow matching inference by quantifying velocity field misguidance through divergence computation.

entry.title: Discovering Failure Modes in Vision-Language Models using RL

author.name: Kanishk Jain, Qian Yang, Shravan Nayak, Parisa Kordjamshidi, Nishanth Anand, Aishwarya Agrawal

entry.summary: Proposes an RL-based framework to automatically discover failure modes and blind spots in Vision-Language Models, replacing costly manual identification of weaknesses like counting and spatial reasoning errors.

entry.title: A Bayesian Information-Theoretic Approach to Data Attribution

author.name: Dharmesh Tailor, Nicol\`o Felicioni, Kamil Ciosek

entry.summary: Formulates training data attribution as Bayesian information-theoretic problem, scoring subsets by information loss (entropy increase when removed). Scales using GP surrogates built from tangent features.

entry.title: Where to Steer: Input-Dependent Layer Selection for Steering Improves LLM Alignment

author.name: Soham Gadgil, Chris Lin, Su-In Lee

entry.summary: Proposes input-dependent layer selection for steering vectors in LLMs, showing theoretically and empirically that the optimal intervention layer varies across inputs, and adaptive selection improves alignment.

entry.title: The Geometric Alignment Tax: Tokenization vs. Continuous Geometry in Scientific Foundation Models

author.name: Prashant C. Raju

entry.summary: Identifies the 'Geometric Alignment Tax'—the cost of forcing continuous manifolds through discrete categorical bottlenecks in scientific foundation models. Shows continuous heads reduce geometric distortion by up to 8.5x.

entry.title: Which Leakage Types Matter?

author.name: Simon Roth

entry.summary: Comprehensive study of four data leakage classes across 2,047 datasets, finding that normalization leakage (Class I) is negligible while selection leakage (Class II) is substantial, inverting the textbook emphasis.

entry.title: Towards Unveiling Vulnerabilities of Large Reasoning Models in Machine Unlearning

author.name: Aobo Chen, Chenxu Zhao, Chenglin Miao, Mengdi Huai

entry.summary: Proposes the first unlearning attack specifically targeting large reasoning models (LRMs), exploiting how unlearning creates new security vulnerabilities in models with explicit multi-step reasoning traces.

entry.title: FlashSAC: Fast and Stable Off-Policy Reinforcement Learning for High-Dimensional Robot Control

author.name: Donghu Kim, Youngdo Lee, Minho Park, Kinam Kim, I Made Aswin Nahendra, Takuma Seno, Sehee Min, Daniel Palenicek, Florian Vogt, Danica Kragic, Jan Peters, Jaegul Choo, Hojoon Lee

entry.summary: Presents FlashSAC, a fast and stable off-policy RL algorithm built on SAC that addresses slow convergence and instability in high-dimensional robot control. Motivated by scaling laws for critic learning to balance convergence speed and stability.

entry.title: Nonparametric Regression Discontinuity Designs with Survival Outcomes

author.name: Maximilian Schuessler, Erik Sverdrup, Robert Tibshirani, Stefan Wager

entry.summary: Proposes nonparametric regression discontinuity design methods for survival outcomes with censoring, combining doubly robust censoring correction with local polynomial regression. Led by Wager and Tibshirani (Stanford).

entry.title: Rethinking Token Prediction: Tree-Structured Diffusion Language Model

author.name: Zihao Wu, Haoming Yang, Juncheng Dong, Vahid Tarokh

entry.summary: Proposes a tree-structured diffusion language model that replaces the full-vocabulary prediction layer (>20% of parameters) with a hierarchical tree structure, reducing parameter count and memory usage while maintaining performance.

entry.title: On the Efficiency of Sinkhorn-Knopp for Entropically Regularized Optimal Transport

author.name: Kun He

entry.summary: Resolves a theory-practice gap for the Sinkhorn-Knopp algorithm by introducing 'well-boundedness,' a local property that isolates well-behaved portions of the transport plan from outlier-affected regions, yielding tighter convergence guarantees.

entry.title: Topological Sensitivity in Connectome-Constrained Neural Networks

author.name: Nalin Dhiman

entry.summary: Investigates topological sensitivity of connectome-constrained neural networks, showing that the apparent advantage of biological graph topology over random controls largely disappears under stricter experimental controls (shared initialization, degree-preserving rewiring).

entry.title: Fine-Tuning Integrity for Modern Neural Networks: Structured Drift Proofs via Norm, Rank, and Sparsity Certificates

author.name: Zhenhang Shang, Kani Chen

entry.summary: Introduces Fine-Tuning Integrity (FTI) as a security goal and Succinct Model Difference Proofs (SMDPs) as zero-knowledge proofs certifying that fine-tuned models differ from base models only within policy-defined drift constraints on norm, rank, and sparsity.

entry.title: Researchers waste 80% of LLM annotation costs by classifying one text at a time

author.name: Christian Pipal, Eva-Maria Vogel, Morgan Wack, Frank Esser

entry.summary: Demonstrates that batching 25 items and stacking multiple variables into single LLM prompts reduces annotation costs by 80%+ while maintaining accuracy within 2pp for 6/8 models. Tests up to batch size 1000 across 8 production LLMs.

entry.title: CoLA: Cross-Modal Low-rank Adaptation for Multimodal Downstream Tasks

author.name: Wish Suharitdamrong, Tony Alex, Muhammad Awais, Sara Ahmed

entry.summary: Proposes Cross-Modal Low-rank Adaptation (CoLA), extending LoRA with a dedicated inter-modal adaptation pathway for multimodal tasks using dual-stream architectures like DINO+BERT. Introduces both intra-modal and inter-modal adaptation paths for better cross-modal interaction capture. Addresses a genuine gap in parameter-efficient fine-tuning for multimodal settings.

entry.title: A Systematic Study of Cross-Modal Typographic Attacks on Audio-Visual Reasoning

author.name: Tianle Chen, Deepti Ghadiyaram

entry.summary: Systematically studies cross-modal typographic attacks on audio-visual MLLMs, finding coordinated multi-modal attacks far more potent (83.43% vs 34.93% success rate) than single-modality attacks. Tests multiple frontier MLLMs across various tasks. Important security finding.

entry.title: ATSS: Detecting AI-Generated Videos via Anomalous Temporal Self-Similarity

author.name: Hang Wang, Chao Shen, Lei Zhang, Zhi-Qi Cheng

entry.summary: Identifies anomalous temporal self-similarity (ATSS) as a distinctive fingerprint of AI-generated videos, where AIGVs show unnaturally repetitive correlations from deterministic anchor-driven trajectories. Proposes a multimodal detection method exploiting this signal. Novel forensic insight into AI video generation.

entry.title: DriveVA: Video Action Models are Zero-Shot Drivers

author.name: Mengmeng Liu, Diankun Zhang, Jiuming Liu, Jianfeng Cui, Hongwei Xie, Guang Chen, Hangjun Ye, Michael Ying Yang, Francesco Nex, Hao Cheng

entry.summary: DriveVA is an autonomous driving world model that jointly decodes future visual forecasts and action sequences in a shared latent generative process, inheriting rich priors from video action models for zero-shot generalization.

entry.title: Reinforce to Learn, Elect to Reason: A Dual Paradigm for Video Reasoning

author.name: Songyuan Yang, Weijiang Yu, Jilin Ma, Ziyu Liu, Guijian Tang, Wenjing Yang, Huibin Tan, Nong Xiao

entry.summary: RLER introduces a dual paradigm for video reasoning that decouples learning to produce evidence from obtaining reliable answers, using group-relative RL with novel task-driven rewards including frame-sensitive, think-transparency, and anti-repetition rewards.

entry.title: Erasure or Erosion? Evaluating Compositional Degradation in Unlearned Text-To-Image Diffusion Models

author.name: Arian Komaei Koma, Seyed Amir Kasaei, Ali Aghayari, AmirMahdi Sadeghzadeh, Mohammad Hossein Rohban

entry.summary: Systematically evaluates concept unlearning in text-to-image diffusion models through the lens of compositional generation, revealing consistent trade-offs between unlearning effectiveness and compositional integrity.

entry.title: OpenWorldLib: A Unified Codebase and Definition of Advanced World Models

author.name: DataFlow Team, Bohan Zeng, Daili Hua, Kaixin Zhu, Yifan Dai, Bozhou Li, Yuran Wang, Chengzhuo Tong, Yifan Yang, Mingkun Chang, Jianbin Zhao, Zhou Liu, Hao Liang, Xiaochen Ma, Ruichuan An, Junbo Niu, Zimo Meng, Tianyi Bai, Meiyi Qiang, Huanyao Zhang, Zhiyou Xiao, Tianyu Guo, Qinhan Yu, Runhao Zhao, Zhengpin Li, Xinyi Huang, Yisheng Pan, Yiwen Tang, Yang Shi, Yue Ding, Xinlong Chen, Hongcheng Gao, Minglei Shi, Jialong Wu, Zekun Wang, Yuanxing Zhang, Xintao Wang, Pengfei Wan, Yiren Song, Mike Zheng Shou, Wentao Zhang

entry.summary: OpenWorldLib provides a unified definition and standardized inference framework for 'Advanced World Models,' proposing that world models are perception-centered with interaction and long-term memory capabilities. Integrates multiple model types into a common framework.

entry.title: CLEAR: Unlocking Generative Potential for Degraded Image Understanding in Unified Multimodal Models

author.name: Xiangzhao Hao, Zefeng Zhang, Zhenyu Zhang, Linhao Yu, Yao Chen, Yiqian Zhang, Haiyun Guo, Shuohuan Wang, Yu Sun

entry.summary: CLEAR connects the understanding and generation pathways of unified multimodal models to handle degraded image inputs, addressing the disconnect where models fail to leverage their generative capacity for restoration during reasoning.

entry.title: From Prompt to Physical Action: Structured Backdoor Attacks on LLM-Mediated Robotic Control Systems

author.name: Mingyang Xie, Jin Wei-Kocsis

entry.summary: Investigates structured backdoor attacks on LLM-mediated ROS2 robotic control systems via LoRA-based supply-chain poisoning. Finds that backdoors at the natural-language reasoning stage don't reliably propagate to executable robot commands, revealing important insights about pipeline vulnerability.

entry.title: Persistent Cross-Attempt State Optimization for Repository-Level Code Generation

author.name: Ruwei Pan, Jiangshuai Wang, Qisheng Zhang, Yueheng Zhu, Linhao Wu, Zixiong Yang, Yakun Zhang, Lu Zhang, Hongyu Zhang

entry.summary: LiveCoder maintains persistent task-specific state across multiple code generation attempts, capturing success/failure knowledge to guide subsequent repository-level code generation.

entry.title: Do No Harm: Exposing Hidden Vulnerabilities of LLMs via Persona-based Client Simulation Attack in Psychological Counseling

author.name: Qingyang Xu, Yaling Shen, Stephanie Fong, Zimu Wang, Yiwen Jiang, Xiangyu Zhao, Jiahe Liu, Zhongxing Xu, Vincent Lee, Zongyuan Ge

entry.summary: Introduces PCSA, the first red-teaming framework for psychological counseling LLMs that simulates persona-driven client dialogues to expose safety vulnerabilities where therapeutic empathy may reinforce harmful beliefs in multi-turn conversations.

entry.title: IC3-Evolve: Proof-/Witness-Gated Offline LLM-Driven Heuristic Evolution for IC3 Hardware Model Checking

author.name: Mingkai Miao, Guangyu Hu, Ziyi Yang, Hongce Zhang

entry.summary: IC3-Evolve uses LLMs to automatically propose and validate small patches to IC3 hardware model checking heuristics, with proof/witness gating to ensure correctness. This bridges LLM code generation with formal verification, ensuring every candidate patch is auditable.

entry.title: TABQAWORLD: Optimizing Multimodal Reasoning for Multi-Turn Table Question Answering

author.name: Tung Sum Thomas Kwok, Xinyu Wang, Xiaofeng Lin, Peng Lu, Chunhe Wang, Changlun Li, Hanwei Wu, Nan Tang, Elisa Kreiss, Guang Cheng

entry.summary: Introduces TABQAWORLD, a framework for multi-turn table question answering that optimizes tabular action through representation and estimation, addressing error accumulation in text serialization of tables over multiple reasoning turns.

entry.title: GUIDE: Interpretable GUI Agent Evaluation via Hierarchical Diagnosis

author.name: Yuwen Zhai, Runze Li, Liang Wang, Nian Shi, Liwu Xu, Wei Zhang, Ran Lin, Bo Xu, Benlei Cui

entry.summary: Introduces GUIDE, a hierarchical diagnostic evaluation framework for GUI agents that decomposes trajectory assessment into segmentation, summarization, and scoring stages for interpretable evaluation.

entry.title: Receding-Horizon Control via Drifting Models

author.name: Daniele Foffano, Alessio Russo, Alexandre Proutiere

entry.summary: Proposes Drifting MPC, an offline trajectory optimization framework that combines drifting generative models with receding-horizon planning for systems with unknown dynamics, learning conditional trajectory distributions from offline datasets.

entry.title: Artificial Intelligence and Systemic Risk: A Unified Model of Performative Prediction, Algorithmic Herding, and Cognitive Dependency in Financial Markets

author.name: Shuchen Meng, Xupeng Chen

entry.summary: Develops a unified model showing AI adoption in financial markets generates systemic risk through three reinforcing channels: performative prediction, algorithmic herding, and cognitive dependency, with a convex coupling that grows superlinearly with adoption.

entry.title: Scaling Teams or Scaling Time? Memory Enabled Lifelong Learning in LLM Multi-Agent Systems

author.name: Shanglin Wu, Yuyang Luo, Yueqing Liang, Kaiwen Shi, Yanfang Ye, Ali Payani, Kai Shu

entry.summary: Introduces LLMA-Mem, a lifelong memory framework for LLM multi-agent systems that jointly considers team size scaling and temporal learning ability, evaluated on MultiAgentBench across coding, research, and database tasks.

entry.title: CresOWLve: Benchmarking Creative Problem-Solving Over Real-World Knowledge

author.name: Mete Ismayilzada, Renqing Cuomao, Daniil Yurshevich, Anna Sotnikova, Lonneke van der Plas, Antoine Bosselut

entry.summary: Introduces CresOWLve, a benchmark for evaluating creative problem-solving in LLMs using puzzles grounded in real-world knowledge, requiring logical reasoning, lateral thinking, analogy-making, and commonsense knowledge.

entry.title: Toward Executable Repository-Level Code Generation via Environment Alignment

author.name: Ruwei Pan, Junlei Shen, Linhao Wu, Yueheng Zhu, Zixiong Yang, Yakun Zhang, Lu Zhang, Hongyu Zhang

entry.summary: EnvGraph formulates repository-level code generation as an environment alignment problem, jointly modeling dependency resolution and execution environment compatibility for multi-file repository generation.

entry.title: CREBench: Evaluating Large Language Models in Cryptographic Binary Reverse Engineering

author.name: Baicheng Chen, Yu Wang, Ziheng Zhou, Xiangru Liu, Juanru Li, Yilei Chen, Tianxing He

entry.summary: CREBench evaluates LLMs on cryptographic binary reverse engineering with 432 challenges from 48 crypto algorithms at 3 difficulty levels. Tests LLM capabilities for security-critical RE tasks.

entry.title: Can Humans Tell? A Dual-Axis Study of Human Perception of LLM-Generated News

author.name: Alexander Loth, Martin Kappes, Marc-Oliver Pahl

entry.summary: Study with 2,318 judgments from 1,054 participants shows humans cannot reliably distinguish LLM-generated from human-written news across six models. Domain expertise predicts accuracy but political orientation does not.

entry.title: Interpreting Video Representations with Spatio-Temporal Sparse Autoencoders

author.name: Atahan Dokme, Sriram Vishwanath

entry.summary: First systematic study of Sparse Autoencoders on video representations, proposing spatio-temporal contrastive objectives and Matryoshka hierarchical grouping to maintain temporal coherence while achieving interpretability.

entry.title: VLA-Forget: Vision-Language-Action Unlearning for Embodied Foundation Models

author.name: Ravi Ranjan, Agoritsa Polyzou

entry.summary: VLA-Forget addresses machine unlearning for vision-language-action robot models, recognizing that undesirable knowledge can be distributed across perception, alignment, and reasoning layers in embodied AI.

entry.title: From Paper to Program: A Multi-Stage LLM-Assisted Workflow for Accelerating Quantum Many-Body Algorithm Development

author.name: Yi Zhou

entry.summary: Multi-stage LLM workflow for translating quantum many-body theory into code, using LaTeX specifications as intermediate blueprints. Validated by generating a DMRG engine that accurately captures critical physics.

entry.title: Learning Robust Visual Features in Computed Tomography Enables Efficient Transfer Learning for Clinical Tasks

author.name: Rub\'en Moreno-Aguado, Alba Magall\'on, Victor Moreno, Yingying Fang, Guang Yang

entry.summary: Proposes learning robust visual features for CT scans that enable efficient transfer learning with frozen backbones, avoiding the need for expensive fine-tuning. Argues CT foundation models should prioritize visual representation quality over vision-language capabilities.

entry.title: Good Rankings, Wrong Probabilities: A Calibration Audit of Multimodal Cancer Survival Models

author.name: Sajad Ghawami

entry.summary: Conducts the first systematic calibration audit of multimodal WSI-genomics cancer survival models, finding that models achieve good discrimination but poor probability calibration.

entry.title: GROUNDEDKG-RAG: Grounded Knowledge Graph Index for Long-document Question Answering

author.name: Tianyi Zhang, Andreas Marfurt

entry.summary: Proposes GroundedKG-RAG, a RAG system using knowledge graphs explicitly grounded in source documents to improve efficiency and factual accuracy for long-document question answering.

entry.title: ENCRUST: Encapsulated Substitution and Agentic Refinement on a Live Scaffold for Safe C-to-Rust Translation

author.name: Hohyun Sim, Hyeonjoong Cho, Ali Shokri, Zhoulai Fu, Binoy Ravindran

entry.summary: ENCRUST is a two-phase pipeline for translating C projects to safe Rust, using ABI-compatible scaffolding to decouple boundary adaptation from function-level LLM translation.

entry.title: Preserving Forgery Artifacts: AI-Generated Video Detection at Native Scale

author.name: Zhengcen Li, Chenyang Jiang, Hang Zhao, Shiyang Zhou, Yunyang Mo, Feng Gao, Fan Yang, Qiben Shan, Shaocong Wu, Jingyong Su

entry.summary: Introduces a native-scale framework for AI-generated video detection that preserves high-frequency forgery artifacts lost by standard preprocessing, along with a comprehensive dataset of modern generative models.

entry.title: Selecting Decision-Relevant Concepts in Reinforcement Learning

author.name: Naveen Raman, Stephanie Milani, Fei Fang

entry.summary: Proposes the first algorithms for automatic concept selection in concept-based RL policies, framing concept selection through state abstraction theory. Provides PAC guarantees and demonstrates that selected concepts match or exceed expert-chosen ones.

entry.title: Scalable Variational Bayesian Fine-Tuning of LLMs via Orthogonalized Low-Rank Adapters

author.name: Haotian Xiang, Bingcong Li, Qin Lu

entry.summary: Proposes scalable variational Bayesian fine-tuning for LLMs using orthogonalized low-rank adapters, enabling uncertainty quantification without multiple full forward passes through the backbone.

entry.title: ACES: Who Tests the Tests? Leave-One-Out AUC Consistency for Code Generation

author.name: Hui Sun, Yun-Ji Zhang, Zheng Xie, Ren-Biao Liu, Yali Du, Xin-Ye Li, Ming Li

entry.summary: ACES proposes leave-one-out AUC consistency for evaluating LLM-generated code using LLM-generated tests, breaking the circular dependency of needing correct tests to evaluate code by ranking rather than counting test votes.

entry.title: Finite-Time Analysis of Q-Value Iteration for General-Sum Stackelberg Games

author.name: Narim Jeong, Donghwan Lee

entry.summary: Studies convergence of Stackelberg Q-value iteration in two-player general-sum Markov games from a control-theoretic perspective. Establishes finite-time error bounds by modeling learning dynamics as a switching system with comparison systems.

entry.title: Expressibility of neural quantum states: a Walsh-complexity perspective

author.name: Taige Wang

entry.summary: Introduces Walsh complexity as a measure of wavefunction spread over parity patterns for neural quantum states, proving that shallow additive feed-forward networks cannot efficiently represent states with near-uniform Walsh spectra, even with short-range entanglement.

entry.title: Debiased Machine Learning for Conformal Prediction of Counterfactual Outcomes Under Runtime Confounding

author.name: Keith Barnatchez, Kevin P. Josey, Rachel C. Nethery, Giovanni Parmigiani

entry.summary: Addresses conformal prediction of counterfactual outcomes when confounders measured in training data are unmeasured in the target population, proposing debiased machine learning methods to maintain coverage guarantees under runtime confounding.

entry.title: Improving ML Attacks on LWE with Data Repetition and Stepwise Regression

author.name: Alberto Alfarano, Eshika Saxena, Emily Wenger, Fran\c{c}ois Charton, Kristin Lauter

entry.summary: Improves ML attacks on Learning with Errors (LWE) lattice-based cryptographic problems using larger training sets, repeated examples, and stepwise regression. Discovers power-law relationships between dataset size and secret recovery.

entry.title: Synthetic Sandbox for Training Machine Learning Engineering Agents

author.name: Yuhang Zhou, Lizhu Zhang, Yifan Wu, Jiayi Liu, Xiangjun Fan, Zhuokai Zhao, Hong Yan

entry.summary: Proposes synthetic sandbox environments with reduced dataset sizes for training ML engineering agents via on-policy RL, addressing the prohibitive cost of full ML pipeline verification at each rollout step. Demonstrates that small synthetic data preserves task fidelity.

entry.title: Your Agent is More Brittle Than You Think: Uncovering Indirect Injection Vulnerabilities in Agentic LLMs

author.name: Wenhui Zhu, Xuanzhao Dong, Xiwen Chen, Rui Cai, Peijie Qiu, Zhipeng Wang, Oana Frunza, Shao Tang, Jindong Gu, Yalin Wang

entry.summary: Systematically evaluates six defense strategies against indirect prompt injection attacks across four attack types in multi-agent LLM systems, revealing that expanded action spaces and inter-system interactions create severe security challenges.

entry.title: DeonticBench: A Benchmark for Reasoning over Rules

author.name: Guangyao Dou, Luis Brena, Akhil Deo, William Jurayj, Jingyu Zhang, Nils Holzenberger, Benjamin Van Durme

entry.summary: Introduces DeonticBench with 6,232 tasks across taxes, airline policies, immigration, and housing law for evaluating LLM reasoning about obligations, permissions, and prohibitions, supporting both natural language and symbolic computation approaches.

entry.title: Talk2AI: A Longitudinal Dataset of Human--AI Persuasive Conversations

author.name: Alexis Carrillo, Enrique Taietta, Ali Aghazadeh Ardebili, Giuseppe Alessandro Veltri, Massimo Stella

entry.summary: Presents Talk2AI, a longitudinal dataset of 3,080 conversations between humans and LLMs (GPT-4o, Claude 3.7, DeepSeek V3, Mistral Large) studying persuasion and opinion change. Collected from 770 Italian adults across four weekly sessions on topics like climate change and health misinformation. Includes rich psychometric and sociodemographic metadata.

entry.title: DiffSparse: Accelerating Diffusion Transformers with Learned Token Sparsity

author.name: Haowei Zhu, Ji Liu, Ziqiong Liu, Dong Li, Junhai Yong, Bin Wang, Emad Barsoum

entry.summary: Proposes DiffSparse, a differentiable layer-wise sparsity optimization framework for diffusion transformers using learned token sparsity. Addresses limitations of existing cache-based acceleration methods for few-step diffusion models. Reduces computational cost through intelligent token selection.

entry.title: ResGuard: Enhancing Robustness Against Known Original Attacks in Deep Watermarking

author.name: Hanyi Wang, Han Fang, Yupeng Qiu, Shilin Wang, Ee-Chien Chang

entry.summary: Exposes the Known Original Attack (KOA) vulnerability in deep watermarking where adversaries with original-watermarked pairs can almost completely remove watermarks. Proposes ResGuard to enhance robustness against this attack. Important security analysis of watermarking systems.

entry.title: ActivityForensics: A Comprehensive Benchmark for Localizing Manipulated Activity in Videos

author.name: Peijun Bao, Anwei Luo, Gang Pan, Alex C. Kot, Xudong Jiang

entry.summary: Introduces ActivityForensics, the first large-scale benchmark for localizing manipulated human activities in videos with 6K+ forged segments. Addresses activity-level forgeries that modify human actions to distort event semantics. Goes beyond appearance-level forgeries like face swapping.

entry.title: Hypothesis Graph Refinement: Hypothesis-Driven Exploration with Cascade Error Correction for Embodied Navigation

author.name: Peixin Chen, Guoxi Zhang, Jianwei Ma, Qing Li

entry.summary: Hypothesis Graph Refinement (HGR) enables embodied navigation agents to make semantic predictions about unexplored regions while systematically retracting errors when new evidence contradicts them. Addresses structural error accumulation in graph-based navigation.

entry.title: Multimodal Backdoor Attack on VLMs for Autonomous Driving via Graffiti and Cross-Lingual Triggers

author.name: Jiancheng Wang, Lidan Liang, Yong Wang, Zengzhen Su, Haifeng Xia, Yuanting Yan, Wei Wang

entry.summary: GLA introduces multimodal backdoor attacks on VLMs for autonomous driving using graffiti-based visual patterns from stable diffusion and cross-language text triggers that maintain semantic consistency while introducing distributional shifts.

entry.title: Don't Waste Bits! Adaptive KV-Cache Quantization for Lightweight On-Device LLMs

author.name: Sayed Pedram Haeri Boroujeni, Niloufar Mehrabi, Patrick Woods, Gabriel Hillesheim, Abolfazl Razi

entry.summary: Proposes adaptive KV-cache quantization for on-device LLMs, inspired by Huffman coding's variable-length allocation principle, learning to allocate precision per-token based on importance rather than using fixed precision.

entry.title: E-VLA: Event-Augmented Vision-Language-Action Model for Dark and Blurred Scenes

author.name: Jiajun Zhai, Hao Shi, Shangwei Guo, Kailun Yang, Kaiwei Wang

entry.summary: E-VLA augments Vision-Language-Action models with event camera data for robust robotic manipulation under adverse conditions like extreme low light and motion blur. Includes a real-world RGB-event-action dataset.

entry.title: Rethinking Model Efficiency: Multi-Agent Inference with Large Models

author.name: Sixun Dong, Juhua Hu, Steven Li, Wei Wen, Qi Qian

entry.summary: Shows that larger VLMs with fewer output tokens can be more efficient than smaller models with longer outputs, proposing a multi-agent inference approach that leverages this observation.

entry.title: HAD: Combining Hierarchical Diffusion with Metric-Decoupled RL for End-to-End Driving

author.name: Wenhao Yao, Xinglong Sun, Zhenxin Li, Shiyi Lan, Zi Wang, Jose M. Alvarez, Zuxuan Wu

entry.summary: HAD combines hierarchical diffusion with metric-decoupled reinforcement learning for end-to-end autonomous driving, using structured RL signals instead of single coupled rewards for better optimization.

entry.title: OmniSonic: Towards Universal and Holistic Audio Generation from Video and Text

author.name: Weiguo Pian, Saksham Singh Kushwaha, Zhimin Chen, Shijian Deng, Kai Wang, Yunhui Guo, Yapeng Tian

entry.summary: OmniSonic tackles universal holistic audio generation from video and text, synthesizing on-screen/off-screen sounds including ambient events, music, and speech—capabilities lacking in prior models that only handle non-speech sounds.

entry.title: Drift-Based Policy Optimization: Native One-Step Policy Learning for Online Robot Control

author.name: Yuxuan Gao, Yedong Shen, Shiqi Zhang, Wenhao Yu, Yifan Duan, Jia pan, Jiajia Wu, Jiajun Deng, Yanyong Zhang

entry.summary: Drift-Based Policy Optimization proposes a two-stage framework for one-step generative robot policies, eliminating the need for multi-step denoising at inference time. Uses fixed-point drifting objectives to internalize iterative refinement into model parameters, enabling high-frequency closed-loop control.

entry.title: Cross-Model Activation Generalizability Isn't Strong (Yet)

author.name: J Lee

entry.summary: Tests activation similarities across different LLM families (Llama, Gemma, Qwen, Pythia) at small scale, finding cross-architectural similarity is statistically real but weak (4-9x weaker than within-family). Linear activation transfer yields better than random but not practically useful across architectures.

entry.title: Beyond Predefined Schemas: TRACE-KG for Context-Enriched Knowledge Graphs from Complex Documents

author.name: Mohammad Sadeq Abolhasani, Yang Ba, Yixuan He, Rong Pan

entry.summary: Proposes TRACE-KG, a multimodal framework that constructs context-enriched knowledge graphs and induced schemas from complex documents without predefined ontologies. Captures conditional relations through structured qualifiers.

entry.title: Quantifying Trust: Financial Risk Management for Trustworthy AI Agents

author.name: Wenyue Hua, Tianyi Peng, Chi Wang, Ian Kaufman, Bryan Lim, Chandler Fang

entry.summary: Proposes a risk management framework for trustworthy AI agents inspired by financial risk management, addressing the gap between model-level reliability and user-facing assurance for autonomous agents connected to payments.

entry.title: Scaling DPPs for RAG: Density Meets Diversity

author.name: Xun Sun, Baiheng Xie, Li Huang, Qiang Gao

entry.summary: Proposes ScalDPP, a diversity-enhanced retrieval method for RAG that uses Determinantal Point Processes to jointly optimize for both density (relevance) and diversity in retrieved context, addressing redundancy in standard relevance-only ranking.

entry.title: Beyond Static Vision: Scene Dynamic Field Unlocks Intuitive Physics Understanding in Multi-modal Large Language Models

author.name: Nanxi Li, Xiang Wang, Yuanjie Chen, Haode Zhang, Hong Li, Yong-Lu Li

entry.summary: Investigates MLLMs' ability to understand intuitive physics of continuum objects, introducing two benchmark tasks (Next Frame Selection and Temporal Coherence Verification) that reveal substantial limitations in current state-of-the-art models.

entry.title: Downscaling weather forecasts from Low- to High-Resolution with Diffusion Models

author.name: Joffrey Dumont Le Brazidec, Simon Lang, Martin Leutbecher, Baudouin Raoult, Gert Mertes, Florian Pinault, Aristofanis Tsiringakis, Pedro Maciel, Ana Prieto Nemesio, Jan Polster, Cathal O Brien, Matthew Chantry

entry.summary: Introduces a probabilistic diffusion-based method for weather forecast downscaling within ECMWF's Anemoi framework, transforming 100km ensemble forecasts to 30km resolution by learning conditional fine-scale residual distributions.

entry.title: LangFIR: Discovering Sparse Language-Specific Features from Monolingual Data for Language Steering

author.name: Sing Hieng Wong, Hassan Sajjad, A. B. Siddique

entry.summary: LangFIR discovers language-specific sparse autoencoder features from monolingual data only, enabling language steering in LLMs without requiring multilingual or parallel data.

entry.title: Automated Attention Pattern Discovery at Scale in Large Language Models

author.name: Jonathan Katzy, Razvan-Mihai Popescu, Erik Mekkes, Arie van Deursen, Maliheh Izadi

entry.summary: Proposes automated discovery of attention patterns in LLMs at scale by mining completion scenarios in Java code datasets. Shows attention patterns are scalable signals for global interpretability.

entry.title: Representational Collapse in Multi-Agent LLM Committees: Measurement and Diversity-Aware Consensus

author.name: Dipkumar Patel

entry.summary: Identifies 'representational collapse' in multi-agent LLM committees where cloned agents produce highly similar reasoning (0.888 cosine similarity). DALC protocol uses diversity-weighted consensus to improve accuracy while reducing token cost.

entry.title: Enhancing behavioral nudges with large language model-based iterative personalization: A field experiment on electricity and hot-water conservation

author.name: Zonghan Li, Yi Liu, Chunyan Wang, Song Tong, Kaiping Peng, Feng Ji

entry.summary: Field experiment (N=233) showing LLM-personalized nudges with iterative updates produce largest conservation effects for electricity and hot-water use among university residents in China.

entry.title: Diagonal-Tiled Mixed-Precision Attention for Efficient Low-Bit MXFP Inference

author.name: Yifu Ding, Xinhao Zhang, Jinyang Guo

entry.summary: Presents DMA, a low-bit mixed-precision attention kernel using MXFP format for next-gen GPU architectures, implementing diagonal-tiled design in Triton for efficient LLM inference.

entry.title: CoopGuard: Stateful Cooperative Agents Safeguarding LLMs Against Evolving Multi-Round Attacks

author.name: Siyuan Li, Zehao Liu, Xi Lin, Qinghua Mao, Yuliang Chen, Haoyu Li, Jun Wu, Jianhua Li, Xiu Su

entry.summary: CoopGuard is a stateful multi-round LLM defense framework with specialized cooperative agents (Deferring, Tempting, Forensic) coordinated by a System Agent to counter evolving multi-round adversarial attacks.

entry.title: Training Transformers in Cosine Coefficient Space

author.name: Mohamed Amine Bergach

entry.summary: Parameterizes transformer weights in DCT domain, retaining only low-frequency coefficients. Matches standard performance at 52% parameters and achieves 6.9 perplexity at 29% parameters on character-level language modeling.

entry.title: Discrete Prototypical Memories for Federated Time Series Foundation Models

author.name: Liwei Deng, Qingxiang Liu, Xinhe Niu, Shengchao Chen, Sheng Sun, Yuankai Wu, Guodong Long, Yuxuan Liang

entry.summary: Proposes FeDPM, a federated framework using discrete prototypical memories to bridge semantic gap between time series data and LLM latent spaces, addressing cross-domain heterogeneity in federated settings.

entry.title: Temporal Inversion for Learning Interval Change in Chest X-Rays

author.name: Hanbin Ko, Kyeongmin Jeon, Doowoong Choi, Chang Min Park

entry.summary: Introduces TILA, a framework that uses temporal inversion (reversing image pairs) as a supervisory signal to enhance vision-language models' sensitivity to directional change in chest X-rays.

entry.title: Ruling Out to Rule In: Contrastive Hypothesis Retrieval for Medical Question Answering

author.name: Byeolhee Kim, Min-Kyung Kim, Young-Hak Kim, Tae-Joon Jeon

entry.summary: Proposes Contrastive Hypothesis Retrieval for medical QA, inspired by clinical differential diagnosis, which explicitly suppresses hard negative conditions that are semantically close but clinically distinct.

entry.title: Is a Picture Worth a Thousand Words? Adaptive Multimodal Fact-Checking with Visual Evidence Necessity

author.name: Jaeyoon Jung, Yejun Yoon, Kunwoo Park

entry.summary: Proposes AMuFC, a multimodal fact-checking framework with collaborative agents that adaptively determine when visual evidence is necessary, challenging the assumption that multimodal evidence always helps.

entry.title: MUXQ: Mixed-to-Uniform Precision MatriX Quantization via Low-Rank Outlier Decomposition

author.name: Seoungsub Lee, In Seo Kim, Seon Wook Kim

entry.summary: MUXQ proposes a mixed-to-uniform quantization method for LLMs that handles activation outliers through low-rank decomposition, enabling efficient NPU deployment with uniform INT quantization.

entry.title: The Infinite-Dimensional Nature of Spectroscopy and Why Models Succeed, Fail, and Mislead

author.name: Umberto Michelucci, Francesca Venturini

entry.summary: Provides theoretical analysis showing that high-dimensional spectral data can appear perfectly separable due to intrinsic dimensionality effects, explaining why ML models achieve high accuracy in spectroscopy even without using meaningful features.

entry.title: SkillX: Automatically Constructing Skill Knowledge Bases for Agents

author.name: Chenxi Wang, Zhuoyun Yu, Xin Xie, Wuguannan Yao, Runnan Fang, Shuofei Qiao, Kexin Cao, Guozhou Zheng, Xiang Qi, Peng Zhang, Shumin Deng

entry.summary: Proposes SkillX, a framework for automatically constructing reusable skill knowledge bases for LLM agents through multi-level skill design, skill retrieval via concept lattice, and skill evolution through merging and filtering.

entry.title: Your Pre-trained Diffusion Model Secretly Knows Restoration

author.name: Sudarshan Rajagopalan, Vishal M. Patel

entry.summary: Shows that pre-trained diffusion models inherently possess restoration behavior that can be unlocked by learning prompt embeddings at the text encoder output, without fine-tuning or Control-Net modules.

entry.title: Adversarial Robustness of Deep State Space Models for Forecasting

author.name: Sribalaji C. Anand, George J. Pappas

entry.summary: Analyzes adversarial robustness of state-space models for time-series forecasting through a control-theoretic lens, showing Spacetime SSM can represent optimal Kalman predictors and formulating robust design as a Stackelberg game.

entry.title: Align Your Structures: Generating Trajectories with Structure Pretraining for Molecular Dynamics

author.name: Aniketh Iyengar, Jiaqi Han, Pengwei Sun, Mingjian Jiang, Jianwen Xie, Stefano Ermon

entry.summary: Proposes a framework for molecular dynamics trajectory generation using structure pretraining on large conformer datasets followed by an interpolator module for temporal consistency, leveraging abundant structural data to mitigate MD data scarcity.

entry.title: Uncertainty-Aware Foundation Models for Clinical Data

author.name: Qian Zhou, Yuanyun Zhang, Shi Li

entry.summary: Proposes uncertainty-aware foundation modeling for clinical data, representing patients as distributions over latent states rather than point embeddings, with consistency enforcement across partial views.

entry.title: Subspace Control: Turning Constrained Model Steering into Controllable Spectral Optimization

author.name: Yancheng Huang, Changsheng Wang, Chongyu Fan, Yicheng Lang, Bingqi Shang, Yang Zhang, Mingyi Hong, Qing Qu, Alvaro Velasquez, Sijia Liu

entry.summary: Proposes subspace control for constrained model training, analyzing spectral cross-task interference from a model merging perspective and resolving it via orthogonal subspace decomposition.

entry.title: Beyond Imbalance Ratio: Data Characteristics as Critical Moderators of Oversampling Method Selection

author.name: Yuwen Jiang, Songyun Ye

entry.summary: Challenges the common assumption that imbalance ratio (IR) positively correlates with oversampling effectiveness through 12 controlled experiments. Shows class separability and cluster structure are stronger moderators than IR for oversampling method selection.

entry.title: Stochastic Generative Plug-and-Play Priors

author.name: Chicago Y. Park, Edward P. Chandler, Yuyang Hu, Michael T. McCann, Cristina Garcia-Cardona, Brendt Wohlberg, Ulugbek S. Kamilov

entry.summary: Establishes a score-based interpretation of Plug-and-Play methods that justifies using pretrained score-based diffusion models directly within PnP algorithms, introducing a Stochastic Generative PnP (SGPnP) framework for imaging inverse problems.

entry.title: PhaseFlow4D: Physically Constrained 4D Beam Reconstruction via Feedback-Guided Latent Diffusion

author.name: Alexander Scheinker, Alexander Plastun, Peter Ostroumov

entry.summary: Proposes PhaseFlow4D, a feedback-guided latent diffusion model that reconstructs 4D transverse phase space distributions of charged particle beams from sparse 2D projections with hard physics constraints built into a 4D VAE decoder.

entry.title: Sharp asymptotic theory for Q-learning with LDTZ learning rate and its generalization

author.name: Soham Bonnerjee, Zhipeng Lou, Wei Biao Wu

entry.summary: Establishes sharp asymptotic theory for Q-learning with linear-decay-to-zero (LDTZ) learning rate schedules and their generalization, addressing a gap between the practical success of LDTZ and its theoretical understanding.

entry.title: The Tool Illusion: Rethinking Tool Use in Web Agents

author.name: Renze Lou, Baolin Peng, Wenlin Yao, Qianhui Wu, Hao Cheng, Suman Nath, Wenpeng Yin, Jianfeng Gao

entry.summary: Conducts an extensive empirical study revisiting tool use in web agents across diverse tool sources, testing whether tools provide consistent gains, what design principles characterize effective tools, and what side effects they introduce.

entry.title: Emergent Inference-Time Semantic Contamination via In-Context Priming

author.name: Marcin Abram

entry.summary: Shows that inference-time semantic contamination via few-shot priming with culturally loaded numbers can induce distributional shifts in capable LLMs, revisiting prior claims that k-shot prompting doesn't cause emergent misalignment.

entry.title: EgoMind: Activating Spatial Cognition through Linguistic Reasoning in MLLMs

author.name: Zhenghao Chen, Huiqun Wang, Di Huang

entry.summary: Proposes EgoMind, a Chain-of-Thought framework for geometry-free spatial reasoning in MLLMs using Role-Play Caption to construct linguistic scene graphs across frames. Avoids the need for 3D priors or geometric supervision. Demonstrates that linguistic reasoning can activate spatial cognition in multimodal models.

entry.title: SpectralSplat: Appearance-Disentangled Feed-Forward Gaussian Splatting for Driving Scenes

author.name: Quentin Herau, Tianshuo Xu, Depu Meng, Jiezhi Yang, Chensheng Peng, Spencer Sherk, Yihan Hu, Wei Zhan

entry.summary: Presents SpectralSplat, a method disentangling appearance from geometry in feed-forward Gaussian Splatting for autonomous driving. Factors color prediction into appearance-agnostic and appearance-conditioned streams using DINOv2 embeddings. Enables relighting, appearance transfer, and consistent multi-traversal rendering.

entry.title: Can Natural Image Autoencoders Compactly Tokenize fMRI Volumes for Long-Range Dynamics Modeling?

author.name: Peter Yongho Kim, Juhyeon Park, Jungwoo Park, Jubin Choi, Jungwoo Seo, Jiook Cha, Taesup Moon

entry.summary: Proposes TABLeT, which tokenizes fMRI volumes using pre-trained 2D natural image autoencoders for long-range brain dynamics modeling. Compresses 3D fMRI volumes into compact continuous tokens enabling long-sequence Transformer modeling. Creative cross-domain transfer of image autoencoders to neuroimaging.

entry.title: FunFact: Building Probabilistic Functional 3D Scene Graphs via Factor-Graph Reasoning

author.name: Zhengyu Fu, Ren\'e Zurbr\"ugg, Kaixian Qu, Marc Pollefeys, Marco Hutter, Hermann Blum, Zuria Bauer

entry.summary: Introduces FunFact for constructing probabilistic functional 3D scene graphs from RGB-D images using factor graphs. Combines foundation model proposals with LLM common-sense and geometric priors for joint probabilistic reasoning. Advances beyond pairwise functional relationships to scene-wide interdependence.

entry.title: SafeCtrl: Region-Aware Safety Control for Text-to-Image Diffusion via Detect-Then-Suppress

author.name: Lingyun Zhang, Yu Xie, Zhongli Fang, Yu Liu, Ping Chen

entry.summary: Proposes SafeCtrl, a region-aware safety control framework for text-to-image diffusion using Detect-Then-Suppress paradigm. Addresses the trade-off between safety and context preservation by targeting only unsafe regions. Designed to resist adversarial attacks on safety mechanisms.

entry.title: NTIRE 2026 3D Restoration and Reconstruction in Real-world Adverse Conditions: RealX3D Challenge Results

author.name: Shuhong Liu, Chenyu Bao, Ziteng Cui, Xuangeng Chu, Bin Ren, Lin Gu, Xiang Chen, Mingrui Li, Long Ma, Marcos V. Conde, Radu Timofte, Yun Liu, Ryo Umagami, Tomohiro Hashimoto, Zijian Hu, Yuan Gan, Tianhan Xu, Yusuke Kurose, Tatsuya Harada, Junwei Yuan, Gengjia Chang, Xining Ge, Mache You, Qida Cao, Zeliang Li, Xinyuan Hu, Hongde Gu, Changyue Shi, Jiajun Ding, Zhou Yu, Jun Yu, Seungsang Oh, Fei Wang, Donggun Kim, Zhiliang Wu, Seho Ahn, Xinye Zheng, Kun Li, Yanyan Wei, Weisi Lin, Dizhe Zhang, Yuchao Chen, Meixi Song, Hanqing Wang, Haoran Feng, Lu Qi, Jiaao Shan, Yang Gu, Jiacheng Liu, Shiyu Liu, Kui Jiang, Junjun Jiang, Runyu Zhu, Sixun Dong, Qingxia Ye, Zhiqiang Zhang, Zhihua Xu, Zhiwei Wang, Phan The Son, Zhimiao Shi, Zixuan Guo, Xueming Fu, Lixia Han, Changhe Liu, Zhenyu Zhao, Manabu Tsukada, Zheng Zhang, Zihan Zhai, Tingting Li, Ziyang Zheng, Yuhao Liu, Dingju Wang, Jeongbin You, Younghyuk Kim, Il-Youp Kwak, Mingzhe Lyu, Junbo Yang, Wenhan Yang, Hongsen Zhang, Jinqiang Cui, Hong Zhang, Haojie Guo, Hantang Li, Qiang Zhu, Bowen He, Xiandong Meng, Debin Zhao, Xiaopeng Fan, Wei Zhou, Linzhe Jiang, Linfeng Li, Louzhe Xu, Qi Xu, Hang Song, Chenkun Guo, Weizhi Nie, Yufei Li, Xingan Zhan, Zhanqi Shi, Dufeng Zhang, Boyuan Tian, Jingshuo Zeng, Gang He, Yubao Fu, Weijie Wang, Cunchuan Huang

entry.summary: Reports results of the NTIRE 2026 challenge on 3D reconstruction under adverse real-world conditions (extreme low-light and smoke). 279 participants registered with 33 valid submissions, revealing significant progress on the RealX3D benchmark.

entry.title: 3D-Fixer: Coarse-to-Fine In-place Completion for 3D Scenes from a Single Image

author.name: Ze-Xin Yin, Liu Liu, Xinjie Wang, Wei Sui, Zhizhong Su, Jian Yang, Jin Xie

entry.summary: 3D-Fixer introduces an in-place completion paradigm for compositional 3D scene generation from a single image, generating complete 3D assets conditioned on partially visible point clouds at original locations, bridging feed-forward and per-instance approaches.

entry.title: Beyond Standard Benchmarks: A Systematic Audit of Vision-Language Model's Robustness to Natural Semantic Variation Across Diverse Tasks

author.name: Jia Chengyu, AprilPyone MaungMaung, Huy H. Nguyen, Jinyin Chen, Isao Echizen

entry.summary: Systematic evaluation of vision-language models (CLIP, BLIP2, SigLIP2) under natural adversarial scenarios including typographic attacks and language-induced adversarial examples across diverse tasks.

entry.title: Beyond Semantics: Uncovering the Physics of Fakes via Universal Physical Descriptors for Cross-Modal Synthetic Detection

author.name: Mei Qiu, Jianqiang Zhao, Yanyun Qu

entry.summary: Investigates universal physical descriptors (pixel-level features like noise patterns, frequency spectra) that can distinguish AI-generated from real images across diverse generative architectures, integrating them with CLIP for cross-modal detection.

entry.title: AvatarPointillist: AutoRegressive 4D Gaussian Avatarization

author.name: Hongyu Liu, Xuan Wang, Yating Wang, Zijian Wu, Ziyu Wan, Yue Ma, Runtao Liu, Boyao Zhou, Yujun Shen, Qifeng Chen

entry.summary: AvatarPointillist generates dynamic 4D Gaussian avatars from single portrait images using an autoregressive Transformer that sequentially generates point clouds with per-point binding for animation.

entry.title: SpatialEdit: Benchmarking Fine-Grained Image Spatial Editing

author.name: Yicheng Xiao, Wenhu Zhang, Lin Song, Yukang Chen, Wenbo Li, Nan Jiang, Tianhe Ren, Haokun Lin, Wei Huang, Haoyang Huang, Xiu Li, Nan Duan, Xiaojuan Qi

entry.summary: SpatialEdit introduces a benchmark (SpatialEdit-Bench) and large synthetic dataset (SpatialEdit-500k) for evaluating and training fine-grained spatial image editing, measuring both perceptual plausibility and geometric fidelity.

entry.title: Vanast: Virtual Try-On with Human Image Animation via Synthetic Triplet Supervision

author.name: Hyunsoo Cha, Wonjung Woo, Byungjun Kim, Hanbyul Joo

entry.summary: Vanast unifies virtual try-on and pose-driven animation in a single framework, generating garment-transferred animation videos from a single human image, garment images, and pose guidance, avoiding identity drift from two-stage pipelines.

entry.title: Adaptive Action Chunking at Inference-time for Vision-Language-Action Models

author.name: Yuanchang Liang, Xiaobo Wang, Kai Wang, Shuo Wang, Xiaojiang Peng, Haoyu Chen, David Kim Huat Chua, Prahlad Vadakkepat

entry.summary: Proposes adaptive action chunking at inference time for Vision-Language-Action models, dynamically selecting chunk sizes to balance reactivity and consistency. Addresses the fixed chunk length limitation in current VLA models.

entry.title: ActionNex: A Virtual Outage Manager for Cloud

author.name: Zhenfeng Lin, Haoji Hu, Ming Hao, Xuchao Zhang, Ryan Zhang, Junhao Li, Ze Li, Oleg Kulygin, Chetan Bansal, Hatay Tuna, Murali Chintalapati, Sheila Jiang, Salman Zafar, Angie Anderson

entry.summary: Presents ActionNex, a production-grade agentic system for cloud outage management that provides real-time updates, knowledge distillation, and next-best action recommendations using multimodal operational signals.

entry.title: Rashomon Memory: Towards Argumentation-Driven Retrieval for Multi-Perspective Agent Memory

author.name: Albert Sadowski, Jaros{\l}aw A. Chudziak

entry.summary: Proposes Rashomon Memory, an architecture where parallel goal-conditioned agents encode experiences according to their priorities and negotiate interpretations through argumentation at query time. Each perspective maintains its own ontology.

entry.title: InsTraj: Instructing Diffusion Models with Travel Intentions to Generate Real-world Trajectories

author.name: Yuanshao Zhu, Yuxuan Liang, Xiangyu Zhao, Liang Han, Xinwei Fang, Xuetao Wei, James Jianqiao Yu

entry.summary: Introduces InsTraj, a framework using diffusion models guided by LLM-interpreted natural language travel intentions to generate realistic GPS trajectories for urban planning and mobility simulation.

entry.title: Pedagogical Safety in Educational Reinforcement Learning: Formalizing and Detecting Reward Hacking in AI Tutoring Systems

author.name: Oluseyi Olukola, Nick Rahimi

entry.summary: Introduces a four-layer pedagogical safety model for educational RL and proposes the Reward Hacking Severity Index to quantify misalignment between proxy rewards and genuine learning in AI tutoring systems.

entry.title: Optimizing Service Operations via LLM-Powered Multi-Agent Simulation

author.name: Yanyuan Wang, Xiaowei Zhang

entry.summary: Introduces an LLM-powered multi-agent simulation framework for optimizing service operations, posing the problem as stochastic optimization with decision-dependent uncertainty and developing on-trajectory learning algorithms.

entry.title: PSY-STEP: Structuring Therapeutic Targets and Action Sequences for Proactive Counseling Dialogue Systems

author.name: Jihyun Lee, Yejin Min, Yejin Jeon, SungJun Yang, Hyounghun Kim, Gary Geunbae Lee

entry.summary: Introduces PSY-STEP, a dataset modeling CBT counseling with explicit automatic thoughts and dynamic action sequences, and trains STEPPER, a counseling agent refined through preference learning on simulated sessions.

entry.title: Memory Intelligence Agent

author.name: Jingyang Qiao, Weicheng Meng, Yu Cheng, Zhihang Lin, Zhizhong Zhang, Xin Tan, Jingyu Gong, Kun Shao, Yuan Xie

entry.summary: Proposes Memory Intelligence Agent (MIA), a framework for deep research agents with a Manager-Planner-Executor architecture that compresses historical search trajectories and trains a parametric planner to produce search plans, addressing storage costs and memory evolution limitations.

entry.title: Is your AI Model Accurate Enough? The Difficult Choices Behind Rigorous AI Development and the EU AI Act

author.name: Lucas G. Uberti-Bona Marin, Bram Rijsbosch, Kristof Meding, Gerasimos Spanakis, Gijs van Dijck, Konrad Kollnig

entry.summary: Provides a legal-technical analysis of AI accuracy evaluation under the EU AI Act, arguing that accuracy is not an objective property but depends on context-dependent normative decisions about error prioritization, risk distribution, and trade-offs.

entry.title: Learning Additively Compositional Latent Actions for Embodied AI

author.name: Hangxing Wei, Xiaoyu Chen, Chuheng Zhang, Tim Pearce, Jianyu Chen, Alex Lamb, Li Zhao, Jiang Bian

entry.summary: Proposes Additively Compositional Latent Action Model (AC-LAM) that enforces additive compositional structure on latent actions learned from video, encouraging algebraic properties (identity, inverse, cycle consistency) for embodied AI.

entry.title: CRAFT: Video Diffusion for Bimanual Robot Data Generation

author.name: Jason Chen, I-Chun Arthur Liu, Gaurav Sukhatme, Daniel Seita

entry.summary: CRAFT uses video diffusion transformers conditioned on edge-based structural cues from simulator trajectories to generate bimanual robot demonstration data with action labels, addressing data scarcity in bimanual manipulation.

entry.title: Stabilizing Unsupervised Self-Evolution of MLLMs via Continuous Softened Retracing reSampling

author.name: Yunyao Yu, Zhengxian Wu, Zhuohong Chen, Hangrui Xu, Zirui Liao, Xiangwen Deng, Zhifang Liu, Senyuan Shi, Haoqian Wang

entry.summary: CSRS proposes a retracing re-sampling mechanism for unsupervised self-evolution of multimodal LLMs, addressing the problem of majority voting propagating model biases as pseudo-golden answers.

entry.title: Build on Priors: Vision--Language--Guided Neuro-Symbolic Imitation Learning for Data-Efficient Real-World Robot Manipulation

author.name: Pierrick Lorang, Johannes Huemer, Timothy Duggan, Kai Goebel, Patrik Zips, Matthias Scheutz

entry.summary: Neuro-symbolic framework that constructs symbolic planning domains and control policies from 1-30 unannotated skill demonstrations using VLMs, enabling long-horizon robot manipulation.

entry.title: AdaptFuse: Training-Free Sequential Preference Learning via Externalized Bayesian Inference

author.name: Fangzhou Lin, Peiran Li, Shuo Xing, Siyuan Yang, Qianwen Ge, Kazunori Yamada, Ziming Zhang, Haichong Zhang, Zhengzhong Tu

entry.summary: AdaptFuse is a training-free framework for sequential preference learning that externalizes Bayesian inference from the LLM using a symbolic module for posterior maintenance and entropy-adaptive fusion.

entry.title: Learning Dexterous Grasping from Sparse Taxonomy Guidance

author.name: Juhan Park, Taerim Yoon, Seungmin Kim, Joonggil Kim, Wontae Ye, Jeongeun Park, Yoonbyung Chai, Geonwoo Cho, Geunwoo Cho, Dohyeong Kim, Kyungjae Lee, Yongjae Kim, Sungjoon Choi

entry.summary: Introduces GRIT, a two-stage framework for dexterous robotic grasping that uses sparse taxonomy-based grasp specifications rather than dense pose targets, combining grasp prediction with policy execution.

entry.title: Boosted Distributional Reinforcement Learning: Analysis and Healthcare Applications

author.name: Zequn Chen, Wesley J. Marrero

entry.summary: Introduces boosted distributional reinforcement learning that models full outcome distributions and addresses fairness across heterogeneous patient groups in healthcare decision-making.

entry.title: Context is All You Need

author.name: Jean Erik Delanois, Shruti Joshi, Ryan Golden, Teresa Nick, Maxim Bazhenov

entry.summary: Introduces CONTXT, a simple method for domain generalization and test-time adaptation using additive and multiplicative modulation of internal representations, achieving strong results on ImageNet variants.

entry.title: MC-GenRef: Annotation-free mammography microcalcification segmentation with generative posterior refinement

author.name: Hyunwoo Cho, Yeeun Kwon, Min Jung Kim, Yangmo Yoo

entry.summary: MC-GenRef proposes a label-free framework for mammography microcalcification segmentation using synthetic supervision from physically plausible MC injection and test-time generative posterior refinement.

entry.title: FileGram: Grounding Agent Personalization in File-System Behavioral Traces

author.name: Shuai Liu, Shulin Tian, Kairui Hu, Yuhao Dong, Zhe Yang, Bo Li, Jingkang Yang, Chen Change Loy, Ziwei Liu

entry.summary: Proposes FileGram, a framework grounding AI agent personalization in file-system behavioral traces, including a data engine for synthetic trace generation, a memory module, and a benchmark for evaluation.

entry.title: The limits of bio-molecular modeling with large language models : a cross-scale evaluation

author.name: Yaxin Xu, Yue Zhou, Tianyu Zhao, Fengwei An, Zhixiang Ren

entry.summary: Proposes BioMol-LLM-Bench, a cross-scale benchmark for evaluating LLMs on bio-molecular tasks across 26 tasks and 4 difficulty levels. Evaluates 13 models and reveals systematic gaps in mechanistic understanding.

entry.title: Super Agents and Confounders: Influence of surrounding agents on vehicle trajectory prediction

author.name: Daniel Jost, Luca Paparusso, Martin Stoll, J\"org Wagner, Raghu Rajan, Joschka B\"odecker

entry.summary: Reveals that many surrounding agents in trajectory prediction models degrade accuracy rather than improve it, using Shapley-based attribution. Proposes a Conditional Information Bottleneck to compress agent features and remove spurious influences.

entry.title: SODA: Semi On-Policy Black-Box Distillation for Large Language Models

author.name: Xiwen Chen, Jingjing Wang, Wenhui Zhu, Peijie Qiu, Xuanzhao Dong, Hejian Sang, Zhipeng Wang, Alborz Geramifard, Feng Luo

entry.summary: SODA proposes semi on-policy black-box knowledge distillation for LLMs, exploiting the capability gap between teacher and student to avoid adversarial training instability while correcting student errors.

entry.title: BWTA: Accurate and Efficient Binarized Transformer by Algorithm-Hardware Co-design

author.name: Yifu Ding, Xianglong Liu, Shenghao Jin, Jinyang Guo, Jiwen Lu

entry.summary: BWTA proposes binary weights with ternary activations quantization for transformers, with a custom CUDA kernel achieving practical speedups. Includes smooth multi-stage quantization for stable training.

entry.title: Estimating Central, Peripheral, and Temporal Visual Contributions to Human Decision Making in Atari Games

author.name: Henrik Krauss, Takehisa Yairi

entry.summary: Studies how peripheral vision, gaze information, and temporal information contribute to human decision-making in Atari games using the Atari-HEAD eye-tracking dataset. Finds peripheral information is by far the most important (35-43% accuracy drop when removed).

entry.title: Batch Loss Score for Dynamic Data Pruning

author.name: Qing Zhou, Bingxuan Zhao, Tao Yang, Hongyuan Zhang, Junyu Gao, Qi Wang

entry.summary: Proposes Batch Loss Score (BLS), a computationally efficient data pruning metric using exponential moving average of batch losses, formally shown to function as a first-order Kalman filter for estimating individual sample importance.

entry.title: HI-MoE: Hierarchical Instance-Conditioned Mixture-of-Experts for Object Detection

author.name: Vadim Vashkelis, Natalia Trukhina

entry.summary: Proposes HI-MoE, a hierarchical instance-conditioned Mixture-of-Experts architecture for DETR-style object detection with two-stage routing: scene-level expert selection followed by instance-level query routing.

entry.title: Diffusion Policy with Bayesian Expert Selection for Active Multi-Target Tracking

author.name: Haotian Xiang, Qin Lu, Yaakov Bar-Shalom

entry.summary: Proposes a Bayesian framework for pessimistic expert selection in diffusion policies for active multi-target tracking, using a multi-head Variational Bayesian Last Layer to predict performance of each behavioral strategy.

entry.title: The Generalised Kernel Covariance Measure

author.name: Luca Bergen, Dino Sejdinovic, Vanessa Didelez

entry.summary: Proposes the Generalised Kernel Covariance Measure (GKCM) for conditional independence testing that accommodates arbitrary regression models beyond kernel ridge regression, improving computational efficiency and calibration.

entry.title: Non-Equilibrium Stochastic Dynamics as a Unified Framework for Insight and Repetitive Learning: A Kramers Escape Approach to Continual Learning

author.name: Gunn Kim

entry.summary: Models the stability-plasticity dilemma in continual learning as Kramers escape from a double-well potential under Langevin dynamics, providing a unified physical framework for insight learning and gradual skill acquisition.

entry.title: Minimaxity and Admissibility of Bayesian Neural Networks

author.name: Daniel Andrew Coulson, Martin T. Wells

entry.summary: Studies Bayesian neural networks through statistical decision theory, showing fixed-prior BNN Bayes rules are not minimax, then proposing a hyperprior that yields simultaneously admissible and minimax decision rules under quadratic loss.

entry.title: CAWN: Continuous Acoustic Wave Networks for Autoregressive Language Modeling

author.name: Dejan \v{C}ugalj, Aleksandar Jevremovic

entry.summary: Introduces CAWN, a continuous architecture replacing transformer self-attention with complex-domain phasor projections and causal O(L) phase accumulation for sequence mixing, plus a dual-gated selective phase resonance mechanism for long contexts.

entry.title: How Well Do Agentic Skills Work in the Wild: Benchmarking LLM Skill Usage in Realistic Settings

author.name: Yujian Liu, Jiabao Ji, Li An, Tommi Jaakkola, Yang Zhang, Shiyu Chang

entry.summary: Studies LLM agent skill usage under realistic conditions where agents must retrieve from large skill collections and handle imperfect skill matches, finding significant gaps between idealized and realistic skill utility.

entry.title: Bridging the Dimensionality Gap: A Taxonomy and Survey of 2D Vision Model Adaptation for 3D Analysis

author.name: Akshat Pandya, Bhavuk Jain

entry.summary: Provides a comprehensive survey and unified taxonomy of strategies for adapting 2D vision models to 3D analysis, covering data-centric, architecture-centric, and hybrid methods. Bridges the gap between regular 2D grids and irregular 3D data like point clouds and meshes. Timely review of a rapidly growing research area.

entry.title: KiToke: Kernel-based Interval-aware Token Compression for Video Large Language Models

author.name: Haifeng Huang, Yang Li

entry.summary: Proposes KiToke, a training-free token compression approach for Video LLMs that reduces spatiotemporal redundancy using kernel-based redundancy estimation. Introduces temporal interval construction with interval-aware token merging. Addresses inference cost issues in video understanding.

entry.title: DSERT-RoLL: Robust Multi-Modal Perception for Diverse Driving Conditions with Stereo Event-RGB-Thermal Cameras, 4D Radar, and Dual-LiDAR

author.name: Hoonhee Cho, Jae-Young Kang, Yuhwan Jeong, Yunseo Yang, Wonyoung Lee, Youngho Kim, Kuk-Jin Yoon

entry.summary: Presents DSERT-RoLL, a driving dataset incorporating stereo event, RGB, thermal cameras with 4D radar and dual LiDAR across diverse conditions. Provides 2D/3D bounding boxes with track IDs and ego odometry. Addresses data scarcity for novel sensor types like event cameras and 4D radar.

entry.title: SymphoMotion: Joint Control of Camera Motion and Object Dynamics for Coherent Video Generation

author.name: Guiyu Zhang, Yabo Chen, Xunzhi Xiang, Junchao Huang, Zhongyu Wang, Li Jiang

entry.summary: Introduces SymphoMotion for unified camera motion and object dynamics control in video generation. Uses geometry-aware cues for camera trajectory control and 3D trajectory embeddings for depth-aware object manipulation. Addresses the entanglement of camera-induced parallax with true object movement.

entry.title: Next-Scale Autoregressive Models for Text-to-Motion Generation

author.name: Zhiwei Zheng, Shibo Jin, Lingjie Liu, Mingmin Zhao

entry.summary: Introduces MoScale, a next-scale autoregressive framework for text-to-motion generation that generates hierarchically from coarse to fine temporal resolutions. Incorporates cross-scale refinement and in-scale temporal refinement for robustness under limited data. Claims SOTA results on text-to-motion benchmarks.

entry.title: Learning 3D Reconstruction with Priors in Test Time

author.name: Lei Zhou, Haoyu Wu, Akshat Dave, Dimitris Samaras

entry.summary: Introduces a test-time optimization framework for multiview Transformers incorporating priors (poses, intrinsics, depth) as constraints without retraining. Uses self-supervised objectives with prior penalty terms at inference time. Improves 3D tasks by optimizing pre-trained networks.

entry.title: UENR-600K: A Large-Scale Physically Grounded Dataset for Nighttime Video Deraining

author.name: Pei Yang, Hai Ci, Beibei Lin, Yiren Song, Mike Zheng Shou

entry.summary: UENR-600K is a large-scale physically grounded dataset of 600K 1080p frame pairs for nighttime video deraining, using Unreal Engine to simulate rain as 3D particles with realistic light interactions.

entry.title: InCTRLv2: Generalist Residual Models for Few-Shot Anomaly Detection and Segmentation

author.name: Jiawen Zhu, Mengjia Niu, Guansong Pang

entry.summary: InCTRLv2 extends the InCTRL framework for generalist anomaly detection and segmentation, learning a single model to detect anomalies across diverse domains without retraining using few-shot in-context residual learning.

entry.title: Less Detail, Better Answers: Degradation-Driven Prompting for VQA

author.name: Haoxuan Han, Weijie Wang, Zeyu Zhang, Yefei He, Bohan Zhuang

entry.summary: Degradation-Driven Prompting (DDP) improves VQA by strategically reducing image fidelity to force models to focus on essential structural information, counterintuitively improving performance by removing distracting high-resolution details.

entry.title: NeuralLVC: Neural Lossless Video Compression via Masked Diffusion with Temporal Conditioning

author.name: Tiberio Uricchio, Marco Bertini

entry.summary: NeuralLVC is a neural lossless video codec using masked diffusion with I/P-frame architecture, achieving exact pixel reconstruction through bijective linear tokenization and temporal conditioning.

entry.title: UniSurgSAM: A Unified Promptable Model for Reliable Surgical Video Segmentation

author.name: Haofeng Liu, Ziyue Wang, Alex Y. W. Kong, Guanyi Qin, Yunqiu Xu, Chang Han Low, Mingqi Gao, Lap Yan Lennon Chan, Yueming Jin

entry.summary: UniSurgSAM is a unified promptable model for surgical video segmentation supporting multiple prompt modalities (visual, text, audio), with mechanisms to handle absent targets and mask drift recovery.

entry.title: Stratifying Reinforcement Learning with Signal Temporal Logic

author.name: Justin Curry, Alberto Speranzon

entry.summary: Develops stratification-based semantics for Signal Temporal Logic (STL) where STL formulas induce stratifications of space-time, connecting stratification theory to deep RL by analyzing embedding space geometry relative to the decision space.

entry.title: VIGIL: An Extensible System for Real-Time Detection and Mitigation of Cognitive Bias Triggers

author.name: Bo Kang, Sander Noels, Tijl De Bie

entry.summary: Presents VIGIL, a system for real-time detection and mitigation of cognitive bias triggers in online information, addressing manipulation through exploitation of human cognitive biases rather than just factual misinformation.

entry.title: DARE: Diffusion Large Language Models Alignment and Reinforcement Executor

author.name: Jingyi Yang, Yuxian Jiang, Xuhao Hu, Shuang Cheng, Biqing Qi, Jing Shao

entry.summary: Presents DARE, an open framework unifying post-training pipelines (RL objectives, rollout implementations, evaluation) for diffusion large language models, addressing fragmentation in the dLLM ecosystem.

entry.title: From Plausible to Causal: Counterfactual Semantics for Policy Evaluation in Simulated Online Communities

author.name: Agam Goyal, Yian Wang, Eshwar Chandrasekharan, Hari Sundaram

entry.summary: Proposes a causal counterfactual framework for evaluating governance interventions in LLM-simulated online communities, distinguishing necessary causation (diagnosis) from sufficient causation (design) to move beyond mere believability.

entry.title: Beyond the Final Actor: Modeling the Dual Roles of Creator and Editor for Fine-Grained LLM-Generated Text Detection

author.name: Yang Li, Qiang Sheng, Zhengjia Wang, Yehan Yang, Danding Wang, Juan Cao

entry.summary: Proposes RACE for fine-grained four-class LLM-generated text detection (human-written, LLM-generated, LLM-polished human, humanized LLM), using Rhetorical Structure Theory to characterize creator vs editor signatures.

entry.title: Toward Full Autonomous Laboratory Instrumentation Control with Large Language Models

author.name: Yong Xie, Kexin He, Andres Castellanos-Gomez

entry.summary: Demonstrates using ChatGPT and LLM-based agents to control complex laboratory instruments, reducing the programming barrier for researchers. Case study involves a single-pixel camera/scanning photocurrent microscope setup.

entry.title: Contextual Control without Memory Growth in a Context-Switching Task

author.name: Song-Ju Kim

entry.summary: Introduces an intervention-based recurrent architecture for context-dependent decision-making that adds contextual control through additive operators on shared latent states, without growing memory dimensions.

entry.title: When Adaptive Rewards Hurt: Causal Probing and the Switching-Stability Dilemma in LLM-Guided LEO Satellite Scheduling

author.name: Yuanhang Li

entry.summary: Uncovers a switching-stability dilemma in adaptive reward design for satellite scheduling: near-constant reward weights dramatically outperform dynamic weights because PPO needs quasi-stationary reward signals for value function convergence.

entry.title: Structured Multi-Criteria Evaluation of Large Language Models with Fuzzy Analytic Hierarchy Process and DualJudge

author.name: Yulong He, Ivan Smirnov, Dmitry Fedrushkov, Sergey Kovalchuk, Ilya Revin

entry.summary: Adapts Analytic Hierarchy Process (AHP) to LLM evaluation and proposes a Fuzzy AHP extension that models epistemic uncertainty via triangular fuzzy numbers. Shows structured evaluation outperforms direct scoring across model scales.

entry.title: Profile-Then-Reason: Bounded Semantic Complexity for Tool-Augmented Language Agents

author.name: Paulo Akira F. Enabe

entry.summary: Introduces Profile-Then-Reason (PTR), a bounded execution framework where an LLM first synthesizes a workflow, deterministic operators execute it, a verifier checks the trace, and repair is invoked only when needed.

entry.title: Schema-Aware Planning and Hybrid Knowledge Toolset for Reliable Knowledge Graph Triple Verification

author.name: Xinyan Ma (Harbin Institute of Technology, Harbin, China), Xianhao Ou (Harbin Institute of Technology, Harbin, China), Weihao Zhang (Harbin Institute of Technology, Harbin, China), Shixin Jiang (Harbin Institute of Technology, Harbin, China), Runxuan Liu (Harbin Institute of Technology, Harbin, China), Dandan Tu (Huawei Technologies Co., Ltd., Beijing, China), Lei Chen (Bay Area International Business School, Beijing Normal University, Beijing, China), Ming Liu (Harbin Institute of Technology, Harbin, China), Bing Qin (Harbin Institute of Technology, Harbin, China)

entry.summary: Proposes SHARP, a training-free autonomous agent for KG triple verification that combines schema-aware planning with hybrid knowledge tools for dynamic investigation of facts.

entry.title: MC-CPO: Mastery-Conditioned Constrained Policy Optimization

author.name: Oluseyi Olukola, Nick Rahimi

entry.summary: Formalizes mastery-conditioned constrained policy optimization for AI tutoring, integrating structural action masking with constrained policy optimization. Establishes feasibility preservation and convergence guarantees.

entry.title: Soft Tournament Equilibrium

author.name: Saad Alqithami

entry.summary: Introduces Soft Tournament Equilibrium (STE), a differentiable framework for computing set-valued tournament solutions from pairwise comparison data, addressing non-transitive interactions in AI agent evaluation.

entry.title: Learning, Potential, and Retention: An Approach for Evaluating Adaptive AI-Enabled Medical Devices

author.name: Alexis Burgon, Berkman Sahiner, Nicholas A Petrick, Gene Pennello, Ravi K Samala

entry.summary: Introduces a novel evaluation approach for adaptive AI medical devices using three complementary measurements (learning, potential, retention) to disentangle performance changes from model adaptations versus dynamic environments.

entry.title: From Concept to Practice: an Automated LLM-aided UVM Machine for RTL Verification

author.name: Junhao Ye, Yuchen Hu, Ke Xu, Dingrong Pan, Qichun Chen, Jie Zhou, Shuai Zhao, Xinwei Fang, Xi Wang, Nan Guan, Zhe Jiang

entry.summary: Presents UVM², an automated verification framework using LLMs to generate UVM testbenches for hardware RTL verification and iteratively refine them using coverage feedback, addressing a major bottleneck in IC development.

entry.title: 3D-IDE: 3D Implicit Depth Emergent

author.name: Chushan Zhang, Ruihan Lu, Jinguang Tong, Yikai Wang, Hongdong Li

entry.summary: Proposes 3D-IDE, which reframes 3D perception in MLLMs as an emergent property from geometric self-supervision rather than explicit encoding, using implicit depth emergence for indoor scene understanding.

entry.title: Banana100: Breaking NR-IQA Metrics by 100 Iterative Image Replications with Nano Banana Pro

author.name: Kenan Tang, Praveen Arunshankar, Andong Hua, Anthony Yang, Yao Qin

entry.summary: Identifies iterative degradation in multi-turn image editing by AI systems, introducing Banana100 dataset of 28,000 degraded images across 100 editing steps, showing that NR-IQA metrics fail to capture this degradation.

entry.title: Generative AI for material design: A mechanics perspective from burgers to matter

author.name: Vahidullah Tac, Ellen Kuhl

entry.summary: Shows that diffusion-based generative AI and computational mechanics are rooted in the same principles, using a three-ingredient burger as a minimal benchmark to demonstrate forward/reverse diffusion analytical solutions for material design.

entry.title: AEGIS: Scaling Long-Sequence Homomorphic Encrypted Transformer Inference via Hybrid Parallelism on Multi-GPU Systems

author.name: Zhaoting Gong, Ran Ran, Fan Yao, Wujie Wen

entry.summary: Presents AEGIS, a hybrid parallelism system for scaling long-sequence encrypted Transformer inference across multiple GPUs, addressing memory and communication bottlenecks in fully homomorphic encryption.

entry.title: CountsDiff: A Diffusion Model on the Natural Numbers for Generation and Imputation of Count-Based Data

author.name: Renzo G. Soatto, Anders Hoel, Greycen Ren, Shorna Alam, Stephen Bates, Nikolaos P. Daskalakis, Caroline Uhler, Maria Skoularidou

entry.summary: CountsDiff is a diffusion framework designed for distributions on natural numbers, extending Blackout diffusion with simplified parameterization and modern diffusion features for count-based data.

entry.title: k-Maximum Inner Product Attention for Graph Transformers and the Expressive Power of GraphGPS The Expressive Power of GraphGPS

author.name: Jonas De Schouwer, Haitz S\'aez de Oc\'ariz Borde, Xiaowen Dong

entry.summary: Introduces k-Maximum Inner Product attention for graph transformers that selects top-k most relevant keys per query, balancing efficiency and expressiveness. Analyzes expressive power of GraphGPS.

entry.title: Fine-grained Analysis of Stability and Generalization for Stochastic Bilevel Optimization

author.name: Xuelin Zhang, Hong Chen, Bin Gu, Tieliang Gong, Feng Zheng

entry.summary: Provides systematic generalization analysis of first-order gradient-based bilevel optimization methods through the lens of algorithmic stability, establishing quantitative connections between stability and generalization.

entry.title: Learning from Imperfect Demonstrations via Temporal Behavior Tree-Guided Trajectory Repair

author.name: Aniruddh G. Puranic, Sebastian Schirmer, John S. Baras, Calin Belta

entry.summary: Presents a framework using Temporal Behavior Trees to repair suboptimal robot demonstrations before using them for policy learning, ensuring logical consistency while being interpretable.

entry.title: Agentization of Digital Assets for the Agentic Web: Concepts, Techniques, and Benchmark

author.name: Linyao Chen, Bo Huang, Qinlao Zhao, Shuai Shao, Zhi Han, Zicai Cui, Ziheng Zhang, Guangtao Zeng, Wenzheng Tang, Yikun Wang, Yuanjian Zhou, Zimian Peng, Yong Yu, Weiwen Liu, Hiroki Kobayashi, Weinan Zhang

entry.summary: Formalizes the 'agentization' of digital assets for the Agentic Web using the A2A protocol, developing an automated framework to convert web elements into autonomous agents.

entry.title: HighFM: Towards a Foundation Model for Learning Representations from High-Frequency Earth Observation Data

author.name: Stella Girtsou, Konstantinos Alexis, Giorgos Giannopoulos, Harris Kontoes

entry.summary: Presents HighFM, a foundation model for high-temporal-resolution multispectral Earth observation data, trained on 2+ TB of data for time-critical applications like wildfire and flood monitoring.

entry.title: GA-GS: Generation-Assisted Gaussian Splatting for Static Scene Reconstruction

author.name: Yedong Shen, Shiqi Zhang, Sha Zhang, Yifan Duan, Xinran Zhang, Wenhao Yu, Lu Zhang, Jiajun Deng, Yanyong Zhang

entry.summary: Proposes GA-GS, using diffusion model inpainting to reconstruct regions occluded by dynamic objects in monocular video for static 3D scene reconstruction via Gaussian splatting.

entry.title: Is Prompt Selection Necessary for Task-Free Online Continual Learning?

author.name: Seoyoung Park, Haemin Lee, Hankook Lee

entry.summary: Shows that in task-free online continual learning, simple single-prompt approaches outperform complex prompt selection strategies, which often fail to select appropriate prompts.

entry.title: A Clinical Point Cloud Paradigm for In-Hospital Mortality Prediction from Multi-Level Incomplete Multimodal EHRs

author.name: Bohao Li, Tao Zou, Junchen Ye, Yan Gong, Bowen Du

entry.summary: Proposes a clinical point cloud paradigm for modeling multi-level incomplete EHR data (irregular sampling, missing modalities, sparse labels) for in-hospital mortality prediction.

entry.title: LiveFact: A Dynamic, Time-Aware Benchmark for LLM-Driven Fake News Detection

author.name: Cheng Xu, Changhong Jin, Yingjie Niu, Nan Yan, Yuke Mei, Shuhao Guan, Liming Chen, M-Tahar Kechadi

entry.summary: Introduces LiveFact, a continuously updated benchmark for LLM-based fake news detection that simulates temporal uncertainty with evolving evidence sets, addressing benchmark contamination and temporal reasoning challenges.

entry.title: Improving Feasibility via Fast Autoencoder-Based Projections

author.name: Maria Chzhen, Priya L. Donti
