entry.summary: Proposes using trained autoencoders as approximate projectors for enforcing complex nonconvex constraints in learning and control, learning a convex latent representation of the feasible set.

entry.title: Simple yet Effective: Low-Rank Spatial Attention for Neural Operators

author.name: Zherui Yang, Haiyang Xin, Tao Du, Ligang Liu

entry.summary: Introduces Low-Rank Spatial Attention for neural operators, unifying existing global mixing modules under a low-rank template and proposing a simple attention variant that achieves competitive performance.

entry.title: Algebraic Diversity: Group-Theoretic Spectral Estimation from Single Observations

author.name: Mitchell A. Thornton

entry.summary: Proves that group action on a single observation can replace temporal averaging for second-order statistical estimation, with the symmetric group shown to be universally optimal, unifying DFT, DCT, and KLT.

entry.title: Generative models for decision-making under distributional shift

author.name: Xiuyuan Cheng, Yunqin Zhu, Yao Xie

entry.summary: A tutorial paper presenting modern generative models (flow- and score-based methods) as tools for constructing decision-relevant distributions under distributional shift, unified through pushforward maps, continuity equations, and Fokker-Planck dynamics for operations research.

entry.title: Deep Kuratowski Embedding Neural Networks for Wasserstein Metric Learning

author.name: Andrew Qing He

entry.summary: Proposes two neural architectures (DeepKENN and ODE-KENN) inspired by the Kuratowski embedding theorem for approximating Wasserstein-2 distances. ODE-KENN uses Neural ODEs for implicit regularization and achieves 28% lower test MSE than baselines on MNIST.

entry.title: Anticipatory Reinforcement Learning: From Generative Path-Laws to Distributional Value Functions

author.name: Daniel Bloch

entry.summary: Introduces Anticipatory Reinforcement Learning (ARL) that lifts the state space into a signature-augmented manifold for non-Markovian decision processes, using self-consistent field approaches to maintain anticipated future path-laws for distributional value functions.

entry.title: Computer Architecture's AlphaZero Moment: Automated Discovery in an Encircled World

author.name: Karthikeyan Sankaralingam

entry.summary: Argues that AI-driven automated architecture design (an 'AlphaZero moment') is needed for computer architecture now that Moore's Law has ended, proposing that the vast design space requires AI exploration rather than human-driven design.

entry.title: Nearly Optimal Best Arm Identification for Semiparametric Bandits

author.name: Seok-Jin Kim

entry.summary: Studies fixed-confidence Best Arm Identification in semiparametric bandits, establishing an instance-dependent lower bound and proposing an efficient phase-elimination algorithm with nearly optimal sample complexity.

entry.title: Primal-Dual Methods for Nonsmooth Nonconvex Optimization with Orthogonality Constraints

author.name: Linglingzhi Zhu, Wentao Ding, Shangyuan Liu, Anthony Man-Cho So

entry.summary: Proposes a retraction-free primal-dual approach for nonsmooth nonconvex optimization with orthogonality constraints on the Stiefel manifold, addressing scalability and numerical feasibility issues of Riemannian methods.

entry.title: A Patch-based Cross-view Regularized Framework for Backdoor Defense in Multimodal Large Language Models

author.name: Tianmeng Fang, Yong Wang, Zetai Kong, Zengzhen Su, Jun Wang, Chengjin Yu, Wei Wang

entry.summary: Proposes a patch-based cross-view regularization framework for defending multimodal LLMs against backdoor attacks during supervised fine-tuning. Addresses the tension between suppressing attacks and preserving benign model performance.

entry.title: GeoBrowse: A Geolocation Benchmark for Agentic Tool Use with Expert-Annotated Reasoning Traces

author.name: Xinyu Geng, Yanjing Xiao, Yuyang Zhang, Hanwen Wang, Xinyan Liu, Rui Min, Tianqing Fang, Yi R. Fung

entry.summary: Introduces GeoBrowse, a geolocation benchmark combining visual reasoning with knowledge-intensive multi-hop queries across two difficulty levels, requiring agents to compose fragmented visual cues and verify with web evidence.

entry.title: ViBA: Implicit Bundle Adjustment with Geometric and Temporal Consistency for Robust Visual Matching

author.name: Xiaoji Niu, Yuqing Wang, Yan Wang, Hailiang Tang, Tisheng Zhang

entry.summary: Proposes ViBA, a learning framework integrating geometric optimization with feature learning for visual odometry through differentiable bundle adjustment. Enables continuous online training on unconstrained video streams without requiring accurate pose/depth annotations. Combines initial tracking, depth-based filtering, and differentiable global bundle adjustment.

entry.title: HEDGE: Heterogeneous Ensemble for Detection of AI-GEnerated Images in the Wild

author.name: Fei Wu, Dagong Lu, Mufeng Yao, Xinlei Xu, Fengjun Guo

entry.summary: Proposes HEDGE, a heterogeneous ensemble for detecting AI-generated images combining diverse training data, multi-scale features, and backbone heterogeneity. Uses DINOv3-based detectors with staged data expansion. Addresses the challenge of robust AI-generated image detection in the wild.

entry.title: LOGER: Local--Global Ensemble for Robust Deepfake Detection in the Wild

author.name: Fei Wu, Dagong Lu, Mufeng Yao, Xinlei Xu, Fengjun Guo

entry.summary: Proposes LOGER, a local-global ensemble framework for deepfake detection combining heterogeneous vision foundation model backbones at multiple resolutions with local forgery trace analysis. Addresses the challenge that no single backbone covers both global anomalies and local traces. Companion paper to HEDGE.

entry.title: VidNum-1.4K: A Comprehensive Benchmark for Video-based Numerical Reasoning

author.name: Shaoyang Cui, Lingbei Meng

entry.summary: Introduces VidNum-1.4K, a benchmark for video-based numerical reasoning with 1,379 human-annotated video-question pairs testing multi-step numerical logic beyond simple counting. Evaluates VLMs' ability to understand temporal events, object permanence, and compositional logic. Addresses limitations of existing video QA benchmarks.

entry.title: Rethinking Position Embedding as a Context Controller for Multi-Reference and Multi-Shot Video Generation

author.name: Binyuan Huang, Yuning Lu, Weinan Jia, Hualiang Wang, Mu Liu, Daiqing Yang

entry.summary: Introduces PoCo (Position Embedding as a Context Controller) for multi-reference multi-shot video generation, addressing reference confusion when characters have similar appearances. Uses position encoding for context control beyond semantic retrieval. Tackles an underexplored academic problem inspired by proprietary models like Sora2.

entry.title: Training a Student Expert via Semi-Supervised Foundation Model Distillation

author.name: Pardis Taghavi, Tian Liu, Renjie Li, Reza Langari, Zhengzhong Tu

entry.summary: Introduces a semi-supervised knowledge distillation framework compressing vision foundation models into compact experts using limited labeled data. Three-stage process: domain adaptation via self-training, multi-objective knowledge transfer, and student refinement. Instance-aware pipeline for segmentation.

entry.title: LAA-X: Unified Localized Artifact Attention for Quality-Agnostic and Generalizable Face Forgery Detection

author.name: Dat Nguyen, Enjie Ghorbel, Anis Kacem, Marcella Astrid, Djamila Aouada

entry.summary: LAA-X proposes a deepfake detection framework using explicit localized artifact attention with multi-task learning and blending-based data synthesis. Works with both CNN and transformer backbones and aims to generalize to unseen manipulation types.

entry.title: MVis-Fold: A Three-Dimensional Microvascular Structure Inference Model for Super-Resolution Ultrasound

author.name: Jincao Yao (Department of Diagnostic Ultrasound Imaging & Interventional Therapy, Zhejiang Cancer Hospital, Hangzhou Institute of Medicine, Chinese Academy of Sciences, Hangzhou, China), Ke Zhang (Department of Diagnostic Ultrasound Imaging & Interventional Therapy, Zhejiang Cancer Hospital, Hangzhou Institute of Medicine, Chinese Academy of Sciences, Hangzhou, China), Yahan Zhou (Department of Diagnostic Ultrasound Imaging & Interventional Therapy, Zhejiang Cancer Hospital, Hangzhou Institute of Medicine, Chinese Academy of Sciences, Hangzhou, China), Jiafei Shen (Department of Diagnostic Ultrasound Imaging & Interventional Therapy, Zhejiang Cancer Hospital, Hangzhou Institute of Medicine, Chinese Academy of Sciences, Hangzhou, China), Jie Liu (Department of Diagnostic Ultrasound Imaging & Interventional Therapy, Zhejiang Cancer Hospital, Hangzhou Institute of Medicine, Chinese Academy of Sciences, Hangzhou, China), Mudassar Ali (College of Information Science and Electronic Engineering, Zhejiang University, Hangzhou, China), Bojian Feng (Department of Diagnostic Ultrasound Imaging & Interventional Therapy, Zhejiang Cancer Hospital, Hangzhou Institute of Medicine, Chinese Academy of Sciences, Hangzhou, China), Jiye Chen (Department of Diagnostic Ultrasound Imaging & Interventional Therapy, Zhejiang Cancer Hospital, Hangzhou Institute of Medicine, Chinese Academy of Sciences, Hangzhou, China), Jinlong Fan (Research Center of Interventional Medicine and Engineering, Hangzhou Institute of Medicine, Chinese Academy of Sciences, Hangzhou, China), Ping Liang (Department of Ultrasound, Chinese PLA General Hospital, Chinese PLA Medical School, Beijing, China), Dong Xu (Department of Diagnostic Ultrasound Imaging & Interventional Therapy, Zhejiang Cancer Hospital, Hangzhou Institute of Medicine, Chinese Academy of Sciences, Hangzhou, China)

entry.summary: MVis-Fold reconstructs 3D microvascular structures from 2D super-resolution ultrasound images using a cross-scale network architecture, enabling measurement of 3D parameters that traditional 2D SRUS cannot provide.

entry.title: Training-Free Image Editing with Visual Context Integration and Concept Alignment

author.name: Rui Song, Guo-Hua Wang, Qing-Guo Chen, Weihua Luo, Tongda Xu, Zhening Liu, Yan Wang, Zehong Lin, Jun Zhang

entry.summary: VicoEdit is a training-free, inversion-free method for image editing that injects visual context into pretrained text-prompted editing models, avoiding the consistency issues of diffusion inversion approaches.

entry.title: Relational Epipolar Graphs for Robust Relative Camera Pose Estimation

author.name: Prateeth Rao, Sachit Rao

entry.summary: Reformulates relative camera pose estimation as relational inference over epipolar correspondence graphs, using graph operations (pruning, message passing, pooling) to estimate rotation, translation, and Essential Matrix.

entry.title: Firebolt-VL: Efficient Vision-Language Understanding with Cross-Modality Modulation

author.name: Quoc-Huy Trinh, Mustapha Abdullahi, Bo Zhao, Debesh Jha

entry.summary: Firebolt-VL is an efficient vision-language model that replaces Transformer cross-attention with a more efficient cross-modality modulation mechanism, targeting deployment in resource-constrained scenarios.

entry.title: Synthesis4AD: Synthetic Anomalies are All You Need for 3D Anomaly Detection

author.name: Yihan Sun, Yuqi Cheng, Junjie Zu, Yuxiang Tan, Guoyang Xie, Yucheng Wang, Yunkang Cao, Weiming Shen

entry.summary: Synthesis4AD proposes end-to-end synthetic anomaly generation for 3D industrial anomaly detection using 3D-DefectStudio, which injects geometrically realistic defects guided by higher-dimensional support primitives with MLLM-guided generation.

entry.title: HorizonWeaver: Generalizable Multi-Level Semantic Editing for Driving Scenes

author.name: Mauricio Soroco, Francesco Pittaluga, Zaid Tasneem, Abhishek Aich, Bingbing Zhuang, Wuyang Chen, Manmohan Chandraker, Ziyu Jiang

entry.summary: HorizonWeaver enables multi-level semantic editing for driving scenes, handling object-level and scene-level edits with domain shift robustness for safety testing of autonomous driving systems.

entry.title: Human-Robot Copilot for Data-Efficient Imitation Learning

author.name: Rui Yan, Zaitian Gongye, Lars Paulsen, Xuxin Cheng, Xiaolong Wang

entry.summary: Proposes a Human-Robot Copilot framework for data-efficient imitation learning that addresses out-of-distribution states from limited demonstrations. Improves on HG-DAgger approaches by better balancing dexterity and generality in human intervention during policy execution.

entry.title: Robust Regression with Adaptive Contamination in Response: Optimal Rates and Computational Barriers

author.name: Ilias Diakonikolas, Chao Gao, Daniel M. Kane, Ankit Pensia, Dong Xie

entry.summary: Studies robust regression where covariates are clean but responses may be adaptively corrupted. Shows that clean covariates enable strictly better estimation rates than Huber contamination, including consistency even with constant contamination proportion.

entry.title: [OpenAI] Industrial policy for the Intelligence Age

author.name: Matrice Jacobine

entry.summary: Summary of OpenAI's new industrial policy document for the 'Intelligence Age,' proposing people-first policies to expand opportunity and share prosperity from AI. Announces fellowships, grants, and a DC workshop.

entry.title: Multimodal Structure Learning: Disentangling Shared and Specific Topology via Cross-Modal Graphical Lasso

author.name: Fei Wang, Yutong Zhang, Xiong Wang

entry.summary: Proposes Cross-Modal Graphical Lasso (CM-GLasso) for learning shared and modality-specific graph structures from multimodal (vision-language) data, using cross-attention distillation and aligned feature spaces.

entry.title: Cultural Authenticity: Comparing LLM Cultural Representations to Native Human Expectations

author.name: Erin MacMurray van Liemt, Aida Davani, Sinchana Kumbale, Neha Dixit, Sunipa Dev

entry.summary: Introduces Cultural Importance Vectors derived from human surveys across nine countries to evaluate whether LLM cultural representations align with how native populations perceive their own cultural facets, going beyond diversity and factual accuracy.

entry.title: Position: Logical Soundness is not a Reliable Criterion for Neurosymbolic Fact-Checking with LLMs

author.name: Jason Chan, Robert Gaizauskas, Zhixue Zhao

entry.summary: Argues that logical soundness is not reliable for neurosymbolic fact-checking because of systematic divergences between logically valid conclusions and inferences humans typically make, drawing on cognitive science and pragmatics.

entry.title: RK-MPC: Residual Koopman Model Predictive Control for Quadruped Locomotion in Offroad Environments

author.name: Sriram S. K. S. Narayanan, Umesh Vaidya

entry.summary: RK-MPC augments a nominal template model with a linear residual predictor learned in Koopman-lifted coordinates for quadruped locomotion. Achieves 500Hz onboard control while systematically correcting model mismatch from contact variability and terrain disturbances.

entry.title: Interpretation of Crystal Energy Landscapes with Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks

author.name: Gen Zu, Ning Mao, Claudia Felser, Yang Zhang

entry.summary: Applies Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks (KANs) with learnable activation functions to crystal energy landscape prediction, achieving state-of-the-art accuracy for formation energy, band gap, and work function while providing interpretable physical relationships.

entry.title: IDIOLEX: Unified and Continuous Representations for Idiolectal and Stylistic Variation

author.name: Anjali Kantharuban, Aarohi Srivastava, Fahim Faisal, Orevaoghene Ahia, Antonios Anastasopoulos, David Chiang, Yulia Tsvetkov, Graham Neubig

entry.summary: Introduces IDIOLEX, a framework for learning sentence representations that capture style and dialect decoupled from semantic content, combining provenance supervision with linguistic features and evaluating on Arabic and Spanish dialects.

entry.title: Automated Analysis of Global AI Safety Initiatives: A Taxonomy-Driven LLM Approach

author.name: Takayuki Semitsu, Naoto Kiribuchi, Kengo Zenitani

entry.summary: Presents an automated framework for comparing AI safety policy documents using LLMs and a shared taxonomy. Finds model choice substantially affects crosswalk outcomes across five LLMs and ten policy documents.

entry.title: Towards the AI Historian: Agentic Information Extraction from Primary Sources

author.name: Lorenz Hufe, Niclas Griesshaber, Gavin Greif, Sebastian Oliver Eck, Philip Torr

entry.summary: Introduces the first module of Chronos, an AI Historian system that enables historians to convert image scans of primary sources into structured data through natural-language interactions with a VLM-powered agent.

entry.title: PolySwarm: A Multi-Agent Large Language Model Framework for Prediction Market Trading and Latency Arbitrage

author.name: Rajat M. Barot, Arjun S. Borkhatariya

entry.summary: Presents PolySwarm, a multi-agent LLM framework with 50 diverse personas for prediction market trading on Polymarket, using confidence-weighted Bayesian aggregation and information-theoretic analysis of market inefficiencies.

entry.title: Compliance-by-Construction Argument Graphs: Using Generative AI to Produce Evidence-Linked Formal Arguments for Certification-Grade Accountability

author.name: Mahyar T. Moghaddam

entry.summary: Proposes using generative AI to produce compliance-by-construction argument graphs with formal evidence linking for certification-grade accountability in safety-critical decision systems.

entry.title: CoALFake: Collaborative Active Learning with Human-LLM Co-Annotation for Cross-Domain Fake News Detection

author.name: Esma A\"imeur, Gilles Brassard, Dorsaf Sallami

entry.summary: Proposes CoALFake for cross-domain fake news detection integrating Human-LLM co-annotation with domain-aware active learning to reduce labeling costs while maintaining detection quality.

entry.title: Thermodynamic-Inspired Explainable GeoAI: Uncovering Regime-Dependent Mechanisms in Heterogeneous Spatial Systems

author.name: Sooyoung Lim, Zhenlong Li, Zi-Kui Liu

entry.summary: Introduces a thermodynamics-inspired explainable geospatial AI framework integrating statistical mechanics with graph neural networks to model spatial heterogeneity and critical transitions.

entry.title: What Makes a Sale? Rethinking End-to-End Seller--Buyer Retail Dynamics with LLM Agents

author.name: Jeonghwan Choi, Jibin Hwang, Gyeonghun Sun, Minjeong Ban, Taewon Yun, Hyeonjae Cheon, Hwanjun Song

entry.summary: Introduces RetailSim, an end-to-end retail simulation framework using LLM agents to model the complete seller-buyer interaction pipeline from persuasion through purchase decisions. It evaluates behavioral fidelity through human evaluation and meta-evaluation protocols.

entry.title: IPSL-AID: Generative Diffusion Models for Climate Downscaling from Global to Regional Scales

author.name: Kishanthan Kingston, Olivier Boucher, Freddy Bouchet, Pierre Chapel, Rosemary Eade, Jean-Francois Lamarque, Redouane Lguensat, Kazem Ardaneh

entry.summary: Introduces IPSL-AID, a denoising diffusion probabilistic model for climate downscaling from global (~150km) to regional (0.25°) resolution, trained on ERA5 reanalysis data for temperature, wind, and precipitation.

entry.title: Safety-Aligned 3D Object Detection: Single-Vehicle, Cooperative, and End-to-End Perspectives

author.name: Brian Hsuan-Cheng Liao, Chih-Hong Cheng, Hasan Esen, Alois Knoll

entry.summary: Investigates safety-aligned 3D object detection for autonomous vehicles, proposing evaluation metrics and loss functions that explicitly distinguish safety-critical errors from benign ones across single-vehicle, cooperative, and end-to-end settings.

entry.title: Composer Vector: Style-steering Symbolic Music Generation in a Latent Space

author.name: Xunyi Jiang, Mingyang Yao, Jingyue Huang, Julian McAuley

entry.summary: Proposes Composer Vector, an inference-time steering method that operates in a model's latent space to control composer style in symbolic music generation without retraining, enabling smooth interpolation between styles.

entry.title: VisionClaw: Always-On AI Agents through Smart Glasses

author.name: Xiaoan Liu, DaeHo Lee, Eric J Gonzalez, Mar Gonzalez-Franco, Ryo Suzuki

entry.summary: VisionClaw is an always-on wearable AI agent running on Meta Ray-Ban smart glasses that combines egocentric perception with agentic task execution. Evaluated through both controlled (N=12) and longitudinal (N=5) user studies.

entry.title: Delayed Homomorphic Reinforcement Learning for Environments with Delayed Feedback

author.name: Jongsoo Lee, Jangwon Kim, Soohee Han

entry.summary: DHRL uses MDP homomorphisms to collapse belief-equivalent augmented states for reinforcement learning with delayed feedback, addressing the state-space explosion problem of canonical augmentation approaches.

entry.title: When Models Know More Than They Say: Probing Analogical Reasoning in LLMs

author.name: Hope McGovern, Caroline Craig, Thomas Lippincott, Hale Sirin

entry.summary: Compares probed representations vs prompted performance for analogical reasoning in LLMs, finding that probing outperforms prompting for rhetorical analogies but not narrative analogies.

entry.title: Extracting and Steering Emotion Representations in Small Language Models: A Methodological Comparison

author.name: Jihoon Jeong

entry.summary: First comparative analysis of emotion vector extraction methods for small language models (100M-10B), testing 9 models across 5 architectures using 20 emotions. Generation-based extraction significantly outperforms comprehension-based.

entry.title: LOCARD: An Agentic Framework for Blockchain Forensics

author.name: Xiaohang Yu, William Knottenbelt

entry.summary: Proposes LOCARD, the first agentic framework for blockchain forensics using a Tri-Core Cognitive Architecture that separates planning, execution, and validation with structured belief states.

entry.title: Hierarchical Semantic Correlation-Aware Masked Autoencoder for Unsupervised Audio-Visual Representation Learning

author.name: Donghuo Zeng, Hao Niu, Masato Taya

entry.summary: Proposes HSC-MAE, a hierarchical teacher-student framework for unsupervised audio-visual representation learning that enforces semantic consistency at global, local, and fine-grained levels.

entry.title: RAVEN: Radar Adaptive Vision Encoders for Efficient Chirp-wise Object Detection and Segmentation

author.name: Anuvab Sen, Mir Sayeed Mohammad, Saibal Mukhopadhyay

entry.summary: RAVEN processes raw FMCW radar data in a chirp-wise streaming manner with early-exit capability, achieving strong detection performance while reducing computation and latency for automotive radar.

entry.title: Reproducibility study on how to find Spurious Correlations, Shortcut Learning, Clever Hans or Group-Distributional non-robustness and how to fix them

author.name: Ole Delzer, Sidney Bender

entry.summary: Reproducibility study unifying terminologically fractured research on spurious correlations across DRO, IRM, shortcut learning, simplicity bias, and Clever Hans perspectives.

entry.title: Individual and Combined Effects of English as a Second Language and Typos on LLM Performance

author.name: Serena Liu, Yutong Yang, Prisha Sheth, Weixuan Dong, Mingjiao Diao, Xinru Zhu, Nikhil Banga, Oscar Melendez, Arnav Sharma, Minda Zhao, Marina Lin, Mengyu Wang

entry.summary: Studies combined effects of ESL variation and typos on LLM performance, finding that the combination causes larger performance drops than either factor alone.

entry.title: Neuromorphic Computing for Low-Power Artificial Intelligence

author.name: Keshava Katti, Pratik Chaudhari, Deep Jariwala

entry.summary: A survey on neuromorphic computing for energy-efficient AI, covering novel device modalities, compute-in-memory, and brain-inspired sparse communication. It argues that realizing neuromorphic potential requires co-design across devices, circuits, architectures, and algorithms.

entry.title: Noise Immunity in In-Context Tabular Learning: An Empirical Robustness Analysis of TabPFN's Attention Mechanisms

author.name: James Hu, Mahdi Ghelichi

entry.summary: Provides empirical evidence that TabPFN (a tabular foundation model) is robust to irrelevant predictors, correlated features, and label noise through analysis of its attention mechanisms.

entry.title: Investigating Data Interventions for Subgroup Fairness: An ICU Case Study

author.name: Erin Tan, Judy Hanwen Shen, Irene Y. Chen

entry.summary: Investigates limitations of combining data sources to improve subgroup fairness in healthcare ML, finding that distribution shifts from additional data can counteract benefits of increased sample size.

entry.title: Provable Multi-Task Reinforcement Learning: A Representation Learning Framework with Low Rank Rewards

author.name: Yaoze Guo, Shana Moothedath

entry.summary: Studies multi-task RL with shared representations under low-rank reward structure, providing sample complexity bounds for learning across T linear MDPs with shared dynamics but different rewards.

entry.title: ArrowFlow: Hierarchical Machine Learning in the Space of Permutations

author.name: Ozgur Yilmaz

entry.summary: ArrowFlow operates entirely in the space of permutations, using ranking filters and permutation-matrix accumulation. Connects to Arrow's impossibility theorem, using social-choice fairness axiom violations as inductive biases.

entry.title: Physical Sensitivity Kernels Can Emerge in Data-Driven Forward Models: Evidence From Surface-Wave Dispersion

author.name: Ziye Yu, Yuqi Cai, Xin Liu

entry.summary: Shows that neural network surrogates for surface-wave dispersion learn physically meaningful sensitivity kernels, with automatically differentiated gradients recovering the depth-dependent structure of theoretical kernels.

entry.title: Learning An Interpretable Risk Scoring System for Maximizing Decision Net Benefit

author.name: Wenhao Chi, \c{S}. \.Ilker Birbil

entry.summary: Proposes a risk scoring system that directly optimizes net benefit over decision thresholds via sparse integer linear programming, proving theoretical relationships between net benefit, discrimination, and calibration.

entry.title: DAGAF: A directed acyclic generative adversarial framework for joint structure learning and tabular data synthesis

author.name: Hristo Petkov, Calum MacLellan, Feng Dong

entry.summary: Proposes DAGAF, a dual-step framework that jointly performs causal structure learning and tabular data synthesis using DAGs under multiple causal model assumptions. Combines GANs with causal discovery for synthetic data generation.

entry.title: Forgetting to Witness: Efficient Federated Unlearning and Its Visible Evaluation

author.name: Houzhe Wang, Xiaojie Zhu, Chi Chen

entry.summary: Proposes a complete pipeline for federated unlearning including a knowledge distillation-based approach and a visualization framework (Skyeye) for evaluating forgetting capacity, without requiring stored historical data.

entry.title: R\'enyi Attention Entropy for Patch Pruning

author.name: Hiroaki Aizawa, Yuki Igaue

entry.summary: Introduces Rényi entropy-based attention criteria for patch pruning in Vision Transformers, keeping low-entropy (selectively attended) patches and removing high-entropy (diffusely attended) ones to reduce quadratic attention cost.

entry.title: Biconvex Biclustering

author.name: Sam Rosen, Eric C. Chi, Jason Xu

entry.summary: Proposes biconvex biclustering that jointly learns informative feature weights while discovering biclusters, with finite-sample bounds and an efficient proximal alternating minimization algorithm.

entry.title: Fused Multinomial Logistic Regression Utilizing Summary-Level External Machine-learning Information

author.name: Chi-Shian Dai, Jun Shao

entry.summary: Proposes an empirical likelihood framework for fusing multinomial logistic regression with summary-level predictions from external ML models, enabling improved statistical inference by leveraging black-box predictions as moment constraints.

entry.title: Jellyfish: Zero-Shot Federated Unlearning Scheme with Knowledge Disentanglement

author.name: Houzhe Wang, Xiaojie Zhu, Chi Chen

entry.summary: Proposes Jellyfish, a zero-shot federated unlearning scheme using synthetic error-minimization noise as proxy data and knowledge disentanglement to maintain model utility without storing historical data.

entry.title: TORA: Topological Representation Alignment for 3D Shape Assembly

author.name: Nahyuk Lee, Zhiang Chen, Marc Pollefeys, Sunghwan Hong

entry.summary: Introduces TORA, a topology-first representation alignment framework for 3D shape assembly that distills relational structure from a frozen pretrained 3D encoder into the flow-matching backbone using CKA loss.

entry.title: A Logical-Rule Autoencoder for Interpretable Recommendations

author.name: Jinhao Pan, Bowen Wei, Ziwei Zhu

entry.summary: Introduces a Logical-rule Interpretable Autoencoder (LIA) for collaborative filtering that uses learnable AND/OR gate neurons to discover interpretable logical patterns from data. Addresses the black-box nature of deep recommendation systems with an inherently interpretable architecture.

entry.title: Document-Level Numerical Reasoning across Single and Multiple Tables in Financial Reports

author.name: Yi-Cheng Wang, Wei-An Wang, Chu-Song Chen

entry.summary: Introduces FinLongDocQA, a dataset for single-table and cross-table financial numerical reasoning in long-context annual reports, evaluating LLMs and specialized financial models on document-level numerical QA.

entry.title: RUQuant: Towards Refining Uniform Quantization for Large Language Models

author.name: Han Liu, Haotian Gao, Changya Li, Feng Zhang, Xiaotong Zhang, Wei Wang, Hong Yu

entry.summary: Proposes RUQuant for LLM activation quantization, grounded in Lloyd-Max optimality conditions, identifying that non-uniform activation distributions within quantization intervals cause accuracy loss and proposing refined uniform quantization.

entry.title: Same Geometry, Opposite Noise: Transformer Magnitude Representations Lack Scalar Variability

author.name: Jon-Paul Cacioli

entry.summary: Finds that transformer language models exhibit the opposite of scalar variability - representational noise decreases rather than increases with numerical magnitude - unlike biological magnitude systems. Consistent across three 7-8B parameter models.

entry.title: Align then Train: Efficient Retrieval Adapter Learning

author.name: Seiji Maekawa, Moin Aminnaseri, Pouya Pezeshkpour, Estevam Hruschka

entry.summary: Proposes Efficient Retrieval Adapter (ERA), a lightweight adapter that addresses the query-document asymmetry in dense retrieval without fine-tuning large embedding models. Targets scenarios where queries are complex instructions but documents are simple and static. Aims to reduce computational cost of retrieval system adaptation.

entry.title: Diffusion Path Alignment for Long-Range Motion Generation and Domain Transitions

author.name: Haichao Wang, Alexander Okupnik, Yuxing Han, Gene Wen, Johannes Schneider, Kyriakos Flouris

entry.summary: Proposes a diffusion-based inference-time optimization framework for generating long-range motion transitions across semantically distinct domains. Uses stochastic optimal control to regularize transition trajectories of a pretrained diffusion model. Particularly relevant for applications like dance choreography.

entry.title: Love Me, Love My Label: Rethinking the Role of Labels in Prompt Retrieval for Visual In-Context Learning

author.name: Tianci Luo, Haohao Pan, Jinpeng Wang, Niu Lian, Xinrui Chen, Bin Chen, Shu-Tao Xia, Chun Yuan

entry.summary: Develops LaPR, a label-aware prompt retrieval framework for visual in-context learning that highlights the importance of label consistency between query and prompts. Reveals that existing methods sometimes retrieve visually similar but label-inconsistent prompts. Addresses an overlooked aspect of VICL prompt selection.

entry.title: SciLT: Long-Tailed Classification in Scientific Image Domains

author.name: Jiahao Chen, Bing Su

entry.summary: Investigates scientific long-tailed recognition under parameter-efficient fine-tuning paradigms, revealing that fine-tuning foundation models yields limited gains for scientific images. Introduces benchmarks showing penultimate-layer features play an important role. Highlights distribution gap between pre-training and scientific domains.

entry.title: XSeg: A Large-scale X-ray Contraband Segmentation Benchmark For Real-World Security Screening

author.name: Hongxia Gao, Litao Li, Yixin Chen, Jiali Wen, Kaijie Zhang, Qianyun Liu

entry.summary: Introduces XSeg, the largest X-ray contraband segmentation dataset with 98,644 images and 295,932 instance masks across 30 categories. Proposes Adaptive Point Selection method for efficient annotation. Addresses the limitation of bounding-box-only supervision in security screening.

entry.title: ITIScore: An Image-to-Text-to-Image Rating Framework for the Image Captioning Ability of MLLMs

author.name: Zitong Xu, Huiyu Duan, Shengyao Qin, Guangyu Yao, Guangji Ma, Xiongkuo Min, Ke Gu, Guangtao Zhai, Patrick Le Callet

entry.summary: Presents ITIScore and ICBench, a new framework and benchmark for evaluating MLLM image captioning through image-to-text-to-image rating. Includes 40K captions from 10 MLLMs with extensive human subjective studies. Addresses limitations of existing captioning benchmarks.

entry.title: SPARK-IL: Spectral Retrieval-Augmented RAG for Knowledge-driven Deepfake Detection via Incremental Learning

author.name: Hessen Bougueffa Eutamene, Abdellah Zakaria Sellam, Abdelmalik Taleb-Ahmed, Abdenour Hadid

entry.summary: Proposes SPARK-IL, a retrieval-augmented framework for deepfake detection combining dual-path spectral analysis with incremental learning using Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks. Uses frequency-domain signatures for cross-generator detection robustness. Addresses the challenge of generalizing to unseen generators.

entry.title: DINO-VO: Learning Where to Focus for Enhanced State Estimation

author.name: Qi Chen, Guanghao Li, Sijia Hu, Xin Gao, Junpeng Ma, Xiangyang Xue, Jian Pu

entry.summary: DINO-VO is an end-to-end monocular visual odometry system that uses DINO features with a differentiable adaptive patch selector and bundle adjustment with inverse depth priors. It improves generalization across diverse datasets compared to heuristic feature extraction methods.

entry.title: Spatially-Weighted CLIP for Street-View Geo-localization

author.name: Ting Han, Fengjiao Li, Chunsong Chen, Haoling Huang, Yiping Chen, Meiliu Wu

entry.summary: SW-CLIP incorporates spatial autocorrelation (Tobler's First Law of Geography) into CLIP-based geo-localization, using distance-aware soft labels and neighborhood-consistency regularization instead of treating all non-matching samples equally.

entry.title: Parameter-Efficient Semantic Augmentation for Enhancing Open-Vocabulary Object Detection

author.name: Weihao Cao, Runqi Wang, Xiaoyue Duan, Jinchao Zhang, Ang Yang, Liping Jing

entry.summary: HSA-DINO is a parameter-efficient framework for enhancing open-vocabulary object detection in domain-specific tasks, using multi-source semantic augmentation to address performance drops from domain shifts.

entry.title: PR-IQA: Partial-Reference Image Quality Assessment for Diffusion-Based Novel View Synthesis

author.name: Inseong Choi, Siwoo Lee, Seung-Hun Nam, Soohwan Song

entry.summary: PR-IQA evaluates diffusion-generated novel views using reference images from different poses, computing geometrically consistent quality maps without requiring ground truth, to improve 3D reconstruction supervision.

entry.title: 3D Gaussian Splatting for Annular Dark Field Scanning Transmission Electron Microscopy Tomography Reconstruction

author.name: Beiyuan Zhang, Hesong Li, Ruiwen Shao, Ying Fu

entry.summary: Adapts 3D Gaussian Splatting for ADF-STEM tomography reconstruction of nanoscale materials, enabling better 3D reconstruction from sparse tilt-series views while preserving dose-sensitive samples.

entry.title: PointTPA: Dynamic Network Parameter Adaptation for 3D Scene Understanding

author.name: Siyuan Liu, Chaoqun Zheng, Xin Zhou, Tianrui Feng, Dingkang Liang, Xiang Bai

entry.summary: PointTPA proposes test-time parameter adaptation for scene-level point cloud understanding, generating input-aware network parameters that adapt to scene-specific variations during inference.

entry.title: TM-BSN: Triangular-Masked Blind-Spot Network for Real-World Self-Supervised Image Denoising

author.name: Junyoung Park, Youngjin Oh, Nam Ik Cho

entry.summary: TM-BSN proposes a triangular-masked blind-spot network for self-supervised image denoising that accurately models spatial noise correlation in real sRGB images from ISP pipelines, avoiding the limitations of downsampling-based approaches.

entry.title: AnyUser: Translating Sketched User Intent into Domestic Robots

author.name: Songyuan Yang, Huibin Tan, Kailun Yang, Wenjing Yang, Shaowu Yang

entry.summary: AnyUser is a robotic instruction system that lets users draw free-form sketches on camera images (optionally with language) to command domestic robots, without requiring prior maps or models. It uses multimodal fusion and hierarchical policy to translate spatial-semantic primitives into executable actions, validated on real robots.

entry.title: Adapting Neural Robot Dynamics on the Fly for Predictive Control

author.name: Abdullah Altawaitan, Nikolay Atanasov

entry.summary: Proposes fast online adaptation of neural robot dynamics models by combining offline training with low-rank second-order parameter updates. Demonstrates robust predictive tracking control on a real quadrotor in novel conditions.

entry.title: frax: Fast Robot Kinematics and Dynamics in JAX

author.name: Daniel Morton, Marco Pavone

entry.summary: frax is a JAX-based library for robot kinematics and dynamics providing high-performance computation across CPU, GPU, and TPU. Supports automatic differentiation and parallelization for optimization-based robot control and learning.

entry.title: WaterSplat-SLAM: Photorealistic Monocular SLAM in Underwater Environment

author.name: Kangxu Wang, Shaofeng Zou, Chenxing Jiang, Yixiang Dai, Siang Chen, Shaojie Shen, Guijin Wang

entry.summary: WaterSplat-SLAM achieves photorealistic dense mapping underwater using Gaussian splatting with semantic medium filtering. Couples underwater-adapted camera tracking with an online medium-aware Gaussian map for compact, high-fidelity underwater scene reconstruction.

entry.title: Personality Requires Struggle: Three Regimes of the Baldwin Effect in Neuroevolved Chess Agents

author.name: Diego Armando Resendez Prado

entry.summary: Studies the Baldwin Effect in neuroevolved chess agents, finding that Hebbian plasticity initially compresses behavioral diversity but later expands it, with a variance crossover at generation 34. Identifies three regimes of evolution-learning interaction.

entry.title: Entropy and Attention Dynamics in Small Language Models: A Trace-Level Structural Analysis on the TruthfulQA Benchmark

author.name: Adeyemi Adeseye, Aisvarya Adeseye, Hannu Tenhunen, Jouni Isoaho

entry.summary: Conducts trace-level analysis of entropy and attention dynamics in small language models on TruthfulQA, examining how internal model behavior (entropy evolution, attention distribution) affects factual outputs.

entry.title: Solar-VLM: Multimodal Vision-Language Models for Augmented Solar Power Forecasting

author.name: Hang Fan, Haoran Pei, Runze Liang, Weican Liu, Long Cheng, Wei Wei

entry.summary: Proposes Solar-VLM, an LLM-driven framework for multimodal photovoltaic power forecasting that fuses time-series, satellite imagery, and textual weather information through modality-specific encoders.

entry.title: Beyond Fluency: Toward Reliable Trajectories in Agentic IR

author.name: Anushree Sinha, Srivaths Ranganathan, Debanshu Das, Abhishek Dharmaratnakar

entry.summary: Position paper arguing that agentic information retrieval needs trajectory integrity and causal attribution rather than just endpoint accuracy. Categorizes failure modes across planning, retrieval, reasoning, and execution.

entry.title: Preservation Is Not Enough for Width Growth: Regime-Sensitive Selection of Dense LM Warm Starts

author.name: Eren Unlu

entry.summary: Studies dense width growth for reusing smaller language model checkpoints, comparing various warm-start strategies. Finds that zero-step preservation alone doesn't predict training utility, and results are regime-sensitive.

entry.title: MemMachine: A Ground-Truth-Preserving Memory System for Personalized AI Agents

author.name: Shu Wang, Edwin Yu, Oscar Love, Tom Zhang, Tom Wong, Steve Scargall, Charles Fan

entry.summary: Presents MemMachine, an open-source memory system for LLM agents that integrates short-term, long-term episodic, and profile memory with a ground-truth-preserving architecture that stores entire conversational episodes to reduce lossy LLM-based extraction.

entry.title: FVRuleLearner: Operator-Level Reasoning Tree (OP-Tree)-Based Rules Learning for Formal Verification

author.name: Lily Jiaxin Wan, Chia-Tung Ho, Yunsheng Bai, Cunxi Yu, Deming Chen, Haoxing Ren

entry.summary: Introduces FVRuleLearner, an operator-level reasoning tree approach to learn rules for formal verification, specifically for translating natural language to SystemVerilog Assertions (SVA) using LLMs.

entry.title: TreeGaussian: Tree-Guided Cascaded Contrastive Learning for Hierarchical Consistent 3D Gaussian Scene Segmentation and Understanding

author.name: Jingbin You, Zehao Li, Hao Jiang, Xinzhu Ma, Shuqin Gao, Honglong Zhao, Congcong Zheng, Tianlu Mao, Feng Dai, Yucheng Zhang, Zhaoqi Wang

entry.summary: Introduces TreeGaussian, a tree-guided contrastive learning framework for hierarchical 3D scene segmentation using 3D Gaussian Splatting, explicitly modeling whole-part relationships through multi-level object trees.

entry.title: VitaTouch: Property-Aware Vision-Tactile-Language Model for Robotic Quality Inspection in Manufacturing

author.name: Junyi Zong, Qingxuan Jia, Meixian Shi, Tong Li, Jiayuan Li, Zihang Lv, Gang Chen, Fang Deng

entry.summary: Proposes VitaTouch, a vision-tactile-language model for manufacturing quality inspection that combines modality-specific encoders with dual Q-Former and contrastive learning, along with VitaSet (186 objects, 52k images).

entry.title: RDFace: A Benchmark Dataset for Rare Disease Facial Image Analysis under Extreme Data Scarcity and Phenotype-Aware Synthetic Generation

author.name: Ganlin Feng, Yuxi Long, Hafsa Ali, Erin Lou, Fahad Butt, Qian Liu, Yang Wang, Pingzhao Hu

entry.summary: RDFace introduces a benchmark dataset of 456 pediatric facial images across 103 rare genetic conditions for AI-assisted rare disease diagnosis. It addresses extreme data scarcity with phenotype-aware synthetic data generation.

entry.title: Uncertainty as a Planning Signal: Multi-Turn Decision Making for Goal-Oriented Conversation

author.name: Xinyi Ling, Ye Liu, Reza Averly, Xia Ning

entry.summary: Formulates goal-oriented conversation as uncertainty-aware sequential decision problem where uncertainty serves as a planning signal for balancing information acquisition and target commitment.

entry.title: PATHFINDER: Multi-objective discovery in structural and spectral spaces

author.name: Kamyar Barakati, Boris N. Slautin, Utkarsh Pratiush, Hiroshi Funakubo, Sergei V. Kalinin

entry.summary: PATHFINDER is a framework for autonomous microscopy combining novelty-driven exploration with multi-objective optimization across structural, spectral, and measurement spaces.

entry.title: A Persistent Homology Design Space for 3D Point Cloud Deep Learning

author.name: Prachi Kudeshia, Jiju Poovvancheri, Amr Ghoneim, Dong Chen

entry.summary: Introduces a unified design space for integrating persistent homology into deep learning for 3D point clouds, formalizing the interplay between complex construction, filtration, persistence representation, and neural backbone.

entry.title: MAVEN: A Mesh-Aware Volumetric Encoding Network for Simulating 3D Flexible Deformation

author.name: Zhe Feng, Shilong Tao, Haonan Sun, Shaohan Chen, Zhanxing Zhu, Yunhuai Liu

entry.summary: MAVEN introduces mesh-aware volumetric encoding for GNN-based simulation of 3D flexible deformation, capturing higher-dimensional spatial features (facets, cells) beyond just vertices and edges.

entry.title: ROSClaw: A Hierarchical Semantic-Physical Framework for Heterogeneous Multi-Agent Collaboration

author.name: Rongfeng Zhao, Xuanhao Zhang, Zhaochen Guo, Xiang Shao, Zhongpan Zhu, Bin He, Jie Chen

entry.summary: ROSClaw is a hierarchical framework for heterogeneous multi-robot collaboration combining LLM-based semantic reasoning with physical execution, built on ROS for practical deployment.

entry.title: Sampling Parallelism for Fast and Efficient Bayesian Learning

author.name: Asena Karolin \"Ozdemir, Lars H. Heyen, Arvid Weyrauch, Achim Streit, Markus G\"otz, Charlotte Debus

entry.summary: Introduces sampling parallelism for Bayesian neural networks, enabling parallel evaluation of multiple parameter samples to reduce the computational cost of uncertainty quantification in risk-sensitive domains.

entry.title: Analyzing Symbolic Properties for DRL Agents in Systems and Networking

author.name: Mohammad Zangooei, Jannis Weil, Amr Rizk, Mina Tahmasbi Arashloo, Raouf Boutaba

entry.summary: Studies symbolic properties for DRL agents in systems and networking, enabling verification of expected behavior over ranges of input states rather than just point properties, with applications to video streaming and congestion control.

entry.title: Hardware-Oriented Inference Complexity of Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks

author.name: Bilal Khalid, Pedro Freire, Sergei K. Turitsyn, Jaroslaw E. Prilepsky

entry.summary: Analyzes hardware-oriented inference complexity of Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks (KANs) for dedicated accelerators, going beyond FLOP counts to consider memory access patterns and hardware constraints.

entry.title: Collapse-Free Prototype Readout Layer for Transformer Encoders

author.name: Giansalvo Cirrincione, Rahul Ranjeev Kumar

entry.summary: DDCL-Attention replaces pooling in transformer encoders with a prototype-based readout layer that avoids collapse through exact loss decomposition into reconstruction and diversity terms.

entry.title: CPT: Controllable and Editable Design Variations with Language Models

author.name: Karthik Suresh, Amine Ben Khalifa, Li Zhang, Wei-ting Hsu, Fangzheng Wu, Vinay More, Asim Kadav

entry.summary: Presents CPT (Creative Pre-trained Transformer), a system for generating editable design variations using a decoder-only LM trained on a new Creative Markup Language (CML) representation that captures canvas structure, layout, and element-level details.

entry.title: ENEC: A Lossless AI Model Compression Method Enabling Fast Inference on Ascend NPUs

author.name: Jinwu Yang, Jiaan Wu, Zedong Liu, Xinyang Ma, Hairui Zhao, Yida Gu, Yuanhong Huang, Xingchen Liu, Wenjing Huang, Zheng Wei, Jing Xing, Yili Ma, Qingyi Zhang, Baoyi An, Zhongzhe Hu, Shaoteng Liu, Xia Zhu, Jiaxun Lu, Guangming Tan, Dingwen Tao

entry.summary: Proposes ENEC, a lossless compression method for LLM weights optimized for Huawei's Ascend NPUs, using block-based fixed-length encoding with NPU-specific optimizations achieving significant speedups.

entry.title: Recurrent Quantum Feature Maps for Reservoir Computing

author.name: Utkarsh Singh, Aaron Z. Goldberg, Christoph Simon, Khabat Heshami

entry.summary: Introduces a quantum reservoir computing approach using recurrent quantum feature maps where a fixed quantum circuit encodes both inputs and classical feedback from previous outputs. Outperforms echo state networks on Mackey-Glass prediction.

entry.title: SecureAFL: Secure Asynchronous Federated Learning

author.name: Anjun Gao, Feng Wang, Zhenglin Wan, Yueyang Quan, Zhuqing Liu, Minghong Fang

entry.summary: Proposes SecureAFL for defending asynchronous federated learning against poisoning attacks, addressing vulnerabilities of existing defenses that fail under asynchronous settings.

entry.title: Lotka-Sharpe Neural Operators for Control of Population PDEs

author.name: Miroslav Krstic, Iasson Karafyllis, Luke Bhan, Carina Veil

entry.summary: Proposes neural operator approximations for solving the Lotka-Sharpe condition in age-structured predator-prey PDE control, proving Lipschitz continuity of the operator and semi-global stability of the approximate feedback law.

entry.title: OASIC: Occlusion-Agnostic and Severity-Informed Classification

author.name: Kay Gijzen (Leiden University), Gertjan J. Burghouts (TNO), Dani\"el M. Pelt (Leiden University)

entry.summary: Proposes OASIC for occlusion-robust object classification by simultaneously addressing loss of visible information and distracting occluder patterns through anomaly-based masking and severity-informed training.

entry.title: Generative Modeling under Non-Monotonic MAR Missingness via Approximate Wasserstein Gradient Flows

author.name: Gitte Kremling, Jeffrey N\"af, Johannes Lederer

entry.summary: Proposes FLOWGEM, a principled iterative method using approximate Wasserstein gradient flows for generating complete datasets from data with non-monotonic Missing at Random patterns. Minimizes expected KL divergence between observed and generated distributions.

entry.title: LP-GEMM: Integrating Layout Propagation into GEMM Operations

author.name: C\'esar Guedes Carneiro, Lucas Alvarenga, Guido Araujo, Sandro Rigo

entry.summary: Introduces LP-GEMM, which propagates packing layouts across sequential GEMM operations to eliminate redundant data packing/unpacking in BLAS. Shows significant speedups for sequential matrix multiplication chains in ML workloads.

entry.title: Partially deterministic sampling for compressed sensing with denoising guarantees

author.name: Yaniv Plan, Matthew S. Scott, Ozgur Yilmaz

entry.summary: Derives an optimized compressed sensing sampling scheme that naturally combines random and deterministic row selection from unitary matrices, providing theoretical justification for the common practice of deterministically sampling critical rows.

entry.title: Are Arabic Benchmarks Reliable? QIMMA's Quality-First Approach to LLM Evaluation

author.name: Leen AlQadi, Ahmed Alzubaidi, Mohammed Alyafeai, Hamza Alobeidli, Maitha Alhammadi, Shaikha Alsuwaidi, Omar Alkaabi, Basma El Amel Boussaha, Hakim Hacid

entry.summary: Introduces QIMMA, a quality-assured Arabic LLM benchmark leaderboard that applies systematic validation pipeline to clean existing Arabic benchmarks before evaluation, producing a curated 52k-sample evaluation suite grounded in native Arabic content.

entry.title: Lighting Up or Dimming Down? Exploring Dark Patterns of LLMs in Co-Creativity

author.name: Zhu Li, Jiaming Qu, Yuan Chang

entry.summary: Explores five 'dark patterns' in LLM co-creativity (Sycophancy, Tone Policing, Moralizing, Loop of Death, Anchoring), finding Sycophancy nearly ubiquitous at 91.7% in controlled writing sessions.

entry.title: How Far Are We? Systematic Evaluation of LLMs vs. Human Experts in Mathematical Contest in Modeling

author.name: Yuhang Liu, Heyan Huang, Yizhe Yang, Hongyan Zhao, Zhizhuo Zeng, Yang Gao

entry.summary: Proposes a stage-wise evaluation framework for assessing LLM mathematical modeling abilities against expert criteria on Chinese math competition problems, revealing a notable performance gap versus human experts especially in model construction and validation stages.

entry.title: Precise Robot Command Understanding Using Grammar-Constrained Large Language Models

author.name: Xinyun Huo, Raghav Gnanasambandam, Xinyao Zhang

entry.summary: Introduces a grammar-constrained LLM for industrial robotics that combines conversational flexibility with deterministic command precision. Uses a two-stage process: fine-tuned LLM for contextual reasoning followed by a structured language interpreter for safe command execution. Addresses the gap between natural language understanding and safety-critical robot commands.

entry.title: HVG-3D: Bridging Real and Simulation Domains for 3D-Conditional Hand-Object Interaction Video Synthesis

author.name: Mingjin Chen, Junhao Chen, Zhaoxin Fan, Yujian Lee, Zichen Dang, Lili Wang, Yawen Cui, Lap-Pui Chau, Yi Wang

entry.summary: Proposes HVG-3D for 3D-aware hand-object interaction video synthesis using diffusion models with a 3D ControlNet. Bridges real and simulation domains with a two-component design for high-quality synthesis conditioned on explicit 3D representations. Addresses limitations of 2D control signals for spatial expressiveness.

entry.title: Mixture-of-Experts in Remote Sensing: A Survey

author.name: Yongchuan Cui, Peng Liu, Lajiao Chen

entry.summary: Provides the first systematic survey of Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) applications in remote sensing, covering fundamental principles, architectures, and key applications. Addresses the unique challenges of sensor modality diversity and spatiotemporal dynamics. Timely given the growing interest in MoE architectures.

entry.title: PortraitCraft: A Benchmark for Portrait Composition Understanding and Generation

author.name: Yuyang Sha, Zijie Lou, Youyun Tang, Xiaochao Qu, Haoxiang Li, Ting Liu, Luoqi Liu

entry.summary: Introduces PortraitCraft, a benchmark for portrait composition understanding and generation with ~50K curated images, 13 composition attributes, and structured multi-level supervision. Enables both composition analysis and controllable portrait generation. Fills a gap in systematic portrait composition research.

entry.title: Rethinking Exposure Correction for Spatially Non-uniform Degradation

author.name: Ao Li, Jiawei Sun, Le Dong, Zhenyu Wang, Weisheng Dong

entry.summary: Proposes a new exposure correction paradigm for spatially non-uniform degradation, introducing region-adaptive modulation and spatially-varying loss functions instead of the standard global correction approach.

entry.title: HandDreamer: Zero-Shot Text to 3D Hand Model Generation using Corrective Hand Shape Guidance

author.name: Green Rosh, Prateek Kukreja, Vishakha SR, Pawan Prasad B H

entry.summary: HandDreamer is the first method for zero-shot text-to-3D hand model generation, using corrective hand shape guidance with Score Distillation Sampling to address unnatural hand structures and view inconsistencies.

entry.title: Unified Vector Floorplan Generation via Markup Representation

author.name: Kaede Shiohara, Toshihiko Yamasaki

entry.summary: Introduces Floorplan Markup Language (FML) for unified vector floorplan generation, encoding floorplan information in a structured grammar that handles heterogeneous tasks like generation from boundaries, adjacency graphs, or partial layouts.

entry.title: Real-time Neural Six-way Lightmaps

author.name: Wei Li, Hanxiao Sun, Tao Huang, Haoxiang Wang, Tongtong Wang, Zherong Pan, Kui Wu

entry.summary: Proposes neural six-way lightmaps for real-time rendering of participating media (smoke), extending the game industry's six-way lightmap technique with neural networks for dynamic scenarios with camera movement.

entry.title: Activity-Dependent Plasticity in Morphogenetically-Grown Recurrent Networks

author.name: Sergii Medvid, Andrii Valenia, Mykola Glybovets

entry.summary: Studies Hebbian and anti-Hebbian plasticity across 50,000 morphogenetically grown recurrent controllers, finding that anti-Hebbian plasticity significantly outperforms Hebbian. Co-evolutionary experiments recover these patterns independently, suggesting fundamental advantages of anti-Hebbian learning.

entry.title: FORMULA: FORmation MPC with neUral barrier Learning for safety Assurance

author.name: Qintong Xie, Weishu Zhan, Peter Chin

entry.summary: FORMULA integrates MPC with Control Lyapunov Functions and neural network-based Control Barrier Functions for safe distributed multi-robot formation control. Eliminates manual CBF design while providing provable safety in cluttered environments.

entry.title: Biologically Inspired Event-Based Perception and Sample-Efficient Learning for High-Speed Table Tennis Robots

author.name: Ziqi Wang, Jingyue Zhao, Xun Xiao, Jichao Yang, Yaohua Wang, Shi Xu, Lei Wang, Huadong Dai

entry.summary: Uses event-based (neuromorphic) cameras and sample-efficient learning for high-speed table tennis robots. Addresses motion blur and latency issues of frame-based vision in real-world scenarios beyond simplified ball-only settings.

entry.title: Generative Unsupervised Downscaling of Climate Models via Domain Alignment: Application to Wind Fields

author.name: Julie Keisler (ARCHES), Boutheina Oueslati (EDF R\&D OSIRIS), Anastase Charantonis (ARCHES), Yannig Goude (EDF R\&D OSIRIS, LMO), Claire Monteleoni (ARCHES)

entry.summary: Applies generative machine learning for unsupervised downscaling of climate model wind fields, using domain alignment to correct biases without paired high/low-resolution data. Preserves spatial coherence and inter-variable consistency.

entry.title: A Black-Box Procedure for LLM Confidence in Critical Applications

author.name: Jadair

entry.summary: Proposes a black-box procedure for LLM confidence calibration using Google search result counts as a proxy for training data density, combined with repeated sampling to assess consistency. Tests across 320 queries on 3 LLM models.

entry.title: SAIL: Scene-aware Adaptive Iterative Learning for Long-Tail Trajectory Prediction in Autonomous Vehicles

author.name: Bin Rao, Haicheng Liao, Chengyue Wang, Keqiang Li, Zhenning Li, Hai Yang

entry.summary: Proposes SAIL, a framework for long-tail trajectory prediction in autonomous driving that defines and models trajectories across prediction error, collision risk, and state complexity dimensions, with adaptive iterative learning.

entry.title: Structured Causal Video Reasoning via Multi-Objective Alignment

author.name: Zinuo Li, Yongxin Guo, Jun Liu, Jiawei Zhan, Xi Jiang, Chengjie Wang, Mohammed Bennamoun, Farid Boussaid, Feng Zheng, Qiuhong Ke

entry.summary: Proposes Structured Event Facts as compact causal representations for video reasoning, constructed prior to the reasoning stage to serve as explicit constraints promoting concise and causally grounded inference in Video-LLMs.

entry.title: Resource-Conscious Modeling for Next- Day Discharge Prediction Using Clinical Notes

author.name: Ha Na Cho, Sairam Sutari, Alexander Lopez, Hansen Bow, Kai Zheng

entry.summary: Evaluates lightweight models for predicting next-day discharge in spine surgery using clinical notes. Finds TF-IDF with LGBM outperforms fine-tuned LLMs, achieving best balance of performance and resource efficiency.

entry.title: Single-agent vs. Multi-agents for Automated Video Analysis of On-Screen Collaborative Learning Behaviors

author.name: Likai Peng, Shihui Feng

entry.summary: Compares single- and multi-agent VLM configurations (Claude-3.7-Sonnet, GPT-4.1, Qwen2.5-VL-72B) for automated coding of screen recordings in collaborative learning contexts using the ICAP framework.

entry.title: LLM-Agent-based Social Simulation for Attitude Diffusion

author.name: Deepak John Reji

entry.summary: Introduces discourse_simulator, an open-source framework combining LLMs with agent-based modeling to simulate how public attitudes toward immigration change over time in response to events.

entry.title: Empirical Characterization of Rationale Stability Under Controlled Perturbations for Explainable Pattern Recognition

author.name: Abu Noman Md Sakib, Zhensen Wang, Merjulah Roby, Zijie Zhang

entry.summary: Proposes a metric for assessing consistency of model explanations under label-preserving perturbations, evaluating BERT, RoBERTa, and DistilBERT on sentiment analysis tasks.

entry.title: LPC-SM: Local Predictive Coding and Sparse Memory for Long-Context Language Modeling

author.name: Keqin Xie

entry.summary: Proposes LPC-SM, a hybrid architecture that separates local attention, persistent memory, predictive correction, and run-time control within blocks, using Orthogonal Novelty Transport for slow-memory writes. Evaluated at 158M parameters.

entry.title: Event-Driven Neuromorphic Vision Enables Energy-Efficient Visual Place Recognition

author.name: Geoffroy Keime, Nicolas Cuperlier, Benoit R. Cottereau

entry.summary: Introduces SpikeVPR, combining event-based cameras with spiking neural networks for visual place recognition, including a novel EventDilation augmentation strategy. Achieves robust recognition under extreme illumination and viewpoint changes.

entry.title: Generative Chemical Language Models for Energetic Materials Discovery

author.name: Andrew Salij, R. Seaton Ullberg, Megan C. Davis, Marc J. Cawkwell, Christopher J. Snyder, Cristina Garcia Cardona, Ivana Matanovic, Wilton J. M. Kort-Kamp

entry.summary: Develops generative molecular language models for energetic materials discovery, using transfer learning from general chemistry to data-sparse energetic materials with fragment-based molecular encodings.

entry.title: StoryBlender: Inter-Shot Consistent and Editable 3D Storyboard with Spatial-temporal Dynamics

author.name: Bingliang Li, Zhenhong Sun, Jiaming Bian, Yuehao Wu, Yifu Wang, Hongdong Li, Yatao Bian, Huadong Mo, Daoyi Dong

entry.summary: Presents StoryBlender, a 3D storyboard generation framework achieving inter-shot consistency and editability through a three-stage pipeline with story-centric reflection, addressing limitations of both 2D diffusion and traditional 3D workflows.

entry.title: Determined by User Needs: A Salient Object Detection Rationale Beyond Conventional Visual Stimuli

author.name: Chenglizhao Chen, Shujian Zhang, Luming Li, Wenfeng Song, Shuai Li

entry.summary: Proposes need-driven salient object detection where user needs (not just visual stimuli) determine what's salient. Introduces a new paradigm shifting from passive to proactive SOD.

entry.title: Gram-Anchored Prompt Learning for Vision-Language Models via Second-Order Statistics

author.name: Minglei Chen, Weilong Wang, Jiang Duan, Ye Deng

entry.summary: GAPL proposes Gram-anchored prompt learning for VLMs that combines first-order semantic alignment with second-order statistical (Gram matrix) structural consistency for robust adaptation.

entry.title: HOIGS: Human-Object Interaction Gaussian Splatting

author.name: Taewoo Kim, Suwoong Yeom, Jaehyun Pyun, Geonho Cha, Dongyoon Wee, Joonsik Nam, Yun-Seong Jeong, Kyeongbo Kong, Suk-Ju Kang

entry.summary: HOIGS explicitly models human-object interaction deformation in Gaussian Splatting through cross-attention, using HexPlane for humans and Cubic Hermite Splines for objects.

entry.title: Incomplete Multi-View Multi-Label Classification via Shared Codebook and Fused-Teacher Self-Distillation

author.name: Xu Yan, Jun Yin, Shiliang Sun, Minghua Wan

entry.summary: Addresses incomplete multi-view multi-label classification where both views and labels are missing, using a shared codebook for consistent representation learning and fused-teacher self-distillation.

entry.title: Conversational Control with Ontologies for Large Language Models: A Lightweight Framework for Constrained Generation

author.name: Barbara Gendron, Ga\"el Guibon, Mathieu d'Aquin

entry.summary: Proposes using ontological definitions to control LLM conversational outputs, modeling key aspects as constraints and fine-tuning for compliance, demonstrated on English proficiency level and polarity control.

entry.title: Metaphors We Compute By: A Computational Audit of Cultural Translation vs. Thinking in LLMs

author.name: Yuan Chang, Jiaming Qu, Zhu Li

entry.summary: Audits whether LLMs do genuine culture-aware reasoning or merely translate a dominant conceptual framework into localized expressions. Using metaphor generation across five cultural settings, finds models exhibit stereotyped metaphorical reasoning rather than true cultural diversity.

entry.title: InfBaGel: Human-Object-Scene Interaction Generation with Dynamic Perception and Iterative Refinement

author.name: Yude Zou, Junji Gong, Xing Gao, Zixuan Li, Tianxing Chen, Guanjie Zheng

entry.summary: Proposes InfBaGel, a framework for generating human-object-scene interactions using a coarse-to-fine approach aligned with consistency model denoising, featuring dynamic perception for scene context updates.

entry.title: Adaptive Threshold-Driven Continuous Greedy Method for Scalable Submodular Optimization

author.name: Mohammadreza Rostami, Solmaz S. Kia

entry.summary: Proposes ATCG, an adaptive thresholded continuous greedy algorithm for submodular maximization under matroid constraints that gates gradient evaluations behind per-partition progress thresholds for scalability.

entry.title: Neural Operators for Multi-Task Control and Adaptation

author.name: David Sewell, Xingjian Li, Stepan Tretiakov, Krishna Kumar, David Fridovich-Keil

entry.summary: Applies neural operator methods to multi-task control problems, approximating solution operators that map task descriptions to optimal control laws using permutation-invariant architectures.

entry.title: Multirate Stein Variational Gradient Descent for Efficient Bayesian Sampling

author.name: Arash Sarshar

entry.summary: Derives multirate SVGD that updates attraction and repulsion components on different timescales, including symmetric split and adaptive variants for Bayesian inference.

entry.title: Restless Bandits with Individual Penalty Constraints: A New Near-Optimal Index Policy and How to Learn It

author.name: Nida Zamir, I-Hong Hou

entry.summary: Proposes a Penalty-Optimal Whittle index policy for restless multi-armed bandits with individual penalty constraints, enabling per-user performance requirements in wireless resource allocation.

entry.title: Dynamic Free-Rider Detection in Federated Learning via Simulated Attack Patterns

author.name: Motoki Nakamura

entry.summary: Proposes a method to detect dynamic free-riders in federated learning who initially behave honestly then switch to free-riding, by simulating attack patterns and extending weight evolving frequency-based detection.

entry.title: Empowering Power Outage Prediction with Spatially Aware Hybrid Graph Neural Networks and Contrastive Learning

author.name: Xuyang Shen, Zijie Pan, Diego Cerrai, Xinxuan Zhang, Christopher Colorio, Emmanouil N. Anagnostou, Dongjin Song

entry.summary: Develops a spatially-aware hybrid graph neural network with contrastive learning for power outage prediction during extreme weather events, incorporating spatial effects that existing models in the UConn/Eversource system lack.

entry.title: New insights into Elo algorithm for practitioners and statisticians

author.name: Leszek Szczecinski

entry.summary: Reconciles practitioner and statistician views of Elo ranking, showing they coincide for binary outcomes with logistic expected score. Provides corrections for estimation noise and extends to multilevel outcomes.

entry.title: Explainability-Guided Adversarial Attacks on Transformer-Based Malware Detectors Using Control Flow Graphs

author.name: Andrew Wheeler, Kshitiz Aryal, Maanak Gupta

entry.summary: Examines adversarial evasion attacks on a RoBERTa-based malware detector that operates on linearized control flow graphs, using explainability methods to guide attacks on the graph-to-sequence representation.

entry.title: Efficient Onboard Spacecraft Pose Estimation with Event Cameras and Neuromorphic Hardware

author.name: Arunkumar Rathinam, Jules Lecomte, Jost Reelsen, Gregor Lenz, Axel von Arnim, Djamila Aouada

entry.summary: Presents a spacecraft 6-DoF pose estimation pipeline coupling event cameras with the BrainChip Akida neuromorphic processor, using compact MobileNet-style networks on event-frame representations.

entry.title: Relay-Assisted Activation-Integrated SIM for Wireless Physical Neural Networks

author.name: Meng Hua, Deniz G\"und\"uz

entry.summary: Proposes a relay-assisted wireless physical neural network architecture with activation-integrated stacked intelligent metasurfaces that realize nonlinear processing in the analog domain, overcoming the linearity limitation of passive metasurfaces.

entry.title: High-Stakes Personalization: Rethinking LLM Customization for Individual Investor Decision-Making

author.name: Yash Ganpat Sawant

entry.summary: Identifies four fundamental axes where individual investor decision-making exposes limitations of LLM personalization: behavioral memory complexity, thesis consistency under drift, feedback ambiguity, and regulatory constraints. Draws from a deployed AI portfolio management system.

entry.title: Explainable Autonomous Cyber Defense using Adversarial Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning

author.name: Yiyao Zhang, Diksha Goel, Hussain Ahmad

entry.summary: Presents the Causal Multi-Agent Decision Framework (C-MADF) for autonomous cyber defense, using adversarial multi-agent RL with structural causal constraints to handle APT attacks exploiting 'Living off the Land' techniques.

entry.title: ZeD-MAP: Bundle Adjustment Guided Zero-Shot Depth Maps for Real-Time Aerial Imaging

author.name: Selim Ahmet Iz, Francesco Nex, Norman Kerle, Henry Meissner, Ralf Berger

entry.summary: Presents ZeD-MAP, a framework combining zero-shot diffusion depth models with bundle adjustment for real-time metric depth reconstruction from high-resolution UAV imagery, targeting disaster response scenarios.

entry.title: POEMetric: The Last Stanza of Humanity

author.name: Bingru Li, Han Wang, Hazel Wilkinson

entry.summary: Introduces POEMetric, the first comprehensive framework for evaluating LLM poetry generation across instruction-following, creativity/diversity/emotional resonance, and overall quality, testing 30 LLMs against 203 human-written poems.

entry.title: MisEdu-RAG: A Misconception-Aware Dual-Hypergraph RAG for Novice Math Teachers

author.name: Zhihan Guo, Rundong Xue, Yuting Lu, Jionghao Lin

entry.summary: Introduces MisEdu-RAG, a dual-hypergraph RAG framework that helps novice math teachers diagnose student misconceptions by organizing pedagogical knowledge and student mistake cases into separate hypergraphs. Performs two-stage retrieval to generate actionable instructional feedback. Combines educational domain expertise with RAG architecture innovation.

entry.title: Physics-Informed Untrained Learning for RGB-Guided Superresolution Single-Pixel Hyperspectral Imaging

author.name: Hao Zhang, Bilige Xu, Lichen Wei, Xu Ma, Wenyi Ren

entry.summary: Proposes a physics-informed untrained learning framework for hyperspectral imaging that uses RGB guidance for joint reconstruction and super-resolution without external training data. Combines regularized least-squares with RGB-derived priors in an end-to-end physics-informed framework. Addresses the impracticality of large pretraining datasets for hyperspectral imaging.

entry.title: Imagine Before Concentration: Diffusion-Guided Registers Enhance Partially Relevant Video Retrieval

author.name: Jun Li, Xuhang Lou, Jinpeng Wang, Yuting Wang, Yaowei Wang, Shu-Tao Xia, Bin Chen

entry.summary: Proposes DreamPRVR for partially relevant video retrieval using diffusion-guided registers for coarse-to-fine representation learning. Generates global contextual semantic registers as highlights then performs fine-grained cross-modal matching. Novel application of diffusion models to video retrieval.

entry.title: CGHair: Compact Gaussian Hair Reconstruction with Card Clustering

author.name: Haimin Luo, Srinjay Sarkar, Albert Mosella-Montoro, Francisco Vicente Carrasco, Fernando De la Torre

entry.summary: Presents CGHair, a compact pipeline for hair reconstruction from multi-view images using Gaussian Splatting with card clustering. Reduces storage and rendering costs by clustering strands into representative hair cards with shared texture codebooks. Includes a generative prior for initial strand geometry.

entry.title: BoxComm: Benchmarking Category-Aware Commentary Generation and Narration Rhythm in Boxing

author.name: Kaiwen Wang, Kaili Zheng, Rongrong Deng, Yiming Shi, Chenyi Guo, Ji Wu

entry.summary: BoxComm presents the first large-scale benchmark for boxing commentary generation with 445 match videos and 52K+ commentary sentences, addressing the unique challenges of combat sports commentary including rapid critical actions and tactical analysis.

entry.title: Group-DINOmics: Incorporating People Dynamics into DINO for Self-supervised Group Activity Feature Learning

author.name: Ryuki Tezuka, Chihiro Nakatani, Norimichi Ukita

entry.summary: Group-DINOmics proposes self-supervised group activity feature learning without annotations, using dynamics-aware pretext tasks (person flow estimation, group-relevant object location) built on DINO features.

entry.title: ClickAIXR: On-Device Multimodal Vision-Language Interaction with Real-World Objects in Extended Reality

author.name: Dawar Khan, Alexandre Kouyoumdjian, Xinyu Liu, Omar Mena, Dominik Engel, Ivan Viola

entry.summary: ClickAIXR is an on-device framework for multimodal vision-language interaction in extended reality, enabling precise object selection via controller with local VLM inference for privacy-preserving Q&A.

entry.title: DRIFT: Deep Restoration, ISP Fusion, and Tone-mapping

author.name: Soumendu Majee, Joshua Peter Ebenezer, Abhinau K. Venkataramanan, Weidi Liu, Thilo Balke, Zeeshan Nadir, Sreenithy Chandran, Seok-Jun Lee, Hamid Rahim Sheikh

entry.summary: DRIFT is an AI mobile camera pipeline that processes raw captures through multi-frame processing (alignment, denoising, demosaicing, super-resolution) followed by ISP fusion and tone-mapping.

entry.title: G-EDF-Loc: 3D Continuous Gaussian Distance Field for Robust Gradient-Based 6DoF Localization

author.name: Jos\'e E. Maese, Luc\'ia Coto-Elena, Luis Merino, Fernando Caballero

entry.summary: G-EDF-Loc presents a 6-DoF localization framework using a continuous Gaussian-based Euclidean Distance Field with C1 continuity, enabling CPU-based real-time scan-to-map registration.

entry.title: Dynamic Whole-Body Dancing with Humanoid Robots -- A Model-Based Control Approach

author.name: Shibowen Zhang, Jiayang Wu, Guannan Liu, Helin Zhu, Junjie Liu, Zhehan Li, Junhong Guo, Xiaokun Leng, Hangxin Liu, Jingwen Zhang, Jikai Wang, Zonghai Chen, Zhicheng He, Jiayi Wang, Yao Su

entry.summary: Presents an integrated model-based framework for humanoid robot dancing, combining offline motion retargeting from human MoCap data with online MPC-based execution. Demonstrated on a real humanoid robot performing dynamic whole-body dance motions.

entry.title: Primitive-based Truncated Diffusion for Efficient Trajectory Generation of Differential Drive Mobile Manipulators

author.name: Long Xu, Choilam Wong, Yuhang Zhong, Junxiao Lin, Jialiang Hou, Fei Gao

entry.summary: Presents a learning-enhanced motion planner for differential drive mobile manipulators using primitive-based truncated diffusion models. Uses keypoint-based task encoding and attention-based fusion of point clouds and boundary states.

entry.title: Risk-Constrained Belief-Space Optimization for Safe Control under Latent Uncertainty

author.name: Clinton Enwerem, John S. Baras, Calin Belta

entry.summary: Proposes risk-sensitive belief-space MPC for safety-critical control under latent uncertainty that sensors cannot resolve. Optimizes over belief distributions of latent parameters while providing risk constraints against rare but severe outcomes.

entry.title: Defense-favoured coordination design sketches

author.name: owencb

entry.summary: Sketches six near-term AI-enabled coordination technologies that could favor defense: fast facilitation, automated negotiation, structured disclosure, monitoring systems, and accountability mechanisms. Argues AI could enable new forms of cooperative governance.

entry.title: Minimising Willmore Energy via Neural Flow

author.name: Edward Hirst, Henrique N. S\'a Earp, Tom\'as S. R. Silva

entry.summary: Introduces neural Willmore flow using PINN-style loss to minimize Willmore energy (squared L2-norm of mean curvature) on 2-surfaces. Successfully reproduces known minimizers for genus 0 and 1, and provides novel approaches for the open genus 2 problem.

entry.title: NAIMA: Semantics Aware RGB Guided Depth Super-Resolution

author.name: Tayyab Nasir, Daochang Liu, Ajmal Mian

entry.summary: Proposes NAIMA for guided depth super-resolution, introducing global contextual semantic priors from pretrained vision transformer embeddings and a Guided Token Attention module to reduce artifacts from misleading RGB color/texture cues.

entry.title: Adversarial Robustness Analysis of Cloud-Assisted Autonomous Driving Systems

author.name: Maher Al Islam, Amr S. El-Wakeel

entry.summary: Presents a hardware-in-the-loop IoV testbed evaluating adversarial vulnerabilities in cloud-assisted autonomous driving, testing YOLOv8 under adversarial patches combined with network impairments like latency and packet loss.

entry.title: MERIT: Multilingual Expert-Reward Informed Tuning for Chinese-Centric Low-Resource Machine Translation

author.name: Zhixiang Lu, Chong Zhang, Chenyu Xue, Angelos Stefanidis, Chong Li, Jionglong Su, Zhengyong Jiang

entry.summary: Introduces MERIT, a unified translation framework transforming the English-centric ALT benchmark into Chinese-centric directions for low-resource Southeast Asian languages (Lao, Burmese, Tagalog), using expert-reward informed tuning.

entry.title: Structural Rigidity and the 57-Token Predictive Window: A Physical Framework for Inference-Layer Governability in Large Language Models

author.name: Gregory M. Ruddell

entry.summary: Proposes an energy-based governance framework connecting transformer inference dynamics to constraint-satisfaction models, identifying a 57-token 'pre-commitment window' in Phi-3-mini under specific conditions. Results are highly model/task/config specific.

entry.title: Beyond Retrieval: Modeling Confidence Decay and Deterministic Agentic Platforms in Generative Engine Optimization

author.name: XinYu Zhao, ChengYou Li, XiangBao Meng, Kai Zhang, XiaoDong Liu

entry.summary: Proposes a paradigm shift in Generative Engine Optimization from RAG-based approaches to deterministic multi-agent intent routing, introducing Semantic Entropy Drift to model confidence decay in LLMs.

entry.title: Affording Process Auditability with QualAnalyzer: An Atomistic LLM Analysis Tool for Qualitative Research

author.name: Max Hao Lu, Ryan Ellegood, Rony Rodriguez-Ramirez, Sophia Blumert

entry.summary: Presents QualAnalyzer, a Chrome extension for Google Workspace that supports atomistic LLM-assisted qualitative analysis by processing each data segment independently and preserving full audit trails.

entry.title: CODE-GEN: A Human-in-the-Loop RAG-Based Agentic AI System for Multiple-Choice Question Generation

author.name: Xiaojing Duan, Frederick Nwanganga, Chaoli Wang

entry.summary: Presents CODE-GEN, a RAG-based agentic system for generating multiple-choice coding questions with a Generator and Validator agent. Evaluated by six human experts on 288 questions.

entry.title: A Model of Understanding in Deep Learning Systems

author.name: David Peter Wallis Freeborn
